## Copilot

```yaml name=schemas/sair.yaml
# =============================================================================
# sair.yaml
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Structured Anchored Intermediate Representation (SAIR).
#
# SAIR is the single, schema-validated, fixity-anchored output of Phase 2
# (PARSE) of the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha pipeline. It is produced by the family
# of parse skills (`parse-prepare-pdf`, `parse-detect-layout`,
# `parse-extract-text`, `parse-acc-aha-recbox`, `parse-extract-figures`,
# `parse-ocr-fallback`, `parse-reconcile-queue`) and consumed by every Phase
# 3 (EXTRACT) skill, principally `extract-recommendation-cor-loe`.
#
# SAIR does NOT decide what is a "recommendation". It deterministically
# reconstructs the document's logical structure: pages, columns, reading
# order, text regions, tables (with cell-level consensus), figures
# (with caption pairing, type classification, and where applicable, parsed
# logic graphs and chart data), footnotes, and chrome (headers/footers).
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage, verbatim over
# paraphrase. Every region is anchored to (pdf_sha256, page, bbox). Every
# text byte is anchored to glyph-level char_spans. Every reversible Unicode
# transform is recorded. Every multi-engine consensus state is preserved
# (consensus / quorum / disputed). Every flagged item is queued, never
# silently resolved.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D2, D3, D4, D9, D10, D11, D12, D13, D15
#   - Parse + Extraction Phase Spec §2 (full), §3 (full), §3.7 (root shape)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by $ref):
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml (downstream consumer)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/sair.yaml"
title: "StructuredAnchoredIntermediateRepresentation"
description: >
  Phase-2 (PARSE) output document. Single source of truth for page layout,
  reading order, text content, table structure, figure content, footnotes,
  and chrome of the conditioned 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline working set.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Every enum below is a closed set. Validators MUST reject unknown values;
# downstream skills MUST refuse to operate on documents carrying unknown
# values. Auto-correction is forbidden. Extending an enum requires schema
# semver bump and panel-chair signoff (see §6 change_control).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.1 Region classes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RegionClass:
    type: string
    enum:
      - title
      - heading
      - text
      - list
      - table
      - figure
      - caption
      - header             # page-top chrome
      - footer             # page-bottom chrome
      - page-number
      - running-title
      - footnote
      - equation
      - chrome             # generic non-body repeating content
    description: >
      Classes assigned by the dual-detector layout consensus in Phase 2.1.
      `chrome`, `header`, `footer`, `page-number`, and `running-title` are
      excluded from body reading order but are persisted (anchored) for audit.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.2 Reading-order continuity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ColumnModel:
    type: string
    enum: ["1col", "2col", "3col", "mixed", "unknown"]

  ReadingOrderMethod:
    type: string
    enum: [tagged-pdf-structtree, xy-cut, layoutreader, vlm-reading-order]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.3 Text-engine and consensus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TextEngine:
    type: string
    enum: [pymupdf-glyph, pdfminer-six, marker, nougat, surya-text]

  TextConsensusState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - text-consensus       # all configured engines agree at the sentence level (>= 0.98 sim)
      - text-quorum          # advisory; not allowed in clinical-content channels
      - text-disputed        # below threshold; queued for §3.6 reconciliation
      - text-resolved        # was disputed, resolved via queue with two-person rule

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.4 Table-engine and consensus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TableEngine:
    type: string
    enum:
      - camelot-lattice
      - camelot-stream
      - tabula-lattice
      - tabula-stream
      - pdfplumber
      - vlm-tablemaster
      - donut-table

  TableSchemaDetected:
    type: string
    enum:
      - acc-aha-recommendation-box
      - acc-aha-recommendation-box-candidate   # partial-match; does NOT advance recommendation rows
      - drug-table
      - lab-table
      - evidence-table
      - other
      - unknown
    description: >
      `acc-aha-recommendation-box-candidate` is reserved for tables that match
      some heuristics but not all. Recommendation rows are NEVER emitted from
      candidates; they are escalated as `schema-partial-match`.

  CellConsensusState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cell-consensus    # >= 4 of 5 engines agree after normalization
      - cell-quorum       # exactly 3 of 5 agree; advisory; forbidden in recommendation rows
      - cell-disputed     # < 3 of 5 agree; queued; row is held
      - cell-resolved     # was disputed, resolved via queue with two-person rule

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.5 Figure typing and parsers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FigureType:
    type: string
    enum:
      - flowchart
      - algorithm-diagram
      - bar-chart
      - line-chart
      - scatter-chart
      - forest-plot
      - nomogram
      - anatomical
      - photograph
      - schematic
      - composite
      - other
      - unknown

  FigureParser:
    type: string
    enum:
      - opencv-shapes
      - vlm-pix2struct
      - vlm-donut
      - vlm-florence-2
      - chart-deplot
      - chart-matcha
      - chart-qa-tuned
      - none

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.6 OCR engines and consensus
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OcrEngine:
    type: string
    enum: [tesseract, paddleocr, surya, easyocr]

  OcrConfidenceState:
    type: string
    enum: [ocr-high-confidence, ocr-quorum, ocr-low-confidence]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.7 Reversible Unicode normalization kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NormalizationKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - unicode-nfc
      - soft-hyphen-removed
      - ligature-decomposed
      - non-breaking-space-normalized
      - smart-quote-normalized
      - hyphen-line-break-rejoined
      - en-dash-range-preserved
      - em-dash-preserved
      - cid-glyph-mapped
      - cid-glyph-orphan          # no ToUnicode mapping; OCR fallback required

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1.8 Flagged-item categories (queue handoff)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlaggedKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - disputed-layout
      - text-disputed
      - cell-disputed
      - engine-quorum-failure
      - header-alignment-failure
      - enum-violation                 # COR / LOE outside closed enum in a recommendation box
      - schema-partial-match
      - footnote-orphan
      - hyphen-uncertain
      - unit-mismatch
      - caption-orphan
      - flowchart-disputed
      - chart-discrepancy
      - ocr-low-confidence
      - cid-glyph-orphan
      - supportive-multi-bind
      - header-unmapped
      - page-split-table

  FlaggedSeverity:
    type: string
    enum: [info, warning, blocking]
    description: >
      `blocking` flags prevent the affected region from advancing to Phase 3.
      Any flag touching a recommendation row, COR, LOE, threshold, drug, or
      population scope is `blocking` regardless of category.

  ResolutionState:
    type: string
    enum: [open, in-review, resolved-accept, resolved-edit, resolved-escalate]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 BBox — bounding box (PDF user-space units)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BBox:
    type: array
    minItems: 4
    maxItems: 4
    items: { type: number }
    description: "[x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF user-space units (origin lower-left per PDF convention)."

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 PageSize
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PageSize:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [w, h]
    properties:
      w: { type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0 }
      h: { type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0 }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 ColumnPolygon
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ColumnPolygon:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [column_index, bbox]
    properties:
      column_index: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      bbox: { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 NormalizationLog
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NormalizationLog:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [nfc_applied, transforms]
    properties:
      nfc_applied: { type: boolean }
      transforms:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [kind, position, original, replacement]
          properties:
            kind:        { $ref: "#/$defs/NormalizationKind" }
            position:    { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
            original:    { type: string }
            replacement: { type: string }
            note:        { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 CharSpan — links a text segment to its on-page geometry
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CharSpan:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [start, end, page, bbox]
    properties:
      start: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      end:   { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      page:  { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      bbox:  { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
      font:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: PostScript font name as embedded; null if undetectable.
      size:        { type: [number, "null"], exclusiveMinimum: 0 }
      is_superscript: { type: boolean, default: false }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 EngineParse (per text engine)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EngineParseText:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [engine, pin, text_nfc, similarity_to_consensus]
    properties:
      engine:                 { $ref: "#/$defs/TextEngine" }
      pin:                    { type: string }
      text_nfc:               { type: string }
      similarity_to_consensus:
        type: number
        minimum: 0.0
        maximum: 1.0

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 TextRegion content
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TextRegionContent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [raw_utf8_nfc, char_spans, normalization_log, consensus]
    properties:
      raw_utf8_nfc:
        type: string
        description: Canonical region text (NFC). The reversible normalization log restores the original glyph stream.
      char_spans:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/CharSpan" }
      footnote_refs:
        type: array
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^fn-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$" }
        description: Resolved footnote IDs; superscripts that cannot be resolved go to flagged_items as `footnote-orphan`.
      normalization_log: { $ref: "#/$defs/NormalizationLog" }
      consensus:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [state, engines]
        properties:
          state:    { $ref: "#/$defs/TextConsensusState" }
          engines:
            type: array
            minItems: 2
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/EngineParseText" }
          pairwise_min_similarity:
            type: number
            minimum: 0.0
            maximum: 1.0
            description: Lowest pairwise similarity across the configured engines.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 TableCell
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TableCell:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [row, col, bbox, value_consensus, consensus_state]
    properties:
      row: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      col: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      bbox: { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
      value_consensus:
        type: string
        description: Canonical, NFC-normalized, whitespace-collapsed cell value.
      value_variants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [engine, value, bbox]
          properties:
            engine: { $ref: "#/$defs/TableEngine" }
            value:  { type: string }
            bbox:   { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
            confidence:
              type: [number, "null"]
              minimum: 0.0
              maximum: 1.0
      consensus_state: { $ref: "#/$defs/CellConsensusState" }
      cell_span:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [row_start, row_end, col_start, col_end]
        properties:
          row_start: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
          row_end:   { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
          col_start: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
          col_end:   { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
        description: Merged-cell geometry; preserved verbatim, never flattened.
      footnote_refs:
        type: array
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^fn-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 TableRegion content
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TableRegionContent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [headers, rows, schema_detected, engines_used]
    properties:
      headers:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [col, bbox, value_consensus, consensus_state]
          properties:
            col:             { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
            bbox:            { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
            value_consensus: { type: string }
            consensus_state: { $ref: "#/$defs/CellConsensusState" }
      rows:
        type: array
        items:
          type: array
          items: { $ref: "#/$defs/TableCell" }
        description: rows[i][j] is the cell at row i, column j (after consensus).
      schema_detected: { $ref: "#/$defs/TableSchemaDetected" }
      engines_used:
        type: array
        minItems: 4
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/TableEngine" }
        description: At least four engines required by `parse-acc-aha-recbox` G2.3-F.
      recommendation_box_rows:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RecommendationBoxRow" }
        description: >
          Present only when schema_detected == "acc-aha-recommendation-box".
          One entry per body row of the recommendation box, with COR/LOE/text
          captured verbatim and validated against closed enums. These entries
          are the direct input to `extract-recommendation-cor-loe`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 RecommendationBoxRow — the parse-time row record
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RecommendationBoxRow:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - region_id
      - row_index
      - cor
      - loe
      - text_verbatim
      - cell_bboxes
      - char_spans
      - section_path
      - consensus_state
      - parent_table_region_id
      - normalization_log
    properties:
      region_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^row-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Deterministic; derived from (pdf_sha256, page, row_bbox).
      row_index: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      cor:
        # Validated against acc-aha-grading.yaml at write-time. The schema lists
        # the enum here for self-containment; the canonical source is
        # schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml.
        type: string
        enum: ["I", "IIa", "IIb", "III: No Benefit", "III: Harm"]
      loe:
        type: string
        enum: ["A", "B-R", "B-NR", "C-LD", "C-EO"]
      text_verbatim:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: NFC-normalized recommendation cell content; reversible transforms in normalization_log.
      cell_bboxes:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [cor, loe, recommendation]
        properties:
          cor:            { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
          loe:            { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
          recommendation: { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
      char_spans:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/CharSpan" }
      footnote_refs:
        type: array
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^fn-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$" }
      section_path:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      supportive_text_region_ids:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }
        description: SAIR text-region IDs for the bound supportive-text block(s); never merged into text_verbatim.
      consensus_state:
        type: string
        enum: [cell-consensus]
        description: The recommendation-box channel admits only `cell-consensus` rows; anything else is held in flagged_items.
      parent_table_region_id: { type: string }
      normalization_log: { $ref: "#/$defs/NormalizationLog" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 FigureCaption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FigureCaption:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [caption_id, region_id, number, text_nfc, bbox]
    properties:
      caption_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cap-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"
      region_id: { type: string }
      number:    { type: string, description: "Figure number string as printed (e.g., '3', '3a')." }
      text_nfc:  { type: string }
      bbox:      { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 FigureGraph (logic-bearing diagrams: flowcharts, algorithms)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FigureGraph:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [nodes, edges, parsers]
    properties:
      nodes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [id, shape, text_nfc, bbox]
          properties:
            id:       { type: string }
            shape:    { type: string, enum: [rectangle, diamond, parallelogram, oval, circle, hexagon, other] }
            text_nfc: { type: string }
            bbox:     { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
      edges:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [source, target]
          properties:
            source:    { type: string }
            target:    { type: string }
            label_nfc: { type: [string, "null"] }
            agreement: { type: number, minimum: 0.0, maximum: 1.0, description: "Agreement across independent parsers." }
      parsers:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/FigureParser" }
      awaiting_corroboration:
        type: boolean
        default: true
        description: >
          Logic-bearing figures NEVER feed CQL or CDS Hooks on their own. This
          flag stays true until a body-text or recommendation-box anchor for
          the same logic is found in Phase 3. See Parse Spec §2.4.4 hard rule.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.13 FigureChartData (numeric figures: bar/line/scatter/forest)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FigureChartData:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [axes, series, parsers]
    properties:
      axes:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [x, y]
        properties:
          x:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [label_nfc, scale]
            properties:
              label_nfc: { type: string }
              scale:     { type: string, enum: [linear, log, categorical, time] }
              units:
                type: [string, "null"]
                description: UCUM canonical form when applicable.
          y:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [label_nfc, scale]
            properties:
              label_nfc: { type: string }
              scale:     { type: string, enum: [linear, log, categorical, time] }
              units:     { type: [string, "null"] }
      series:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [name, points]
          properties:
            name: { type: string }
            points:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
                additionalProperties: false
                required: [x, y]
                properties:
                  x: { type: [number, string] }
                  y: { type: [number, "null"] }
                  ci_low:  { type: [number, "null"] }
                  ci_high: { type: [number, "null"] }
      parsers:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/FigureParser" }
      cross_check:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [matches_table_or_text]
        properties:
          matches_table_or_text:
            type: boolean
            description: True iff chart numerics agree with a table or text in the same section. False → `chart-discrepancy`.
          discrepancy_note: { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.14 FigureRegion content
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FigureRegionContent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [file, type, dpi]
    properties:
      file:
        type: string
        description: Relative path to the rasterized figure (e.g., 'figures/12-2.png').
      file_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      type:        { $ref: "#/$defs/FigureType" }
      dpi:         { type: integer, enum: [300, 600] }
      caption_id:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      graph:       { $ref: "#/$defs/FigureGraph" }
      chart_data:  { $ref: "#/$defs/FigureChartData" }
      ocr_overlay:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [confidence_min, engines]
        properties:
          confidence_min: { type: number, minimum: 0.0, maximum: 1.0 }
          engines:
            type: array
            minItems: 2
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/OcrEngine" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.15 FootnoteRegion content
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FootnoteRegionContent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [footnote_id, marker, text_nfc]
    properties:
      footnote_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^fn-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"
        description: "Format: fn-<page>-<seq>."
      marker:    { type: string, description: "Superscript marker as printed (e.g., '1', '*', 'a')." }
      text_nfc:  { type: string }
      reference_resolution:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          ref_id: { type: string }
          doi:    { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
          pmid:   { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9]+$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.16 ChromeRegion content (headers, footers, page numbers, running titles)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChromeRegionContent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [text_nfc, kind]
    properties:
      text_nfc: { type: string }
      kind:
        type: string
        enum: [header, footer, page-number, running-title, watermark, other]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.17 Region — discriminated union by class
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Region:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - region_id
      - class
      - bbox
      - reading_order_index
      - provenance
    properties:
      region_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^r-[0-9]+-[0-9]{3,}$"
        description: "Format: r-<page>-<zero-padded-index>."
      class:               { $ref: "#/$defs/RegionClass" }
      bbox:                { $ref: "#/$defs/BBox" }
      reading_order_index: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      column_index:        { type: [integer, "null"], minimum: 0 }
      content:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/TextRegionContent"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/TableRegionContent"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FigureRegionContent"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FootnoteRegionContent"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/ChromeRegionContent"
        description: >
          The content shape MUST match the region class:
            class=text|list|title|heading|equation        → TextRegionContent
            class=table                                    → TableRegionContent
            class=figure                                   → FigureRegionContent
            class=footnote                                 → FootnoteRegionContent
            class=header|footer|page-number|running-title|chrome → ChromeRegionContent
            class=caption                                  → TextRegionContent (with caption_pairing)
          Validators MUST enforce the matrix.
      caption_pairing:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [caption_id, target_figure_region_id]
        properties:
          caption_id:              { type: string }
          target_figure_region_id: { type: string }
      provenance:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [layout_consensus, extractor_consensus]
        properties:
          layout_consensus:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [state, detectors]
            properties:
              state: { type: string, enum: [agree, resolved, disputed] }
              detectors:
                type: array
                minItems: 2
                items:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: false
                  required: [name, pin, iou]
                  properties:
                    name: { type: string }
                    pin:  { type: string }
                    iou:  { type: number, minimum: 0.0, maximum: 1.0 }
          extractor_consensus:
            type: string
            enum:
              - text-consensus
              - cell-consensus
              - figure-parsed
              - footnote-attached
              - chrome-detected
              - escalated-and-resolved
              - escalated-pending

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.18 Page
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Page:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [page_number, size, column_model, regions]
    properties:
      page_number:  { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      size:         { $ref: "#/$defs/PageSize" }
      column_model: { $ref: "#/$defs/ColumnModel" }
      column_polygons:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ColumnPolygon" }
      reading_order:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [primary_method, region_ids_in_order]
        properties:
          primary_method:        { $ref: "#/$defs/ReadingOrderMethod" }
          region_ids_in_order:
            type: array
            items: { type: string }
          alternative_methods:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [method, transitions_disagreement_pct]
              properties:
                method:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/ReadingOrderMethod" }
                transitions_disagreement_pct: { type: number, minimum: 0.0, maximum: 100.0 }
      regions:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Region" }
      raster:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [path_300dpi, sha256_300dpi]
        properties:
          path_300dpi:    { type: string }
          sha256_300dpi:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
          path_600dpi:    { type: [string, "null"] }
          sha256_600dpi:  { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      tagged_pdf_structtree_present: { type: boolean, default: false }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.19 FlaggedItem (queue handoff)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlaggedItem:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [item_id, kind, severity, region_id, opened_at, resolution_state]
    properties:
      item_id:         { type: string, pattern: "^flag-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/FlaggedKind" }
      severity:        { $ref: "#/$defs/FlaggedSeverity" }
      region_id:       { type: string }
      page:            { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      opened_at:       { type: string, format: date-time }
      reason:          { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      decision_required:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      crop_path_600dpi: { type: string }
      candidate_parses:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [engine, value]
          properties:
            engine:     { type: string }
            value:      { type: string }
            confidence: { type: [number, "null"], minimum: 0.0, maximum: 1.0 }
      resolution_state: { $ref: "#/$defs/ResolutionState" }
      resolution:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [resolved_at, decision, reviewer_ids, prov_activity_id]
        properties:
          resolved_at:      { type: string, format: date-time }
          decision:         { type: string }
          rationale:        { type: string }
          reviewer_ids:
            type: array
            minItems: 2
            maxItems: 4
            items: { type: string }
            description: Two-person rule for any clinical-content resolution.
          before_value:     { type: [string, "null"] }
          after_value:      { type: [string, "null"] }
          prov_activity_id: { type: string }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.20 ToolsLock
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ToolsLock:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [lock_sha, items]
    properties:
      lock_sha: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      items:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [name, pin]
          properties:
            name: { type: string }
            pin:  { type: string }
            kind:
              type: string
              enum: [pdf-parser, table-engine, layout-detector, vlm, ocr, llm, fhir-validator, ig-builder, terminology-server, other]
            deterministic:
              type: boolean
              description: If false, this tool cannot be the SOLE basis for any consensus state.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.21 RunRecord (per-skill invocation log)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RunRecord:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [skill, started_at, ended_at, parameters, counts, gates]
    properties:
      skill:
        type: string
        enum:
          - parse-prepare-pdf
          - parse-detect-layout
          - parse-extract-text
          - parse-acc-aha-recbox
          - parse-extract-figures
          - parse-ocr-fallback
          - parse-reconcile-queue
      started_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      ended_at:   { type: string, format: date-time }
      parameters:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: true
      counts:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: true
        description: Free-form counts (regions emitted, cells reconciled, queue entries opened, etc.).
      gates:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [gate_id, status]
          properties:
            gate_id: { type: string }
            status:  { type: string, enum: [PASS, FAIL] }
            note:    { type: [string, "null"] }
      operator_id: { type: string }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ROOT TYPE — SAIR document
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - document_id
  - source
  - tools_lock
  - pages
  - footnotes_index
  - flagged_items
  - run
  - fixity
  - guideline_manifest_ref
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance for this run.

  document_id:
    type: string
    format: uuid

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 Source identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  source:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [pdf_sha256, pdf_path, doi, publisher, publication_date, document_role]
    properties:
      pdf_sha256:        { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      pdf_path:          { type: string }
      doi:               { type: string, pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
      url:               { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }
      publisher:         { type: string }
      publication_date:  { type: string, format: date }
      document_role:
        type: string
        enum: [main-guideline, executive-summary, supplement, predecessor-2017]
      page_count:        { type: integer, minimum: 1 }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Tools lock (version pinning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tools_lock: { $ref: "#/$defs/ToolsLock" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 Pages
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  pages:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Page" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Footnotes index (cross-page resolved)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  footnotes_index:
    type: object
    additionalProperties:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [footnote_id, region_id, page]
      properties:
        footnote_id: { type: string, pattern: "^fn-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$" }
        region_id:   { type: string }
        page:        { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
        text_nfc:    { type: string }
    description: >
      Map keyed by footnote_id for O(1) resolution from any superscript.
      Orphaned superscripts go to flagged_items as `footnote-orphan`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 Flagged items (queue)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  flagged_items:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/FlaggedItem" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Run records (one per skill invocation that touched this SAIR)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  run:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [run_id, started_at, steps]
    properties:
      run_id:     { type: string, format: uuid }
      started_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      ended_at:   { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      steps:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RunRecord" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 Fixity (self-fingerprint)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [sair_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      sair_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
        description: SAIR is canonicalized per RFC 8785 (JCS) before hashing.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# JSON Schema cannot express all of these directly; the framework's validator
# (`aiwg-cpg-htn validate sair`) implements them. Each invariant is a
# release-blocker if violated.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: SAIR-INV-01
    description: >
      Every region_id referenced anywhere in the document (caption_pairing,
      flagged_items.region_id, footnotes_index.region_id, page.reading_order.region_ids_in_order,
      RecommendationBoxRow.parent_table_region_id, RecommendationBoxRow.supportive_text_region_ids)
      MUST exist in pages[].regions[].

  - id: SAIR-INV-02
    description: >
      Every Region.content shape MUST match Region.class per the matrix in §2.17.
      Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: SAIR-INV-03
    description: >
      For every TextRegionContent, every CharSpan.start/end pair MUST satisfy
      `0 <= start < end <= len(raw_utf8_nfc)`, and the union of CharSpan ranges
      MUST cover raw_utf8_nfc without gaps.

  - id: SAIR-INV-04
    description: >
      For every TableRegionContent with schema_detected == "acc-aha-recommendation-box",
      `engines_used` MUST contain at least four members from TableEngine, AND
      `recommendation_box_rows` MUST be non-empty, AND every row MUST have
      consensus_state == "cell-consensus".

  - id: SAIR-INV-05
    description: >
      Every RecommendationBoxRow.cor MUST be in the AccAhaCOR enum and every
      RecommendationBoxRow.loe MUST be in the AccAhaLOE enum, exact verbatim.
      Auto-correction is forbidden; deviations belong in flagged_items as
      `enum-violation`.

  - id: SAIR-INV-06
    description: >
      Every footnote_ref string in any region MUST resolve via footnotes_index.
      Unresolved references MUST appear in flagged_items as `footnote-orphan`.

  - id: SAIR-INV-07
    description: >
      For every Region.class == "caption", caption_pairing MUST be non-null and
      `target_figure_region_id` MUST point to a Region with class == "figure"
      OR the orphan MUST appear in flagged_items as `caption-orphan`.

  - id: SAIR-INV-08
    description: >
      For every FigureRegionContent with type ∈ {flowchart, algorithm-diagram},
      a FigureGraph MUST be present, parsers MUST contain at least two members,
      and `awaiting_corroboration` MUST be true at SAIR write time.
      Logic-bearing figures NEVER feed CQL or CDS Hooks on their own.

  - id: SAIR-INV-09
    description: >
      For every FigureRegionContent with type ∈ {bar-chart, line-chart, scatter-chart, forest-plot},
      FigureChartData MUST be present and `cross_check.matches_table_or_text` MUST
      be set. False values open `chart-discrepancy` in flagged_items.

  - id: SAIR-INV-10
    description: >
      For every region whose Region.provenance.extractor_consensus is anything
      other than `*-consensus`, `figure-parsed`, `footnote-attached`, or
      `chrome-detected`, a corresponding FlaggedItem MUST exist with the same
      region_id and a non-`resolved-*` resolution_state at SAIR write time, OR
      the consensus value MUST be `escalated-and-resolved` with a populated
      FlaggedItem.resolution.

  - id: SAIR-INV-11
    description: >
      Every FlaggedItem.severity == "blocking" item touching a recommendation
      row, COR, LOE, threshold, drug, or population scope MUST have
      resolution_state in {open, in-review} or a resolution with
      `reviewer_ids` of length >= 2 (two-person rule).

  - id: SAIR-INV-12
    description: >
      Reading-order region_ids_in_order MUST exclude all chrome-class regions
      (header, footer, page-number, running-title, chrome). Chrome regions are
      anchored for audit but never enter the body reading order.

  - id: SAIR-INV-13
    description: >
      ToolsLock.lock_sha MUST equal SHA-256 of the canonicalized items array.
      Any tool with `deterministic == false` MUST NOT be the sole engine in any
      consensus state.

  - id: SAIR-INV-14
    description: >
      `fixity.sair_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the canonicalized SAIR document
      with `fixity` field excluded, per RFC 8785. The hash MUST be deterministic
      across re-runs given identical inputs and tools_lock.

  - id: SAIR-INV-15
    description: >
      Every page.regions[].bbox MUST lie within [0, 0, page.size.w, page.size.h]
      with a tolerance of 1.0 user-space unit for floating-point rounding.

  - id: SAIR-INV-16
    description: >
      For every TableCell, value_variants MUST contain at least four entries
      whenever the parent TableRegionContent.schema_detected ==
      "acc-aha-recommendation-box". Cells with fewer variants cannot reach
      `cell-consensus` in a recommendation box.

  - id: SAIR-INV-17
    description: >
      For every RecommendationBoxRow, char_spans MUST cover text_verbatim
      contiguously (no gaps, no overlaps), and the union of CharSpan.bbox MUST
      lie within cell_bboxes.recommendation (with 1.0-unit tolerance).

  - id: SAIR-INV-18
    description: >
      Page.tagged_pdf_structtree_present == true implies that every body region
      on that page has a corresponding StructTree element id captured in
      Region.provenance.layout_consensus.detectors with name == "tagged-pdf-structtree".

  - id: SAIR-INV-19
    description: >
      No two regions on the same page may share a region_id. region_id MUST be
      deterministic from (pdf_sha256, page, bbox, class).

  - id: SAIR-INV-20
    description: >
      `source.document_role == "predecessor-2017"` SAIR documents MUST NOT be
      consumed by Phase-3 clinical extraction. Predecessor SAIRs are advisory
      inputs to `predecessor-map-2017` only.

# =============================================================================
# 5. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These examples are illustrative shape-correctness fixtures. EVERY field whose
# value can ONLY come from the published source PDF is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with
# explicit instructions describing what must be sourced and how. The pipeline
# refuses to operate on documents containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
#
# Three examples are provided:
#   5.1 A two-column body text region with NFC normalization log
#   5.2 An ACC/AHA recommendation-box table with one body row
#   5.3 A flowchart figure with a parsed graph awaiting corroboration
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5.1 Body text region (two-column page, with hyphenation rejoin)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"
    document_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"

    source:
      pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      pdf_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/02-normalized.pdf"
      doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
      url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
      publisher: "ACC/AHA"
      publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      document_role: main-guideline
      page_count: 0  # HUMAN_FILL: integer page count

    tools_lock:
      lock_sha: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      items:
        - { name: "qpdf",          pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: pdf-parser,       deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pymupdf",       pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: pdf-parser,       deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pdfminer.six",  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: pdf-parser,       deterministic: true }
        - { name: "marker",        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: pdf-parser,       deterministic: false }
        - { name: "publaynet-d2",  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: layout-detector,  deterministic: true }
        - { name: "layoutlmv3",    pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: layout-detector,  deterministic: false }

    pages:
      - page_number: 0          # HUMAN_FILL
        size: { w: 0, h: 0 }    # HUMAN_FILL: PDF page size in user-space units
        column_model: "2col"
        column_polygons:
          - column_index: 0
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]  # HUMAN_FILL
          - column_index: 1
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]  # HUMAN_FILL
        reading_order:
          primary_method: xy-cut
          region_ids_in_order:
            - "r-HUMAN_FILL-001"
          alternative_methods:
            - { method: layoutreader, transitions_disagreement_pct: 0.0 }
        regions:
          - region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-001"
            class: text
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]  # HUMAN_FILL
            reading_order_index: 0
            column_index: 0
            content:
              raw_utf8_nfc: |
                HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim NFC-normalized body text from the source
                page. Preserve internal whitespace; reversible transforms
                (e.g., soft-hyphen removal at line breaks, ligature
                decomposition) are recorded in normalization_log below.
              char_spans:
                - start: 0
                  end:   0    # HUMAN_FILL: must cover raw_utf8_nfc contiguously
                  page:  0    # HUMAN_FILL
                  bbox:  [0, 0, 0, 0]   # HUMAN_FILL
                  font:  null
                  size:  null
                  is_superscript: false
              footnote_refs: []
              normalization_log:
                nfc_applied: true
                transforms:
                  - kind: hyphen-line-break-rejoined
                    position: 0          # HUMAN_FILL
                    original: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'hyper-\\ntension'"
                    replacement: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'hypertension'"
                    note: "Joined token validated against medical lexicon."
              consensus:
                state: text-consensus
                pairwise_min_similarity: 0.99
                engines:
                  - { engine: pymupdf-glyph, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 1.00 }
                  - { engine: pdfminer-six,  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 0.99 }
                  - { engine: marker,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 0.99 }
            provenance:
              layout_consensus:
                state: agree
                detectors:
                  - { name: publaynet-d2, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.95 }
                  - { name: layoutlmv3,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.95 }
              extractor_consensus: text-consensus
        raster:
          path_300dpi: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/03-pages-300dpi/page-0001.png"
          sha256_300dpi: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
          path_600dpi: null
          sha256_600dpi: null
        tagged_pdf_structtree_present: false

    footnotes_index: {}

    flagged_items: []

    run:
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      ended_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      steps:
        - skill: parse-extract-text
          started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          ended_at:   "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          parameters: { dpi: 300 }
          counts:     { regions_emitted: 1 }
          gates:
            - { gate_id: "G2-A", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2-E", status: PASS }
          operator_id: "HUMAN_FILL"

    fixity:
      sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5.2 ACC/AHA recommendation-box table (one body row, cell-consensus)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"
    document_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"

    source:
      pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      pdf_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/02-normalized.pdf"
      doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
      url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
      publisher: "ACC/AHA"
      publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      document_role: main-guideline
      page_count: 0   # HUMAN_FILL

    tools_lock:
      lock_sha: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      items:
        - { name: "camelot",     pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: table-engine, deterministic: true }
        - { name: "tabula",      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: table-engine, deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pdfplumber",  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: table-engine, deterministic: true }
        - { name: "tablemaster", pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: vlm,          deterministic: false }
        - { name: "donut-table", pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: vlm,          deterministic: false }

    pages:
      - page_number: 0          # HUMAN_FILL
        size: { w: 0, h: 0 }    # HUMAN_FILL
        column_model: "1col"
        reading_order:
          primary_method: xy-cut
          region_ids_in_order:
            - "r-HUMAN_FILL-007"   # the table region
            - "r-HUMAN_FILL-008"   # the supportive-text region following the box
        regions:
          # The recommendation-box table region
          - region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-007"
            class: table
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]   # HUMAN_FILL
            reading_order_index: 7
            column_index: 0
            content:
              headers:
                - { col: 0, bbox: [0,0,0,0], value_consensus: "COR",            consensus_state: cell-consensus }
                - { col: 1, bbox: [0,0,0,0], value_consensus: "LOE",            consensus_state: cell-consensus }
                - { col: 2, bbox: [0,0,0,0], value_consensus: "Recommendations", consensus_state: cell-consensus }
              rows:
                - - row: 0
                    col: 0
                    bbox: [0,0,0,0]  # HUMAN_FILL: COR cell bbox
                    value_consensus: "HUMAN_FILL_COR_VERBATIM_FROM_BOX"   # one of: I, IIa, IIb, III: No Benefit, III: Harm
                    consensus_state: cell-consensus
                    value_variants:
                      - { engine: camelot-lattice,  value: "HUMAN_FILL", bbox: [0,0,0,0], confidence: null }
                      - { engine: camelot-stream,   value: "HUMAN_FILL", bbox: [0,0,0,0], confidence: null }
                      - { engine: tabula-lattice,   value: "HUMAN_FILL", bbox: [0,0,0,0], confidence: null }
                      - { engine: pdfplumber,       value: "HUMAN_FILL", bbox: [0,0,0,0], confidence: null }
                      - { engine: vlm-tablemaster,  value: "HUMAN_FILL", bbox: [0,0,0,0], confidence: 0.99 }
                  - row: 0
                    col: 1
                    bbox: [0,0,0,0]
                    value_consensus: "HUMAN_FILL_LOE_VERBATIM_FROM_BOX"   # one of: A, B-R, B-NR, C-LD, C-EO
                    consensus_state: cell-consensus
                  - row: 0
                    col: 2
                    bbox: [0,0,0,0]
                    value_consensus: |
                      HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim recommendation text from the source
                      recommendation cell. NFC-normalized; reversible transforms
                      recorded in the row-level normalization log below.
                    consensus_state: cell-consensus
              schema_detected: acc-aha-recommendation-box
              engines_used:
                - camelot-lattice
                - camelot-stream
                - tabula-lattice
                - pdfplumber
                - vlm-tablemaster
              recommendation_box_rows:
                - region_id: "row-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
                  row_index: 0
                  cor: "HUMAN_FILL_COR_VERBATIM_FROM_BOX"
                  loe: "HUMAN_FILL_LOE_VERBATIM_FROM_BOX"
                  text_verbatim: |
                    HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim recommendation text exactly as printed.
                  cell_bboxes:
                    cor:            [0,0,0,0]
                    loe:            [0,0,0,0]
                    recommendation: [0,0,0,0]
                  char_spans:
                    - start: 0
                      end:   0
                      page:  0
                      bbox:  [0,0,0,0]
                  footnote_refs: []
                  section_path:
                    - "HUMAN_FILL: chapter heading"
                    - "HUMAN_FILL: subsection heading"
                  supportive_text_region_ids:
                    - "r-HUMAN_FILL-008"
                  consensus_state: cell-consensus
                  parent_table_region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-007"
                  normalization_log:
                    nfc_applied: true
                    transforms:
                      - kind: unicode-nfc
                        position: 0
                        original: "HUMAN_FILL"
                        replacement: "HUMAN_FILL"
            provenance:
              layout_consensus:
                state: agree
                detectors:
                  - { name: publaynet-d2, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.95 }
                  - { name: layoutlmv3,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.93 }
              extractor_consensus: cell-consensus

          # The Recommendation-Specific Supportive Text region following the box
          - region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-008"
            class: text
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]
            reading_order_index: 8
            column_index: 0
            content:
              raw_utf8_nfc: |
                HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim Recommendation-Specific Supportive Text
                paragraph(s). Bound to the recommendation row above via
                supportive_text_region_ids. NEVER merged into the
                recommendation text_verbatim.
              char_spans:
                - start: 0
                  end:   0
                  page:  0
                  bbox:  [0, 0, 0, 0]
              footnote_refs: []
              normalization_log:
                nfc_applied: true
                transforms: []
              consensus:
                state: text-consensus
                pairwise_min_similarity: 0.99
                engines:
                  - { engine: pymupdf-glyph, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 1.00 }
                  - { engine: pdfminer-six,  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 0.99 }
                  - { engine: marker,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 0.99 }
            provenance:
              layout_consensus:
                state: agree
                detectors:
                  - { name: publaynet-d2, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.94 }
                  - { name: layoutlmv3,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.94 }
              extractor_consensus: text-consensus
        raster:
          path_300dpi: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/03-pages-300dpi/page-0001.png"
          sha256_300dpi: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
          path_600dpi: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/03-pages-600dpi/page-0001.png"
          sha256_600dpi: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        tagged_pdf_structtree_present: false

    footnotes_index: {}

    flagged_items: []

    run:
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      ended_at:   "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      steps:
        - skill: parse-acc-aha-recbox
          started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          ended_at:   "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          parameters: { dpi: 600, engines: [camelot-lattice, camelot-stream, tabula-lattice, pdfplumber, vlm-tablemaster] }
          counts:     { recommendation_rows_emitted: 1, queue_entries_opened: 0 }
          gates:
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-A", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-B", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-C", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-D", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-E", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-F", status: PASS }
            - { gate_id: "G2.3-G", status: PASS }
          operator_id: "HUMAN_FILL"

    fixity:
      sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5.3 Flowchart figure with parsed graph awaiting corroboration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"
    document_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"

    source:
      pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      pdf_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/02-normalized.pdf"
      doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
      url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
      publisher: "ACC/AHA"
      publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      document_role: main-guideline
      page_count: 0  # HUMAN_FILL

    tools_lock:
      lock_sha: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      items:
        - { name: "opencv",        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: other,  deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pix2struct",    pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: vlm,    deterministic: false }
        - { name: "florence-2",    pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: vlm,    deterministic: false }
        - { name: "tesseract",     pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: ocr,    deterministic: true }
        - { name: "paddleocr",     pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", kind: ocr,    deterministic: true }

    pages:
      - page_number: 0
        size: { w: 0, h: 0 }
        column_model: "1col"
        reading_order:
          primary_method: layoutreader
          region_ids_in_order:
            - "r-HUMAN_FILL-002"   # caption
            - "r-HUMAN_FILL-003"   # the figure
        regions:
          # Caption (read first per reading order on this page; its content is the caption text)
          - region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-002"
            class: caption
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]
            reading_order_index: 0
            column_index: 0
            content:
              raw_utf8_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'Figure 5. Diagnostic algorithm for confirmed hypertension.'"
              char_spans:
                - start: 0
                  end:   0
                  page:  0
                  bbox:  [0, 0, 0, 0]
              footnote_refs: []
              normalization_log: { nfc_applied: true, transforms: [] }
              consensus:
                state: text-consensus
                pairwise_min_similarity: 0.99
                engines:
                  - { engine: pymupdf-glyph, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 1.00 }
                  - { engine: pdfminer-six,  pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL", similarity_to_consensus: 0.99 }
            caption_pairing:
              caption_id: "cap-HUMAN_FILL-1"
              target_figure_region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-003"
            provenance:
              layout_consensus:
                state: agree
                detectors:
                  - { name: publaynet-d2, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.97 }
                  - { name: layoutlmv3,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.97 }
              extractor_consensus: text-consensus

          # The figure
          - region_id: "r-HUMAN_FILL-003"
            class: figure
            bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]
            reading_order_index: 1
            column_index: 0
            content:
              file: "figures/HUMAN_FILL_PAGE-1.png"
              file_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
              type: flowchart
              dpi: 600
              caption_id: "cap-HUMAN_FILL-1"
              graph:
                nodes:
                  - id: "n1"
                    shape: rectangle
                    text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL: node text exactly as in figure"
                    bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]
                  - id: "n2"
                    shape: diamond
                    text_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL"
                    bbox: [0, 0, 0, 0]
                edges:
                  - { source: "n1", target: "n2", label_nfc: null,                  agreement: 1.00 }
                  - { source: "n2", target: "n1", label_nfc: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'No'", agreement: 1.00 }
                parsers:
                  - opencv-shapes
                  - vlm-pix2struct
                  - vlm-florence-2
                awaiting_corroboration: true   # logic-bearing; never feeds CQL/CDS Hooks alone
              chart_data: null
              ocr_overlay:
                confidence_min: 0.95
                engines: [tesseract, paddleocr]
            provenance:
              layout_consensus:
                state: agree
                detectors:
                  - { name: publaynet-d2, pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.96 }
                  - { name: layoutlmv3,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", iou: 0.95 }
              extractor_consensus: figure-parsed
        raster:
          path_300dpi: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/03-pages-300dpi/page-0001.png"
          sha256_300dpi: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
          path_600dpi: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/03-pages-600dpi/page-0001.png"
          sha256_600dpi: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        tagged_pdf_structtree_present: false

    footnotes_index: {}

    flagged_items: []

    run:
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      ended_at:   "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      steps:
        - skill: parse-extract-figures
          started_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          ended_at:   "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          parameters: { dpi: 600 }
          counts:     { figures_emitted: 1, flowcharts_parsed: 1 }
          gates:
            - { gate_id: "G2-C", status: PASS }
          operator_id: "HUMAN_FILL"

    fixity:
      sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

# =============================================================================
# 6. CHANGE CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Any change to this schema (closed enums, required fields, invariants, or
# example fixtures) requires:
#   - A change-controlled diff with regression evaluation against the golden set.
#   - Panel-chair signoff.
#   - Increment of `schema_version` (semver: breaking = major).
#   - Update of `last_reviewed`.
#   - Coordinated update of every producing/consuming skill's `tools_lock`
#     reference and acceptance test fixtures.
# =============================================================================

change_control:
  semver: true
  golden_set_regression_required: true
  panel_chair_signoff_required: true
  parent_skills_to_update_on_breaking_change:
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-prepare-pdf
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-detect-layout
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-extract-text
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-acc-aha-recbox
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-extract-figures
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-ocr-fallback
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-reconcile-queue
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/extract-recommendation-cor-loe
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/extract-bp-thresholds
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/extract-pharm-rules
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/predecessor-map-2017
```

Saved as `schemas/sair.yaml`. The schema is JSON-Schema-2020-12-flavored YAML, mirrors the parent repo's closed-enum-first / `additionalProperties: false` discipline, and is fully aligned to the Parse Spec §2–§3 and the SAIR root shape in §3.7. Twenty cross-field invariants (`SAIR-INV-01` … `SAIR-INV-20`) are enumerated for the framework's validator, including the recommendation-box four-engine quorum rule, the logic-bearing-figure `awaiting_corroboration` rule, the chrome-excluded-from-reading-order rule, the deterministic SAIR fixity-hash rule (RFC 8785 canonicalization with `fixity` excluded), and the predecessor-2017-not-consumable-by-clinical-extraction rule. Three worked examples (two-column body text with hyphenation rejoin, an ACC/AHA recommendation-box table with one body row at cell-consensus, and a flowchart figure with a parsed graph in `awaiting_corroboration: true`) demonstrate the shape without inventing any clinical content; every value sourceable only from the published PDF is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions.

If you want the next concrete step at the same fidelity (one at a time):

1. `schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml` — the standalone closed-enum file referenced by both the SAIR and the recommendation-record schemas.
2. `schemas/atomic-unit.yaml` — the atomic-unit span schema referenced by `recommendation-record-htn.yaml`.
3. `schemas/gate1-register.yaml` — the Gate 1 cohort register schema, with reviewer credentials, signature envelope, and panel-chair signoff.
4. `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` — the per-build manifest referenced by `guideline_manifest_ref` in both schemas.
5. `flow-hbp-2025-build` orchestrator with all three gate stops wired (Gate 1 stop wired to `extract-recommendation-cor-loe`).
6. Open a tracking issue in `jmagly/aiwg-training` (or a new repo `jmagly/aiwg-cpg-htn-2025`) proposing this SAIR contract as the canonical Phase-2 → Phase-3 handoff.
