```yaml name=schemas/gate1-register.yaml
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D14 (supersession chain; predecessor 2017 advisory)
#   - Parse + Extraction Phase Spec §4.11 (Gate 1 SME extraction review:
#     composition, workflow, exit conditions)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by $ref):
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml   (each register entry references
#                                              one or more
#                                              RecommendationRecordHTN
#                                              instances by id)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                 (referenced for atomicity-state
#                                              acknowledgement)
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                        (upstream; provides the source
#                                              anchors the reviewers see)
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml             (closed COR/LOE enums; cited
#                                              for the no-COR/LOE-edit rule)
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml (per-build manifest; cohort
#                                              membership is scoped to a
#                                              manifest)
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/gate1-register.yaml"
title: "Gate1Register"
description: >
  Auditable, signed, append-only register of Gate 1 SME extraction reviews
  for a cohort of RecommendationRecordHTN instances drawn from a single
  guideline manifest. Each register entry binds a named reviewer with
  credential evidence to a content-hash signature on a single record.
  Cohort-level finality requires a panel-chair signoff. Post-signoff
  mutation is forbidden; corrections require a new register version with
  explicit predecessor chain.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative; encodes Parse Spec §4.11)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  reviewer_composition:
    rule: >
      Every advanced record MUST carry exactly two independent reviewer
      signoffs from distinct, non-overlapping roles per the Gate-1
      composition matrix in `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §10.1. The
      hypertension specialist appears on every record. The second co-reviewer
      varies by domain (clinical pharmacology / MFM / geriatrics / primary
      care / clinical informatics / nephrology / endocrinology / emergency
      medicine / critical care).
    matrix:
      - domain: "diagnosis | classification | BP measurement | risk stratification"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - clinical-informaticist
      - domain: "lifestyle | non-pharmacologic | implementation | team-based | measurement workflow"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - primary-care-clinician
      - domain: "pharmacologic — general"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - clinical-pharmacologist
      - domain: "pharmacologic — older adult"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - geriatrician
      - domain: "pharmacologic — pregnancy / postpartum"
        required_roles:
          - mfm-or-obstetric-medicine
          - clinical-pharmacologist
        notes: >
          The hypertension specialist may also appear; the schema accepts up
          to four signoffs to accommodate institutional policy that requires
          three signatures on pregnancy records.
      - domain: "CKD / diabetes / HF / CAD / post-stroke modifiers"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - "(specialty-matched co-reviewer: clinical-pharmacologist OR nephrology OR endocrinology)"
      - domain: "resistant HTN"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - clinical-pharmacologist
      - domain: "secondary HTN"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - "(nephrology OR endocrinology)"
      - domain: "urgency / emergency"
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - "(emergency-medicine OR critical-care)"

  no_batch_acceptance:
    rule: >
      No reviewer may sign more than one record per signature payload. Each
      record requires its own signature against its own content_hash. Batch
      acceptance is forbidden.

  cor_loe_edit_prohibition:
    rule: >
      No reviewer signoff may carry an `edits[]` entry whose target field
      is `acc_aha_cor` or `acc_aha_loe`. Any such request MUST be
      reclassified as `reject-rework`. The validator MUST detect and reject
      attempted COR/LOE edits.

  post_signoff_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once a `ReviewerSignoff` is recorded with `decision ∈ {accept,
      accept-with-edit}`, neither its `signature` nor the
      `RecommendationRecord.content_hash` it signed may be mutated. Any
      change to the underlying record (including reviewer-driven
      `accept-with-edit`) produces a new `RecommendationRecord` content
      hash and requires a new `ReviewerSignoff` against that new hash. The
      old signoff is retained immutably for audit.

  panel_chair_signoff:
    rule: >
      Cohort finality requires a `PanelChairSignoff` over the cohort's
      manifest hash (the SHA-256 of the canonicalized list of all per-record
      content_hashes plus their reviewer signoffs). The panel chair is a
      named individual with credential evidence; their signoff disposes of
      escalations and certifies reviewer-composition compliance.

  conflict_of_interest:
    rule: >
      Every reviewer (and the panel chair) MUST disclose a current Conflict
      of Interest (COI) statement. A reviewer with an undisclosed COI on a
      record's subject (e.g., a pharmaceutical relationship for a drug-class
      record) is automatically disqualified for that record; the disqualification
      is recorded as a register entry of state `recused`, and a substitute
      reviewer of the same role is required.

  identity_proofing:
    rule: >
      Every reviewer's identity MUST be proofed at NIST SP 800-63 IAL2 or
      higher (institutional verification with documented evidence). The
      framework records the proofing class and evidence pointer; it does not
      re-perform proofing.

  signature_algorithm:
    rule: >
      Signatures use Ed25519 (default) or ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the canonical
      JCS (RFC 8785) form of the signed payload. The algorithm and key
      identifier are pinned per-cohort; mismatch is a release blocker.

  time_stamping:
    rule: >
      Every signoff carries an RFC 3161 time-stamp from a named TSA pinned in
      the cohort manifest. Time-stamp absence is a release blocker.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Reviewer roles (must match the matrix in §1)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerRole:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hypertension-specialist
      - clinical-pharmacologist
      - mfm-or-obstetric-medicine
      - geriatrician
      - primary-care-clinician
      - clinical-informaticist
      - nephrology
      - endocrinology
      - emergency-medicine
      - critical-care
      - panel-chair
      - medical-director

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Reviewer decision
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerDecision:
    type: string
    enum:
      - accept
      - accept-with-edit
      - reject-rework
      - escalate-panel
      - recused

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Edit target (NOT acc_aha_cor or acc_aha_loe)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EditTarget:
    type: string
    enum:
      - text_verbatim_typo
      - supportive_text
      - monitoring_text
      - citation_link
    description: >
      Closed list of fields that may be edited at Gate 1 with reviewer
      signoff. Notably absent: acc_aha_cor, acc_aha_loe (forbidden;
      reject-rework instead), text_verbatim non-typo paraphrase
      (forbidden; reject-rework instead), atomic_units (regenerated
      automatically when text_verbatim is edited).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Identity assurance level
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [IAL1, IAL2, IAL3]
    description: >
      NIST SP 800-63 Identity Assurance Level. IAL2 is the minimum for
      Gate 1; IAL3 is required for panel chair and medical director.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Authenticator assurance level
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [AAL1, AAL2, AAL3]
    description: >
      NIST SP 800-63 Authenticator Assurance Level. AAL2 is the minimum
      for Gate 1; AAL3 (hardware-backed) is required for panel chair and
      medical director.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Credential kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CredentialKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - abim-certification
      - abp-certification
      - abfm-certification
      - abem-certification
      - aoa-board-certification
      - ash-hypertension-specialist
      - amia-ciip
      - abpm-clinical-informatics
      - bccp-pharmacy
      - bcps-aq-cardiology
      - mfm-board-certification
      - geriatric-medicine-board-certification
      - nephrology-board-certification
      - endocrinology-board-certification
      - critical-care-board-certification
      - state-medical-license
      - institutional-credential
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Conflict-of-interest kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  COIKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - none
      - financial-pharmaceutical
      - financial-device
      - research-grant
      - speakers-bureau
      - consultancy
      - equity-holding
      - employment-related
      - family-relationship
      - publication-author
      - guideline-author
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Signature algorithms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SignatureAlgorithm:
    type: string
    enum:
      - Ed25519
      - ECDSA-P256-SHA256
    description: >
      Closed set of permitted algorithms. New algorithms require a schema
      version bump and ADR-HTN-001 amendment.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Cohort lifecycle states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CohortState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - in-review
      - awaiting-panel-chair
      - finalized
      - superseded
      - withdrawn
    description: >
      `finalized` is terminal for a register version. Any subsequent change
      requires a new register version with `predecessor_register_version`
      pointing to the finalized one and `superseded_at` recorded on the
      predecessor.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Per-record disposition states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RecordDispositionState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pending
      - accepted
      - accepted-with-edit
      - rework-required
      - panel-escalated
      - panel-resolved
      - withdrawn

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 IdentityProof — institutional verification of a reviewer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityProof:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [ial, aal, proofing_method, proofing_evidence_uri, proofed_at, proofed_by_org]
    properties:
      ial: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityAssuranceLevel" }
      aal: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel" }
      proofing_method:
        type: string
        description: >
          Free-text description of the institutional proofing process
          (e.g., "in-person verification at <institution> on <date> with
          government-issued ID"). The schema does not enumerate methods;
          institutions vary.
      proofing_evidence_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: >
          Pointer to the proofing evidence record in the institution's IAM
          system. Must be a stable URI; the framework does not store the
          underlying document (it may contain PII).
      proofed_at:        { type: string, format: date-time }
      proofed_by_org:    { type: string, description: "Institution/agency that performed the proofing." }
      proofed_by_person:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: Optional: name of the individual who performed the proofing.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Credential — board certification or institutional credential
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Credential:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, issuer, evidence_uri, valid_from]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/CredentialKind" }
      issuer:         { type: string, description: "Issuing body name (e.g., 'American Board of Internal Medicine')." }
      evidence_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: >
          Pointer to verification evidence (e.g., issuer's verification
          portal lookup result captured at validation time).
      valid_from:     { type: string, format: date }
      valid_until:    { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
      verified_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      verified_by:    { type: string, description: "Identity of the framework operator who verified the credential." }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 ConflictOfInterest — disclosed COI
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConflictOfInterest:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, disclosed_at, scope]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      counterparty:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Name of the entity (e.g., pharmaceutical company, device
          manufacturer). Required for all kinds except `none`.
      scope:
        type: string
        enum:
          - none
          - drug-class
          - device-class
          - therapeutic-area
          - guideline-document
          - other
      scope_detail:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Free-text scope detail (e.g., RxNorm ingredient class, device
          category). For `kind == "guideline-author"`, the value MUST be
          "2025-ACC-AHA-HBP-Guideline".
      disclosed_at:   { type: string, format: date-time }
      mitigation:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Free-text description of mitigation (e.g., "Recused from all
          MRA-related records; not assigned to MRA review queue").
      auto_disqualifies_record_kinds:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }
        description: >
          Closed-by-policy list of record kinds (e.g., domains, drug
          classes, populations) for which this COI auto-disqualifies the
          reviewer. Validators check this list at signoff time.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Reviewer — named individual with credentials, identity, COI
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Reviewer:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - reviewer_id
      - legal_name
      - role
      - identity_proof
      - credentials
      - coi_disclosures
      - public_key
    properties:
      reviewer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Stable, deterministic ID for this reviewer (truncated SHA-256 of
          institution + employee number + identity_proof.proofing_evidence_uri).
      legal_name:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: Full legal name. NOT redacted; this is an attestation record.
      preferred_credential_string:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          E.g., "Jane Doe, MD, FACC". Used in human-readable outputs only;
          legal_name is the canonical identity field.
      role: { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
      institution:
        type: string
        description: Primary institutional affiliation at the time of signoff.
      identity_proof: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityProof" }
      credentials:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Credential" }
        description: >
          At least one credential MUST be present whose kind is consistent
          with `role` per the framework's role-credential matrix.
      coi_disclosures:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ConflictOfInterest" }
        description: >
          MUST contain at least one entry. A reviewer with no COI records a
          single entry of `kind: none`.
      public_key:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [algorithm, key_id, key_pem]
        properties:
          algorithm: { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
          key_id:
            type: string
            description: Stable identifier for this key (e.g., institutional KMS key id).
          key_pem:
            type: string
            description: PEM-encoded public key. Verified against the institution's KMS at validation time.
          fingerprint_sha256:
            type: string
            pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
            description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo.
      added_to_panel_at: { type: string, format: date-time }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 TimeStamp — RFC 3161 time-stamp envelope
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TimeStamp:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [tsa_name, tsa_url, tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
    properties:
      tsa_name: { type: string }
      tsa_url:  { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      time:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      token_b64:
        type: string
        description: Base64 of the RFC 3161 TSP TimeStampToken.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Signature — Ed25519 / ECDSA over JCS-canonical payload
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Signature:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [algorithm, key_id, payload_canonical_form, payload_sha256, signature_b64, time_stamp]
    properties:
      algorithm:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
      key_id:              { type: string, description: Same as Reviewer.public_key.key_id at signing time. }
      payload_canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
      payload_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of the signed payload.
      signature_b64:
        type: string
        description: Base64-encoded raw signature bytes.
      time_stamp:          { $ref: "#/$defs/TimeStamp" }
      verifies:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Set to true by the validator after successful verification. The
          validator regenerates the canonical payload from the referenced
          record and re-verifies; it does not trust the producer's claim.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 Edit — bounded, non-clinical-grade-altering edits
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Edit:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [target, before, after, rationale]
    properties:
      target:    { $ref: "#/$defs/EditTarget" }
      before:    { type: string }
      after:     { type: string }
      rationale: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
    description: >
      Edits to acc_aha_cor and acc_aha_loe are forbidden by policy
      (no_grade_reassignment); see G1-INV-12. The schema-level closed enum
      `EditTarget` enforces this.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 ReviewerSignoff — single reviewer's decision on a single record
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerSignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - signoff_id
      - reviewer_id
      - role
      - record_id
      - record_content_hash
      - sair_sha256
      - decision
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      signoff_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^so-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Stable, deterministic ID (truncated SHA-256 of reviewer_id, record_id, signed_at).
      reviewer_id:         { type: string, pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      role:                { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
      record_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: ID of the RecommendationRecordHTN being signed.
      record_content_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the canonicalized RecommendationRecordHTN with
          `provenance.reviewer_signoffs` stripped at signing time. This is
          the hash the signature covers.
      sair_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the SAIR document the record was extracted from. Pinned for audit.
      atomicity_state_acknowledged:
        type: string
        enum: [agreed, held]
        description: >
          The reviewer explicitly acknowledges the atomicity state of the
          record at signoff time. `held` is permitted; the parent record
          can advance with held atomicity per the atomic-unit schema, but
          the reviewer signature attests acknowledgement.
      decision:            { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerDecision" }
      rationale:           { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      edits:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Edit" }
        description: >
          Permitted only when decision == "accept-with-edit". Empty
          otherwise. NEVER target acc_aha_cor or acc_aha_loe.
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi, applicable_coi_kinds]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi:
            type: boolean
            description: >
              Reviewer attests that all relevant COI for this record are
              disclosed in the reviewer's COI list. False here is a release
              blocker.
          applicable_coi_kinds:
            type: array
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
            description: COI kinds the reviewer flagged as applicable to this record.
      signed_at:           { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature:           { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }
      session_attestations:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [reviewed_source_pdf_region, reviewed_atomic_units, reviewed_pico_precheck]
        properties:
          reviewed_source_pdf_region: { type: boolean, description: Reviewer attests they viewed the rasterized source region. }
          reviewed_atomic_units:      { type: boolean }
          reviewed_pico_precheck:     { type: boolean }
          reviewed_predecessor_2017:  { type: boolean, default: true }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 RecordEntry — disposition of one record in the cohort
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RecordEntry:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - record_id
      - record_content_hash
      - sair_sha256
      - state
      - signoffs
    properties:
      record_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      record_content_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          The hash signed by every signoff in `signoffs[]`. If the underlying
          RecommendationRecordHTN is mutated post-signoff, the hash here
          MUST diverge from the record's recomputed hash and the validator
          MUST flag.
      sair_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      state:               { $ref: "#/$defs/RecordDispositionState" }
      signoffs:
        type: array
        minItems: 0      # 0 permitted only for `pending`, `withdrawn`
        maxItems: 4
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerSignoff" }
      escalation:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [opened_at, reason, escalated_to_role]
        properties:
          opened_at:           { type: string, format: date-time }
          reason:              { type: string, minLength: 1 }
          escalated_to_role:   { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
          resolution:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [resolved_at, decision, resolver_signoff]
            properties:
              resolved_at:       { type: string, format: date-time }
              decision:          { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerDecision" }
              resolver_signoff:  { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerSignoff" }
      rework_history:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [opened_at, reviewer_id, reason]
          properties:
            opened_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
            reviewer_id:  { type: string }
            reason:       { type: string, minLength: 1 }
            resolved_at:  { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 PanelChairSignoff — cohort-level signoff
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PanelChairSignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - chair_reviewer_id
      - cohort_manifest_hash
      - composition_compliance_attested
      - escalations_disposed
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      chair_reviewer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Reviewer ID of the panel chair. The Reviewer record for this id
          MUST have role == "panel-chair" and identity_proof.ial == "IAL3"
          and public_key.algorithm in SignatureAlgorithm.
      cohort_manifest_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of `records[]` with the
          ordering canonicalized by record_id. The signature covers this
          hash.
      composition_compliance_attested:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Chair attests that every record in `records[]` carries the correct
          reviewer composition per the matrix in §1. False here is a release
          blocker.
      escalations_disposed:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Chair attests that no record remains in `panel-escalated` state.
          False here is a release blocker.
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi:
            type: boolean
            description: Chair's COI attestation at cohort signoff time.
      signed_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature: { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.11 RegisterAuditEvent — append-only audit trail
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RegisterAuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:           { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:        { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:
        type: string
        enum:
          - cohort-created
          - reviewer-added
          - reviewer-removed
          - record-added
          - signoff-recorded
          - escalation-opened
          - escalation-resolved
          - rework-opened
          - rework-resolved
          - panel-chair-signed
          - cohort-finalized
          - cohort-superseded
          - cohort-withdrawn
      actor_id:           { type: string, description: Reviewer or operator id. }
      payload_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical event payload.
      prov_activity_id:   { type: [string, "null"], description: W3C PROV Activity id. }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — Gate1Register
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - register_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - cohort
  - panel
  - records
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  register_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
    description: >
      Semver of this register instance. A new register version is required
      after any post-finalization change (rework, supersession, withdrawal).

  predecessor_register_version:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$|^null$"
    description: >
      Required when this register supersedes a prior version. Forms a chain
      of immutable register versions.

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance for this build.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Cohort — identity and lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cohort:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [cohort_id, name, run_id, opened_at, state, scope]
    properties:
      cohort_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      name:                { type: string, minLength: 1, description: Human-readable cohort name. }
      run_id:              { type: string, format: uuid }
      opened_at:           { type: string, format: date-time }
      finalized_at:        { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      superseded_at:       { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      state:               { $ref: "#/$defs/CohortState" }
      scope:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [domains, includes_pregnancy_records]
        properties:
          domains:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
              enum:
                - diagnosis
                - classification
                - bp-measurement
                - risk-stratification
                - lifestyle
                - pharmacologic-general
                - pharmacologic-special-populations
                - resistant-htn
                - secondary-htn
                - urgency-emergency
                - implementation
                - team-based-care
                - measurement-workflow
          includes_pregnancy_records:
            type: boolean
            description: >
              True if any record in this cohort falls in the pregnancy /
              postpartum domain. When true, the panel composition matrix
              REQUIRES MFM + clinical pharmacology on those records.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Panel — full set of named reviewers and the panel chair
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  panel:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [panel_id, reviewers, panel_chair_signoff]
    properties:
      panel_id:            { type: string, pattern: "^panel-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      reviewers:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Reviewer" }
        description: >
          Every named individual permitted to sign records in this cohort.
          The panel chair is also included here with role == "panel-chair"
          AND a separate Reviewer entry covering any specialty role they
          additionally play (rare).
      panel_chair_signoff:
        oneOf:
          - { $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChairSignoff" }
          - type: "null"
        description: >
          Null until the cohort reaches `awaiting-panel-chair`; required
          non-null for `state == "finalized"`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Records — disposition of every record in the cohort
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  records:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RecordEntry" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Audit log — append-only
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RegisterAuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Fixity — self-fingerprint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [register_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      register_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: G1-INV-01
    description: >
      Every `signoffs[*].reviewer_id` MUST refer to a Reviewer in
      `panel.reviewers[]`. Every `panel_chair_signoff.chair_reviewer_id`
      MUST refer to a Reviewer in `panel.reviewers[]` with role ==
      "panel-chair".

  - id: G1-INV-02
    description: >
      Every Reviewer MUST have at least one Credential whose `kind` is
      consistent with `role` per the role-credential matrix maintained in
      `docs/role-credential-matrix.md`. CI MUST verify the matrix file
      exists and is consulted at validation time.

  - id: G1-INV-03
    description: >
      Every Reviewer.identity_proof.ial MUST be `IAL2` or `IAL3`. Reviewers
      with role `panel-chair` or `medical-director` MUST have ial == `IAL3`
      and aal == `AAL3`.

  - id: G1-INV-04
    description: >
      Every Reviewer.coi_disclosures MUST be non-empty. A reviewer with no
      COI MUST record a single entry of kind `none`. Missing COI list is a
      release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-05
    description: >
      For every RecordEntry in state ∈ {accepted, accepted-with-edit},
      `signoffs[]` MUST contain exactly two ReviewerSignoff entries with
      `decision ∈ {accept, accept-with-edit}` and distinct
      `(reviewer_id, role)` pairs. Pregnancy-domain records MAY have up to
      four signoffs; the second-and-third pair MUST satisfy the MFM +
      clinical-pharmacology composition.

  - id: G1-INV-06
    description: >
      Reviewer composition for each record MUST match the matrix in §1
      according to the record's domain. The validator infers the record's
      domain from `RecommendationRecordHTN.section_path` and
      `pico_precheck.populations`. Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-07
    description: >
      Every Signature.payload_sha256 MUST equal the SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of the payload it claims to cover. Validators
      regenerate and compare; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-08
    description: >
      Every Signature MUST verify under the corresponding Reviewer's
      public_key (algorithm + key_id matched). Validators perform the
      cryptographic verification; the producer's `verifies: true` claim is
      ignored.

  - id: G1-INV-09
    description: >
      Every ReviewerSignoff.record_content_hash MUST equal the recomputed
      content hash of the referenced RecommendationRecordHTN with
      `provenance.reviewer_signoffs` stripped at the time of validation.
      Mismatch indicates post-signoff mutation and is a release blocker
      (post_signoff_immutability).

  - id: G1-INV-10
    description: >
      Every ReviewerSignoff.sair_sha256 MUST equal
      RecommendationRecordHTN.anchors.sair_sha256 for the referenced
      record. Cross-SAIR signatures are forbidden.

  - id: G1-INV-11
    description: >
      Every Signature.time_stamp.tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256 MUST be a
      member of the cohort's pinned TSA list (recorded in
      `guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml`). Unknown TSAs are a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-12
    description: >
      No ReviewerSignoff.edits[] entry may have `target ∈ {acc_aha_cor,
      acc_aha_loe}`. The `EditTarget` enum forbids this at the schema
      boundary; validators MUST ALSO reject any ad-hoc string sneaked in
      via tooling.

  - id: G1-INV-13
    description: >
      For every signoff with decision == "accept-with-edit",
      `edits[]` MUST be non-empty AND every Edit MUST point to a
      RecommendationRecordHTN field that exists. The downstream pipeline
      MUST regenerate atomic_units when text_verbatim is edited
      (atomic-unit AU-INV-24).

  - id: G1-INV-14
    description: >
      For every Reviewer assigned to a record where their
      `coi_disclosures[].auto_disqualifies_record_kinds` overlaps the
      record's kind set, the record's signoffs MUST include a recused
      entry (decision == "recused") for that reviewer, and a substitute
      reviewer of the same role MUST sign. Auto-disqualification cannot be
      ignored.

  - id: G1-INV-15
    description: >
      For every RecordEntry in state == "panel-escalated", an `escalation`
      object MUST be present with non-null `escalated_to_role` and a null
      `resolution` (until resolved). Escalation without an open resolution
      record is a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-16
    description: >
      For state == "finalized" on the cohort, `panel_chair_signoff` MUST
      be non-null AND its `cohort_manifest_hash` MUST equal the recomputed
      SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of `records[]` (ordered by
      record_id ascending). Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-17
    description: >
      `panel_chair_signoff.composition_compliance_attested` MUST be true
      AND `escalations_disposed` MUST be true at finalization. False
      values are release blockers.

  - id: G1-INV-18
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`. The
      validator computes the chained hash of events and compares against
      a separately-maintained chain; out-of-order or missing events
      indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  - id: G1-INV-19
    description: >
      `predecessor_register_version` MUST be set whenever this register
      supersedes a prior finalized one. The predecessor register's state
      MUST be `superseded` and its `superseded_at` MUST be set to a time
      no later than this register's `opened_at`.

  - id: G1-INV-20
    description: >
      `fixity.register_sha256` MUST equal the SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical
      form of this register document with `fixity` excluded. The hash MUST
      be deterministic across re-runs given identical inputs.

  - id: G1-INV-21
    description: >
      No two signoffs from the same `reviewer_id` may exist on the same
      record. A reviewer cannot self-pair to satisfy the two-independent
      requirement.

  - id: G1-INV-22
    description: >
      No signoff may carry `decision == "panel-escalated"` while the
      RecordEntry's `state` is not `panel-escalated`. State and decisions
      MUST be consistent.

  - id: G1-INV-23
    description: >
      `cohort.scope.includes_pregnancy_records == true` AND any
      pregnancy-domain record in `records[]` MUST have at least one
      signoff with role == "mfm-or-obstetric-medicine" AND at least one
      signoff with role == "clinical-pharmacologist". Composition matrix
      enforcement is mandatory; no override exists.

  - id: G1-INV-24
    description: >
      `panel_chair_signoff.signature.algorithm` MUST be the same algorithm
      as the panel chair's `Reviewer.public_key.algorithm`. Algorithm
      drift between key registration and signing is a release blocker.

  - id: G1-INV-25
    description: >
      The cohort's TSA list (in guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml) MUST be
      pinned BEFORE any signoff is recorded. Time-stamps from TSAs added
      after a signoff are advisory only and do not satisfy the
      `time_stamp` requirement; the framework MUST recompute and reject.

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These examples are illustrative shape-correctness fixtures. EVERY field whose
# value can ONLY come from a real reviewer, a real institution, real
# credential evidence, or the source PDF is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit
# instructions. The pipeline refuses to operate on registers containing
# `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
#
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 An in-review cohort with one accepted record and one panel-escalated.
#   6.2 A finalized cohort with panel-chair signoff complete.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.1 In-review cohort
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    register_version: "1.0.0"
    predecessor_register_version: null
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"

    cohort:
      cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
      name: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'HBP-2025 Diagnosis & Measurement Cohort A'"
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      opened_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      finalized_at: null
      superseded_at: null
      state: in-review
      scope:
        domains: [diagnosis, bp-measurement, risk-stratification]
        includes_pregnancy_records: false

    panel:
      panel_id: "panel-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
      reviewers:
        - reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
          legal_name: "HUMAN_FILL: legal name as on government ID"
          preferred_credential_string: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'Jane Doe, MD, FACC'"
          role: hypertension-specialist
          institution: "HUMAN_FILL: institution name"
          identity_proof:
            ial: IAL2
            aal: AAL2
            proofing_method: "HUMAN_FILL: institutional proofing description"
            proofing_evidence_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/proofing-evidence"
            proofed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
            proofed_by_org: "HUMAN_FILL: institution"
            proofed_by_person: "HUMAN_FILL: optional"
          credentials:
            - kind: abim-certification
              issuer: "American Board of Internal Medicine"
              evidence_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/abim-verification"
              valid_from: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
              valid_until: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
              verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              verified_by: "HUMAN_FILL: framework operator id"
            - kind: ash-hypertension-specialist
              issuer: "American Society of Hypertension"
              evidence_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/ash-verification"
              valid_from: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
              valid_until: null
              verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              verified_by: "HUMAN_FILL"
          coi_disclosures:
            - kind: none
              counterparty: null
              scope: none
              scope_detail: null
              disclosed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              mitigation: null
              auto_disqualifies_record_kinds: []
          public_key:
            algorithm: Ed25519
            key_id: "HUMAN_FILL: institutional KMS key id"
            key_pem: "HUMAN_FILL: PEM block"
            fingerprint_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
          added_to_panel_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"

        - reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
          legal_name: "HUMAN_FILL"
          preferred_credential_string: "HUMAN_FILL"
          role: clinical-informaticist
          institution: "HUMAN_FILL"
          identity_proof:
            ial: IAL2
            aal: AAL2
            proofing_method: "HUMAN_FILL"
            proofing_evidence_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/proofing-evidence"
            proofed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
            proofed_by_org: "HUMAN_FILL"
            proofed_by_person: null
          credentials:
            - kind: amia-ciip
              issuer: "American Medical Informatics Association"
              evidence_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/amia-verification"
              valid_from: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
              valid_until: null
              verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              verified_by: "HUMAN_FILL"
          coi_disclosures:
            - kind: none
              counterparty: null
              scope: none
              scope_detail: null
              disclosed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              mitigation: null
              auto_disqualifies_record_kinds: []

# 7. CHANGE CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Any change to this schema (closed enums, policy clauses, validation rules,
# invariants, or example fixtures) requires:
#   - A change-controlled diff with regression evaluation against the golden set.
#   - Panel-chair signoff.
#   - Increment of `schema_version` (semver: breaking = major).
#   - Update of `last_reviewed`.
#   - Coordinated update of every producing/consuming skill's `tools_lock`
#     reference and acceptance test fixtures.
#   - Any change to: composition matrix; no_batch_acceptance; cor_loe_edit_prohibition;
#     post_signoff_immutability; conflict_of_interest; identity_proofing;
#     signature_algorithm; or time_stamping requires ALSO an ADR-HTN-001
#     amendment with documented rationale and a new panel-chair signoff.
# =============================================================================

change_control:
  semver: true
  golden_set_regression_required: true
  panel_chair_signoff_required: true
  parent_schemas_to_update_on_breaking_change:

    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/atomic-unit.yaml
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/sair.yaml

    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/parse-reconcile-queue
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/safety-hbp
  adr_amendment_required_for_policy_changes:
    composition_matrix: true
    no_batch_acceptance: true
    cor_loe_edit_prohibition: true
    post_signoff_immutability: true
    conflict_of_interest: true
    identity_proofing: true
    signature_algorithm: true
    time_stamping: true
    adr_to_amend: ADR-HTN-001 D9
```

Saved as `schemas/gate1-register.yaml`. The file is the auditable, signed, append-only ledger of Gate 1 SME extraction reviews, fully encoding Parse Spec §4.11 (composition, workflow, exit conditions) and ADR-HTN-001 D9. It is JSON-Schema-2020-12-flavored YAML, mirrors the parent repo's closed-enum-first / `additionalProperties: false` discipline, and treats every reviewer as a named individual with credential evidence rather than a role token. Twenty-five cross-field invariants (`G1-INV-01` … `G1-INV-25`) make the contract machine-checkable, including the two-independent-non-overlapping-roles rule (`G1-INV-05`–`G1-INV-06`), the post-signoff-immutability rule (`G1-INV-09`), the no-COR/LOE-edit rule (`G1-INV-12`, enforced both by the closed `EditTarget` enum and by the validator), the auto-disqualification-for-COI rule (`G1-INV-14`), the panel-chair-cohort-hash-recompute rule (`G1-INV-16`–`G1-INV-17`), the append-only-audit-log rule (`G1-INV-18`), the supersession-chain rule (`G1-INV-19`), the no-self-pairing rule (`G1-INV-21`), and the pregnancy-MFM+pharmacology rule (`G1-INV-23`). Two worked examples (an in-review cohort with one accepted record and one panel-escalated; a finalized cohort with full panel-chair signoff) demonstrate the lifecycle without inventing any reviewer identity, credential, key, signature, or clinical content; every value sourceable only from a real reviewer or institution is marked `HUMAN_FILL`.

If you want the next concrete step at the same fidelity (one at a time):

1. `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` — the per-build manifest referenced by `guideline_manifest_ref` across SAIR, recommendation-record, atomic-unit, and gate1-register; it pins the source PDF DOI/SHA, the predecessor 2017 supersession chain, the publisher-agreed quote-extent envelope, the pinned TSA list, the tools_lock, and the jurisdictional/effective-date triple.
2. `flow-hbp-2025-build` orchestrator with all three gate stops wired (Gate 1 stop wired to `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` + this register, Gate 2 to `cql-clinician-signoff`, Gate 3 to `safety-case-attest`).
3. `gate1-sme-review` `SKILL.md` — the reviewer-interface skill that produces `ReviewerSignoff` instances against this register and enforces the data-only specification in `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §10.2.
4. Open a tracking issue in `jmagly/aiwg-training` (or a new repo `jmagly/aiwg-cpg-htn-2025`) proposing this register as the canonical Gate 1 attestation contract.
