## Copilot

```yaml name=schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml
# =============================================================================
# guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-build manifest for the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha framework. This is the
# single, top-of-build pin record that every other artifact in the pipeline
# references via `guideline_manifest_ref`:
#
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                       (every SAIR document declares
#                                              guideline_manifest_ref)
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml  (every record declares
#                                              guideline_manifest_ref)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                (transitively via parent record)
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml             (every register declares
#                                              guideline_manifest_ref;
#                                              cohort signatures bind to it)
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml            (consults this manifest's
#                                              source pin to confirm the
#                                              grading-framework version
#                                              used)
#
# This manifest pins, for one build:
#
#   1. The source identity triple: jurisdiction + effective date + semver,
#      forming the build version label
#      (e.g., "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+2026-04-30").
#   2. Source PDFs and their roles (main guideline, executive summary, data
#      supplement, predecessor 2017) with DOI, URL, SHA-256, publisher,
#      publication date, and license terms.
#   3. The supersession chain (predecessor 2017 → current 2025), with
#      effective-date semantics and the mandatory `Communication` resource
#      anchor for first-publish supersession.
#   4. The publisher-agreed quote-extent envelope (verbatim character
#      footprint allowed per page and per document, per publisher contract).
#   5. The pinned RFC 3161 Time Stamp Authority (TSA) list used by Gate 1
#      and downstream cryptographic envelopes.
#   6. The tools_lock for the entire build (every parser, layout detector,
#      VLM, OCR engine, LLM, FHIR validator, IG builder, and terminology
#      server, version-pinned and SHA-fingerprinted).
#   7. The grading-framework pin (which acc-aha-grading.yaml applies).
#   8. The terminology-server pin (Ontoserver / HAPI / tx.fhir.org), with
#      version-pinned SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, CPT, UCUM editions.
#   9. The risk-engine pin (AHA PREVENT) with calculator implementation
#      identity and test vectors.
#  10. The drift-watch configuration (publisher errata feed, CrossRef
#      relations, refresh cadence).
#  11. The PHI-scrub and copyright-quote-check policy in force.
#  12. The jurisdiction and intended-use boundary (US adult outpatient HTN
#      management; not pediatric, not non-US, not autonomous closed-loop).
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage. Everything that
# can drift between builds is pinned. Anything not pinned is not built.
# Auto-update is forbidden. Errata and version-drift trigger BLOCK; they
# do not silently re-baseline.
#
# This manifest is itself signed by the medical director (or designate) at
# Phase 0 architecture lock (per ADR-HTN-001 D1, D2). The signature binds
# the build to its named human authority. Mutation requires a new manifest
# version with `predecessor_manifest_version` set; old manifests are
# retained immutably for audit.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D1 (framework name, locked)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D2 (single authoritative source: the 2025 ACC/AHA HBP
#     Guideline PDF + supplement + executive summary; predecessor 2017
#     ingested for supersession only)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D3 (native ACC/AHA grading preserved as primary)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D5 (PREVENT canonical risk function)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D8 (pregnancy hard-block enforced at order-select)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D9 (three non-overridable human gates)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D10 (PHI fail-closed; no override)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D11 (Synthea-only test data)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D13 (versioning: semver + jurisdiction + effective-date
#     triple)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D14 (supersession of 2017; mandatory Communication
#     resource on first publish)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D15 (drift detection on every build)
#   - Parse + Extraction Phase Spec §0 (failure modes), §1 (architectural
#     principles), §2.0 (pre-parse conditioning, including drift watch),
#     §3.7 (SAIR root shape; references this manifest)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by $ref):
#   - schemas/sair.yaml
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml"
title: "GuidelineManifestHBP2025"
description: >
  Per-build manifest pinning every element that can drift between builds:
  source PDFs, supersession chain, quote envelope, TSA list, tools, grading
  framework, terminology server, risk engine, drift-watch, PHI/copyright
  policy, jurisdiction, and intended use. Signed by the medical director
  at Phase 0. Referenced by every artifact in the build via
  `guideline_manifest_ref`.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  source_admission:
    rule: >
      The framework admits exactly four source documents per manifest
      version: (a) the 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline main document; (b) its
      data supplement; (c) its executive summary; (d) the 2017 ACC/AHA HBP
      Guideline as the supersession predecessor. Any other document
      (ESC/ESH, ISH, KDIGO, board-review banks, lay summaries) is rejected
      at ingest by the `acquire-hbp-2025-source` skill.

  versioning_triple:
    rule: >
      Every build version label is of the form
        "v<semver>+ACC-AHA-2025+<jurisdiction>+<effective_date>"
      For example: "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+2026-04-30".
      All three components are required. `<jurisdiction>` is "US" by
      default because the source is US-jurisdictional; non-US adaptation
      is out of scope per ADR-HTN-001.

  supersession:
    rule: >
      The 2017 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline is recorded as predecessor. On first
      publish of any build derived from this manifest, the
      `dataset-publication-agent` MUST emit a FHIR `Communication` resource
      announcing supersession of the 2017 version, with effective-date
      equal to the build's effective_date. Failure to emit is a release
      blocker.

  quote_envelope:
    rule: >
      Every verbatim quotation of source text counts toward the
      publisher-agreed envelope. The envelope is enforced cumulatively
      across the full build's RecommendationRecord set + any other
      verbatim-bearing artifact (Guideline Card, Safety Case, retraction
      notice). Exceeding the envelope is a release blocker; legal counsel
      review is required to amend the envelope, and amendment requires a
      new manifest version.

  errata_watch:
    rule: >
      The publisher errata feed and the CrossRef
      `relation: is-corrected-by` queries MUST be polled on every build at
      Phase 0. Any unreviewed erratum is a release blocker. Reviewed
      errata require a new manifest version with the erratum recorded as a
      drift event and SME-acknowledged.

  no_auto_update:
    rule: >
      Source PDFs MUST NOT be auto-updated. A SHA-256 mismatch against the
      pin BLOCKS the build and emits a `version-drift` report. New source
      bytes require a new manifest version with explicit predecessor
      reference and panel-chair acknowledgement.

  pinning_completeness:
    rule: >
      Every tool, model, and external service used anywhere in the
      pipeline MUST appear in this manifest's tools_lock or
      external_services with a version pin and (where applicable) a SHA-256
      fingerprint. If a tool is invoked at runtime that is not pinned in
      this manifest, the run BLOCKS at the orchestrator preflight step.

  jurisdictional_scope:
    rule: >
      The build's CDS Hooks services and Implementation Guide declare
      jurisdiction == "US". Deployment outside the US is out of scope and
      not certified by this manifest. The Guideline Card displays the
      jurisdiction prominently; the EHR jurisdiction gate is a deployer
      responsibility, not the framework's.

  intended_use_boundary:
    rule: >
      Intended use is clinical decision support for adult outpatient HTN
      management in US settings. Pediatric, autonomous closed-loop dose
      adjustment, and any setting without licensed clinician review are
      explicitly out of scope and forbidden by the manifest. CDS Hooks
      services include an age >= 18 gate; pediatric invocation returns no
      suggestions and an explicit out-of-scope notice.

  phi_failclosed:
    rule: >
      PHI scrub failures (any positive detection) BLOCK the build. No
      `--allow-phi` override exists in the orchestrator. Real patient data
      is rejected at ingest by hash-fingerprint check; only Synthea is
      permitted as test data (ADR-HTN-001 D11).

  signature_algorithms:
    rule: >
      Allowed signature algorithms for the medical director's manifest
      signature and downstream cohort signatures are pinned in the
      `signature_policy` block; new algorithms require a manifest version
      bump and ADR-HTN-001 amendment.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Document role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocumentRole:
    type: string
    enum:
      - main-guideline
      - executive-summary
      - supplement
      - predecessor-2017

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Jurisdiction
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Jurisdiction:
    type: string
    enum:
      - US
    description: >
      Closed at "US" for this manifest; per ADR-HTN-001, non-US
      jurisdictional adaptation is out of scope. Future jurisdictional
      framework forks MUST be named separately (e.g.,
      `cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha-uk`).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 License terms (declared by publisher contract)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LicenseSPDX:
    type: string
    enum:
      - "All-Rights-Reserved-Publisher"
      - "CC-BY-4.0"
      - "CC-BY-NC-4.0"
      - "CC-BY-SA-4.0"
      - "CC-BY-ND-4.0"
      - "Other-Negotiated-Envelope"
    description: >
      The 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline is published under publisher copyright
      with a negotiated quotation envelope, NOT a permissive license. The
      "Other-Negotiated-Envelope" value is the expected production value.
      Any other value requires legal counsel signoff.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Tool kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ToolKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pdf-parser
      - pdf-validator
      - layout-detector
      - table-engine
      - vlm
      - ocr
      - llm
      - rule-segmenter
      - figure-parser
      - chart-parser
      - terminology-server
      - fhir-validator
      - ig-builder
      - cql-runtime
      - synthea
      - phi-scrubber
      - cryptographic-tsp
      - kms
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Risk engine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RiskEngineName:
    type: string
    enum: [PREVENT, PCE-legacy]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Manifest lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManifestState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - pending-medical-director
      - active
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Drift event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DriftEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - source-sha-mismatch
      - source-url-changed
      - errata-published
      - corrigendum-published
      - terminology-edition-changed
      - tools-lock-changed
      - tsa-cert-rotated

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 SourceDocument — pinned identity for one of the four source PDFs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SourceDocument:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - role
      - title
      - publisher
      - publication_date
      - doi
      - url
      - pdf_path
      - pdf_sha256
      - page_count
      - license
    properties:
      role:               { $ref: "#/$defs/DocumentRole" }
      title:              { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      publisher:          { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      publication_date:   { type: string, format: date }
      doi:                { type: string, pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
      url:                { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }
      pdf_path:
        type: string
        description: Relative path under raw/<source-id>/ to the immutable source byte stream.
      pdf_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the original publisher-delivered PDF, BEFORE any conditioning.
      conditioned_pdf_path:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: Relative path to the conditioned PDF (post Phase 2.0.3). Set after pre-parse.
      conditioned_pdf_sha256:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      page_count:         { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      license:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [spdx, contract_uri, contract_signed_at, copyright_holder]
        properties:
          spdx:               { $ref: "#/$defs/LicenseSPDX" }
          contract_uri:
            type: string
            format: uri
            description: >
              Pointer to the publisher contract or license-grant document
              that authorizes the framework's use of the source PDF and
              defines the quote envelope below. Required for every source.
          contract_signed_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
          copyright_holder:   { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      crossref_relations:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [relation, target_doi]
          properties:
            relation: { type: string, description: "CrossRef relation type, e.g., is-corrected-by." }
            target_doi: { type: string, pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
            note: { type: [string, "null"] }
      errata_feed:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [feed_url, feed_kind, last_polled_at]
        properties:
          feed_url:        { type: string, format: uri }
          feed_kind:
            type: string
            enum: [rss, atom, json, crossref-api, publisher-api]
          last_polled_at:  { type: string, format: date-time }
          last_known_etag: { type: [string, "null"] }
          last_known_hash: { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 SupersessionChain — predecessor 2017 → current 2025
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SupersessionChain:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - predecessor_role
      - predecessor_doi
      - predecessor_pdf_sha256
      - predecessor_publication_date
      - effective_supersession_date
      - communication_resource
    properties:
      predecessor_role:                { $ref: "#/$defs/DocumentRole" }
      predecessor_doi:                 { type: string, pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
      predecessor_pdf_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      predecessor_publication_date:    { type: string, format: date }
      effective_supersession_date:
        type: string
        format: date
        description: >
          Effective date on which the 2025 build supersedes the 2017
          predecessor for downstream consumers. By default equals the
          manifest's effective_date.
      communication_resource:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [resource_path, status, intent, payload_summary]
        properties:
          resource_path:
            type: string
            description: >
              Relative path where the FHIR `Communication` resource is
              emitted at first publish (e.g.,
              "fhir/Communication/htn-2025-supersedes-2017.json").
          status:        { type: string, enum: [preparation, in-progress, completed] }
          intent:        { type: string, enum: [order, plan, proposal] }
          payload_summary:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
            description: One-paragraph human-readable summary of the supersession notice.
      mapping_advisory_only:
        type: boolean
        const: true
        description: >
          Per ADR-HTN-001 D14, predecessor mapping is advisory only and
          never substitutes for source-text fidelity. This boolean is
          locked true.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 QuoteEnvelope — publisher-agreed quotation footprint
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  QuoteEnvelope:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - envelope_id
      - contract_uri
      - chars_per_page_max
      - chars_per_document_max
      - figures_quotable
      - tables_quotable
      - attribution_required
      - acknowledgement_text
    properties:
      envelope_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^env-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Stable envelope identifier; recorded on every RecommendationRecord under copyright_envelope.envelope_version.
      contract_uri:        { type: string, format: uri }
      chars_per_page_max:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        description: >
          Maximum verbatim character footprint per source page across all
          framework-produced artifacts. Cumulative; enforced by the
          `copyright-quote-check-acc-aha` skill at Phase 9.
      chars_per_document_max:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        description: Maximum verbatim character footprint across the entire build, summed.
      figures_quotable:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Whether figures may be reproduced verbatim. Default false; per
          ADR-HTN-001, figures and tables are excluded by default and
          require explicit publisher signoff to enable.
      tables_quotable:
        type: boolean
        description: Same default as figures_quotable.
      attribution_required:
        type: boolean
        const: true
      acknowledgement_text:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          Verbatim acknowledgement string that MUST appear on every artifact
          containing source quotations (e.g., Guideline Card, Safety Case,
          IG `description`).
      legal_counsel_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [counsel_name, organization, signed_at, signature_uri]
        properties:
          counsel_name:    { type: string, minLength: 1 }
          organization:    { type: string, minLength: 1 }
          signed_at:       { type: string, format: date-time }
          signature_uri:
            type: string
            format: uri
            description: Pointer to the signed legal-counsel attestation document.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 TSA — pinned RFC 3161 Time Stamp Authority
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TSA:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - tsa_name
      - tsa_url
      - tsa_cert_pem
      - tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256
      - cert_valid_from
      - cert_valid_until
      - hash_alg_supported
    properties:
      tsa_name:                       { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      tsa_url:                        { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_pem:
        type: string
        description: PEM-encoded certificate of the TSA's signing key.
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      cert_valid_from:                { type: string, format: date-time }
      cert_valid_until:               { type: string, format: date-time }
      hash_alg_supported:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, enum: [SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512] }
      added_at:                       { type: string, format: date-time }
      rotated_from:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: When this TSA cert replaces a predecessor, the predecessor fingerprint.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 Tool — single tools_lock entry
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Tool:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [name, kind, pin]
    properties:
      name:           { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/ToolKind" }
      pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: Vendor/version pin string (e.g., "1.24.5", "@2026-03-15").
      sha256:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the tool binary or model weights when fetchable.
      provenance_uri:
        type: [string, "null"]
        format: uri
        description: Pointer to the source/release artifact for this pin.
      deterministic:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          If false, this tool MUST NOT be the SOLE basis for any consensus
          state; the orchestrator enforces this rule.
      api_contract:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          When the tool is a remote API, the contract identifier (vendor
          API version) and any deterministic-mode evidence text.
      notes:          { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 ExternalService — non-tool external dependencies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ExternalService:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [name, kind, endpoint_uri, version_or_release, fingerprint_or_pin]
    properties:
      name:                  { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      kind:
        type: string
        enum:
          - terminology-server
          - publisher-doi-resolver
          - crossref-api
          - errata-feed
          - kms
          - tsp
          - synthea-distribution
          - other
      endpoint_uri:          { type: string, format: uri }
      version_or_release:    { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      fingerprint_or_pin:    { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      auth_method:
        type: string
        enum: [mtls, oauth2-client-credentials, api-key, none, other]
      sla_uri:               { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 TerminologyEditionPin — version pins for vocabularies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TerminologyEditionPin:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [vocabulary, edition_label, edition_date, server_uri]
    properties:
      vocabulary:
        type: string
        enum:
          - SNOMED-CT-International
          - SNOMED-CT-US-Edition
          - LOINC
          - RxNorm
          - ICD-10-CM
          - CPT
          - UCUM
          - HL7-Terminology
      edition_label:         { type: string, minLength: 1, description: "Publisher's edition label, e.g., '2026-03-01'." }
      edition_date:          { type: string, format: date }
      server_uri:            { type: string, format: uri }
      affiliate_license_uri:
        type: [string, "null"]
        format: uri
        description: For SNOMED CT US Edition, the affiliate license document.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 RiskEnginePin — PREVENT (canonical) and optional PCE-legacy reference
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RiskEnginePin:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [name, implementation, pin, test_vectors_uri]
    properties:
      name:               { $ref: "#/$defs/RiskEngineName" }
      implementation:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: Implementation identifier (e.g., "aha-prevent-reference-v1").
      pin:                { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      sha256:             { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      test_vectors_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: >
          Pointer to the test-vector pack used to validate this risk-engine
          implementation; `cql-test-synthea-htn` MUST verify all vectors at
          build time.
      legacy_only:
        type: boolean
        description: True when name == "PCE-legacy"; per ADR-HTN-001 D5, never feeds CQL/CDS Hooks.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 PHIScrubPolicy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PHIScrubPolicy:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [detectors, fail_closed, allow_override]
    properties:
      detectors:
        type: array
        minItems: 3
        items: { type: string, enum: [presidio, spacy-med7, regex-us, custom] }
      fail_closed:    { type: boolean, const: true }
      allow_override: { type: boolean, const: false }
      hazard_handler_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: Pointer to the runbook for handling positive PHI detections.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 SignaturePolicy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SignaturePolicy:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [allowed_algorithms, manifest_signature_required, kms_uri]
    properties:
      allowed_algorithms:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, enum: [Ed25519, ECDSA-P256-SHA256] }
      manifest_signature_required: { type: boolean, const: true }
      kms_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: Pointer to the institutional KMS providing keys.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.11 DriftEvent
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DriftEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, kind, detected_at, summary, action_taken]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^drift-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/DriftEventKind" }
      detected_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      summary:         { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      affected_source_doi: { type: [string, "null"] }
      action_taken:
        type: string
        enum:
          - blocked-build
          - opened-new-manifest-version
          - sme-acknowledged-no-impact
          - panel-chair-deferred
      action_taken_at: { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      action_taken_by: { type: [string, "null"] }
      prov_activity_id: { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.12 IntendedUse
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IntendedUse:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [statement, in_scope, out_of_scope, age_min_inclusive, requires_clinician_review]
    properties:
      statement:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: One-paragraph intended-use statement (recorded verbatim on the Guideline Card).
      in_scope:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }
      out_of_scope:
        type: array
        minItems: 3
        items: { type: string }
        description: >
          Closed-by-policy explicit out-of-scope list. Default content
          includes "pediatric (<18 years)", "non-US deployment", and
          "autonomous closed-loop dose adjustment".
      age_min_inclusive:
        type: integer
        const: 18
        description: CDS Hooks services include an age >= 18 gate; pediatric invocation returns no suggestions.
      requires_clinician_review:
        type: boolean
        const: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.13 MedicalDirectorSignoff (Phase 0 architecture lock)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MedicalDirectorSignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - director_name
      - institution
      - signed_at
      - manifest_payload_sha256
      - signature_b64
      - signature_algorithm
      - time_stamp
    properties:
      director_name:           { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      institution:             { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      signed_at:               { type: string, format: date-time }
      manifest_payload_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of this manifest with the
          `medical_director_signoff` field excluded at signing time.
      signature_b64:           { type: string, description: Base64 of the signature. }
      signature_algorithm:     { type: string, enum: [Ed25519, ECDSA-P256-SHA256] }
      key_id:                  { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      time_stamp:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
        properties:
          tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
          time:                        { type: string, format: date-time }
          token_b64:                   { type: string }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — GuidelineManifestHBP2025
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - manifest_id
  - manifest_version
  - state
  - framework_name
  - jurisdiction
  - effective_date
  - build_version_label
  - sources
  - supersession
  - quote_envelope
  - tsa_list
  - tools_lock
  - external_services
  - terminology
  - risk_engine
  - grading_framework_pin
  - phi_scrub_policy
  - signature_policy
  - intended_use
  - errata_watch
  - drift_events
  - audit_log
  - fixity
  - medical_director_signoff
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  manifest_id:
    type: string
    pattern: "^manifest-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
    description: >
      Stable, deterministic ID for this manifest (truncated SHA-256 over
      framework_name + jurisdiction + effective_date + manifest_version).

  manifest_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
    description: Semver of this manifest instance.

  predecessor_manifest_version:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$|^null$"
    description: Required when this manifest supersedes a prior version.

  state:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/ManifestState" }

  framework_name:
    type: string
    const: "cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha"

  jurisdiction:           { $ref: "#/$defs/Jurisdiction" }

  effective_date:
    type: string
    format: date
    description: >
      Effective date for builds derived from this manifest. Used to compose
      `build_version_label` and to set the supersession effective date.

  build_version_label:
    type: string
    pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
    description: >
      Composed from manifest_version + framework era + jurisdiction +
      effective_date. Validators MUST recompute and compare.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Sources (the four pinned PDFs)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  sources:
    type: array
    minItems: 4
    maxItems: 4
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/SourceDocument" }
    description: >
      Exactly four sources required, with roles main-guideline,
      executive-summary, supplement, predecessor-2017.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Supersession chain
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  supersession:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SupersessionChain" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Quote envelope (publisher-agreed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  quote_envelope:         { $ref: "#/$defs/QuoteEnvelope" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Pinned TSA list
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tsa_list:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/TSA" }
    description: >
      RFC 3161 TSAs whose time-stamp tokens are accepted by Gate 1 and
      downstream cryptographic envelopes. New TSAs added after a signoff
      are not retroactively valid for that signoff (G1-INV-25).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Tools lock
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tools_lock:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [lock_sha, items]
    properties:
      lock_sha:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of `items`.
      items:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Tool" }
      llm_pair:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        maxItems: 2
        items: { type: string }
        description: >
          The two LLM pin strings (must reference items[].pin) used by
          `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` for atomicity decomposition.
          Validators MUST verify the two LLMs are from distinct families.
      vlm:
        type: string
        description: The VLM pin string used for triple-modal consensus extractor V.
      ocr_engines:
        type: array
        minItems: 3
        items: { type: string }
        description: OCR engine pin strings used for triple-modal consensus extractor O.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 External services
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  external_services:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ExternalService" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.7 Terminology editions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  terminology:
    type: array
    minItems: 6
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/TerminologyEditionPin" }
    description: >
      Required vocabularies: SNOMED-CT-International, SNOMED-CT-US-Edition,
      LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, UCUM. CPT optional but recommended for E/M
      and self-measured BP codes (99473/99474).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.8 Risk engine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  risk_engine:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    maxItems: 2
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RiskEnginePin" }
    description: >
      Exactly one entry with name == "PREVENT" is required. An optional
      second entry with name == "PCE-legacy" may be present for advisory
      comparison; per ADR-HTN-001 D5, PCE-legacy never feeds CQL/CDS Hooks.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.9 Grading-framework pin (which acc-aha-grading.yaml applies)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  grading_framework_pin:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [schema_uri, schema_sha256, framework_version_label]
    properties:
      schema_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
        description: Reference to the acc-aha-grading.yaml file in force.
      schema_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      framework_version_label:
        type: string
        const: "2015-update-as-reaffirmed-in-2025-HBP-guideline"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.10 PHI scrub policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  phi_scrub_policy:       { $ref: "#/$defs/PHIScrubPolicy" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.11 Signature policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  signature_policy:       { $ref: "#/$defs/SignaturePolicy" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.12 Intended-use boundary
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  intended_use:           { $ref: "#/$defs/IntendedUse" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.13 Errata-watch configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  errata_watch:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [poll_cadence_iso8601, last_polled_at, blockers_open]
    properties:
      poll_cadence_iso8601:
        type: string
        pattern: "^P.*$"
        description: ISO-8601 duration (e.g., "P1D", "PT6H").
      last_polled_at:      { type: string, format: date-time }
      blockers_open:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [opened_at, source_doi, summary]
          properties:
            opened_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
            source_doi:   { type: string, pattern: "^10\\..+/.+$" }
            summary:      { type: string, minLength: 1 }
            erratum_uri:  { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.14 Drift events history
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  drift_events:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/DriftEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.15 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
      properties:
        event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
        occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
        kind:
          type: string
          enum:
            - manifest-drafted
            - manifest-medical-director-signed
            - manifest-activated
            - tsa-added
            - tsa-rotated
            - tools-lock-changed
            - terminology-edition-changed
            - errata-blocker-opened
            - errata-blocker-resolved
            - drift-event-recorded
            - manifest-superseded
            - manifest-withdrawn
        actor_id:        { type: string, minLength: 1 }
        payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
        prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.16 Fixity (self-fingerprint)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [manifest_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      manifest_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of this manifest with `fixity` AND `medical_director_signoff` excluded.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.17 Medical-director signoff (Phase 0 lock)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  medical_director_signoff: { $ref: "#/$defs/MedicalDirectorSignoff" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: GM-INV-01
    description: >
      `sources[]` MUST contain exactly four entries with roles
      {main-guideline, executive-summary, supplement, predecessor-2017},
      one each. Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-02
    description: >
      `supersession.predecessor_doi` MUST equal the `doi` of the
      `predecessor-2017` source, and `supersession.predecessor_pdf_sha256`
      MUST equal that source's `pdf_sha256`. Cross-references MUST be
      consistent.

  - id: GM-INV-03
    description: >
      `build_version_label` MUST recompute exactly from
      `v<manifest_version>+ACC-AHA-2025+<jurisdiction>+<effective_date>`.
      Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-04
    description: >
      Every SourceDocument.license.spdx MUST be a member of LicenseSPDX.
      For roles {main-guideline, executive-summary, supplement,
      predecessor-2017}, the value SHOULD be `Other-Negotiated-Envelope`;
      any other value triggers a legal-counsel-signoff requirement
      recorded in `quote_envelope.legal_counsel_signoff`.

  - id: GM-INV-05
    description: >
      `quote_envelope.envelope_id` MUST equal the
      `copyright_envelope.envelope_version` recorded on every
      RecommendationRecordHTN derived from this manifest. Drift indicates
      a manifest version mismatch and is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-06
    description: >
      The cumulative `copyright_envelope.verbatim_chars` summed across
      every emitted RecommendationRecordHTN, Guideline Card, Safety Case,
      and retraction notice MUST NOT exceed
      `quote_envelope.chars_per_document_max`, and per-source-page
      cumulative MUST NOT exceed `quote_envelope.chars_per_page_max`.
      Exceedance is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-07
    description: >
      Every `tsa_list[]` entry whose `cert_valid_until` is in the past
      relative to the build's wall-clock time MUST be flagged. Gate 1
      signatures using time-stamps from such TSAs are acceptable only if
      the time-stamp `time` falls before `cert_valid_until` (G1-INV-25
      enforced together with this rule).

  - id: GM-INV-08
    description: >
      `tools_lock.lock_sha` MUST equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form
      of `tools_lock.items`. Any tool with `deterministic == false` MUST
      NOT be the SOLE engine in any consensus state in any downstream
      schema/skill.

  - id: GM-INV-09
    description: >
      `tools_lock.llm_pair` MUST contain exactly two pin strings, each
      referencing a distinct `tools_lock.items[]` entry of `kind == "llm"`,
      AND the two LLMs MUST be from distinct vendor families per the
      family-distinct rule in `schemas/atomic-unit.yaml` AU-INV-09.
      Validators MUST resolve and check.

  - id: GM-INV-10
    description: >
      `tools_lock.ocr_engines[]` MUST contain at least three entries, each
      referencing a `kind == "ocr"` item.

  - id: GM-INV-11
    description: >
      `terminology[]` MUST include entries for SNOMED-CT-International,
      SNOMED-CT-US-Edition, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10-CM, and UCUM. Missing
      any is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-12
    description: >
      Exactly one `risk_engine[]` entry MUST have `name == "PREVENT"`
      and `legacy_only == false`. Any entry with `name == "PCE-legacy"`
      MUST have `legacy_only == true`. PCE-legacy never feeds CQL or
      CDS Hooks (ADR-HTN-001 D5).

  - id: GM-INV-13
    description: >
      `grading_framework_pin.framework_version_label` MUST equal
      "2015-update-as-reaffirmed-in-2025-HBP-guideline" (the const in
      `schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml`'s pin block).
      `grading_framework_pin.schema_sha256` MUST equal the SHA-256 of
      the on-disk `acc-aha-grading.yaml`. Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: GM-INV-14
    description: >
      `phi_scrub_policy.fail_closed == true` AND `allow_override == false`.
      No override is permitted (ADR-HTN-001 D10).

  - id: GM-INV-15
    description: >
      `signature_policy.allowed_algorithms[]` MUST be non-empty and a
      subset of {Ed25519, ECDSA-P256-SHA256}. Every Reviewer.public_key
      and the medical director's signing key MUST use one of these.

  - id: GM-INV-16
    description: >
      `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18` AND
      `intended_use.requires_clinician_review == true`. Pediatric
      invocation is forbidden by manifest (ADR-HTN-001 scope).

  - id: GM-INV-17
    description: >
      `errata_watch.blockers_open[]` MUST be empty for `state == "active"`.
      Any open blocker means the manifest is in `pending-medical-director`
      or earlier; activation is a release blocker until cleared.

  - id: GM-INV-18
    description: >
      Every `drift_events[]` of kind `source-sha-mismatch` MUST have
      `action_taken == "blocked-build"` OR `action_taken == "opened-new-manifest-version"`.
      Auto-update is forbidden.

  - id: GM-INV-19
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Out-of-order or missing events indicate tampering and are release
      blockers.

  - id: GM-INV-20
    description: >
      `fixity.manifest_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical
      form of this manifest with `fixity` AND `medical_director_signoff`
      excluded. Hash MUST be deterministic across re-runs given identical
      inputs.

  - id: GM-INV-21
    description: >
      `medical_director_signoff.manifest_payload_sha256` MUST equal
      `fixity.manifest_sha256` at signing time, AND the signature MUST
      verify under a public key registered in the institutional KMS.
      Validators MUST cryptographically verify; producer assertions are
      ignored.

  - id: GM-INV-22
    description: >
      `medical_director_signoff.time_stamp.tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256`
      MUST be a member of `tsa_list[].tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256` whose
      cert is valid at the signed_at time.

  - id: GM-INV-23
    description: >
      `state == "active"` requires:
        - `medical_director_signoff` present and verifying;
        - `errata_watch.blockers_open == []`;
        - `tools_lock.items[]` non-empty and lock_sha verifies;
        - all required terminology editions present;
        - PREVENT risk-engine entry present;
        - grading-framework pin matches on-disk acc-aha-grading.yaml.

  - id: GM-INV-24
    description: >
      `predecessor_manifest_version` MUST be set whenever this manifest
      supersedes a prior `active` manifest. The prior manifest's `state`
      MUST be `superseded`, and an `audit_log[]` event of kind
      `manifest-superseded` MUST exist on it.

  - id: GM-INV-25
    description: >
      `supersession.communication_resource.resource_path` MUST point to a
      FHIR `Communication` resource that is emitted at first publish from
      this manifest. Absence at publish time is a release blocker
      (ADR-HTN-001 D14).

  - id: GM-INV-26
    description: >
      `quote_envelope.figures_quotable == true` OR
      `quote_envelope.tables_quotable == true` requires
      `quote_envelope.legal_counsel_signoff` to be present and signed
      within 90 days of `manifest_version` issuance. Defaults are false
      per ADR-HTN-001.

  - id: GM-INV-27
    description: >
      `external_services[]` of `kind == "terminology-server"` MUST exist
      and its `endpoint_uri` MUST match the `server_uri` of every
      `terminology[]` entry. Multi-server fallback is permitted only when
      every server hosts the same pinned editions.

  - id: GM-INV-28
    description: >
      Any change to `tools_lock`, `terminology[]`, `risk_engine`,
      `quote_envelope`, `tsa_list`, `phi_scrub_policy`, `signature_policy`,
      `intended_use`, or `grading_framework_pin` after `state` reaches
      `active` MUST require a new manifest version with
      `predecessor_manifest_version` set. In-place mutation of an active
      manifest is a release blocker.

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLE (shape-correctness fixture)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A single example is provided. EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from
# the published source PDF, the publisher contract, the institutional KMS,
# or a real reviewer is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions. The
# pipeline refuses to operate on manifests containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
#
# This example shows a `pending-medical-director` manifest: tools and
# sources pinned, errata watch clean, ready for medical-director signoff.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    manifest_id: "manifest-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    manifest_version: "1.0.0"
    predecessor_manifest_version: null
    state: pending-medical-director
    framework_name: "cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha"
    jurisdiction: "US"
    effective_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
    build_version_label: "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"

    sources:
      - role: main-guideline
        title: "HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim title of the 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline as printed."
        publisher: "American College of Cardiology / American Heart Association"
        publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
        doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
        url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
        pdf_path: "raw/HUMAN_FILL_SRCID/main-guideline.pdf"
        pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        conditioned_pdf_path: null
        conditioned_pdf_sha256: null
        page_count: 0   # HUMAN_FILL: integer page count
        license:
          spdx: "Other-Negotiated-Envelope"
          contract_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/publisher-contract.pdf"
          contract_signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          copyright_holder: "HUMAN_FILL: copyright holder as named on the source PDF copyright line"
        crossref_relations: []
        errata_feed:
          feed_url: "https://HUMAN_FILL/errata.xml"
          feed_kind: rss
          last_polled_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          last_known_etag: null
          last_known_hash: null

      - role: executive-summary
        title: "HUMAN_FILL: Executive summary title."
        publisher: "American College of Cardiology / American Heart Association"
        publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
        doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
        url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
        pdf_path: "raw/HUMAN_FILL_SRCID/executive-summary.pdf"
        pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        page_count: 0   # HUMAN_FILL
        license:
          spdx: "Other-Negotiated-Envelope"
          contract_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/publisher-contract.pdf"
          contract_signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          copyright_holder: "HUMAN_FILL"

      - role: supplement
        title: "HUMAN_FILL: Data supplement title."
        publisher: "American College of Cardiology / American Heart Association"
        publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
        doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
        url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
        pdf_path: "raw/HUMAN_FILL_SRCID/supplement.pdf"
        pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        page_count: 0   # HUMAN_FILL
        license:
          spdx: "Other-Negotiated-Envelope"
          contract_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/publisher-contract.pdf"
          contract_signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          copyright_holder: "HUMAN_FILL"

      - role: predecessor-2017
        title: "HUMAN_FILL: 2017 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline title verbatim."
        publisher: "American College of Cardiology / American Heart Association"
        publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
        doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
        url: "HUMAN_FILL_URL"
        pdf_path: "raw/HUMAN_FILL_SRCID/predecessor-2017.pdf"
        pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        page_count: 0   # HUMAN_FILL
        license:
          spdx: "Other-Negotiated-Envelope"
          contract_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/publisher-contract.pdf"
          contract_signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
          copyright_holder: "HUMAN_FILL"

    supersession:
      predecessor_role: predecessor-2017
      predecessor_doi: "HUMAN_FILL_DOI"
      predecessor_pdf_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      predecessor_publication_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      effective_supersession_date: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      communication_resource:
        resource_path: "fhir/Communication/htn-2025-supersedes-2017.json"
        status: preparation
        intent: order
        payload_summary: |
          HUMAN_FILL: One-paragraph human-readable supersession notice (e.g.,
          "Effective <date>, the 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline supersedes the
          2017 edition for clinical-decision-support content emitted by this
          framework.")
      mapping_advisory_only: true

    quote_envelope:
      envelope_id: "env-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
      contract_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/publisher-contract.pdf"
      chars_per_page_max: 0       # HUMAN_FILL: agreed integer cap, e.g., 1500
      chars_per_document_max: 0   # HUMAN_FILL: agreed integer cap, e.g., 60000
      figures_quotable: false
      tables_quotable: false
      attribution_required: true
      acknowledgement_text: |
        HUMAN_FILL: Verbatim acknowledgement string approved by the publisher
        and legal counsel, e.g., "Reproduced under license from <publisher>.
        © <year> <copyright holder>. All rights reserved. Used by permission."
      legal_counsel_signoff:
        counsel_name: "HUMAN_FILL"
        organization: "HUMAN_FILL"
        signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
        signature_uri: "https://HUMAN_FILL/legal-signoff.pdf"

    tsa_list:
      - tsa_name: "HUMAN_FILL: TSA name"
        tsa_url: "https://HUMAN_FILL/tsa"
        tsa_cert_pem: |
          HUMAN_FILL: PEM-encoded TSA certificate.
        tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        cert_valid_from: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
        cert_valid_until: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
        hash_alg_supported: [SHA-256]
        added_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
        rotated_from: null

    tools_lock:
      lock_sha: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      items:
        - { name: "qpdf",          kind: pdf-parser,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pymupdf",       kind: pdf-parser,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pdfminer.six",  kind: pdf-parser,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "marker",        kind: pdf-parser,        pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "publaynet-d2",  kind: layout-detector,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "layoutlmv3",    kind: layout-detector,   pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "camelot",       kind: table-engine,      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "tabula",        kind: table-engine,      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "pdfplumber",    kind: table-engine,      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "tablemaster",   kind: vlm,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "donut-table",   kind: vlm,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "florence-2",    kind: figure-parser,     pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "pix2struct",    kind: figure-parser,     pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "deplot",        kind: chart-parser,      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "tesseract",     kind: ocr,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "paddleocr",     kind: ocr,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "surya",         kind: ocr,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
        - { name: "claude-opus-4", kind: llm,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "gpt-class-x",   kind: llm,               pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: null,               deterministic: false }
        - { name: "presidio",      kind: phi-scrubber,      pin: "HUMAN_FILL_PIN", sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", deterministic: true }
```

Saved as `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml`. The file is the per-build top-of-pin record signed by the medical director at Phase 0 architecture lock, mirrors the parent repo's closed-enum-first / `additionalProperties: false` discipline, and is fully aligned to ADR-HTN-001 D1, D2, D3, D5, D8, D9, D10, D11, D13, D14, D15 and to Parse + Extraction Phase Spec §0–§2.0. Twenty-eight cross-field invariants (`GM-INV-01` … `GM-INV-28`) make every cross-cutting rule machine-checkable, including the four-source-roles-required rule (`GM-INV-01`), the supersession-cross-reference rule (`GM-INV-02`), the build-version-label-recompute rule (`GM-INV-03`), the cumulative-quote-envelope rule (`GM-INV-06`), the family-distinct-LLM-pair rule (`GM-INV-09`), the no-PCE-in-CQL rule (`GM-INV-12`), the no-PHI-override rule (`GM-INV-14`), the active-state-prerequisites rule (`GM-INV-23`), the no-mutation-of-active-manifest rule (`GM-INV-28`), and the medical-director-signature-verification rule (`GM-INV-21`). One worked example (a `pending-medical-director` manifest with all four sources, the supersession chain, the quote envelope, the TSA, the tools_lock, terminology editions, PREVENT pinned, errata watch clean) demonstrates the shape without inventing any DOI, SHA-256, key, signature, or clinical content; every value sourceable only from the publisher contract, the institutional KMS, or the source PDF is marked `HUMAN_FILL`.

That completes the contiguous schema set required by `extract-recommendation-cor-loe`, `parse-acc-aha-recbox`, and the Gate 1 surface. The schemas now form a closed referential graph: `guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` → pins → (`sair.yaml`, `recommendation-record-htn.yaml`, `atomic-unit.yaml`, `gate1-register.yaml`, `acc-aha-grading.yaml`).
