## Copilot

```yaml name=schemas/gate2-register.yaml
# =============================================================================
# gate2-register.yaml
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standalone schema for the Gate 2 cohort register — the auditable, signed,
# append-only ledger of Library-scoped clinician + informaticist signoffs
# that gate every CQL Library before it advances to Phase 22 (CDS Hooks
# packaging) and Phase 28 (publication).
#
# This file is the contract for:
#   - Cohort identity (a named batch of CQL Libraries under review).
#   - Reviewer credential evidence (named individuals, board certifications,
#     identity proofing, conflicts of interest) — same primitives as
#     gate1-register.yaml but scoped to Library reviews.
#   - Per-Library reviewer signoffs (decisions, rationales, COI re-attestations,
#     concern categories, signatures) — NEVER edits to Library content.
#   - Cohort-axis informatics signoff (one per cohort) covering provenance
#     integrity, terminology pin consistency, FHIR-IG version alignment, and
#     CDS-Hooks service-Library wiring readiness.
#   - Hard-block invariants registry for each Library (the pregnancy
#     denylist, the PREVENT canonicalization, the age gate, etc.) with
#     reference-test verification pointers.
#   - Coverage-floor invariants (95% Synthea branch coverage per Library).
#   - Panel-chair cohort signoff.
#   - Cryptographic signature envelope (Ed25519 / ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over
#     RFC 8785 JCS canonical payload, RFC 3161 time-stamp).
#   - Post-signoff immutability rules (no mutation of signed Library
#     content; corrections require a new Library snapshot with a new
#     library_content_hash and a fresh signoff).
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage. Every signature
# is verified, never trusted. Every reviewer is a named, credential-evidenced
# individual, not a role token. Every decision is on a single Library, never
# on a batch. Every hard-block-relax proposal is auto-routed to reject-rework
# regardless of clinical rationale; the schema makes the rule machine-checkable.
# Below the 95% coverage floor, the Library cannot advance.
#
# This file does NOT contain CQL source. It records WHO signed WHICH Library
# at WHAT content hash and WHEN, against the typecheck and coverage reports
# computed by `emit-cql-htn` and `cql-test-synthea-htn`. CQL source lives
# in work/<run_id>/cql/<library_id>/ ; this file points to it.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D5 (PREVENT canonical risk function)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D8 (pregnancy hard-block enforced at order-select)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D9 (three non-overridable human gates; Gate 2 enforces
#     two-independent-reviewer signoff per Library, panel-chair cohort
#     signoff)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D10 (PHI fail-closed; copyright envelope respected;
#     these are upstream/sibling concerns but the manifest reference is
#     consulted at sign time)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D11 (Synthea-only test data; the coverage report is
#     against Synthea cohorts only)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D14 (supersession chain; predecessor 2017 advisory)
#   - Framework spec §7 (CDS Hooks; pregnancy denylist as order-select)
#   - Framework spec §9 (CQL Libraries; the nine canonical Libraries)
#   - Framework spec §10 (Synthea cohort coverage floor)
#   - `cql-clinician-signoff` SKILL.md (the only authorized writer)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by $ref):
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml   (each Library entry references
#                                              the consumed RecommendationRecord
#                                              ids by content hash)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                 (referenced for atomic-unit
#                                              consumption by Libraries)
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                        (referenced for source anchors
#                                              the reviewers may navigate to
#                                              as context)
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml             (closed COR/LOE enums; cited
#                                              for the no-grade-relax rule)
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml              (the prerequisite Gate 1
#                                              register; this register
#                                              cannot finalize without
#                                              every contributing Gate 1
#                                              cohort being finalized)
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml (per-build manifest;
#                                              terminology editions,
#                                              risk_engine pin, tsa_list,
#                                              quote envelope, intended use,
#                                              and signature_policy are
#                                              consulted)
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/gate2-register.yaml"
title: "Gate2Register"
description: >
  Auditable, signed, append-only register of Gate 2 Library reviews for a
  cohort of CQL Libraries derived from a single guideline manifest. Each
  register entry binds a named reviewer with credential evidence to a
  content-hash signature on a single Library snapshot. Cohort-level
  finality requires a panel-chair signoff and a cohort-axis informatics
  signoff. Post-signoff Library content is immutable; corrections require
  a new Library snapshot with explicit predecessor chain and a fresh
  signoff against the new library_content_hash.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  reviewer_composition:
    rule: >
      Every advanced Library MUST carry exactly two independent reviewer
      signoffs from distinct, non-overlapping roles per the Gate-2
      composition matrix. The hypertension specialist appears on every
      Library except `PregnancyHTN`, which is reviewed by MFM (or
      obstetric medicine) plus clinical pharmacology. The clinical
      informaticist additionally co-signs every Library on the cohort
      axis (a single CohortAxisSignoff per cohort), not as a per-Library
      reviewer except where the matrix below names them.
    matrix:
      - library_name_glob: "HBPStaging"
        domain: classification
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-informaticist]
      - library_name_glob: "TreatmentThreshold"
        domain: pharmacologic-general
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-informaticist]
      - library_name_glob: "PreventRisk"
        domain: risk-stratification
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-informaticist]
      - library_name_glob: "FirstLineSelection"
        domain: pharmacologic-general
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-pharmacologist]
      - library_name_glob: "SpecialPopulationModifiers"
        domain: special-populations-modifiers
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-pharmacologist]
      - library_name_glob: "PregnancyHTN"
        domain: pregnancy-postpartum
        required_roles: [mfm-or-obstetric-medicine, clinical-pharmacologist]
        notes: >
          The hypertension specialist may also appear; the schema accepts
          up to four signoffs to accommodate institutional policy that
          requires three signatures on pregnancy Libraries.
      - library_name_glob: "ResistantHTN"
        domain: resistant-htn
        required_roles: [hypertension-specialist, clinical-pharmacologist]
      - library_name_glob: "SecondaryHTNTriggers"
        domain: secondary-htn
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - "(nephrology OR endocrinology)"
      - library_name_glob: "HypertensiveUrgencyEmergency"
        domain: urgency-emergency
        required_roles:
          - hypertension-specialist
          - "(emergency-medicine OR critical-care)"
    cohort_axis_attestation:
      role: clinical-informaticist
      scope: >
        Provenance integrity across all Libraries; terminology pin
        consistency; FHIR-IG version alignment; CDS-Hooks service-Library
        wiring readiness.
      required: true

  no_batch_acceptance:
    rule: >
      No reviewer may sign more than one Library per signature payload.
      Each Library requires its own signature against its own
      library_content_hash. Batch acceptance is forbidden.

  no_edit_at_gate2:
    rule: >
      Gate 2 has no `accept-with-edit` mode. Library content (CQL source,
      ELM, value-set bindings, risk-engine bindings, hard-block invariants,
      denylists, age gates) is read-only at this gate. Any reviewer
      proposal to change Library content MUST be expressed as
      `reject-rework` with a closed concern category and a free-text
      rationale. The orchestrator consumes the rework signal, re-authors
      the Library upstream at P20, regenerates coverage at P21, and
      re-posts the new Library snapshot to a fresh register entry. The
      reviewer's prior signoff is invalidated by the new
      library_content_hash and a new signoff is required.

  no_relax_of_hard_block:
    rule: >
      No reviewer signoff (rationale, comment, or concern) may propose:
        - converting an `order-select` hard refusal to a soft warning,
        - removing a class from a Library's denylist (notably the
          pregnancy denylist for ACEi, ARB, MRA, direct renin inhibitor),
        - replacing PREVENT with PCE-legacy in any Library binding a
          risk engine,
        - lowering the age gate below 18,
        - adding an attending-override or "permit on attending override"
          branch to any denylist or hard-block.
      Such proposals MUST be auto-rewritten to `reject-rework` with the
      rationale prefixed "Auto-rewrite per `no_relax_of_hard_block`."
      Validators MUST detect attempted hard-block-relax decisions
      sneaking in via direct API as `gate2-edit-attempt` events.

  coverage_floor:
    rule: >
      No Library may advance with branch coverage below 95.0% on the
      pinned Synthea cohort. The coverage report is recomputed at sign
      time from work/<run_id>/cql/coverage/<library_id>.json and
      compared byte-for-byte (or aggregate-metric-equal under
      `eq-tolerance` recorded on the runtime, where the runtime is
      declared `nondeterministic` in `tools_lock`) to the recorded
      report. Mismatch is a release blocker.

  typecheck_clean:
    rule: >
      No Library may advance with any typecheck error or with any
      typecheck warning that the manifest's policy promotes to error.
      The typecheck report is recomputed at sign time and compared to
      the recorded report.

  hard_block_verification:
    rule: >
      Every Library's declared hard-block invariants MUST be verified
      by at least one reference test in the Library's reference-test
      pack. Unverified hard-blocks are a release blocker. The schema
      records the verification pointer per invariant.

  cor_loe_immutable_at_gate2:
    rule: >
      ACC/AHA COR and LOE values, atomic-recommendation spans, and
      atomic-unit inheritance are read-only at Gate 2 (they were
      finalized at Gate 1). Validators MUST refuse any signoff whose
      payload references altered COR/LOE on any consumed
      RecommendationRecord.

  post_signoff_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once a `LibrarySignoff` is recorded with `decision ∈ {accept,
      accept-with-comment}`, neither its `signature` nor the
      `library_content_hash` it signed may be mutated. Any change to the
      underlying Library produces a new snapshot with a new content hash
      and requires a new `LibrarySignoff` against that new hash. The old
      signoff is retained immutably for audit.

  panel_chair_signoff:
    rule: >
      Cohort finality requires a `PanelChairSignoff` over the cohort's
      manifest hash (the SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of
      `libraries[]` ordered by `library_id` ascending). The panel chair
      is a named individual with credential evidence; their signoff
      disposes of escalations and certifies composition compliance,
      coverage-floor satisfaction, hard-block-invariant verification,
      and the cohort-axis informatics signoff presence.

  conflict_of_interest:
    rule: >
      Every reviewer (and the panel chair) MUST disclose a current
      Conflict of Interest (COI) statement. A reviewer with an
      undisclosed or material COI on a Library's subject (e.g., a
      pharmaceutical relationship for `FirstLineSelection`,
      `SpecialPopulationModifiers`, `PregnancyHTN`, or `ResistantHTN`) is
      automatically disqualified for that Library; the disqualification
      is recorded as a register entry of state `recused`, and a
      substitute reviewer of the same role is required.

  identity_proofing:
    rule: >
      Every reviewer's identity MUST be proofed at NIST SP 800-63 IAL2
      or higher. Reviewers with role `panel-chair` or `medical-director`
      MUST be at IAL3/AAL3.

  signature_algorithm:
    rule: >
      Signatures use Ed25519 (default) or ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the
      canonical JCS (RFC 8785) form of the signed payload. The algorithm
      and key identifier are pinned per cohort in the active manifest;
      mismatch is a release blocker.

  time_stamping:
    rule: >
      Every signoff carries an RFC 3161 time-stamp from a TSA pinned in
      the active manifest's `tsa_list[]`. Time-stamp absence is a
      release blocker.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Library identity (closed set; matches framework spec §9)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibraryName:
    type: string
    enum:
      - HBPStaging
      - PreventRisk
      - TreatmentThreshold
      - FirstLineSelection
      - SpecialPopulationModifiers
      - PregnancyHTN
      - ResistantHTN
      - SecondaryHTNTriggers
      - HypertensiveUrgencyEmergency

  LibraryDomain:
    type: string
    enum:
      - classification
      - risk-stratification
      - pharmacologic-general
      - special-populations-modifiers
      - pregnancy-postpartum
      - resistant-htn
      - secondary-htn
      - urgency-emergency

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Reviewer roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerRole:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hypertension-specialist
      - clinical-pharmacologist
      - mfm-or-obstetric-medicine
      - geriatrician
      - primary-care-clinician
      - clinical-informaticist
      - nephrology
      - endocrinology
      - emergency-medicine
      - critical-care
      - panel-chair
      - medical-director

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Reviewer decisions (Gate 2; note absence of accept-with-edit)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerDecision:
    type: string
    enum:
      - accept
      - accept-with-comment
      - reject-rework
      - escalate-panel
      - recused
    description: >
      Gate 2 deliberately omits `accept-with-edit`. Any change to Library
      content is `reject-rework`, which signals the orchestrator to
      re-author at P20.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Concern categories (closed; surface a substantive concern without edit)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConcernCategory:
    type: string
    enum:
      - boundary-too-permissive
      - boundary-too-restrictive
      - mapping-incorrect
      - denylist-incomplete
      - coverage-gap
      - hard-block-relax-attempted   # auto-detected; recorded for audit
      - documentation-only
      - other
    description: >
      Closed-by-policy concern categories. Any category other than
      `documentation-only` automatically proposes `reject-rework`.
      `hard-block-relax-attempted` is recorded by the auto-routing
      machinery on detection of a hard-block-relax proposal; reviewers
      do not select it directly.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Identity assurance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [IAL1, IAL2, IAL3]

  AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [AAL1, AAL2, AAL3]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Credential kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CredentialKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - abim-certification
      - abp-certification
      - abfm-certification
      - abem-certification
      - aoa-board-certification
      - ash-hypertension-specialist
      - amia-ciip
      - abpm-clinical-informatics
      - bccp-pharmacy
      - bcps-aq-cardiology
      - mfm-board-certification
      - geriatric-medicine-board-certification
      - nephrology-board-certification
      - endocrinology-board-certification
      - critical-care-board-certification
      - state-medical-license
      - institutional-credential
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Conflict-of-interest kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  COIKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - none
      - financial-pharmaceutical
      - financial-device
      - research-grant
      - speakers-bureau
      - consultancy
      - equity-holding
      - employment-related
      - family-relationship
      - publication-author
      - guideline-author
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Signature algorithms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SignatureAlgorithm:
    type: string
    enum:
      - Ed25519
      - ECDSA-P256-SHA256

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Cohort lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CohortState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - in-review
      - awaiting-cohort-axis
      - awaiting-panel-chair
      - finalized
      - superseded
      - withdrawn
    description: >
      `awaiting-cohort-axis` is reached when every per-Library signoff
      pair is complete but the cohort-axis informatics signoff has not
      yet been recorded. `awaiting-panel-chair` is reached when both
      per-Library and cohort-axis are complete but the panel-chair
      signoff has not yet been recorded. `finalized` is terminal for a
      register version.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Per-Library disposition states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibraryDispositionState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pending
      - accepted
      - accepted-with-comment
      - rework-required
      - panel-escalated
      - panel-resolved
      - awaiting-time-stamp
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Hard-block invariant kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HardBlockInvariantKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
      - pregnancy-firstline-restricted
      - pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql
      - prevent-canonical-binding
      - age-gate-ge-18
      - aki-triple-whammy-warning
      - hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning
      - beta-blocker-no-abrupt-discontinuation
      - older-adult-orthostasis-monitoring
      - aldosteronism-screen-resistant
      - bp-confirmation-out-of-office
    description: >
      Closed kinds for declared hard-block invariants per Library. Each
      Library carries the subset applicable to it. Validators MUST
      verify that every declared kind has a verifying reference test.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Audit-event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cohort-created
      - reviewer-added
      - reviewer-removed
      - library-added
      - signoff-recorded
      - cohort-axis-signed
      - escalation-opened
      - escalation-resolved
      - rework-opened
      - rework-resolved
      - panel-chair-signed
      - cohort-finalized
      - cohort-superseded
      - cohort-withdrawn
      - hard-block-relax-attempted   # adversarial input audit
      - gate2-edit-attempt           # adversarial input audit

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 IdentityProof — institutional verification of a reviewer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityProof:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [ial, aal, proofing_method, proofing_evidence_uri, proofed_at, proofed_by_org]
    properties:
      ial: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityAssuranceLevel" }
      aal: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel" }
      proofing_method:        { type: string }
      proofing_evidence_uri:
        type: string
        format: uri
      proofed_at:             { type: string, format: date-time }
      proofed_by_org:         { type: string }
      proofed_by_person:      { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Credential
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Credential:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, issuer, evidence_uri, valid_from]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/CredentialKind" }
      issuer:         { type: string }
      evidence_uri:   { type: string, format: uri }
      valid_from:     { type: string, format: date }
      valid_until:    { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
      verified_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      verified_by:    { type: string }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 ConflictOfInterest
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConflictOfInterest:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, disclosed_at, scope]
    properties:
      kind:                              { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      counterparty:                      { type: [string, "null"] }
      scope:
        type: string
        enum:
          - none
          - drug-class
          - device-class
          - therapeutic-area
          - guideline-document
          - library-domain
          - other
      scope_detail:                      { type: [string, "null"] }
      disclosed_at:                      { type: string, format: date-time }
      mitigation:                        { type: [string, "null"] }
      auto_disqualifies_library_names:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryName" }
      auto_disqualifies_library_domains:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryDomain" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Reviewer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Reviewer:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - reviewer_id
      - legal_name
      - role
      - identity_proof
      - credentials
      - coi_disclosures
      - public_key
    properties:
      reviewer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Stable, deterministic ID for this reviewer (truncated SHA-256
          of institution + employee number + identity_proof.proofing_evidence_uri).
          Reviewers may be the same individuals as in the cohort's
          contributing Gate 1 register; the reviewer_id is shared by
          design.
      legal_name:                   { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      preferred_credential_string:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      role:                         { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
      institution:                  { type: string }
      identity_proof:               { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityProof" }
      credentials:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Credential" }
      coi_disclosures:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ConflictOfInterest" }
      public_key:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [algorithm, key_id, key_pem]
        properties:
          algorithm:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
          key_id:              { type: string }
          key_pem:             { type: string }
          fingerprint_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      added_to_panel_at:       { type: string, format: date-time }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 TimeStamp
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TimeStamp:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [tsa_name, tsa_url, tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
    properties:
      tsa_name:                       { type: string }
      tsa_url:                        { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      time:                           { type: string, format: date-time }
      token_b64:                      { type: string }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Signature
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Signature:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [algorithm, key_id, payload_canonical_form, payload_sha256, signature_b64, time_stamp]
    properties:
      algorithm:               { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
      key_id:                  { type: string }
      payload_canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
      payload_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      signature_b64:           { type: string }
      time_stamp:              { $ref: "#/$defs/TimeStamp" }
      verifies:                { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 LibrarySnapshotPointer — what each Library entry points to on disk
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibrarySnapshotPointer:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - library_id
      - library_name
      - library_version
      - snapshot_dir
      - cql_files
      - elm_files
      - typecheck_report_path
      - coverage_report_path
      - reference_tests_path
      - bound_recommendation_record_ids
      - bound_atomic_unit_ids
      - bound_value_set_ids
      - bound_code_system_ids
    properties:
      library_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      library_name:        { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryName" }
      library_version:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
      snapshot_dir:
        type: string
        description: Relative path to work/<run_id>/cql/<library_id>/ at sign time.
      cql_files:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [path, sha256]
          properties:
            path:    { type: string }
            sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      elm_files:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [path, sha256]
          properties:
            path:    { type: string }
            sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      typecheck_report_path: { type: string }
      typecheck_report_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      coverage_report_path:    { type: string }
      coverage_report_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      reference_tests_path:    { type: string }
      reference_tests_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      bound_recommendation_record_ids:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      bound_atomic_unit_ids:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      bound_value_set_ids:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }
      bound_code_system_ids:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }
      bound_risk_engine:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [name, legacy_only]
        properties:
          name:        { type: string, enum: [PREVENT, PCE-legacy] }
          legacy_only: { type: boolean }
      cds_hooks_service_ids_wired:
        type: array
        items: { type: string }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 TypecheckReportSummary — what the schema records (full report on disk)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TypecheckReportSummary:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [runtime_pin, errors_count, warnings_count, warnings_promoted_to_errors_count, status]
    properties:
      runtime_pin:                          { type: string }
      errors_count:                         { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      warnings_count:                       { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      warnings_promoted_to_errors_count:    { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      status:                               { type: string, enum: [clean, errors-present, warnings-promoted] }
      report_sha256:                        { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 CoverageReportSummary — what the schema records (full report on disk)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CoverageReportSummary:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - runtime_pin
      - synthea_cohort_run_id
      - synthea_seed
      - branch_coverage_pct
      - branches_total
      - branches_covered
      - report_sha256
      - status
    properties:
      runtime_pin:           { type: string }
      synthea_cohort_run_id: { type: string }
      synthea_seed:          { type: string }
      branch_coverage_pct:
        type: number
        minimum: 0.0
        maximum: 100.0
      branches_total:        { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      branches_covered:      { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
      report_sha256:         { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      status:
        type: string
        enum: [floor-met, below-floor]
      eq_tolerance_applied:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: True when the runtime is declared `nondeterministic` and aggregate-metric-equal under tolerance was used at sign time.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 HardBlockInvariant — declared per Library with verification pointer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HardBlockInvariant:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, statement, verifying_test_id, verified, basis]
    properties:
      kind:               { $ref: "#/$defs/HardBlockInvariantKind" }
      statement:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: One-line, source-anchored statement of the invariant.
      verifying_test_id:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: ID of the reference test that asserts this invariant. Resolved against `reference_tests_path`.
      verified:
        type: boolean
        description: True iff the verifying test passes at sign time. Validators recompute.
      basis:
        type: string
        enum:
          - cor-iii-harm-anchor
          - cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor
          - explicit-should-not-anchor
          - explicit-not-recommended-anchor
          - manifest-pin-prevent
          - manifest-intended-use-age
          - safety-hazard-mitigation
        description: Why this invariant exists; pointer to source authority.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.11 ReferenceTestResult
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReferenceTestResult:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [test_id, status]
    properties:
      test_id:    { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      status:     { type: string, enum: [pass, fail, skipped] }
      asserts_invariant_kind:
        type: [string, "null"]
        # Validators MUST resolve to a HardBlockInvariantKind when non-null.
      duration_ms: { type: [integer, "null"], minimum: 0 }
      report_uri:  { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.12 LibrarySignoff — per-Library reviewer signoff
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibrarySignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - signoff_id
      - reviewer_id
      - role
      - library_id
      - library_content_hash
      - manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff
      - decision
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      signoff_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^so-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Stable, deterministic ID (truncated SHA-256 of reviewer_id, library_id, signed_at).
      reviewer_id:                       { type: string, pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      role:                              { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
      library_id:                        { type: string, pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      library_content_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical Library snapshot at sign time
          (the Library's CQL files, ELM files, typecheck and coverage
          report SHAs, bound RecommendationRecord ids and content
          hashes, bound AtomicUnit ids, bound value-set/code-system ids,
          bound risk-engine binding, and CDS Hooks service ids wired).
          This is the hash the signature covers.
      manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the active manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at sign time. Pinned for audit.
      gate1_register_refs:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [register_path, register_sha256]
          properties:
            register_path:    { type: string }
            register_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
        description: >
          Every Gate 1 register from which this Library consumes
          finalized records. The orchestrator verifies each register
          finalized state at preflight; the schema records the SHA for
          audit immutability.
      decision:                          { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerDecision" }
      rationale:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      comment:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: Audit-only free-text comment for `accept-with-comment`. Does NOT modify the Library.
      concern_category:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: One of ConcernCategory; required when decision is `reject-rework` or when the reviewer surfaces a substantive concern.
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi, applicable_coi_kinds]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi:    { type: boolean }
          applicable_coi_kinds:
            type: array
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      session_attestations:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - reviewed_cql_source
          - reviewed_typecheck_report
          - reviewed_coverage_report
          - reviewed_reference_tests
          - reviewed_hard_block_invariants
          - reviewed_cds_hooks_wiring_preview
        properties:
          reviewed_cql_source:                  { type: boolean }
          reviewed_typecheck_report:            { type: boolean }
          reviewed_coverage_report:             { type: boolean }
          reviewed_reference_tests:             { type: boolean }
          reviewed_hard_block_invariants:       { type: boolean }
          reviewed_cds_hooks_wiring_preview:    { type: boolean }
          reviewed_provenance_inputs:           { type: boolean, default: true }
      signed_at:                         { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature:                         { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.13 LibraryEntry — disposition of one Library in the cohort
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibraryEntry:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - library_id
      - library_name
      - library_version
      - library_content_hash
      - snapshot
      - typecheck_summary
      - coverage_summary
      - hard_block_invariants
      - reference_test_results
      - state
      - signoffs
    properties:
      library_id:               { type: string, pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      library_name:             { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryName" }
      library_version:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
      library_content_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: The hash signed by every signoff in `signoffs[]`.
      snapshot:                 { $ref: "#/$defs/LibrarySnapshotPointer" }
      typecheck_summary:        { $ref: "#/$defs/TypecheckReportSummary" }
      coverage_summary:         { $ref: "#/$defs/CoverageReportSummary" }
      hard_block_invariants:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/HardBlockInvariant" }
        description: >
          Closed list of declared hard-block invariants for this Library.
          Empty for Libraries with no hard-block invariants applicable
          (e.g., HBPStaging, PreventRisk under default policy). For
          PregnancyHTN, MUST include kind
          `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse`.
      reference_test_results:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ReferenceTestResult" }
      state:                    { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryDispositionState" }
      signoffs:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        maxItems: 4
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LibrarySignoff" }
      escalation:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [opened_at, reason, escalated_to_role]
        properties:
          opened_at:              { type: string, format: date-time }
          reason:                 { type: string, minLength: 1 }
          escalated_to_role:      { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
          resolution:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [resolved_at, decision, resolver_signoff]
            properties:
              resolved_at:        { type: string, format: date-time }
              decision:           { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerDecision" }
              resolver_signoff:   { $ref: "#/$defs/LibrarySignoff" }
      rework_history:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [opened_at, reviewer_id, reason]
          properties:
            opened_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
            reviewer_id:  { type: string }
            reason:       { type: string, minLength: 1 }
            concern_category: { $ref: "#/$defs/ConcernCategory" }
            resolved_at:  { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
            resolved_via_new_library_id:
              type: [string, "null"]
              pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
              description: >
                When rework results in a new Library snapshot, the new
                library_id is recorded here for predecessor chaining.
                The new entry is added to libraries[] with its own
                signoffs[].

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.14 CohortAxisSignoff — one per cohort, by the clinical informaticist
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CohortAxisSignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - reviewer_id
      - role
      - cohort_axis_payload_sha256
      - attestations
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      reviewer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      role:
        type: string
        enum: [clinical-informaticist]
      cohort_axis_payload_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical cohort-axis attestation payload
          (provenance ribbon, terminology pin set, IG version, CDS
          Hooks wiring matrix). The signature covers this hash.
      attestations:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - provenance_integrity_attested
          - terminology_pin_consistency_attested
          - ig_version_alignment_attested
          - cds_hooks_wiring_readiness_attested
        properties:
          provenance_integrity_attested:           { type: boolean }
          terminology_pin_consistency_attested:    { type: boolean }
          ig_version_alignment_attested:           { type: boolean }
          cds_hooks_wiring_readiness_attested:     { type: boolean }
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi: { type: boolean }
      signed_at:               { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature:               { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.15 PanelChairSignoff — cohort-level signoff
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PanelChairSignoff:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - chair_reviewer_id
      - cohort_manifest_hash
      - composition_compliance_attested
      - coverage_floor_satisfied
      - hard_block_invariants_verified
      - escalations_disposed
      - cohort_axis_present
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      chair_reviewer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      cohort_manifest_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of `libraries[]` ordered
          by `library_id` ascending. The signature covers this hash.
      composition_compliance_attested: { type: boolean }
      coverage_floor_satisfied:        { type: boolean }
      hard_block_invariants_verified:  { type: boolean }
      escalations_disposed:            { type: boolean }
      cohort_axis_present:             { type: boolean }
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi: { type: boolean }
      signed_at:                       { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.16 RegisterAuditEvent
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RegisterAuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — Gate2Register
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - register_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - cohort
  - panel
  - libraries
  - cohort_axis_signoff
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  register_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
    description: Semver of this register instance. New register version after any post-finalization change.

  predecessor_register_version:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$|^null$"

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Cohort identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cohort:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [cohort_id, name, run_id, opened_at, state, scope]
    properties:
      cohort_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      name:                { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      run_id:              { type: string, format: uuid }
      opened_at:           { type: string, format: date-time }
      finalized_at:        { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      superseded_at:       { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      state:               { $ref: "#/$defs/CohortState" }
      scope:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [domains, includes_pregnancy_library]
        properties:
          domains:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryDomain" }
          includes_pregnancy_library:
            type: boolean
            description: >
              True if any Library in this cohort is `PregnancyHTN`. When
              true, the composition matrix REQUIRES MFM + clinical
              pharmacology on that Library, and `htn-pregnancy-denylist`
              MUST be wired as `order-select` with hard refusal.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Panel
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  panel:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [panel_id, reviewers, panel_chair_signoff]
    properties:
      panel_id:    { type: string, pattern: "^panel-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      reviewers:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Reviewer" }
      panel_chair_signoff:
        oneOf:
          - { $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChairSignoff" }
          - type: "null"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Libraries
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  libraries:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryEntry" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Cohort-axis informatics signoff
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cohort_axis_signoff:
    oneOf:
      - { $ref: "#/$defs/CohortAxisSignoff" }
      - type: "null"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/RegisterAuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 Fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [register_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      register_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      computed_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form:  { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: G2R-INV-01
    description: >
      Every `signoffs[*].reviewer_id` MUST refer to a Reviewer in
      `panel.reviewers[]`. Every `panel_chair_signoff.chair_reviewer_id`
      MUST refer to a Reviewer with `role == "panel-chair"`. Every
      `cohort_axis_signoff.reviewer_id` MUST refer to a Reviewer with
      `role == "clinical-informaticist"`.

  - id: G2R-INV-02
    description: >
      Every Reviewer MUST have at least one Credential whose `kind` is
      consistent with `role` per the role-credential matrix maintained
      in `docs/role-credential-matrix.md`. CI MUST verify the matrix
      file exists and is consulted at validation time.

  - id: G2R-INV-03
    description: >
      Every Reviewer.identity_proof.ial MUST be `IAL2` or `IAL3`.
      Reviewers with role `panel-chair` or `medical-director` MUST be
      IAL3/AAL3.

  - id: G2R-INV-04
    description: >
      For every LibraryEntry in state ∈ {accepted, accepted-with-comment},
      `signoffs[]` MUST contain exactly two LibrarySignoff entries with
      `decision ∈ {accept, accept-with-comment}` and distinct
      `(reviewer_id, role)` pairs that satisfy the composition matrix
      for the Library's name (§1).

  - id: G2R-INV-05
    description: >
      For LibraryEntry whose `library_name == "PregnancyHTN"` and state
      ∈ {accepted, accepted-with-comment}, signoffs[] MUST include at
      least one with `role == "mfm-or-obstetric-medicine"` AND at least
      one with `role == "clinical-pharmacologist"`.

  - id: G2R-INV-06
    description: >
      Every Signature.payload_sha256 MUST equal the SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of the payload it claims to cover. Validators
      regenerate and compare; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: G2R-INV-07
    description: >
      Every Signature MUST verify under the corresponding Reviewer's
      public_key. Validators perform the cryptographic verification;
      the producer's `verifies: true` claim is ignored.

  - id: G2R-INV-08
    description: >
      Every LibrarySignoff.library_content_hash MUST equal the
      recomputed Library content hash (over the snapshot's CQL files,
      ELM files, typecheck and coverage report SHAs, bound record / unit
      / value-set / code-system / risk-engine identifiers, and CDS Hooks
      wiring) at validation time. Mismatch indicates post-signoff
      mutation and is a release blocker (post_signoff_immutability).

  - id: G2R-INV-09
    description: >
      Every LibrarySignoff.manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff MUST equal
      the active manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at signing time.
      Manifest drift between signoff and validation is a release
      blocker.

  - id: G2R-INV-10
    description: >
      Every Signature.time_stamp.tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256 MUST be a
      member of the active manifest's `tsa_list[].tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256`,
      and the time-stamp `time` MUST fall within that TSA cert's
      validity window.

  - id: G2R-INV-11
    description: >
      No LibrarySignoff may carry an edit to Library content. The
      schema-level discrimination is enforced by the absence of an
      `accept-with-edit` decision. Validators MUST ALSO scan rationale
      and comment for hard-block-relax patterns (heuristic; matches
      auto-route to `reject-rework` or to `hard-block-relax-attempted`
      audit events).

  - id: G2R-INV-12
    description: >
      For every signoff with decision == "accept-with-comment",
      `comment` MUST be non-empty. Comments are audit-only and DO NOT
      modify the Library; the orchestrator MUST NOT consume comments as
      input to upstream re-author.

  - id: G2R-INV-13
    description: >
      For every Reviewer assigned to a Library where the reviewer's
      `coi_disclosures[].auto_disqualifies_library_names` includes the
      Library's name OR
      `coi_disclosures[].auto_disqualifies_library_domains` includes the
      Library's domain, the Library's signoffs MUST include a recused
      entry for that reviewer, and a substitute reviewer of the same
      role MUST sign. Auto-disqualification cannot be ignored.

  - id: G2R-INV-14
    description: >
      For every LibraryEntry in state == "panel-escalated", an
      `escalation` object MUST be present with non-null
      `escalated_to_role` and a null `resolution` (until resolved).

  - id: G2R-INV-15
    description: >
      For state == "finalized" on the cohort:
        - `panel_chair_signoff` MUST be non-null AND its
          `cohort_manifest_hash` MUST equal the recomputed SHA-256 over
          the JCS-canonical form of `libraries[]` (ordered by
          library_id ascending);
        - `cohort_axis_signoff` MUST be non-null;
        - `panel_chair_signoff.composition_compliance_attested` MUST
          be true;
        - `panel_chair_signoff.coverage_floor_satisfied` MUST be true;
        - `panel_chair_signoff.hard_block_invariants_verified` MUST be
          true;
        - `panel_chair_signoff.escalations_disposed` MUST be true;
        - `panel_chair_signoff.cohort_axis_present` MUST be true.

  - id: G2R-INV-16
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      The validator computes the chained hash of events and compares
      against a separately-maintained chain; out-of-order or missing
      events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  - id: G2R-INV-17
    description: >
      `predecessor_register_version` MUST be set whenever this register
      supersedes a prior finalized one. The predecessor register's
      `state` MUST be `superseded` and its `superseded_at` MUST be set
      to a time no later than this register's `opened_at`.

  - id: G2R-INV-18
    description: >
      `fixity.register_sha256` MUST equal the SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of this register document with `fixity`
      excluded. The hash MUST be deterministic across re-runs.

  - id: G2R-INV-19
    description: >
      Every LibraryEntry.coverage_summary.branch_coverage_pct MUST be
      ≥ 95.0 for state ∈ {accepted, accepted-with-comment}. Below floor
      is a release blocker (coverage_floor).

  - id: G2R-INV-20
    description: >
      Every LibraryEntry.coverage_summary.report_sha256 MUST equal the
      SHA-256 of the on-disk coverage report at validation time, and
      MUST match `snapshot.coverage_report_sha256`. Drift indicates
      report mutation and is a release blocker.

  - id: G2R-INV-21
    description: >
      Every LibraryEntry.typecheck_summary.status MUST be `clean` for
      state ∈ {accepted, accepted-with-comment}. `errors-present` or
      `warnings-promoted` is a release blocker (typecheck_clean).

  - id: G2R-INV-22
    description: >
      For every LibraryEntry, every declared HardBlockInvariant.kind in
      `hard_block_invariants[]` MUST have a corresponding
      ReferenceTestResult with `asserts_invariant_kind == kind` and
      `status == "pass"`. Unverified hard-blocks are a release blocker
      (hard_block_verification).

  - id: G2R-INV-23
    description: >
      For LibraryEntry.library_name == "PregnancyHTN":
        - `hard_block_invariants[]` MUST include kind
          `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse`;
        - the verifying reference test MUST be `pass`;
        - the bound CDS Hooks service `htn-pregnancy-denylist` MUST be
          recorded in `snapshot.cds_hooks_service_ids_wired[]`.
      Validators MUST refuse to advance the Library otherwise.

  - id: G2R-INV-24
    description: >
      For any LibraryEntry whose `snapshot.bound_risk_engine` is
      non-null, `bound_risk_engine.name` MUST equal "PREVENT" and
      `bound_risk_engine.legacy_only` MUST be false. PCE-legacy MUST
      NOT feed CQL (ADR-HTN-001 D5).

  - id: G2R-INV-25
    description: >
      For every LibraryEntry:
        `snapshot.bound_recommendation_record_ids[]` MUST be non-empty
        AND every id MUST exist in the build's records.json (validators
        load and check). The recorded records MUST all be in state
        `gate-1-passed` per their parent Gate 1 register, which MUST be
        `finalized`.

  - id: G2R-INV-26
    description: >
      `signoffs[*].gate1_register_refs[]` MUST be non-empty for every
      LibrarySignoff, AND every register_path MUST resolve to a Gate 1
      register file whose `cohort.state == "finalized"` at sign time.

  - id: G2R-INV-27
    description: >
      No two signoffs from the same `reviewer_id` may exist on the same
      Library (no self-pairing).

  - id: G2R-INV-28
    description: >
      No signoff may carry `decision == "panel-escalated"` while the
      LibraryEntry's `state` is not `panel-escalated`. State and
      decisions MUST be consistent.

  - id: G2R-INV-29
    description: >
      Validators MUST scan signoff rationale and comment for hard-block-
      relax proposals (the patterns listed in §1 no_relax_of_hard_block).
      Any match MUST appear in `audit_log[]` as a
      `hard-block-relax-attempted` event AND the signoff's decision
      MUST have been auto-rewritten to `reject-rework`. Validators MUST
      reject the signoff if the auto-rewrite did not occur.

  - id: G2R-INV-30
    description: >
      `cohort.scope.includes_pregnancy_library == true` AND any
      LibraryEntry whose `library_name == "PregnancyHTN"` exists in
      `libraries[]` together imply that the cohort's panel.reviewers[]
      MUST include at least one reviewer with role
      `mfm-or-obstetric-medicine` AND at least one with role
      `clinical-pharmacologist` (so the matrix can be satisfied for
      that Library).

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 An in-review cohort with one accepted Library and one panel-escalated.
#   6.2 A finalized cohort with cohort-axis informatics signoff and panel-chair
#       signoff complete.
#
# EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from a real reviewer, a real
# institution, real credential evidence, or a real Library snapshot is marked
# `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions. The pipeline refuses to operate on
# registers containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.1 In-review cohort
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    register_version: "1.0.0"
    predecessor_register_version: null
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"

    cohort:
      cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
      name: "HUMAN_FILL: e.g., 'HBP-2025 CQL Library Cohort A'"
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      opened_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      finalized_at: null
      superseded_at: null
      state: in-review
      scope:
        domains: [classification, risk-stratification, pharmacologic-general]
        includes_pregnancy_library: false

    panel:
      panel_id: "panel-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
      reviewers:
        - reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
          legal_name: "HUMAN_FILL"

          institution: "HUMAN_FILL"
          identity_proof:
            ial: IAL2
            aal: AAL2
            proofing_method: "HUMAN_FILL"

            proofed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"

            proofed_by_person: null
          credentials:
            - kind: abim-certification

              valid_until: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"

            - kind: ash-hypertension-specialist

        - reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"

          role: clinical-informaticist

    libraries:

            signed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
            signature:

              payload_canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785
              payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
              signature_b64: "HUMAN_FILL_BASE64"
              time_stamp:
                tsa_name: "HUMAN_FILL"

                tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"

                token_b64: "HUMAN_FILL_BASE64"
              verifies: true

          - signoff_id: "so-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
            reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
            role: clinical-informaticist
            library_id: "lib-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
            library_content_hash: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
            manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
            gate1_register_refs:
              - { register_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/gate1/cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX.signed.jsonld", register_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
            decision: accept
            rationale: "HUMAN_FILL"
            comment: null
            concern_category: null
            coi_attestation_at_signoff:
              no_undisclosed_coi: true
              applicable_coi_kinds: []
            session_attestations:

              reviewed_typecheck_report: true

`schemas/gate2-register.yaml` is now complete: §1 policy (composition matrix, no-batch, no-edit-at-gate-2, no-relax-of-hard-block with five named patterns, coverage-floor 95%, typecheck-clean, hard-block verification, COR/LOE immutable at gate 2, post-signoff immutability, panel-chair signoff, COI, identity proofing, signature algorithms, time-stamping); §2 closed enums (LibraryName, LibraryDomain, ReviewerRole, ReviewerDecision *without* `accept-with-edit`, ConcernCategory, IAL/AAL, CredentialKind, COIKind, SignatureAlgorithm, CohortState, LibraryDispositionState, HardBlockInvariantKind, AuditEventKind); §3 structured types (IdentityProof, Credential, ConflictOfInterest, Reviewer, TimeStamp, Signature, LibrarySnapshotPointer, TypecheckReportSummary, CoverageReportSummary, HardBlockInvariant, ReferenceTestResult, LibrarySignoff, LibraryEntry, CohortAxisSignoff, PanelChairSignoff, RegisterAuditEvent); §4 root with mandatory `cohort_axis_signoff`; §5 thirty cross-field invariants `G2R-INV-01`…`G2R-INV-30` including `G2R-INV-19` (≥95% coverage), `G2R-INV-22` (every declared hard-block has a passing reference test), `G2R-INV-23` (PregnancyHTN order-select hard-refuse + `htn-pregnancy-denylist` wired), `G2R-INV-24` (PCE-legacy never feeds CQL), `G2R-INV-29` (auto-detect hard-block-relax attempts and require auto-rewrite to `reject-rework`); two examples (in-review + finalized); and §7 change control.
