## Part 2 — `schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml`

```yaml name=schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml
# =============================================================================
# gate3-attestation.yaml
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standalone schema for the Gate 3 pre-publish safety-case attestation —
# the auditable, signed, append-only build-level document produced by
# `safety-case-attest` that authorizes (or declines) publication of a
# build derived from the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha framework.
#
# This file is the contract for:
#   - Build identity (the run id, the build version label, the active
#     manifest reference).
#   - The canonical Gate-3 BundleManifest: an exhaustive, closed list of
#     bundle members, each pinned by a content hash computed under
#     explicit canonicalization rules.
#   - The attesters: a primary medical-director attester and an optional
#     second attester for institutional dual-control policy.
#   - Per-attester credential evidence (identity proofing at IAL3/AAL3
#     for the medical director; IAL2/AAL2+ for the second attester per
#     institutional policy).
#   - Per-attester decision: attest / decline / escalate-to-board, with
#     a closed `decline_reason` enum and a required acknowledgement
#     toggle set for `attest`.
#   - Cryptographic signature envelope (Ed25519 or ECDSA-P256-SHA256
#     over RFC 8785 JCS canonical payload, RFC 3161 time-stamp).
#   - The predecessor-attestation chain: a declined attestation links
#     to its successor (a fresh attestation against a re-built bundle);
#     a superseded attestation links to its successor as well.
#   - Decline-without-publish semantics: a `declined` state is terminal
#     for that bundle; re-attestation requires a new bundle with a new
#     `bundle_sha256` and a new attestation document with explicit
#     predecessor.
#   - Post-attestation immutability rules.
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage, decline over
# override. No batch attestation. No relaxation of any prior gate. An
# attestation may decline to publish; it cannot override a prior gate's
# reject. Post-attestation bundle content is immutable; the bundle hash
# binds the attester to a specific moment in build history.
#
# This file does NOT contain clinical content. It records WHO attested
# WHICH build at WHAT bundle hash and WHEN, plus the explicit
# acknowledgements that publication is being authorized under specific
# safety, copyright, PHI, and intended-use representations.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D5 (PREVENT canonical risk function)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D8 (pregnancy hard-block enforced at order-select)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D9 (three non-overridable human gates; Gate 3
#     enforces medical-director attestation prior to publication)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D10 (PHI fail-closed; copyright envelope respected;
#     these are upstream/sibling concerns and Gate 3 verifies the
#     reports are clean before attestation)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D11 (Synthea-only test data; coverage reports verified
#     at Gate 2 and re-confirmed at Gate 3 via bundle hash)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D13 (versioning triple)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D14 (supersession of 2017; mandatory Communication
#     resource on first publish, verified at Gate 3)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D15 (drift detection; bundle hash is recomputed at
#     session start, before signing, and after signing)
#   - Framework spec §11 (Guideline Card / NAM CGAT / Safety Case /
#     Regulatory Traceability Matrix / Retraction Notice)
#   - `safety-case-attest` SKILL.md (the only authorized writer)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by
# $ref or by content-hash pointer):
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml             (Gate 1 cohort registers
#                                              referenced from the
#                                              BundleManifest as `g1`
#                                              members; each finalized)
#   - schemas/gate2-register.yaml             (Gate 2 cohort registers
#                                              referenced from the
#                                              BundleManifest as `g2`
#                                              members; each finalized)
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml  (referenced as `recs`)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                (referenced as `aus`)
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                       (referenced as `sair`)
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml            (transitively, via
#                                              record/atomic-unit
#                                              inheritance)
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml (referenced as `mfst`;
#                                              tsa_list, signature_policy,
#                                              quote_envelope,
#                                              intended_use,
#                                              supersession,
#                                              errata_watch are
#                                              consulted at preflight
#                                              and at sign time)
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml"
title: "Gate3Attestation"
description: >
  Auditable, signed, build-level pre-publish safety-case attestation
  document. Constructs the canonical Gate-3 BundleManifest from live
  build artifacts; records the medical director's (and optional second
  attester's) decision (attest / decline / escalate-to-board); binds the
  decision cryptographically to the bundle's content hash with an RFC
  3161 time-stamp from a manifest-pinned TSA. Decline-without-publish
  semantics. No relaxation of any prior gate. Post-attestation bundle
  content is immutable; corrections require a new bundle with explicit
  predecessor chain.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  attester_identity:
    rule: >
      The primary attester is the medical director (or named designate
      per ADR-HTN-001 D9) with NIST SP 800-63 IAL3/AAL3 identity
      assurance. Where institutional policy requires dual control, an
      optional second attester is named (e.g., compliance officer, chief
      medical informatics officer, alternate medical director,
      panel-chair-cohort) at IAL2/AAL2 minimum (institutional policy may
      pin higher).

  bundle_completeness:
    rule: >
      The Gate-3 BundleManifest MUST contain exactly the closed set of
      member ids enumerated in §2.1 (each appearing exactly once). Any
      missing member is a release blocker. The bundle MUST be
      constructed from live build artifacts at session time; pre-recorded
      hashes are not trusted.

  bundle_integrity_recompute:
    rule: >
      The `bundle_sha256` MUST be recomputed by `safety-case-attest`:
        - at session start (preflight),
        - immediately before signing,
        - immediately after signing (post-validation).
      All three values MUST match. Any mismatch BLOCKS attest mode and
      requires a fresh session.

  bundle_member_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      Every member's content hash MUST be computed under the
      canonicalization rule declared on its kind (see §2.2). For
      JSON/JSON-LD/YAML members, RFC 8785 (JCS) is applied; for CQL/ELM
      directories, a deterministic file-list JCS object ordered by path
      ascending; for text/Markdown members, NFC normalization + trailing
      newline normalization, then SHA-256. Any deviation is a release
      blocker.

  decline_without_publish:
    rule: >
      A `declined` attestation is terminal for the bundle it covers.
      Publication is forbidden against a declined bundle. Re-attestation
      requires the orchestrator to re-run upstream phases addressed by
      the decline reason, produce a new bundle with a new
      `bundle_sha256`, and post a fresh attestation document with
      `predecessor_attestation_id` referring to the declined one. The
      old attestation is retained immutably for audit.

  no_relax_of_prior_gates:
    rule: >
      No attestation rationale, comment, or acknowledgement may relax a
      prior gate's outcome. The attester MAY decline; the attester MUST
      NOT publish past:
        - any Gate 1 reject,
        - any Gate 2 reject,
        - any Library coverage below 95.0%,
        - any unverified hard-block invariant,
        - the age gate (>= 18),
        - PREVENT canonicalization (no PCE-legacy substitution),
        - any PHI hit,
        - any copyright envelope overage,
        - any HL7 Validator error,
        - any soft-warning posture on `htn-pregnancy-denylist`,
        - first-publish-without-Communication-resource.
      Validators MUST scan attestation rationale for relax-of-prior-gates
      proposals (closed pattern set in §6 G3A-INV-15) and treat any
      match as a release blocker.

  acknowledgement_toggles_required:
    rule: >
      An `attest` decision MUST include the closed set of
      acknowledgement toggles in §3.5, all set to `true`. Missing or
      `false` toggles BLOCK the attest decision (`G3A-INV-08`).

  decline_reason_required:
    rule: >
      A `decline` decision MUST include a `decline_reason` from the
      closed enum in §2.5. Free-text rationale is also required.

  coi_auto_disqualification:
    rule: >
      An attester with a material COI on the build's clinical content
      (e.g., a financial-pharmaceutical relationship for a build whose
      records bear on that drug class) is automatically disqualified
      from attestation. The schema records the disqualification as
      `decision == "escalate-to-board"`; a substitute attester is
      appointed by the institution's board.

  post_attestation_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once an attestation is recorded with `decision ∈ {attest, decline}`
      and `signature.verifies == true`, neither its `signature` nor the
      `bundle_sha256` it covers may be mutated. The attestation
      document's lifecycle state transitions monotonically:
        draft → awaiting-second-attester (optional) → attested|declined
      and any new attestation is a new document with explicit
      predecessor.

  signature_algorithm:
    rule: >
      Signatures use Ed25519 (default) or ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the
      canonical JCS (RFC 8785) form of the signed payload. The algorithm
      and key identifier are pinned per attestation; mismatch is a
      release blocker.

  time_stamping:
    rule: >
      Every signature carries an RFC 3161 time-stamp from a TSA pinned
      in the active manifest's `tsa_list[]` whose certificate validity
      covers `signed_at`. Time-stamp absence is a release blocker.

  publication_signal:
    rule: >
      Publication is permitted ONLY when `attestation.state ==
      "attested"` and (where dual control is required) both attesters
      have decided `attest`. The orchestrator (`flow-hbp-2025-build`
      P28) MUST refuse to publish on any other state.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Bundle member ids (closed; see §2.1 of safety-case-attest)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BundleMemberId:
    type: string
    enum:
      - mfst
      - sair
      - recs
      - aus
      - g1
      - g2
      - cql
      - cov
      - cdsh
      - safe
      - phi
      - cpr
      - ig
      - comm
      - card
      - cgat
      - rtm
      - prov

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Bundle member kinds (drives canonicalization rule)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BundleMemberKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - manifest
      - sair
      - records
      - atomic-units
      - gate1-register-set
      - gate2-register-set
      - cql-library-set
      - coverage-report-set
      - cds-hooks-service-set
      - safety-case
      - phi-report
      - copyright-report
      - ig-build
      - communication-resource
      - guideline-card
      - cgat-matrix
      - regulatory-traceability
      - prov-bundle

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Canonicalization rules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CanonicalizationRule:
    type: string
    enum:
      - jcs-rfc8785-then-sha256
      - file-list-jcs-then-sha256
      - nfc-trailing-newline-then-sha256

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Attester roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttesterRole:
    type: string
    enum:
      - medical-director
      - compliance-officer
      - chief-medical-informatics-officer
      - panel-chair-cohort
      - alternate-medical-director

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Attester decisions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttesterDecision:
    type: string
    enum:
      - attest
      - decline
      - escalate-to-board

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Decline reasons (closed set)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeclineReason:
    type: string
    enum:
      - bundle-drift
      - gate1-incomplete
      - gate2-incomplete
      - coverage-below-floor
      - hard-block-unverified
      - phi-detected
      - copyright-overage
      - ig-validator-error
      - pregnancy-not-order-select
      - predecessor-supersession-malformed
      - intended-use-mismatch
      - errata-blocker-open
      - tsa-unavailable
      - other-clinical-concern
      - other-governance-concern

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Attestation lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttestationState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - awaiting-time-stamp
      - awaiting-second-attester
      - attested
      - declined
      - escalated-to-board
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Identity / authenticator assurance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [IAL1, IAL2, IAL3]

  AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [AAL1, AAL2, AAL3]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Credential kinds (subset relevant to attesters)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CredentialKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - medical-director
      - alternate-medical-director
      - compliance-officer
      - chief-medical-informatics-officer
      - state-medical-license
      - institutional-credential
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Signature algorithms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SignatureAlgorithm:
    type: string
    enum:
      - Ed25519
      - ECDSA-P256-SHA256

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 COI kinds (re-stated for self-containment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  COIKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - none
      - financial-pharmaceutical
      - financial-device
      - research-grant
      - speakers-bureau
      - consultancy
      - equity-holding
      - employment-related
      - family-relationship
      - publication-author
      - guideline-author
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Audit-event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - attestation-drafted
      - bundle-recomputed
      - attest-recorded
      - decline-recorded
      - second-attest-recorded
      - second-decline-recorded
      - escalate-to-board-recorded
      - attestation-superseded
      - attestation-withdrawn
      - relax-of-prior-gate-attempted
      - bundle-edit-attempt

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 BundleMember
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BundleMember:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [id, kind, path, canonicalization, sha256]
    properties:
      id:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/BundleMemberId" }
      kind:                { $ref: "#/$defs/BundleMemberKind" }
      path:
        type: string
        description: >
          Relative path to the member at session time. For multi-file
          members (g1, g2, cql, cov, cdsh, ig), this is the directory
          path; the per-file enumeration is captured in
          `file_list` below.
      canonicalization:    { $ref: "#/$defs/CanonicalizationRule" }
      sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 over the canonicalized bytes per `canonicalization`.
      file_list:
        type: array
        description: >
          For multi-file members, the deterministic file enumeration
          used to compute `sha256` under `file-list-jcs-then-sha256`.
          Empty for single-file members.
        items:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required: [path, sha256]
          properties:
            path:    { type: string }
            sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      member_count:
        type: [integer, "null"]
        minimum: 0
        description: >
          For set-kind members (g1, g2, cql, cov, cdsh), the count of
          contained items. The schema records the count for fast audit;
          validators recompute and compare.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 BundleManifest
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BundleManifest:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [schema_version, build_run_id, manifest_version, members]
    properties:
      schema_version:
        type: string
        const: "1.0.0"
      build_run_id:        { type: string, format: uuid }
      manifest_version:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"
      members:
        type: array
        minItems: 18
        maxItems: 18
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/BundleMember" }
        description: >
          Exactly 18 members. Each `BundleMemberId` MUST appear exactly
          once. Validators reject duplicates or missing ids.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 IdentityProof
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityProof:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [ial, aal, proofing_method, proofing_evidence_uri, proofed_at, proofed_by_org]
    properties:
      ial: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityAssuranceLevel" }
      aal: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel" }
      proofing_method:        { type: string }
      proofing_evidence_uri:  { type: string, format: uri }
      proofed_at:             { type: string, format: date-time }
      proofed_by_org:         { type: string }
      proofed_by_person:      { type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Credential
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Credential:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, issuer, evidence_uri, valid_from]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/CredentialKind" }
      issuer:         { type: string }
      evidence_uri:   { type: string, format: uri }
      valid_from:     { type: string, format: date }
      valid_until:    { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
      verified_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      verified_by:    { type: string }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 ConflictOfInterest
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConflictOfInterest:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, disclosed_at, scope]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      counterparty:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      scope:
        type: string
        enum:
          - none
          - drug-class
          - device-class
          - therapeutic-area
          - guideline-document
          - build-level
          - other
      scope_detail:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      disclosed_at:   { type: string, format: date-time }
      mitigation:     { type: [string, "null"] }
      auto_disqualifies_build:
        type: boolean
        description: True iff this COI auto-disqualifies the attester from this build.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Attester (medical director or second attester)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Attester:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - attester_id
      - legal_name
      - role
      - identity_proof
      - credentials
      - coi_disclosures
      - public_key
    properties:
      attester_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Stable, deterministic ID. The `rev-` prefix is shared with the
          Gate 1 / Gate 2 reviewer identifier namespace by design — an
          institution's medical director may also appear as a panel
          chair on contributing Gate 1 / Gate 2 cohorts.
      legal_name:                   { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      preferred_credential_string:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      role:                         { $ref: "#/$defs/AttesterRole" }
      institution:                  { type: string }
      identity_proof:               { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityProof" }
      credentials:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Credential" }
      coi_disclosures:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ConflictOfInterest" }
      public_key:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [algorithm, key_id, key_pem]
        properties:
          algorithm:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
          key_id:              { type: string }
          key_pem:             { type: string }
          fingerprint_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      added_to_attestation_at: { type: string, format: date-time }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 TimeStamp / Signature (re-stated for self-containment)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TimeStamp:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [tsa_name, tsa_url, tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
    properties:
      tsa_name:                    { type: string }
      tsa_url:                     { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      time:                        { type: string, format: date-time }
      token_b64:                   { type: string }

  Signature:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [algorithm, key_id, payload_canonical_form, payload_sha256, signature_b64, time_stamp]
    properties:
      algorithm:               { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
      key_id:                  { type: string }
      payload_canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
      payload_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      signature_b64:           { type: string }
      time_stamp:              { $ref: "#/$defs/TimeStamp" }
      verifies:                { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 Acknowledgements (required for `attest` decisions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Acknowledgements:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - bundle_integrity_attested
      - gate1_finalization_acknowledged
      - gate2_finalization_acknowledged
      - hazards_and_mitigations_acknowledged
      - intended_use_boundary_acknowledged
      - phi_clean_attested
      - copyright_envelope_attested
      - ig_validator_clean_attested
      - pregnancy_order_select_hardrefuse_attested
      - supersession_communication_present_attested
    properties:
      bundle_integrity_attested:                       { type: boolean }
      gate1_finalization_acknowledged:                 { type: boolean }
      gate2_finalization_acknowledged:                 { type: boolean }
      hazards_and_mitigations_acknowledged:            { type: boolean }
      intended_use_boundary_acknowledged:              { type: boolean }
      phi_clean_attested:                              { type: boolean }
      copyright_envelope_attested:                     { type: boolean }
      ig_validator_clean_attested:                     { type: boolean }
      pregnancy_order_select_hardrefuse_attested:      { type: boolean }
      supersession_communication_present_attested:     { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 Attestation (single attester's decision)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Attestation:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - attestation_entry_id
      - attester_id
      - role
      - bundle_sha256
      - manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff
      - decision
      - signed_at
      - signature
    properties:
      attestation_entry_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^att-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of build_run_id + attester_id + bundle_sha256 + signed_at).
      attester_id:                 { type: string, pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      role:                        { $ref: "#/$defs/AttesterRole" }
      bundle_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical BundleManifest (with `members` ordered by id ascending). The signature covers this hash.
      manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the active manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at signing time.
      decision:                    { $ref: "#/$defs/AttesterDecision" }
      acknowledgements:
        oneOf:
          - { $ref: "#/$defs/Acknowledgements" }
          - type: "null"
        description: Required (all true) for `decision == "attest"`. Null permitted (and expected) for `decline` and `escalate-to-board`.
      decline_reason:
        oneOf:
          - { $ref: "#/$defs/DeclineReason" }
          - type: "null"
        description: Required for `decision == "decline"`. Null otherwise.
      rationale:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      coi_attestation_at_signoff:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [no_undisclosed_coi, applicable_coi_kinds]
        properties:
          no_undisclosed_coi:    { type: boolean }
          applicable_coi_kinds:
            type: array
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      session_attestations:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required:
          - reviewed_bundle_integrity_pane
          - reviewed_gate1_summary_pane
          - reviewed_gate2_summary_pane
          - reviewed_hazard_log_and_safety_case_pane
          - reviewed_phi_pane
          - reviewed_copyright_pane
          - reviewed_ig_validator_pane
          - reviewed_cds_hooks_wiring_pane
          - reviewed_supersession_pane
          - reviewed_documentation_pane
          - reviewed_intended_use_pane
        properties:
          reviewed_bundle_integrity_pane:               { type: boolean }
          reviewed_gate1_summary_pane:                  { type: boolean }
          reviewed_gate2_summary_pane:                  { type: boolean }
          reviewed_hazard_log_and_safety_case_pane:     { type: boolean }
          reviewed_phi_pane:                            { type: boolean }
          reviewed_copyright_pane:                      { type: boolean }
          reviewed_ig_validator_pane:                   { type: boolean }
          reviewed_cds_hooks_wiring_pane:               { type: boolean }
          reviewed_supersession_pane:                   { type: boolean }
          reviewed_documentation_pane:                  { type: boolean }
          reviewed_intended_use_pane:                   { type: boolean }
      signed_at:                   { type: string, format: date-time }
      signature:                   { $ref: "#/$defs/Signature" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 AuditEvent (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — Gate3Attestation
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - attestation_id
  - attestation_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - build
  - dual_control_required
  - bundle_manifest
  - bundle_sha256
  - attesters
  - attestations
  - state
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  attestation_id:
    type: string
    pattern: "^att-doc-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
    description: >
      Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of build_run_id +
      bundle_sha256 + attestation_version).

  attestation_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"

  predecessor_attestation_id:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^att-doc-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"
    description: >
      Set when this attestation supersedes or follows a declined
      predecessor. Forms the predecessor-attestation chain.

  predecessor_attestation_state:
    type: [string, "null"]
    description: >
      The state the predecessor was in when superseded. Valid values:
      `declined`, `superseded`, `escalated-to-board`, `withdrawn`.
      Validators MUST resolve and verify.
    enum: [declined, superseded, escalated-to-board, withdrawn, null]

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Build identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [run_id, build_version_label, opened_at]
    properties:
      run_id:                 { type: string, format: uuid }
      build_version_label:
        type: string
        pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
      opened_at:              { type: string, format: date-time }
      attested_at:            { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      declined_at:            { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      escalated_to_board_at:  { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      first_publish:
        type: boolean
        description: True iff no prior `dataset-version-published` event exists for builds derived from this manifest.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Dual control
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  dual_control_required:
    type: boolean
    description: >
      True iff institutional policy requires two attestations
      (medical director + second attester). When false, a single
      `attest` decision by the medical director is sufficient.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Bundle manifest and bundle hash
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  bundle_manifest:        { $ref: "#/$defs/BundleManifest" }
  bundle_sha256:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    description: >
      SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical form of `bundle_manifest` (with
      `members` ordered by id ascending). Recomputed by the validator;
      mismatch is a release blocker.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Attesters (1 primary + optional 1 second)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  attesters:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    maxItems: 2
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Attester" }
    description: >
      The first entry is the primary attester (medical director or
      alternate medical director, IAL3/AAL3). The second entry, if
      present and dual_control_required == true, is the second attester
      whose role is one of: compliance-officer,
      chief-medical-informatics-officer, alternate-medical-director,
      panel-chair-cohort.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Attestations (the recorded decisions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  attestations:
    type: array
    minItems: 0
    maxItems: 2
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Attestation" }
    description: >
      The recorded attester decisions. Order corresponds to `attesters[]`
      where present (primary attester at index 0; second attester at
      index 1).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 State
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/AttestationState" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.7 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.8 Fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [attestation_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      attestation_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of this document with `fixity` excluded.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: G3A-INV-01
    description: >
      `bundle_manifest.members[]` MUST contain each `BundleMemberId`
      exactly once (18 entries total). Duplicates or missing ids are a
      release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-02
    description: >
      Every `bundle_manifest.members[].sha256` MUST equal the SHA-256
      of the canonicalized bytes produced by the rule declared in
      `canonicalization` for that member's path. Validators recompute
      from live artifacts; producer claims are not trusted.

  - id: G3A-INV-03
    description: >
      `bundle_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of
      `bundle_manifest` with `members` ordered by id ascending.
      Validators recompute and compare; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-04
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.bundle_sha256` MUST equal the document's
      `bundle_sha256` at the time the attestation was signed. Drift is
      a release blocker (post_signoff_immutability).

  - id: G3A-INV-05
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.attester_id` MUST refer to an Attester in
      `attesters[]`. Attestations from non-listed attesters are a
      release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-06
    description: >
      The primary attester (`attesters[0]`) MUST have role
      `medical-director` or `alternate-medical-director`, and
      `identity_proof.ial == "IAL3"` AND `aal == "AAL3"`. Lower
      assurance is a release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-07
    description: >
      When `dual_control_required == true`, `attesters[]` MUST have
      length 2. The second attester's role MUST be one of:
      compliance-officer, chief-medical-informatics-officer,
      alternate-medical-director, panel-chair-cohort. The two attesters
      MUST have distinct `attester_id` values.

  - id: G3A-INV-08
    description: >
      For every `Attestation` whose `decision == "attest"`,
      `acknowledgements` MUST be non-null AND every property in
      `Acknowledgements` (10 toggles) MUST be true. Missing or false
      toggles are a release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-09
    description: >
      For every `Attestation` whose `decision == "decline"`,
      `decline_reason` MUST be a member of `DeclineReason`. Free-text
      `rationale` MUST be non-empty.

  - id: G3A-INV-10
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.signature.payload_sha256` MUST equal the
      SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of the Attestation candidate
      with `signature` field stripped at signing time. Validators
      regenerate and compare.

  - id: G3A-INV-11
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.signature` MUST verify under the corresponding
      Attester's `public_key` (algorithm + key_id matched). Validators
      perform the cryptographic verification; the producer's
      `verifies: true` claim is ignored.

  - id: G3A-INV-12
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.signature.time_stamp.tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256`
      MUST be a member of the active manifest's `tsa_list[].
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256`, AND the time-stamp `time` MUST
      fall within that TSA cert's validity window.

  - id: G3A-INV-13
    description: >
      Every `Attestation.manifest_payload_sha256_at_signoff` MUST equal
      the active manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at signing time.
      Manifest drift between signoff and validation is a release
      blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-14
    description: >
      `state` consistency MUST hold:
        - `state == "draft"` requires `attestations == []`.
        - `state == "awaiting-second-attester"` requires
          `dual_control_required == true` AND
          `attestations[]` has exactly one entry with `decision == "attest"`.
        - `state == "attested"` requires:
          (a) `dual_control_required == false` AND
              `attestations[]` has exactly one entry with `decision == "attest"`,
          OR
          (b) `dual_control_required == true` AND
              `attestations[]` has exactly two entries, both with
              `decision == "attest"`.
        - `state == "declined"` requires `attestations[]` has at least one
          entry with `decision == "decline"`.
        - `state == "escalated-to-board"` requires at least one entry with
          `decision == "escalate-to-board"`.
      Mismatched state is a release blocker.

  - id: G3A-INV-15
    description: >
      Validators MUST scan attestation rationale for relax-of-prior-gates
      proposals against the closed pattern set (no override of Gate 1 /
      Gate 2 reject; no relax of pregnancy denylist; no PCE-legacy
      substitution; no age-gate lowering; no acceptance below coverage
      floor; no acceptance with PHI hit, copyright overage, or HL7
      Validator error; no first-publish-without-Communication-resource).
      Any match is a release blocker; the auto-detection MUST also
      append a `relax-of-prior-gate-attempted` event to `audit_log[]`.

  - id: G3A-INV-16
    description: >
      `state == "attested"` requires that EVERY upstream prerequisite
      verifies at validation time:
        - The active manifest is `state == "active"`,
          `errata_watch.blockers_open == []`, and
          `medical_director_signoff` verifies.
        - Every `bundle_manifest.members` of kind `gate1-register-set`
          and `gate2-register-set` resolves to register files in state
          `finalized`.
        - The PHI report (member id `phi`) reports zero hits.
        - The copyright report (member id `cpr`) reports per-page and
          document-wide footprints within manifest caps.
        - The IG build (member id `ig`) reports HL7 Validator clean and
          all resources reachable from the IG entry.
        - The CDS Hooks set (member id `cdsh`) declares
          `htn-pregnancy-denylist` as `order-select` with a hard-refusal
          posture.
        - For `build.first_publish == true`, the supersession
          Communication resource (member id `comm`) is present and wired
          to the IG.

  - id: G3A-INV-17
    description: >
      A `declined` attestation is terminal: no later `Attestation` in
      the same document may set `decision == "attest"`. Re-attestation
      requires a NEW attestation document with
      `predecessor_attestation_id` referring to the declined one.

  - id: G3A-INV-18
    description: >
      For any Attestation whose `coi_attestation_at_signoff.applicable_coi_kinds[]`
      contains a kind whose corresponding `coi_disclosures[]` entry has
      `auto_disqualifies_build == true`, the decision MUST be
      `escalate-to-board`. Validators MUST refuse `attest` decisions
      where the attester is auto-disqualified.

  - id: G3A-INV-19
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      The validator computes the chained hash of events and compares
      against a separately-maintained chain; out-of-order or missing
      events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  - id: G3A-INV-20
    description: >
      `fixity.attestation_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of this document with `fixity` excluded. The
      hash MUST be deterministic across re-runs given identical inputs.

  - id: G3A-INV-21
    description: >
      `predecessor_attestation_id` MUST be set when this attestation
      follows a declined or superseded predecessor. The predecessor's
      `state` (recorded in `predecessor_attestation_state`) MUST be one
      of `declined`, `superseded`, `escalated-to-board`, `withdrawn`.

  - id: G3A-INV-22
    description: >
      `build.build_version_label` MUST recompute exactly from the active
      manifest's
      `v<manifest_version>+ACC-AHA-2025+<jurisdiction>+<effective_date>`.
      Mismatch is a release blocker.

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 An attested document with single-control (medical director only).
#   6.2 A declined document with reason `coverage-below-floor`.
#
# EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from a real attester, real KMS
# key, real institutional contract, or live build artifacts is marked
# `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions. The pipeline refuses to
# operate on attestations containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.

# =============================================================================
# 7. CHANGE CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Any change to this schema (closed enums, policy clauses, validation rules,
# invariants, or example fixtures) requires:
#   - A change-controlled diff with regression evaluation against the golden set.
#   - Panel-chair signoff AND medical-director acknowledgement (since this
#     schema directly governs the medical director's signature surface).
#   - Increment of `schema_version` (semver: breaking = major).
#   - Update of `last_reviewed`.
#   - Coordinated update of every producing/consuming skill's tools_lock
#     reference and acceptance-test fixtures.
#   - Any change to: attester_identity; bundle_completeness;
#     bundle_integrity_recompute; bundle_member_canonicalization;
#     decline_without_publish; no_relax_of_prior_gates;
#     acknowledgement_toggles_required; decline_reason_required;
#     coi_auto_disqualification; post_attestation_immutability;
#     signature_algorithm; time_stamping; or publication_signal requires
#     ALSO an ADR-HTN-001 amendment with documented rationale and a new
#     medical-director signoff.
# =============================================================================

change_control:
  semver: true
  golden_set_regression_required: true
  panel_chair_signoff_required: true
  medical_director_acknowledgement_required: true
  parent_schemas_to_update_on_breaking_change:

    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/atomic-unit.yaml

    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml

    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/phi-scrub
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/fhir-implementation-guide-build
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/skills/guideline-docs
  adr_amendment_required_for_policy_changes:
    attester_identity: true
    bundle_completeness: true
    bundle_integrity_recompute: true
    bundle_member_canonicalization: true
    decline_without_publish: true
    no_relax_of_prior_gates: true
    acknowledgement_toggles_required: true
    decline_reason_required: true
    coi_auto_disqualification: true
    post_attestation_immutability: true
    signature_algorithm: true
    time_stamping: true
    publication_signal: true
    adr_to_amend: ADR-HTN-001 D5, D8, D9, D10, D11, D13, D14, D15
```

`schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml` is now complete: §1 policy (attester identity at IAL3/AAL3 for the medical director, IAL2/AAL2+ for the second attester; bundle completeness over the closed 18-member set; triple bundle-hash recompute at session start / before signing / after signing; bundle-member canonicalization rules; decline-without-publish terminal-state semantics; no-relax-of-prior-gates with eleven named patterns; required acknowledgement toggles for `attest`; required `decline_reason` for `decline`; COI auto-disqualification; post-attestation immutability; signature algorithms; time-stamping; publication signal); §2 closed enums (BundleMemberId, BundleMemberKind, CanonicalizationRule, AttesterRole, AttesterDecision, DeclineReason with 15 values, AttestationState, IAL/AAL, CredentialKind, SignatureAlgorithm, COIKind, AuditEventKind); §3 structured types (BundleMember, BundleManifest with `minItems: 18 / maxItems: 18`, IdentityProof, Credential, ConflictOfInterest, Attester, TimeStamp, Signature, Acknowledgements with 10 mandatory toggles, Attestation, AuditEvent); §4 root with explicit `dual_control_required` flag and `predecessor_attestation_id` chain; §5 twenty-two cross-field invariants `G3A-INV-01`…`G3A-INV-22` including the bundle hash recompute (`G3A-INV-03`), all-toggles-true for attest (`G3A-INV-08`), state consistency across single- and dual-control flows (`G3A-INV-14`), pattern-scan for relax-of-prior-gates (`G3A-INV-15`), upstream-prerequisite re-verification at attest time (`G3A-INV-16`), terminal-decline rule (`G3A-INV-17`), COI auto-disqualification (`G3A-INV-18`), build-version-label recompute (`G3A-INV-22`); two examples (attested single-control + declined `coverage-below-floor`); and §7 change control requiring both panel-chair and medical-director acknowledgement for any modification.

The Gate 1 / Gate 2 / Gate 3 schema set is now closed and self-consistent; together with `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, `guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml`, `recommendation-record-htn.yaml`, `atomic-unit.yaml`, `sair.yaml`, and `acc-aha-grading.yaml`, the framework's signature surface is fully specified.
