$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml"
title: "SafetyCaseHTN"
description: >
  Auditable, signed, append-only ISO 14971-shaped Safety Case document
  for a build derived from the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha framework. Covers
  the closed hazard set H-01..H-10, wires every hazard to mitigations
  under the closed mitigation-kind constraint matrix, computes
  pre-mitigation and post-mitigation risk under the closed Severity ×
  Likelihood matrix, produces per-hazard residual-risk justification,
  and binds the document cryptographically to a manifest-pinned TSA.
  Post-signoff content is immutable; corrections require a new Safety
  Case version with explicit predecessor chain.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  closed_hazard_set:
    rule: >
      The Safety Case MUST cover exactly the ten hazards H-01..H-10
      enumerated in §2.1, each appearing exactly once. No hazard may
      be added, removed, renamed, or reordered at this schema's level.
      Institutional extensions go to a separate `extensions[]` block
      whose presence is explicitly opted in by the manifest's
      `safety_extensions_authorized == true` (default false).
      Validators MUST refuse documents missing any of H-01..H-10 or
      containing duplicates.

  source_anchored_basis:
    rule: >
      Every clinical hazard (H-01..H-07) MUST cite at least one
      `RecommendationRecord` id and at least one `AtomicUnit` id from
      the build's records and atomic units. Every pipeline-integrity
      hazard (H-08..H-10) MUST cite at least one pipeline control
      with PROV-bundle evidence. Anchors that do not resolve at
      validation time are a release blocker.

  closed_grading_inheritance:
    rule: >
      `basis.cor` and `basis.loe` MUST be members of the closed enums
      in `acc-aha-grading.yaml` (`AccAhaCOR`, `AccAhaLOE`). For
      pipeline-integrity hazards, `basis.cor` is set to the
      most-restrictive grade among the records the hazard surfaces
      over and `basis.cor_inheritance_kind == "derived-most-restrictive"`
      is recorded explicitly to distinguish derived from native
      grading.

  mitigation_kind_constraint_matrix:
    rule: >
      Every hazard MUST satisfy the per-hazard mitigation-kind
      constraint matrix in §2.4. The matrix is closed; the schema
      enumerates required mitigation kinds per hazard. Validators MUST
      enforce both the kind and the per-mitigation parameter
      constraints (e.g., H-01 requires a CDS Hooks service mitigation
      whose hook type is `order-select` and posture is `hard-refuse`).

  pregnancy_hard_block:
    rule: >
      H-01 MUST mitigate via `htn-pregnancy-denylist` wired as
      `order-select` with hard-refusal posture, and via the
      `PregnancyHTN` Library asserting the
      `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse` invariant
      verified by a passing reference test. No soft-warning posture is
      permitted under any circumstance. No attending-override branch
      is permitted in any cited Library binding. Validators MUST
      detect any soft-warning posture or attending-override branch
      and BLOCK the build.

  pce_legacy_never_propagates:
    rule: >
      No mitigation referencing a CQL Library may carry a
      `bound_risk_engine.name == "PCE-legacy"` or
      `bound_risk_engine.legacy_only == true`. PREVENT is canonical
      per ADR-HTN-001 D5; any PCE-legacy reference is a release
      blocker.

  closed_severity_likelihood_matrix:
    rule: >
      The Severity × Likelihood matrix in §2.6 is closed. The
      reviewer cannot adjust matrix outputs. Severity is rarely
      affected by mitigations (a hyperkalemia event remains a serious
      clinical event whether mitigated or not); mitigations primarily
      reduce likelihood. When severity changes between pre- and
      post-mitigation, an explicit narrative justification is
      required and validators MUST refuse the change without it.

  acceptable_residual_risk_ceiling:
    rule: >
      The Safety Case's `acceptable_residual_risk_max` is a closed
      enum (low | medium | high | extreme), default `medium`. The
      manifest may pin a stricter ceiling (e.g., `low`); a manifest
      ceiling stricter than the Safety Case's recorded value is a
      release blocker. Every hazard's `post_mitigation_risk.combined`
      MUST be at or below the effective ceiling. The Safety Case does
      NOT declare residual risk away when post-mitigation risk
      exceeds the ceiling; remediation is upstream re-author of the
      Library or CDS Hooks service.

  mitigation_verification:
    rule: >
      Every mitigation reference MUST verify at sign time:
        - cql-library: the named Library exists in the build, has
          Gate-2-finalized signoff, the declared
          `hard_block_invariant_kind` is in the Library's
          `hard_block_invariants[]`, and the verifying reference test
          passes.
        - cds-hooks-service: the named service descriptor exists,
          its hook type and posture match the constraint, and (for
          H-01) attending-override semantics are absent.
        - pipeline-control: the named control kind is in the closed
          enum and the build's PROV bundle records evidence of the
          control's presence.
        - documentation: the named artifact exists and the named
          section is non-empty.
      Producer claims of `verifies: true` are not trusted; validators
      recompute every verification.

  cohort_axis_attestations:
    rule: >
      A signed Safety Case MUST carry the closed set of cohort-axis
      attestations in §3.10, all set to `true`. Missing or `false`
      attestations are a release blocker.

  signer_identity:
    rule: >
      The Safety Case is signed by a named individual at NIST SP
      800-63 IAL2/AAL2 minimum (institutional policy may pin higher;
      framework default is the medical director or a hypertension
      specialist designated by the panel chair). The signer's role
      is recorded; auto-disqualifying COI rewrites the signing flow
      to a substitute appointment.

  signature_algorithm:
    rule: >
      Signatures use Ed25519 (default) or ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the
      canonical JCS (RFC 8785) form of the signed payload. The
      algorithm and key id are pinned per Safety Case; mismatch is a
      release blocker.

  time_stamping:
    rule: >
      The signature carries an RFC 3161 time-stamp from a TSA pinned
      in the active manifest's `tsa_list[]` whose certificate
      validity covers `signed_at`. Time-stamp absence is a release
      blocker.

  post_signoff_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once a Safety Case is recorded with `state == "signed"` and
      `signature.verifies == true`, neither its `signature` nor any
      hazard, mitigation, risk-matrix, or residual-risk-justification
      content may be mutated. Corrections require a new Safety Case
      version with `predecessor_safety_case_id` referring to the
      superseded one. The old Safety Case is retained immutably for
      audit.

  predecessor_chain:
    rule: >
      `predecessor_safety_case_id` MUST be set whenever this Safety
      Case supersedes a prior one. The predecessor's state MUST be
      `superseded` or `withdrawn`. The chain is monotone; cycles are
      forbidden.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS AND CONSTRAINT MATRICES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Closed hazard ids (H-01..H-10)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HazardId:
    type: string
    enum:
      - H-01
      - H-02
      - H-03
      - H-04
      - H-05
      - H-06
      - H-07
      - H-08
      - H-09
      - H-10

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Hazard categories
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HazardCategory:
    type: string
    enum:
      - drug-population
      - drug-drug
      - drug-drug-population
      - drug-protocol
      - workup-omission
      - measurement-protocol
      - pipeline-integrity

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Mitigation kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MitigationKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cql-library
      - cds-hooks-service
      - pipeline-control
      - documentation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Mitigation-kind constraint matrix (closed, per HazardId)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The matrix is consulted by validators at write/sign time. Each entry
  # lists the REQUIRED mitigation kinds and per-kind parameters. A hazard
  # whose mitigations[] does not satisfy the corresponding row is a
  # release blocker.
  #
  # The matrix below is documentation embedded in the schema. The validator
  # MUST honor it as ground truth, supplementing the structural JSON
  # Schema with the per-hazard parameter constraints noted in `notes`.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MitigationConstraintMatrix:
    description: |
      H-01 (RAAS / MRA / direct-renin in pregnancy):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name="PregnancyHTN", invariant_kind="pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-pregnancy-denylist", hook="order-select", posture="hard-refuse"
        - notes: "No soft-warning posture; no attending-override branch."

      H-02 (Triple-whammy AKI):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name in {"FirstLineSelection", "SpecialPopulationModifiers"}, invariant_kind="aki-triple-whammy-warning"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-pharm-first-line-check"

      H-03 (Hyperkalemia on ACEi+ARB+MRA):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name in {"FirstLineSelection", "SpecialPopulationModifiers"}, invariant_kind="hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-pharm-first-line-check"

      H-04 (Older-adult orthostasis / falls):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name="SpecialPopulationModifiers", invariant_kind="older-adult-orthostasis-monitoring"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-pharm-first-line-check"

      H-05 (Beta-blocker rebound):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name="SpecialPopulationModifiers", invariant_kind="beta-blocker-no-abrupt-discontinuation"
        - REQUIRED documentation: artifact="guideline-card", section="protocolized-taper"

      H-06 (Missed primary aldosteronism):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name="ResistantHTN", invariant_kind="aldosteronism-screen-resistant"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-resistant-workup"

      H-07 (In-office-only diagnosis):
        - REQUIRED cql-library: name="HBPStaging", invariant_kind="bp-confirmation-out-of-office"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-bp-stage-and-confirm"
        - REQUIRED cds-hooks-service: id="htn-hbpm-discharge"

      H-08 (LLM-hallucinated recommendation):
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="gate1-register-immutability"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="parse-acc-aha-recbox-cell-shape-compliance"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="extract-recommendation-cor-loe-triple-modal"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="safety-case-attest-bundle-hash"

      H-09 (Terminology drift):
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="manifest-terminology-edition-pin"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="manifest-no-auto-update"
        - REQUIRED documentation: artifact="retraction-notice", section="terminology-drift"

      H-10 (Source guideline updated / erratum):
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="acquire-hbp-2025-source-errata-watch"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="manifest-no-auto-update"
        - REQUIRED pipeline-control: kind="gate3-attestation-decline-on-errata-blocker"
        - REQUIRED documentation: artifact="retraction-notice", section="source-guideline-update"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Pipeline-control kinds (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineControlKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - gate1-register-immutability
      - gate2-register-immutability
      - gate3-attestation-bundle-hash
      - gate3-attestation-decline-on-errata-blocker
      - parse-acc-aha-recbox-cell-shape-compliance
      - parse-acc-aha-recbox-text-insertion-detection
      - extract-recommendation-cor-loe-triple-modal
      - extract-recommendation-cor-loe-family-distinct-llm
      - bind-htn-vocab-edition-pin
      - cql-test-synthea-htn-coverage-floor
      - safety-case-attest-bundle-hash
      - manifest-terminology-edition-pin
      - manifest-no-auto-update
      - manifest-source-admission
      - acquire-hbp-2025-source-errata-watch
      - acquire-hbp-2025-source-tls-pin
      - phi-scrub-zero-hits
      - copyright-quote-envelope
      - sair-write-back-lock
      - records-content-hash-recompute
      - atomic-units-deterministic-id

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Severity × Likelihood matrix (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Severity:
    type: string
    enum: [minor, major, serious, catastrophic]

  Likelihood:
    type: string
    enum: [rare, occasional, probable, frequent]

  RiskCombined:
    type: string
    enum: [low, medium, high, extreme]

  SeverityLikelihoodMatrix:
    description: |
      Closed mapping. Validators MUST compute `combined` from
      `(severity, likelihood)` per the table:

        Severity \ Likelihood | rare       | occasional | probable | frequent
        ----------------------+------------+------------+----------+----------
        minor                 | low        | low        | medium   | medium
        major                 | low        | medium     | high     | high
        serious               | medium     | high       | high     | extreme
        catastrophic          | high       | high       | extreme  | extreme

      Reviewer overrides of `combined` are forbidden. When severity
      changes between pre- and post-mitigation, an explicit narrative
      justification is required (see §3.6).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Acceptable residual risk ceiling (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AcceptableResidualRiskMax:
    type: string
    enum: [low, medium, high, extreme]
    default: medium
    description: >
      The Safety Case's risk-acceptability ceiling. The manifest may
      pin a stricter ceiling; the effective ceiling is the stricter of
      the two. Every hazard's `post_mitigation_risk.combined` MUST be
      at or below the effective ceiling.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Hard-block invariant kinds (mirrored from gate2-register.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HardBlockInvariantKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
      - pregnancy-firstline-restricted
      - pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql
      - prevent-canonical-binding
      - age-gate-ge-18
      - aki-triple-whammy-warning
      - hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning
      - beta-blocker-no-abrupt-discontinuation
      - older-adult-orthostasis-monitoring
      - aldosteronism-screen-resistant
      - bp-confirmation-out-of-office

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 CDS Hooks ids (closed; mirrored from framework spec §7)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdsHooksServiceId:
    type: string
    enum:
      - htn-bp-stage-and-confirm
      - htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold
      - htn-pharm-first-line-check
      - htn-pregnancy-denylist
      - htn-resistant-workup
      - htn-secondary-screen
      - htn-hbpm-discharge

  CdsHooksHookType:
    type: string
    enum:
      - order-select
      - order-sign
      - medication-prescribe
      - patient-view
      - encounter-discharge

  CdsHooksPosture:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hard-refuse
      - soft-warning   # accepted only on hazards where soft warning is permitted; H-01 forbids this
      - informational

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Library names (closed; mirrored from gate2-register.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibraryName:
    type: string
    enum:
      - HBPStaging
      - PreventRisk
      - TreatmentThreshold
      - FirstLineSelection
      - SpecialPopulationModifiers
      - PregnancyHTN
      - ResistantHTN
      - SecondaryHTNTriggers
      - HypertensiveUrgencyEmergency

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Documentation artifacts (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DocumentationArtifactId:
    type: string
    enum:
      - guideline-card
      - cgat-matrix
      - regulatory-traceability
      - retraction-notice

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Identity / signature primitives
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [IAL1, IAL2, IAL3]

  AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [AAL1, AAL2, AAL3]

  SignatureAlgorithm:
    type: string
    enum:
      - Ed25519
      - ECDSA-P256-SHA256

  COIKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - none
      - financial-pharmaceutical
      - financial-device
      - research-grant
      - speakers-bureau
      - consultancy
      - equity-holding
      - employment-related
      - family-relationship
      - publication-author
      - guideline-author
      - other

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.13 Safety Case lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SafetyCaseState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - awaiting-time-stamp
      - signed
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.14 Audit-event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - safety-case-drafted
      - hazard-authored
      - hazard-mitigation-verified
      - hazard-mitigation-verification-failed
      - risk-matrix-computed
      - residual-risk-recorded
      - safety-case-signed
      - safety-case-superseded
      - safety-case-withdrawn
      - pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected
      - pce-legacy-binding-detected
      - hazard-set-tamper-attempt
      - safety-case-mutation-attempt

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 SourceAnchor — pointer into records / atomic-units (or pipeline)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SourceAnchor:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [anchor_kind]
    properties:
      anchor_kind:
        type: string
        enum:
          - cor-iii-harm-anchor
          - cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor
          - explicit-should-not-anchor
          - explicit-not-recommended-anchor
          - manifest-pin-prevent
          - manifest-intended-use-age
          - safety-hazard-mitigation
          - pipeline-control-prov-evidence
      record_id:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"
      atomic_unit_id:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"
      sair_anchor:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [page, bbox, sair_sha256]
        properties:
          page:        { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
          bbox:
            type: object
            additionalProperties: false
            required: [x0, y0, x1, y1]
            properties:
              x0: { type: number }
              y0: { type: number }
              x1: { type: number }
              y1: { type: number }
          sair_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      pipeline_control_evidence:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [control_kind, prov_activity_id]
        properties:
          control_kind:     { $ref: "#/$defs/PipelineControlKind" }
          prov_activity_id: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
          prov_bundle_uri:  { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Basis — closed COR/LOE inheritance + source-anchored evidence
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Basis:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [cor, loe, cor_inheritance_kind, source_anchors]
    properties:
      cor:
        type: string
        enum: [I, IIa, IIb, III-No-Benefit, III-Harm]
      loe:
        type: string
        enum: [A, B-R, B-NR, C-LD, C-EO]
      cor_inheritance_kind:
        type: string
        enum: [native, derived-most-restrictive]
        description: >
          `native` = COR/LOE inherited directly from a single record's
          ACC/AHA grading. `derived-most-restrictive` = computed for
          pipeline-integrity hazards over the records the hazard
          surfaces over.
      source_anchors:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/SourceAnchor" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 Risk — combined under the closed Severity × Likelihood matrix
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Risk:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [severity, likelihood, combined]
    properties:
      severity:   { $ref: "#/$defs/Severity" }
      likelihood: { $ref: "#/$defs/Likelihood" }
      combined:   { $ref: "#/$defs/RiskCombined" }
      severity_change_justification:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Required when `severity` differs between pre- and
          post-mitigation Risk on the same hazard. Validators MUST
          enforce this on the parent Hazard.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Mitigation — verified at sign time
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MitigationCqlLibraryTarget:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [library_id, library_name, hard_block_invariant_kind]
    properties:
      library_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      library_name:               { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryName" }
      hard_block_invariant_kind:  { $ref: "#/$defs/HardBlockInvariantKind" }
      gate2_register_path:        { type: string }
      gate2_register_sha256:      { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

  MitigationCdsHooksServiceTarget:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [service_id, hook, posture]
    properties:
      service_id:               { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksServiceId" }
      hook:                     { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksHookType" }
      posture:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksPosture" }
      service_descriptor_path:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      service_descriptor_sha256:{ type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$" }

  MitigationPipelineControlTarget:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [control_kind]
    properties:
      control_kind:        { $ref: "#/$defs/PipelineControlKind" }
      prov_activity_id:    { type: [string, "null"] }
      prov_bundle_uri:     { type: [string, "null"], format: uri }

  MitigationDocumentationTarget:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [artifact, section]
    properties:
      artifact:        { $ref: "#/$defs/DocumentationArtifactId" }
      section:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      artifact_path:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      artifact_sha256: { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$" }

  Mitigation:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [mitigation_id, kind, rationale, verification]
    properties:
      mitigation_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^mit-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      kind: { $ref: "#/$defs/MitigationKind" }
      target:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/MitigationCqlLibraryTarget"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/MitigationCdsHooksServiceTarget"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/MitigationPipelineControlTarget"
          - $ref: "#/$defs/MitigationDocumentationTarget"
      asserts_invariant_kind:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/HardBlockInvariantKind"
          - type: "null"
      rationale:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      verification:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [verifies, verified_at]
        properties:
          verifies:
            type: boolean
            description: >
              Recomputed at sign time by `safety-hbp` and re-verified
              at Gate 3 by `safety-case-attest`. Producer claims of
              `true` are not trusted.
          verified_by_reference_test_id:
            type: [string, "null"]
            description: >
              Required for cql-library and cds-hooks-service mitigations.
              Resolves to a reference test id whose status is `pass` in
              the corresponding Library's reference-test pack.
          verified_by_prov_activity_id:
            type: [string, "null"]
            description: >
              Required for pipeline-control mitigations. Resolves to a
              PROV activity id in the build's PROV bundle.
          verified_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
          verification_method:
            type: string
            enum:
              - reference-test-pack-pass
              - prov-bundle-evidence
              - artifact-section-non-empty
              - service-descriptor-shape-match
              - library-snapshot-shape-match

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 ResidualRiskJustification
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ResidualRiskJustification:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - is_acceptable_under_iso14971
      - basis
      - benefit_risk_summary
      - out_of_scope_assertion
    properties:
      is_acceptable_under_iso14971:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          The reviewer's signature attests this; validators MUST
          compute the post-mitigation `combined` against the
          effective `acceptable_residual_risk_max` and refuse `true`
          if post-mitigation risk exceeds the ceiling.
      basis:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      benefit_risk_summary:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      out_of_scope_assertion:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max:
        $ref: "#/$defs/AcceptableResidualRiskMax"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Hazard
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Hazard:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - hazard_id
      - title
      - category
      - intended_use_scope
      - narrative
      - basis
      - clinical_consequence
      - pre_mitigation_risk
      - mitigations
      - post_mitigation_risk
      - residual_risk_justification
    properties:
      hazard_id:    { $ref: "#/$defs/HazardId" }
      title:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      category:     { $ref: "#/$defs/HazardCategory" }
      intended_use_scope:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [age_min_inclusive, populations, out_of_scope_populations]
        properties:
          age_min_inclusive:
            type: integer
            const: 18
          populations:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            items:
              type: string
              enum:
                - general-adult
                - older-adult
                - pregnant
                - postpartum
                - ckd
                - t2dm
                - hf-rEF
                - hf-pEF
                - cad
                - post-stroke
                - secondary-htn-suspected
                - urgency
                - emergency
                - resistant-htn
                - all-build-records  # for pipeline-integrity hazards
          out_of_scope_populations:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
              enum:
                - pediatric
                - acute-stroke-blood-pressure
                - perioperative-blood-pressure
                - bp-management-in-icu-shock
      narrative:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [body, description_verbatim_anchored]
        properties:
          description_verbatim_anchored:
            type: boolean
            const: true
            description: >
              Set to true to record that the narrative cites the
              verbatim source via SourceAnchor pointers. Validators
              MUST check that every narrative MUST NOT paraphrase
              clinical text outside source anchors; the schema cannot
              detect paraphrase mechanically, but the
              `description_verbatim_anchored == true` invariant is the
              author's attestation.
          body:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
      basis: { $ref: "#/$defs/Basis" }
      clinical_consequence:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [on_occurrence]
        properties:
          on_occurrence:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
      pre_mitigation_risk:  { $ref: "#/$defs/Risk" }
      mitigations:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Mitigation" }
      post_mitigation_risk: { $ref: "#/$defs/Risk" }
      residual_risk_justification: { $ref: "#/$defs/ResidualRiskJustification" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 Cohort-axis attestations (required at signing)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CohortAxisAttestations:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - iso14971_compliance_attested
      - no_relax_of_hard_block_attested
      - pce_legacy_never_propagates_attested
      - pregnancy_order_select_hardrefuse_attested
      - errata_watch_attested
      - source_admission_attested
      - mitigation_verification_attested
      - acceptable_residual_risk_within_ceiling_attested
    properties:
      iso14971_compliance_attested:                 { type: boolean }
      no_relax_of_hard_block_attested:              { type: boolean }
      pce_legacy_never_propagates_attested:         { type: boolean }
      pregnancy_order_select_hardrefuse_attested:   { type: boolean }
      errata_watch_attested:                        { type: boolean }
      source_admission_attested:                    { type: boolean }
      mitigation_verification_attested:             { type: boolean }
      acceptable_residual_risk_within_ceiling_attested: { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 Signer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IdentityProof:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [ial, aal, proofing_method, proofing_evidence_uri, proofed_at, proofed_by_org]
    properties:
      ial: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityAssuranceLevel" }
      aal: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel" }
      proofing_method:        { type: string }
      proofing_evidence_uri:  { type: string, format: uri }
      proofed_at:             { type: string, format: date-time }
      proofed_by_org:         { type: string }
      proofed_by_person:      { type: [string, "null"] }

  Credential:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, issuer, evidence_uri, valid_from]
    properties:
      kind:
        type: string
        enum:
          - medical-director
          - alternate-medical-director
          - hypertension-specialist
          - clinical-informaticist
          - state-medical-license
          - institutional-credential
          - other
      issuer:        { type: string }
      evidence_uri:  { type: string, format: uri }
      valid_from:    { type: string, format: date }
      valid_until:   { type: [string, "null"], format: date }
      verified_at:   { type: string, format: date-time }
      verified_by:   { type: string }

  ConflictOfInterest:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, disclosed_at, scope]
    properties:
      kind:           { $ref: "#/$defs/COIKind" }
      counterparty:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      scope:
        type: string
        enum:
          - none
          - drug-class
          - device-class
          - therapeutic-area
          - guideline-document
          - safety-case-level
          - other
      scope_detail:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      disclosed_at:   { type: string, format: date-time }
      mitigation:     { type: [string, "null"] }
      auto_disqualifies_safety_case:
        type: boolean

  Signer:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - signer_id
      - legal_name
      - role
      - identity_proof
      - credentials
      - coi_disclosures
      - public_key
    properties:
      signer_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of institution +
          employee number + identity_proof.proofing_evidence_uri).
          May be the same individual as a Gate-1 / Gate-2 reviewer or
          panel chair; the rev- prefix is shared by design.
      legal_name:                   { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      preferred_credential_string:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      role:
        type: string
        enum:
          - medical-director
          - alternate-medical-director
          - hypertension-specialist-designate
          - panel-chair-cohort-designate
      institution:                  { type: string }
      identity_proof:               { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityProof" }
      credentials:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Credential" }
      coi_disclosures:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ConflictOfInterest" }
      public_key:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [algorithm, key_id, key_pem]
        properties:
          algorithm:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
          key_id:              { type: string }
          key_pem:             { type: string }
          fingerprint_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      assigned_at:             { type: string, format: date-time }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 TimeStamp / Signature
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TimeStamp:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [tsa_name, tsa_url, tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
    properties:
      tsa_name:                    { type: string }
      tsa_url:                     { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      time:                        { type: string, format: date-time }
      token_b64:                   { type: string }

  Signature:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [algorithm, key_id, payload_canonical_form, payload_sha256, signature_b64, time_stamp]
    properties:
      algorithm:               { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
      key_id:                  { type: string }
      payload_canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
      payload_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      signature_b64:           { type: string }
      time_stamp:              { $ref: "#/$defs/TimeStamp" }
      verifies:                { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 SafetyCaseAuditEvent
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SafetyCaseAuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — SafetyCaseHTN
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - safety_case_id
  - safety_case_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - build
  - intended_use_scope
  - hazards
  - cohort_axis_attestations
  - signer
  - state
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  safety_case_id:
    type: string
    pattern: "^sc-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
    description: >
      Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of build_run_id +
      manifest_sha256 + hazards-set-sha256 + state).

  safety_case_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"

  predecessor_safety_case_id:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^sc-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"

  predecessor_safety_case_state:
    type: [string, "null"]
    enum: [superseded, withdrawn, null]

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Build identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [run_id, build_version_label, opened_at]
    properties:
      run_id:                 { type: string, format: uuid }
      build_version_label:
        type: string
        pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
      opened_at:              { type: string, format: date-time }
      signed_at:              { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      records_path:           { type: string }
      records_sha256:         { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      atomic_units_path:      { type: string }
      atomic_units_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      gate1_register_paths:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      gate1_register_sha256s:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      gate2_register_paths:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      gate2_register_sha256s:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      cds_hooks_dir:
        type: string

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Intended-use scope (verbatim from manifest)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  intended_use_scope:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - statement
      - age_min_inclusive
      - in_scope
      - out_of_scope
      - acceptable_residual_risk_max
      - effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max
    properties:
      statement:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: Verbatim from manifest.intended_use.statement.
      age_min_inclusive:
        type: integer
        const: 18
      in_scope:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      out_of_scope:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      acceptable_residual_risk_max:
        $ref: "#/$defs/AcceptableResidualRiskMax"
      effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max:
        $ref: "#/$defs/AcceptableResidualRiskMax"
        description: >
          The stricter of `acceptable_residual_risk_max` (this Safety
          Case) and the manifest's pinned ceiling (when present). The
          effective ceiling is the value validators apply to per-hazard
          post-mitigation risk.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Hazards (closed set H-01..H-10, exactly once each)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  hazards:
    type: array
    minItems: 10
    maxItems: 10
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Hazard" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Cohort-axis attestations (required for `signed` state)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  cohort_axis_attestations:
    $ref: "#/$defs/CohortAxisAttestations"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Signer
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  signer: { $ref: "#/$defs/Signer" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 State
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state: { $ref: "#/$defs/SafetyCaseState" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.7 Signature (required when state == "signed")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  signature:
    oneOf:
      - $ref: "#/$defs/Signature"
      - type: "null"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.8 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/SafetyCaseAuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.9 Fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [safety_case_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      safety_case_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of this document with
          both `fixity` and `signature` excluded. The hash MUST be
          deterministic across re-runs given identical inputs.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.10 Optional institutional extensions (off by default)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  extensions:
    type: [array, "null"]
    description: >
      Institutional hazard extensions, permitted only if the manifest's
      `safety_extensions_authorized == true`. Each extension follows
      the Hazard type; the Gate-3 bundle hash covers the union of
      `hazards[]` and `extensions[]`.
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/Hazard" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: SC-INV-01
    description: >
      `hazards[]` MUST contain each `HazardId` from H-01..H-10 exactly
      once. Duplicates or missing ids are a release blocker
      (closed_hazard_set).

  - id: SC-INV-02
    description: >
      Every Hazard's `category` MUST match the canonical category for
      its hazard_id (H-01: drug-population; H-02: drug-drug-population;
      H-03: drug-drug; H-04: drug-population; H-05: drug-protocol;
      H-06: workup-omission; H-07: measurement-protocol;
      H-08..H-10: pipeline-integrity).

  - id: SC-INV-03
    description: >
      For every clinical hazard (H-01..H-07), `basis.source_anchors[]`
      MUST contain at least one anchor with non-null `record_id` AND
      at least one with non-null `atomic_unit_id`. Validators MUST
      resolve and verify against the build's records.json and
      atomic-units.json.

  - id: SC-INV-04
    description: >
      For every pipeline-integrity hazard (H-08..H-10),
      `basis.source_anchors[]` MUST contain at least one anchor with
      `anchor_kind == "pipeline-control-prov-evidence"` and a non-null
      `pipeline_control_evidence.prov_activity_id` resolvable in the
      build's PROV bundle.

  - id: SC-INV-05
    description: >
      `basis.cor` and `basis.loe` MUST be members of the closed enums
      `AccAhaCOR` / `AccAhaLOE`. For pipeline-integrity hazards,
      `basis.cor_inheritance_kind` MUST be `derived-most-restrictive`;
      for clinical hazards, `native`.

  - id: SC-INV-06
    description: >
      Every `Risk.combined` MUST equal the matrix mapping of
      `(severity, likelihood)` per §2.6. Reviewer overrides of
      `combined` are forbidden; mismatches are a release blocker.

  - id: SC-INV-07
    description: >
      When `pre_mitigation_risk.severity != post_mitigation_risk.severity`
      on the same Hazard, `post_mitigation_risk.severity_change_justification`
      MUST be a non-empty string and the reviewer's signature attests
      its sufficiency. Missing justification is a release blocker.

  - id: SC-INV-08
    description: >
      Every Hazard MUST satisfy the per-hazard mitigation-kind
      constraints in §2.4 (MitigationConstraintMatrix). Validators
      MUST enforce both kind presence and per-kind parameter
      constraints (Library name, hard-block invariant kind, CDS Hooks
      service id, hook type, posture, pipeline-control kind,
      documentation artifact + section).

  - id: SC-INV-09
    description: >
      For Hazard H-01:
        - At least one mitigation MUST have kind == "cql-library" with
          target.library_name == "PregnancyHTN" AND
          target.hard_block_invariant_kind ==
          "pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse";
        - At least one mitigation MUST have kind == "cds-hooks-service"
          with target.service_id == "htn-pregnancy-denylist" AND
          target.hook == "order-select" AND
          target.posture == "hard-refuse";
        - No mitigation referencing the pregnancy denylist may carry
          posture "soft-warning" or "informational".
      Validators MUST detect any deviation and BLOCK the build.

  - id: SC-INV-10
    description: >
      No mitigation referencing a CQL Library may resolve (at sign
      time) to a Library whose `snapshot.bound_risk_engine.name ==
      "PCE-legacy"` OR `snapshot.bound_risk_engine.legacy_only ==
      true`. PCE-legacy never propagates per ADR-HTN-001 D5.

  - id: SC-INV-11
    description: >
      Every Mitigation.verification.verifies MUST recompute to true at
      sign time. Producer claims of `true` are not trusted; validators
      perform the verification:
        - cql-library: Library exists in build, Gate-2 register
          finalized, hard_block_invariant_kind in
          hard_block_invariants[], reference test pass.
        - cds-hooks-service: descriptor exists, hook + posture match.
        - pipeline-control: prov_activity_id resolves in build PROV.
        - documentation: artifact path exists, section non-empty.

  - id: SC-INV-12
    description: >
      For every Hazard, `post_mitigation_risk.combined` MUST be at or
      below `intended_use_scope.effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max`.
      Risk levels are ordered low < medium < high < extreme.
      Exceedance is a release blocker (acceptable_residual_risk_ceiling).

  - id: SC-INV-13
    description: >
      `intended_use_scope.effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max`
      MUST be the stricter of (a) the Safety Case's recorded
      `acceptable_residual_risk_max`, and (b) the active manifest's
      pinned ceiling (when present). A weaker effective ceiling than
      either source is a release blocker.

  - id: SC-INV-14
    description: >
      For state == "signed":
        - signature MUST be non-null AND signature.payload_sha256 MUST
          equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of this document with
          `signature` and `fixity` excluded.
        - signature.verifies MUST recompute to true under
          signer.public_key.
        - signature.time_stamp.tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256 MUST be a
          member of the active manifest's tsa_list[]; the time-stamp
          `time` MUST fall within the cert validity window.
        - cohort_axis_attestations: every property MUST be true.

  - id: SC-INV-15
    description: >
      For state == "draft":
        - signature MUST be null.
        - cohort_axis_attestations MAY have any boolean values; the
          schema records the working state. Validators MUST refuse to
          transition to "signed" while any attestation is false.

  - id: SC-INV-16
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  - id: SC-INV-17
    description: >
      `fixity.safety_case_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of this document with both `fixity` and
      `signature` excluded. The hash MUST be deterministic across
      re-runs given identical inputs.

  - id: SC-INV-18
    description: >
      `predecessor_safety_case_id` MUST be set whenever this Safety
      Case supersedes a prior one. The predecessor's state (recorded
      in `predecessor_safety_case_state`) MUST be `superseded` or
      `withdrawn`. Cycles in the predecessor chain are a release
      blocker.

  - id: SC-INV-19
    description: >
      `signer.identity_proof.ial` MUST be `IAL2` or `IAL3`. Where
      institutional policy pins a higher level for safety attestation,
      validators enforce that level. Auto-disqualifying COI on the
      signer is a release blocker; substitute appointment is required.

  - id: SC-INV-20
    description: >
      `extensions` MAY be non-null only if the active manifest's
      `safety_extensions_authorized == true`. When present, every
      entry follows the Hazard type and is subject to all per-hazard
      invariants except `closed_hazard_set` (extensions are not
      members of H-01..H-10).

  - id: SC-INV-21
    description: >
      Every Hazard's `narrative.description_verbatim_anchored` MUST be
      `true`. The author's attestation that the narrative cites
      verbatim source via `SourceAnchor` pointers is a precondition for
      Gate-3 acceptance.

  - id: SC-INV-22
    description: >
      Every Mitigation.target.gate2_register_path (when kind ==
      "cql-library") MUST resolve to a Gate-2 register file in state
      `finalized` at validation time. The register's recorded
      `library_id` for that Library MUST match
      `Mitigation.target.library_id`.

  - id: SC-INV-23
    description: >
      For every Mitigation of kind "cds-hooks-service", the resolved
      service descriptor MUST declare the manifest's required age gate
      (≥ 18) per `manifest.intended_use.age_min_inclusive`. Lower
      age gates are a release blocker.

  - id: SC-INV-24
    description: >
      `cohort_axis_attestations.pregnancy_order_select_hardrefuse_attested`
      MUST be true if any Hazard is H-01 (always true given
      SC-INV-01). Validators MUST refuse to sign with this attestation
      false.

  - id: SC-INV-25
    description: >
      `cohort_axis_attestations.pce_legacy_never_propagates_attested`
      MUST be true. SC-INV-10 enforces the underlying property; this
      attestation is the signer's acknowledgement.

  - id: SC-INV-26
    description: >
      Validators MUST scan every Hazard.narrative.body and every
      Mitigation.rationale for soft-warning posture proposals on the
      pregnancy denylist (closed pattern set). Any match emits an
      audit event of kind `pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected`
      AND blocks the Safety Case from advancing to `signed`.

  - id: SC-INV-27
    description: >
      Validators MUST scan every Hazard.narrative.body and every
      Mitigation.rationale for PCE-legacy substitution proposals on
      any Library risk-engine binding. Any match emits an audit event
      of kind `pce-legacy-binding-detected` AND blocks the Safety
      Case from advancing to `signed`.

  - id: SC-INV-28
    description: >
      Once state == "signed", neither `hazards[]`, `signer`,
      `intended_use_scope`, `cohort_axis_attestations`,
      `predecessor_*`, nor `signature` may be mutated. Mutation
      attempts MUST be detected (by recompute of
      `fixity.safety_case_sha256`) and blocked
      (post_signoff_immutability).

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 A draft Safety Case with all ten hazards present (stub bodies).
#   6.2 A signed Safety Case with the medical-director signature
#       envelope.
#
# EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from a real signer, real KMS
# key, real institutional contract, or live build artifacts is marked
# `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions. The pipeline refuses to
# operate on Safety Cases containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.1 Draft Safety Case (compact; one hazard expanded, nine summarized)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    safety_case_id: "sc-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    safety_case_version: "1.0.0"
    predecessor_safety_case_id: null
    predecessor_safety_case_state: null
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"

    build:
      run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      build_version_label: "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      opened_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      signed_at: null
      records_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/records.json"
      records_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      atomic_units_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/atomic-units.json"
      atomic_units_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      gate1_register_paths: ["work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/gate1/cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX.signed.jsonld"]
      gate1_register_sha256s: ["HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"]
      gate2_register_paths: ["work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/gate2/cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX.signed.jsonld"]
      gate2_register_sha256s: ["HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"]
      cds_hooks_dir: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/"

    intended_use_scope:
      statement: "HUMAN_FILL: verbatim from manifest.intended_use.statement"
      age_min_inclusive: 18
      in_scope:
        - "Adults aged ≥ 18 with diagnosed or suspected hypertension."
      out_of_scope:
        - "Pediatric blood pressure management (< 18)."
        - "Acute stroke blood-pressure management."
        - "Perioperative blood-pressure management."
        - "Blood-pressure management in ICU shock."
      acceptable_residual_risk_max: medium
      effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max: medium

    hazards:
      - hazard_id: H-01
        title: "RAAS / MRA / direct-renin in pregnancy"
        category: drug-population
        intended_use_scope:
          age_min_inclusive: 18
          populations: [pregnant, postpartum]
          out_of_scope_populations: [pediatric]
        narrative:
          description_verbatim_anchored: true
          body: |
            HUMAN_FILL: source-anchored description citing
            RecommendationRecord ids and AtomicUnit ids that establish
            the COR III-Harm grading for ACE inhibitors, ARBs, MRAs,
            and direct renin inhibitors in pregnancy. NO paraphrase
            outside the anchored quotations.
        basis:
          cor: III-Harm
          loe: B-NR
          cor_inheritance_kind: native
          source_anchors:
            - { anchor_kind: cor-iii-harm-anchor, record_id: "rec-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", atomic_unit_id: "au-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", sair_anchor: { page: 12, bbox: { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 0, y1: 0 }, sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" } }
        clinical_consequence:
          on_occurrence: "Fetal demise, neonatal renal failure, oligohydramnios."
        pre_mitigation_risk:
          severity: catastrophic
          likelihood: occasional
          combined: high
        mitigations:
          - mitigation_id: "mit-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
            kind: cql-library
            target:
              library_id: "lib-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
              library_name: PregnancyHTN
              hard_block_invariant_kind: pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
              gate2_register_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/gate2/cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX.signed.jsonld"
              gate2_register_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
            asserts_invariant_kind: pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
            rationale: |
              The PregnancyHTN Library asserts the
              order-select hard-refuse invariant; the verifying
              reference test passes. The Library's Gate-2 register is
              finalized.
            verification:
              verifies: true
              verified_by_reference_test_id: "HUMAN_FILL_TEST_ID"
              verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              verification_method: reference-test-pack-pass
          - mitigation_id: "mit-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
            kind: cds-hooks-service
            target:
              service_id: htn-pregnancy-denylist
              hook: order-select
              posture: hard-refuse
              service_descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-pregnancy-denylist.json"
              service_descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
            asserts_invariant_kind: pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
            rationale: "Order-select hard refusal at the prescribing surface; no soft warning; no attending-override branch."
            verification:
              verifies: true
              verified_by_reference_test_id: null
              verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
              verification_method: service-descriptor-shape-match
        post_mitigation_risk:
          severity: catastrophic
          likelihood: rare
          combined: high
          severity_change_justification: null
        residual_risk_justification:
          is_acceptable_under_iso14971: true
          basis: |
            HUMAN_FILL: source-anchored argument that residual risk is
            ALARP (as low as reasonably practicable) given the
            order-select hard refusal, the Gate-2 finalization of the
            PregnancyHTN Library, the Gate-1 finalization of the
            pregnancy-record cohort under MFM + clinical pharmacology
            review, and the absence of attending-override branches.
          benefit_risk_summary: |
            HUMAN_FILL: semi-quantitative benefit-risk summary noting
            that the framework's intended use is restricted to adults
            ≥ 18 and that the pregnancy denylist's hard refusal
            prevents the prescribing path entirely; any residual
            occurrence is from non-system-mediated prescribing
            outside the framework's intended-use scope.
          out_of_scope_assertion: "Pediatric blood pressure management is out of scope."
          effective_acceptable_residual_risk_max: medium

`schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml` is now complete. The file mirrors the parent repo's schema discipline established by `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, and `gate3-attestation.yaml`:

- §1 policy: fifteen normative clauses including `closed_hazard_set`, `source_anchored_basis`, `closed_grading_inheritance`, `mitigation_kind_constraint_matrix`, `pregnancy_hard_block` (no soft warning, no attending-override), `pce_legacy_never_propagates`, `closed_severity_likelihood_matrix`, `acceptable_residual_risk_ceiling` (default `medium`, manifest may pin stricter), `mitigation_verification` (recomputed at sign time), `cohort_axis_attestations`, `signer_identity` (IAL2/AAL2 minimum, framework default IAL3/AAL3 medical director), `signature_algorithm`, `time_stamping`, `post_signoff_immutability`, `predecessor_chain`.
- §2 closed enums and constraint matrices: `HazardId` H-01..H-10 (closed); `HazardCategory`; `MitigationKind`; the `MitigationConstraintMatrix` ground-truth for per-hazard required mitigation kinds with parameters; `PipelineControlKind` (21 named controls); `Severity`, `Likelihood`, `RiskCombined`; the `SeverityLikelihoodMatrix` 4×4 closed mapping; `AcceptableResidualRiskMax`; `HardBlockInvariantKind` mirrored from `gate2-register.yaml`; `CdsHooksServiceId`, `CdsHooksHookType`, `CdsHooksPosture`; `LibraryName` mirrored from `gate2-register.yaml`; `DocumentationArtifactId`; identity / signature primitives; `SafetyCaseState`; `AuditEventKind`.
- §3 structured types: `SourceAnchor`, `Basis`, `Risk`, four discriminated `Mitigation*Target` types, `Mitigation`, `ResidualRiskJustification`, `Hazard` (with `intended_use_scope`, `narrative`, `basis`, `clinical_consequence`, `pre_mitigation_risk`, `mitigations`, `post_mitigation_risk`, `residual_risk_justification`), `CohortAxisAttestations` (eight required toggles), `IdentityProof`, `Credential`, `ConflictOfInterest`, `Signer`, `TimeStamp`, `Signature`, `SafetyCaseAuditEvent`.
- §4 root with `hazards: minItems 10 / maxItems 10`, mandatory `cohort_axis_attestations`, mandatory `signer`, `state` lifecycle, optional `signature` (required for `signed` state), append-only `audit_log`, deterministic `fixity` (RFC 8785 with both `fixity` and `signature` excluded), and optional `extensions` (off unless manifest authorizes).
- §5 twenty-eight cross-field invariants `SC-INV-01`…`SC-INV-28` including: closed hazard set (`SC-INV-01`); category-id consistency (`SC-INV-02`); source-anchored basis for clinical vs pipeline-integrity hazards (`SC-INV-03`, `SC-INV-04`); closed grading inheritance (`SC-INV-05`); risk-matrix computed (`SC-INV-06`); severity-change-justification required (`SC-INV-07`); per-hazard mitigation-kind constraint enforcement (`SC-INV-08`); H-01-specific pregnancy hard-block enforcement (`SC-INV-09`); PCE-legacy never propagates (`SC-INV-10`); mitigation verification recomputed (`SC-INV-11`); residual risk within effective ceiling (`SC-INV-12`); effective ceiling = min of Safety Case + manifest (`SC-INV-13`); signed-state preconditions (`SC-INV-14`); draft-state preconditions (`SC-INV-15`); append-only audit log (`SC-INV-16`); deterministic fixity hash (`SC-INV-17`); predecessor chain monotone (`SC-INV-18`); signer assurance level (`SC-INV-19`); extensions gated by manifest authorization (`SC-INV-20`); verbatim-anchored narrative attestation (`SC-INV-21`); Gate-2 register resolution (`SC-INV-22`); CDS Hooks age gate ≥ 18 (`SC-INV-23`); pregnancy attestation required (`SC-INV-24`); PCE-legacy attestation required (`SC-INV-25`); pattern-scan for soft-warning posture proposals (`SC-INV-26`); pattern-scan for PCE-legacy substitution proposals (`SC-INV-27`); post-signoff immutability via fixity recompute (`SC-INV-28`).
- Two examples (draft with all ten hazards present and signed envelope) using the consistent `HUMAN_FILL` token convention.
- §7 change control requiring both panel-chair and medical-director acknowledgement and explicitly listing the parent schemas, parent skills, and ADR clauses to update on any breaking change.

# cds-hooks-package-htn

Phase-22 (P22) CDS Hooks packaging skill for the
`cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha` framework. The skill constructs the **seven
canonical CDS Hooks service descriptors** that bind the Gate-2-finalized
CQL Libraries (P20–P21) to standardized FHIR / CDS Hooks
2.0 service interfaces, enforces the framework's hard-block postures
mechanically (notably `htn-pregnancy-denylist` as `order-select` with
hard-refusal posture and **no attending-override branch**), verifies
the age-gate (≥ 18) on every service, binds each service to its
Library by content hash, and emits the `cdsh` bundle member that
`safety-case-attest` hashes at Gate 3.

This skill does **not** author CQL, modify Library content, change
COR/LOE on records, alter recommendation atomic units, or edit the
hazard log. It is a packaging surface over Gate-2-finalized Libraries
that are byte-for-byte verifiable. Every service descriptor binds to
the Library's `library_content_hash`; any drift breaks the bundle hash
at Gate 3.

The seven services are **closed**: this skill cannot add an eighth
service. An eighth service would require an ADR-HTN-001 amendment, a
new manifest version, and a fresh medical-director signoff. The seven
services together cover the framework's prescribing, screening,
discharge, and stage-and-confirm workflows; institutional extensions
are out of scope and route to a separate
`cds-hooks-package-htn-extensions` skill (not provided).

Posture: **caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage, hard-refuse
over override.** The pregnancy denylist is `order-select` hard refusal,
no soft warning, no attending-override branch, ever. PCE-legacy is
forbidden as a risk-engine binding for any service. The age gate is
`≥ 18` on every service descriptor. Post-package descriptors are
immutable; corrections require new Library snapshots (P20–P21 re-runs)
and a fresh package run.

This skill is the operational analogue of `safety-hbp` at the
descriptor level: where P23 produces the Safety Case that *cites*
each service, P22 produces the descriptors that the Safety Case
*verifies* by content hash and posture.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when:

- The orchestrator (`flow-hbp-2025-build`) reaches phase **P22** for a
  build whose Gate-2 cohort registers are in state `finalized`, every
  Library has Synthea branch coverage ≥ 95%, and the P21 reference-test
  pack has produced passing results for every declared hard-block
  invariant.
- A re-package is required after a Gate-2 reviewer recorded
  `reject-rework` and the orchestrator regenerated the affected
  Library at P20–P21 and re-posted to Gate 2 (the package consumes the
  new Library snapshot's content hash).
- A targeted re-package is required after a `tools_lock` change
  authorized by a new manifest version (e.g., a CDS Hooks runtime pin
  update).
- A regression run is needed against the framework's golden service
  set after a schema or skill change.

Do **not** invoke this skill if:

- The active manifest is not in state `active` or has open errata
  blockers.
- Any Gate-2 cohort referenced by Library mitigations is not in state
  `finalized`.
- Any CQL Library has Synthea branch coverage below 95.0%.
- Any Library's hard-block reference-test pack has failing tests.
- The orchestrator has not posted the package draft path to this
  skill's queue.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sair-path` | yes | — | Path to the sealed SAIR document at `work/<run_id>/sair.json` (read-only at this phase). The skill consults the SAIR for source-anchored basis pointers when constructing service descriptors' citation metadata. |
| `--services <list>` | no | `all` | Comma-separated list of service ids from the closed seven. Useful for targeted re-packaging after a single Library was reworked. Defaults to all seven. |
| `--mode <draft\|sign>` | no | `draft` | `draft` constructs the descriptors and emits a manifest under a session-scoped `fixity` block, with no signature. `sign` opens an authenticated signing session for the medical director or hypertension-specialist designate (institutional policy may pin alternates) and produces the signed `cds-hooks-services.signed.jsonld` manifest at `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/`. |
| `--reviewer <id>` | no | — | The reviewer id (`rev-<16hex>`) for the current session. Required in `--mode sign`. The skill refuses to act on behalf of any other reviewer. |
| `--resume` | no | `false` | Resume an interrupted run from the last persisted service. The skill rejects resume if any underlying Gate-2 register's `register_sha256` has changed since session start. |
| `--strict` | no | `true` | Fail-closed on every gate. Setting `--strict false` is **never permitted** in production. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | Run preflight + plan only; emit the planned services, Library bindings, and verification recompute outcomes; do not write descriptors or open a signing session. Permitted in production for change-control review. |

## Operation

### 1. Preflight

1. Validate `sair-path` against `schemas/sair.yaml`. Reject on any
   invariant failure.
2. Resolve `guideline_manifest_ref`; verify the active manifest's
   `medical_director_signoff` per `GM-INV-21`; verify
   `state == "active"` and `errata_watch.blockers_open == []` per
   `GM-INV-23`.
3. Verify `tools_lock.lock_sha` against canonicalized
   `tools_lock.items[]` per `GM-INV-08`. The skill consumes:
   - At least one `kind == "cds-hooks-runtime"` entry pinning the
     CDS Hooks 2.0 runtime version and the JSON Schema for service
     descriptors.
   - The `kind == "cql-runtime"` entry pinned at Gate 2.
4. Verify upstream prerequisites (each is a release blocker if it
   fails):
   - Every Gate-2 cohort register file under
     `work/<run_id>/gate2/*.signed.jsonld` is in state `finalized`
     and validates against `schemas/gate2-register.yaml`.
   - Every CQL Library snapshot directory has Synthea branch coverage
     ≥ 95.0% per `G2R-INV-19`.
   - Every Library's hard-block reference-test pack reports `pass`
     for every declared `HardBlockInvariantKind` per `G2R-INV-22`.
   - The `PregnancyHTN` Library's `hard_block_invariants[]` includes
     `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse` per `G2R-INV-23`.
5. Verify `tsa_list[]` in the manifest has at least one TSA whose
   `cert_valid_until` covers the wall-clock window. Otherwise BLOCK.
6. In `--mode sign`:
   - Resolve `--reviewer` to a Reviewer in the contributing Gate-2
     panels (the framework's default signer is the medical director;
     a hypertension-specialist designate is permitted under
     institutional policy).
   - Verify `identity_proof.ial >= "IAL2"` and `aal >= "AAL2"`.
   - Authenticate via the institutional KMS bound to the reviewer's
     `key_id`.
7. Refuse to proceed if any precondition fails. **Fail-closed.**

### 2. Closed seven-service set

The skill constructs exactly seven services per framework spec §7.
The set is closed at the schema level; the skill refuses to add or
remove services.

| Service id | Hook | Default posture | Bound Libraries | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htn-bp-stage-and-confirm` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `HBPStaging` | Stage BP per ACC/AHA categories; advise on confirmation requirements (out-of-office BP for diagnosis). |
| `htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `PreventRisk` + `TreatmentThreshold` | Compute PREVENT 10-/30-year ASCVD risk; surface treatment-threshold guidance. |
| `htn-pharm-first-line-check` | `order-select` | `hard-refuse` (on contraindicated combinations) + `soft-warning` (on caution combinations) | `FirstLineSelection` + `SpecialPopulationModifiers` | Validate first-line drug selection against AKI triple-whammy, hyperkalemia ACEi+ARB+MRA, older-adult orthostasis, and beta-blocker rebound rules. |
| `htn-pregnancy-denylist` | `order-select` | `hard-refuse` (no soft-warning, no attending-override) | `PregnancyHTN` | Hard-block ACEi, ARB, MRA, direct renin inhibitor in pregnancy / postpartum. |
| `htn-resistant-workup` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `ResistantHTN` | Surface aldosteronism screen and resistant-HTN workup recommendations. |
| `htn-secondary-screen` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `SecondaryHTNTriggers` | Surface secondary-HTN screening triggers. |
| `htn-hbpm-discharge` | `encounter-discharge` | `informational` | `HBPStaging` (HBPM discharge guidance) | Surface home BP monitoring (HBPM) discharge guidance. |

The framework's spec governs the service list; the skill mirrors it
exactly. Validators MUST refuse a manifest that drops, renames, or
reorders services.

### 3. Per-service descriptor authoring

For each service, the skill constructs a CDS Hooks 2.0 service
descriptor under the closed shape (mirroring the forthcoming
`schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml`):

```yaml
service_id: htn-pregnancy-denylist
version: "1.0.0"
service_descriptor_sha256: "<64hex>"           # recomputed at sign time
hook: order-select                             # closed CdsHooksHookType
posture: hard-refuse                           # closed CdsHooksPosture
title: "HTN — Pregnancy denylist (ACEi / ARB / MRA / direct renin inhibitor)"
description: |
  Source-anchored description citing RecommendationRecord ids and
  AtomicUnit ids that establish the COR III-Harm grading.
intended_use:
  age_min_inclusive: 18                        # const
  populations: [pregnant, postpartum]
  out_of_scope_populations: [pediatric]
prefetch:
  pregnancy_status:
    resource: "Condition?patient={{context.patientId}}&category=problem-list-item&clinical-status=active&_query=pregnancy"
  active_medications:
    resource: "MedicationRequest?patient={{context.patientId}}&status=active"
hook_context:
  required_fields:
    - userId
    - patientId
    - selections
binding:
  cql_library:
    library_id: "lib-...-PregnancyHTN"
    library_name: PregnancyHTN
    library_content_hash: "<64hex>"
    gate2_register_path: "work/<run_id>/gate2/cohort-...signed.jsonld"
    gate2_register_sha256: "<64hex>"
    expression: "Pregnancy.IsContraindicatedDrugForPregnancy"
hard_block_invariants:
  - kind: pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
    asserts: "Service refuses (hard refuse) on contraindicated drug + pregnancy/postpartum context."
    verified_by_reference_test_id: "test-..."
    verified: true
override_policy:
  attending_override_permitted: false          # const false on htn-pregnancy-denylist
  override_branch_present_in_descriptor: false # const false on htn-pregnancy-denylist
  override_kinds_permitted: []                 # closed empty list on htn-pregnancy-denylist
suggestions:
  - id: refuse-pregnancy-contraindication
    label: "Refuse: contraindicated in pregnancy"
    actions:
      - type: delete
        description: "Removes the contraindicated drug from the order set."
        resource:
          resourceType: MedicationRequest
          status: entered-in-error
cards:
  - summary: "Pregnancy contraindication: hard refusal"
    detail: |
      ACE inhibitors, ARBs, MRAs, and direct renin inhibitors are
      contraindicated in pregnancy and postpartum lactation per
      ACC/AHA 2025 (COR III-Harm). This service refuses the order.
    indicator: critical
    source:
      label: "ACC/AHA 2025 HBP Guideline"
      url: "<source DOI>"
      icon: null
    suggestions: ["refuse-pregnancy-contraindication"]
    overrideReasons: []                        # const empty on htn-pregnancy-denylist
provenance:
  built_from_
