# cds-hooks-package-htn

Phase-22 (P22) CDS Hooks packaging skill for the
`cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha` framework. The skill constructs the closed
**seven-service CDS Hooks service set** from Gate-2-finalized CQL
Libraries, wires hooks to Libraries under the framework's
hook-type-and-posture constraint matrix, builds
**`htn-pregnancy-denylist` as `order-select` with hard-refusal
posture and no attending-override branch**, computes per-service
descriptor SHAs and the service-set manifest hash, and emits the
descriptors that become the `cdsh` member of the Gate-3 bundle hashed
and signed by `safety-case-attest`.

This skill does **not** author CQL, modify Library bytes, change
terminology bindings, alter risk-engine identity, edit recommendation
records, or modify atomic units. It is the **wiring** surface between
content (Libraries gated at Gate 2) and the prescribing surface
(EHR-side CDS Hooks consumers). Every wiring is a closed-by-policy
binding; the skill enforces the binding mechanically.

Posture: **caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage,
hard-refusal-on-pregnancy over attending-override.** No soft warning
on the pregnancy denylist under any circumstance. No attending-override
branch on any denylist (the framework default is no attending-override
on any service; institutional policy may opt in to soft-warning posture
on specific non-denylist services where the manifest explicitly
permits, but the pregnancy denylist remains hard refuse). PCE-legacy
never feeds any service. Age gate ≥ 18 on every service. Post-package
descriptors are immutable until the next P22 run against a new Library
snapshot or a new manifest version.

This skill is the operational counterpart of `safety-case-attest` at
the wiring level: where Gate 3 attests that the published service set
is faithful to the safety case, P22 produces the service set that the
Gate-3 bundle covers.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when:

- The orchestrator (`flow-hbp-2025-build`) reaches phase **P22** for a
  build whose Gate-2 cohort registers are in state `finalized`, whose
  Libraries pass the 95% Synthea coverage floor, and whose
  hard-block invariants verify.
- A targeted re-package is required after a Gate-2 reviewer recorded
  `reject-rework` on a Library that wires to a service (the
  orchestrator regenerates the Library at P20–P21 and re-posts to
  Gate 2; on resume, this skill re-verifies the Library and re-emits
  the affected service descriptor with a new descriptor SHA).
- A regression run is needed against the framework's golden
  service-set after a schema or skill change.
- A `--mode verify` re-check is needed by `safety-case-attest` at
  Gate 3 (the same descriptor SHAs are recomputed under the same
  canonicalization rule).

Do **not** invoke this skill if:

- The active manifest is not in state `active` or has open errata
  blockers.
- Any Gate-2 cohort referenced by a wiring is not in state
  `finalized`.
- Any Library bound to a service has Synthea branch coverage below
  95.0%.
- Any Library bound to a service has an unverified hard-block
  invariant.
- The orchestrator has not posted the service-set draft path to this
  skill's queue.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sair-path` | yes | — | Path to the sealed SAIR document at `work/<run_id>/sair.json` (read-only at this phase). The skill consults the SAIR for source-anchored citations recorded in service descriptor metadata. |
| `--services <list>` | no | `all` | Comma-separated list of service ids from the closed seven (see §2.1). Default packages the full seven-service set. |
| `--mode <build\|verify\|verify+build>` | no | `verify+build` | `build` constructs descriptors from live Library snapshots and writes them; `verify` recomputes descriptor SHAs against on-disk descriptors and reports drift; `verify+build` builds any missing descriptors and verifies all. |
| `--strict` | no | `true` | Fail-closed on every gate. Setting `--strict false` is **never permitted** in production. |
| `--resume` | no | `false` | Resume an interrupted run from the last persisted descriptor. The skill rejects resume if any contributing Library's `library_content_hash` has changed since session start. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | Run preflight + plan only; emit the planned service set and the Library-wiring outcomes; do not write descriptors. Permitted in production for change-control review. |

## Operation

### 1. Preflight

1. Validate `sair-path` against `schemas/sair.yaml`. Reject on any
   invariant failure.
2. Resolve `guideline_manifest_ref` from the SAIR; verify the active
   manifest's `medical_director_signoff` cryptographically per
   `GM-INV-21`; verify `state == "active"` and
   `errata_watch.blockers_open == []` per `GM-INV-23`.
3. Verify `tools_lock.lock_sha` against canonicalized
   `tools_lock.items[]` per `GM-INV-08`.
4. Verify upstream prerequisites (each is a release blocker):
   - Every Gate-2 cohort register file under
     `work/<run_id>/gate2/*.signed.jsonld` is in state `finalized`
     and validates against `schemas/gate2-register.yaml`.
   - Every CQL Library required by the wiring matrix in §3 has a
     finalized Library entry with branch coverage ≥ 95.0%, a clean
     typecheck, and verified hard-block invariants.
   - The manifest's `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18`
     (`GM-INV-24` semantics; the skill consults the value and
     refuses to build with any other age gate).
   - The manifest's pinned `risk_engine.name == "PREVENT"` and
     `risk_engine.legacy_only == false` (PCE-legacy never feeds
     CDS; `GM-INV-12` semantics).
5. Verify `tsa_list[]` has at least one TSA whose `cert_valid_until`
   covers the wall-clock window. Otherwise BLOCK.
6. Acquire the service-set write-back lock at
   `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/.lock`. The skill is the only writer
   into this directory during its run.
7. Refuse to proceed if any precondition fails. **Fail-closed.**

### 2. Closed seven-service set

The skill packages exactly the following seven services, in this
order, each appearing exactly once:

| Service id | Hook type | Posture | Bound Libraries | Hazards mitigated |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htn-bp-stage-and-confirm` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `HBPStaging` | H-07 |
| `htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `PreventRisk`, `TreatmentThreshold` | (binds risk engine; consulted by H-04, H-07 indirectly) |
| `htn-pharm-first-line-check` | `order-select` | `hard-refuse` | `FirstLineSelection`, `SpecialPopulationModifiers` | H-02, H-03, H-04 |
| `htn-pregnancy-denylist` | `order-select` | `hard-refuse` | `PregnancyHTN` | H-01 |
| `htn-resistant-workup` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `ResistantHTN` | H-06 |
| `htn-secondary-screen` | `patient-view` | `informational` | `SecondaryHTNTriggers` | (workup advisory) |
| `htn-hbpm-discharge` | `encounter-discharge` | `informational` | `HBPStaging` | H-07 |

The service set is **closed** at the schema level. The skill refuses
to add or remove services without a manifest-version-level amendment
under panel-chair signoff and an ADR-HTN-001 amendment.
Institution-specific services go to a separate `cds-hooks-extensions`
skill (out of scope) only if the manifest's
`cds_extensions_authorized == true`.

### 3. Hook-type and posture constraint matrix (closed)

The skill enforces the per-service hook-type and posture constraints
mechanically. Any deviation BLOCKs the build.

#### 3.1 `htn-bp-stage-and-confirm`
- Hook type: `patient-view` only. `order-select` and other types are
  rejected.
- Posture: `informational` only. `hard-refuse` is rejected (this
  service is advisory; staging cannot refuse a prescribing path).
- Bound Library: `HBPStaging`. The Library's `bp-confirmation-out-of-office`
  invariant MUST verify.
- Card semantics: at most one informational card per encounter; no
  prescription suggestions; no override semantics.

#### 3.2 `htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold`
- Hook type: `patient-view` only.
- Posture: `informational` only.
- Bound Libraries: `PreventRisk`, `TreatmentThreshold`. The
  `prevent-canonical-binding` and `pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql`
  invariants MUST verify on `PreventRisk`.
- Card semantics: a single risk-stratification card; numeric outputs
  cite the manifest's pinned PREVENT risk-engine version; the card
  MUST NOT cite PCE-legacy under any circumstance.
- The skill verifies that `bound_risk_engine.name == "PREVENT"` and
  `legacy_only == false` on the bound Libraries' Gate-2-finalized
  snapshots. PCE-legacy in any binding BLOCKs.

#### 3.3 `htn-pharm-first-line-check`
- Hook type: `order-select` only. `medication-prescribe` is
  rejected (the framework's policy is that first-line checks fire at
  selection, before signing).
- Posture: `hard-refuse` is permitted; `soft-warning` is permitted
  only for non-denylist subroutines (e.g., the older-adult
  orthostasis monitoring suggestion); `informational` is permitted
  only for non-blocking suggestions. The skill enforces per-branch
  posture (a single service may carry multiple posture-distinct
  branches per CQL output).
- Bound Libraries: `FirstLineSelection`, `SpecialPopulationModifiers`.
  The `aki-triple-whammy-warning` and
  `hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning` invariants MUST verify.
- Card semantics: when a hard-refuse branch fires (triple-whammy or
  hyperkalemia ACEi+ARB+MRA), the descriptor declares
  `suggestions[]` only — never a `card.indicator: "warning"` with a
  permissive override; the skill rejects any descriptor whose
  hard-refuse branch carries override semantics.

#### 3.4 `htn-pregnancy-denylist` — the safety-critical service

This service is the most-restricted of the seven. The skill enforces
**every** rule below; any single violation BLOCKs.

- Hook type: **`order-select` only**. `order-sign` is rejected.
  `medication-prescribe` is rejected. `patient-view` is rejected. The
  rationale is that the denylist must fire **before** the prescribing
  decision is made; firing at sign or prescribe would permit a
  partial workflow path on which the user has already committed
  cognitively to the prescription.
- Posture: **`hard-refuse` only**. `soft-warning` is rejected
  unconditionally. `informational` is rejected. The framework's
  posture is that a recommendation graded **COR III-Harm** in the
  source guideline cannot be downgraded to a warning at the wiring
  layer; doing so would substitute the framework's judgment for the
  source guideline's.
- **No attending-override branch.** The descriptor MUST NOT contain a
  `permit_on_attending_override` flag, an `override_role` field, an
  `override_reason_required` field, or any equivalent semantic. The
  skill scans the descriptor's JSON tree for the closed pattern set
  in §3.4.1 and rejects any match.
- **No card.indicator override semantics.** The descriptor MUST
  declare `suggestions[]` containing zero suggestions for the
  denylist branch (i.e., the EHR's decision panel renders no
  permissive options); the descriptor MUST NOT declare any
  `card.indicator` of `info` or `warning` on the denylist branch;
  only `critical` is permitted.
- **No documentationOnly bypass.** The descriptor MUST NOT declare
  `documentationOnly: true` or any equivalent flag that would let
  the EHR render the denylist as commentary rather than a refusal.
- **Bound Library invariant.** The bound Library `PregnancyHTN` MUST
  declare the `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse`
  hard-block invariant in its Gate-2 register entry, AND the
  verifying reference test MUST pass.
- **Coverage floor on the denylist branch.** The bound Library's
  Synthea branch coverage MUST be ≥ 99.0% on the denylist branch
  specifically (the framework default coverage floor is 95%, but
  the pregnancy denylist branch is held to 99% by manifest pin).
  Below the branch floor → BLOCK.
- **Two-person rule witness.** The skill records, in the descriptor's
  metadata, the Gate-1 cohort id and the Gate-2 cohort id whose
  signoffs cover the pregnancy records and the `PregnancyHTN`
  Library, including the MFM and clinical-pharmacology signoff
  entries. The descriptor's metadata is part of the
  canonicalization payload, so any later mutation invalidates the
  descriptor SHA.
- **No card on out-of-pregnancy population.** The descriptor's
  prefetch query MUST gate the denylist branch on the manifest's
  pregnancy-population value-set; an empty pregnancy population
  produces no card. The skill verifies that the prefetch query
  references the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id and rejects
  any deviation.
- **No silent enable.** The descriptor MUST set `enabled: true`
  unconditionally; runtime toggles that disable the denylist are
  rejected at packaging time. The framework's policy is that the
  denylist cannot be disabled at deployment; institutions wishing to
  scope the framework's deployment to non-pregnancy populations must
  do so by EHR-side filtering of the consuming clinical workflow,
  not by disabling the service.

##### 3.4.1 Closed pattern set for attending-override scan

The skill scans every key/value pair in the descriptor JSON tree and
rejects any descriptor containing any of the following patterns
(case-insensitive, after Unicode NFC):

```
permit_on_attending_override
permitOnAttendingOverride
attending_override
attendingOverride
override_role
overrideRole
override_reason_required
overrideReasonRequired
attending_can_override
attendingCanOverride
override_with_attending_co_sign
overrideWithAttendingCoSign
permit_on_co_sign
permitOnCoSign
override_permitted
overridePermitted
suppressible
suppressibleByRole
documentationOnly
documentation_only
soft_warning
softWarning
warning_only
warningOnly
```

The pattern set is closed at the schema level. New patterns are
added only by ADR-HTN-001 amendment under panel-chair signoff.

#### 3.5 `htn-resistant-workup`
- Hook type: `patient-view` only.
- Posture: `informational` only.
- Bound Library: `ResistantHTN`. The
  `aldosteronism-screen-resistant` invariant MUST verify.

#### 3.6 `htn-secondary-screen`
- Hook type: `patient-view` only.
- Posture: `informational` only.
- Bound Library: `SecondaryHTNTriggers`.

#### 3.7 `htn-hbpm-discharge`
- Hook type: `encounter-discharge` only.
- Posture: `informational` only.
- Bound Library: `HBPStaging`. The
  `bp-confirmation-out-of-office` invariant MUST verify (the
  service surfaces the confirmation expectation at discharge).

### 4. Per-service descriptor construction

For each service in scope, the skill constructs a CDS Hooks service
descriptor under the framework's descriptor shape (mirroring the
forthcoming `schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml`). The shape is:

```json
{
  "service_id": "htn-pregnancy-denylist",
  "title": "Pregnancy denylist for hypertension medications",
  "description": "Hard refusal on order-select for ACE inhibitors, ARBs, MRAs, and direct renin inhibitors in pregnancy.",
  "hook": "order-select",
  "posture": "hard-refuse",
  "enabled": true,
  "bound_libraries": [
    {
      "library_id": "lib-...",
      "library_name": "PregnancyHTN",
      "library_content_hash": "...",
      "gate2_register_path": "...",
      "gate2_register_sha256": "...",
      "asserts_invariant_kinds": ["pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse"]
    }
  ],
  "prefetch": {
    "patient": "Patient/{{context.patientId}}",
    "pregnancy": "Condition?subject=Patient/{{context.patientId}}&code:in=<pregnancy-value-set-id>",
    "medications_in_session": "<encounter or order session medication list>"
  },
  "indicator_set": ["critical"],
  "suggestions_present": false,
  "documentation_only": false,
  "age_gate_min_inclusive": 18,
  "intended_use_population_filter": ["pregnant", "postpartum"],
  "out_of_scope_populations": ["pediatric"],
  "metadata": {
    "build_run_id": "...",
    "build_version_label": "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+<date>",
    "manifest_payload_sha256": "...",
    "gate1_cohort_ids": ["cohort-..."],
    "gate2_cohort_ids": ["cohort-..."],
    "two_person_witnesses": [
      { "role": "mfm-or-obstetric-medicine",  "reviewer_id": "rev-...", "gate": "gate-1" },
      { "role": "clinical-pharmacologist",    "reviewer_id": "rev-...", "gate": "gate-1" },
      { "role": "mfm-or-obstetric-medicine",  "reviewer_id": "rev-...", "gate": "gate-2" },
      { "role": "clinical-pharmacologist",    "reviewer_id": "rev-...", "gate": "gate-2" }
    ],
    "prov_activity_id": "..."
  },
  "fixity": {
    "descriptor_sha256": "<recomputed at write>",
    "computed_at": "<ISO-8601>",
    "canonical_form": "json-canonical-rfc8785"
  }
}
```

The deterministic id derivation:

- `service_id` is the closed enum value.
- `descriptor_sha256` is SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of the
  descriptor with `fixity` excluded.
- For multi-Library services, `bound_libraries[]` is sorted by
  `library_id` ascending before canonicalization.

The skill records the explicit `intended_use_population_filter[]`
on every service. For most services this is `["general-adult"]` or a
specialized clinical population (e.g., `["resistant-htn"]` for
`htn-resistant-workup`); for `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the filter is
`["pregnant", "postpartum"]`. The filter is informational at the
descriptor level and consulted by EHR-side workflow scoping; it does
**not** disable the denylist when no pregnancy condition is asserted —
the prefetch query is the gating mechanism, not the filter.

### 5. Per-service verification

For every service in scope, the skill recomputes the following at
build (and at `--mode verify`) time:

1. **Hook type** matches the constraint in §3.
2. **Posture** matches the constraint in §3.
3. **Bound Libraries** all have Gate-2 register state `finalized`,
   coverage ≥ 95.0% (≥ 99.0% on the pregnancy denylist branch
   specifically), clean typecheck, and verifying reference tests
   passing for declared hard-block invariants.
4. **Library content hashes** recompute to the values recorded in
   the bound-library entries; mismatch indicates Library mutation
   since Gate 2 and BLOCKs.
5. **Risk engine binding** on any consuming Library is `PREVENT` and
   `legacy_only == false`.
6. **Age gate** is exactly 18 (`age_gate_min_inclusive == 18`).
7. **Closed pattern scan** for attending-override patterns on the
   pregnancy denylist (and, by framework default, on every
   `hard-refuse` posture descriptor across the seven services).
8. **`htn-pregnancy-denylist`-specific reinforcements**: hook type
   `order-select`, posture `hard-refuse`, no soft-warning indicator,
   no `documentationOnly`, no permissive `suggestions[]`,
   prefetch query references manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set,
   `enabled: true` unconditionally.
9. **Descriptor SHA** is deterministic and recomputes byte-for-byte
   from the JCS-canonical form.

Producer claims of `verifies: true` are **not trusted**; the skill
recomputes every verification at every run.

### 6. Service-set manifest

After all per-service descriptors are built and verified, the skill
emits a service-set manifest at
`work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/manifest.json`:

```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "build_run_id": "<uuid>",
  "manifest_version": "1.0.0",
  "services": [
    { "id": "htn-bp-stage-and-confirm",       "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold", "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-pharm-first-line-check",     "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-pregnancy-denylist",         "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-resistant-workup",           "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-secondary-screen",           "descriptor_sha256": "..." },
    { "id": "htn-hbpm-discharge",             "descriptor_sha256": "..." }
  ],
  "service_set_sha256": "<SHA-256 of JCS(services[] sorted by id ascending)>"
}
```

The `service_set_sha256` is what `safety-case-attest` consumes when
it composes the Gate-3 bundle's `cdsh` member: the Gate-3 bundle's
file-list-jcs canonicalization over `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/`
produces a SHA that recomposes deterministically from the per-service
descriptor SHAs.

### 7. Audit log and provenance

For every per-service build/verify step, the skill emits:

- An `audit_log[]` entry into the service-set manifest's audit
  region with kind `service-built`, `service-verified`, or
  `service-rejected` (closed kinds), occurred-at, actor id, and
  payload SHA.
- A W3C PROV-O record into the build's PROV bundle at
  `provenance/cds-hooks-package-<run_id>.jsonld`:
  - `Activity`: this packaging run.
  - `Entity`: each service descriptor (with its computed SHA).
  - `Agent`: the operator id and the framework's pinned
    descriptor-build tooling.
  - `wasGeneratedBy`, `used`, `wasAttributedTo` relations.
- A FHIR `Provenance` resource update at
  `work/<run_id>/fhir/provenance/cds-hooks-<service-id>.json` per
  service, recording the descriptor SHA as a binding hash to the
  Library content hashes via `Provenance.signature` semantics
  (the signature here is the descriptor SHA, not a cryptographic
  attester signature; the cryptographic signature is added at Gate 3
  by `safety-case-attest`).

### 8. Determinism and reproducibility

- The service set is closed at seven; the skill cannot add or remove
  services.
- The hook-type and posture constraint matrix is closed; the skill
  enforces it mechanically.
- The closed pattern set in §3.4.1 is closed; the skill rejects any
  descriptor matching a pattern.
- The descriptor canonicalization is RFC 8785 (JCS); identical
  inputs produce identical SHAs.
- Re-running this skill on a successfully-built service set with
  identical Library content hashes is a no-op (the skill confirms
  every descriptor SHA recomputes to the recorded value and writes
  no new descriptors).
- A change to any contributing Library's content hash invalidates
  the affected descriptors and forces a rebuild on next run.

## DQA Gates Enforced By This Skill

| Gate | Condition for advance |
|---|---|
| **GP-A** Manifest active | Active manifest with verified medical-director signoff and zero open errata blockers. |
| **GP-B** Closed seven-service set | Exactly the seven services, in the canonical order; no addition or removal. |
| **GP-C** Hook-type compliance | Every service's hook type matches the constraint matrix in §3. |
| **GP-D** Posture compliance | Every service's posture matches the constraint matrix in §3. |
| **GP-E** Pregnancy denylist hard refuse | `htn-pregnancy-denylist` is `order-select` + `hard-refuse`; no soft-warning indicator; no `documentationOnly`; no permissive `suggestions[]`. |
| **GP-F** No attending-override | No descriptor on any service matches the closed attending-override pattern set in §3.4.1. |
| **GP-G** Library invariants verified | Every bound Library has Gate-2 register state `finalized`, coverage ≥ 95.0% (≥ 99.0% on pregnancy denylist branch), clean typecheck, hard-block invariants verified. |
| **GP-H** PCE-legacy excluded | No bound Library has `bound_risk_engine.name == "PCE-legacy"` or `legacy_only == true`. |
| **GP-I** Age gate ≥ 18 | Every descriptor declares `age_gate_min_inclusive == 18`. |
| **GP-J** Library content-hash binding | Every descriptor's `library_content_hash` recomputes against the live Library snapshot at packaging time. |
| **GP-K** Descriptor SHA deterministic | Every descriptor SHA recomputes byte-for-byte from the JCS-canonical form. |
| **GP-L** Service-set manifest deterministic | The service-set manifest's `service_set_sha256` recomputes deterministically from the per-service descriptor SHAs. |
| **GP-M** Two-person witness recorded | Every service's `metadata.two_person_witnesses[]` records the Gate-1 and Gate-2 reviewer ids whose signoffs cover the bound content; for `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, MFM and clinical-pharmacology witnesses are present at both Gate 1 and Gate 2. |

Failure of any gate at any service → BLOCK; the skill rolls back the
in-flight write, surfaces the specific gate, and emits a diagnostic
at `work/<run_id>/reports/cds-hooks-package-<run_id>.md`. There is
**no override**.

## Outputs

- Per-service descriptor files at
  `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/<service-id>.json`, one per service.
- Service-set manifest at `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/manifest.json`,
  recording the per-service descriptor SHAs and the
  `service_set_sha256`.
- Per-service FHIR `Provenance` resources at
  `work/<run_id>/fhir/provenance/cds-hooks-<service-id>.json`.
- Per-run packaging report at
  `work/<run_id>/reports/cds-hooks-package-<run_id>.md` summarizing
  services built, hook-type and posture compliance, Library wiring
  outcomes, hard-block-invariant verification results, and any
  blockers.
- Build PROV bundle update at
  `provenance/cds-hooks-package-<run_id>.jsonld`.
- Notifications to the orchestrator queue:
  - `cds-hooks-package-complete` on full success.
  - `cds-hooks-package-blocked` with the failing gate and remediation
    guidance on any failure.

## Error Handling

- **Manifest stale or not active.** BLOCK preflight.
- **Gate-2 cohort not finalized.** BLOCK; await `cql-clinician-signoff`
  finalization.
- **Library coverage below floor.** BLOCK; await `cql-test-synthea-htn`
  re-run.
- **Library hard-block invariant unverified.** BLOCK.
- **Pregnancy denylist hook type not order-select.** BLOCK
  unconditionally; emit
  `pregnancy-denylist-hook-type-mismatch` audit event.
- **Pregnancy denylist posture not hard-refuse.** BLOCK
  unconditionally; emit
  `pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected` audit event.
- **Attending-override pattern detected on any descriptor.** BLOCK
  unconditionally; emit `attending-override-pattern-detected` audit
  event with the matching pattern; investigate as adversarial input.
- **`documentationOnly` flag detected on any descriptor.** BLOCK;
  emit `documentation-only-detected`.
- **PCE-legacy binding detected on any bound Library.** BLOCK
  unconditionally; emit `pce-legacy-binding-detected`; require
  upstream remediation under ADR-HTN-001 D5.
- **Age gate ≠ 18 on any descriptor.** BLOCK; emit
  `age-gate-mismatch`.
- **Library content-hash drift.** BLOCK; emit
  `library-content-hash-drift`; require upstream re-finalization.
- **Service set not exactly seven.** BLOCK; emit
  `service-set-cardinality-mismatch`.
- **Two-person witnesses missing on pregnancy denylist.** BLOCK;
  emit `pregnancy-witnesses-missing`; require upstream
  `gate1-sme-review` and `cql-clinician-signoff` re-run.
- **Descriptor SHA non-deterministic.** BLOCK; emit
  `descriptor-sha-nondeterministic`; investigate canonicalization
  drift.
- **Lock contention.** Wait up to a configured timeout; fail-closed
  if not acquired; concurrent writers on the service-set directory
  are not permitted.
- **Resume after Library content-hash change.** Reject; require
  fresh run.
- **Direct edit attempt against a built descriptor.** Reject; emit
  `descriptor-mutation-attempt`; investigate as adversarial input.

## Examples

```bash
# Default first-pass packaging of the full seven-service set
cds-hooks-package-htn work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json

# Verify-only re-check (used by safety-case-attest's preflight)
cds-hooks-package-htn work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --mode verify

# Targeted re-package of a single service after Library rework
cds-hooks-package-htn work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --services htn-pharm-first-line-check

# Resume after orchestrator reposted a re-finalized Library
cds-hooks-package-htn work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --resume

# Dry-run plan emission for change-control review
cds-hooks-package-htn work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --dry-run
```

## Authority Boundaries

**Can do**
- Read finalized records, atomic units, Gate-2 registers, CQL
  Library snapshots, and manifest pins.
- Construct per-service descriptors under the closed seven-service
  set with closed hook-type and posture constraints.
- Build `htn-pregnancy-denylist` as `order-select` + `hard-refuse`
  with no attending-override branch, no soft-warning indicator, no
  `documentationOnly`, and no permissive `suggestions[]`.
- Recompute per-service descriptor SHAs and the service-set
  manifest hash deterministically.
- Emit per-service FHIR `Provenance` resources and PROV bundle
  updates.
- Append append-only audit events to the service-set manifest's
  audit region.
- BLOCK the build on any unverified Library, soft-warning posture
  on the pregnancy denylist, attending-override pattern, PCE-legacy
  binding, age-gate mismatch, or descriptor-SHA non-determinism.

**Requires approval (panel chair / new manifest version / ADR
amendment)**
- Any change to the closed seven-service set.
- Any change to the hook-type or posture constraint matrix in §3.
- Any change to the closed attending-override pattern set in §3.4.1.
- Any change to the pregnancy denylist branch's coverage floor (≥
  99.0%).
- Any institutional opt-in to `cds_extensions_authorized == true`
  on the manifest, which itself routes through a manifest-version
  amendment under panel-chair signoff.
- Any decision to permit `soft-warning` posture on a non-denylist
  service (the framework default rejects this; institutional policy
  may opt in via manifest pin, with explicit ADR amendment).

**Never**
- Add or remove services from the closed seven-service set at this
  skill's level.
- Build `htn-pregnancy-denylist` with any hook type other than
  `order-select`.
- Build `htn-pregnancy-denylist` with any posture other than
  `hard-refuse`.
- Permit any attending-override pattern on any descriptor.
- Permit `documentationOnly` on any descriptor.
- Permit a permissive `suggestions[]` on the pregnancy denylist
  branch.
- Permit `soft-warning` on a denylist branch under any
  circumstance.
- Substitute PCE-legacy for PREVENT in any bound Library.
- Lower the age gate below 18 on any service.
- Mutate a built descriptor; corrections require a new packaging run
  against a new Library content hash or a new manifest version.
- Run with `--strict false` in production.

Saved as `skills/cds-hooks-package-htn/SKILL.md`. The skill is the only authorized P22 producer of the closed seven-service CDS Hooks service set (`cdsh` member of the Gate-3 bundle), mirrors the parent repo's frontmatter and section discipline established by `acquire-training-source`, `dataset-docs`, `parse-acc-aha-recbox`, `extract-recommendation-cor-loe`, `flow-hbp-2025-build`, `gate1-sme-review`, `cql-clinician-signoff`, `safety-case-attest`, `acquire-hbp-2025-source`, and `safety-hbp`, and is fully aligned to ADR-HTN-001 D5/D8/D9/D10/D15 and to the framework spec §7/§8/§11.

The skill encodes the closed seven-service set in §2.1 and the per-service hook-type and posture constraint matrix in §3 with seven discrete subsections, one per service. The pregnancy denylist (`htn-pregnancy-denylist`) is the most-restricted service in §3.4: hook type `order-select` only (rationale spelled out: must fire before prescribing decision is committed); posture `hard-refuse` only (no soft-warning, no informational); no attending-override branch (closed pattern set of 22 patterns in §3.4.1 mechanically scanned and rejected); no `card.indicator` override semantics (only `critical` permitted on the denylist branch); no `documentationOnly` bypass; bound Library `PregnancyHTN` with verifying reference test for the `pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse` invariant; coverage floor on the denylist branch held to ≥ 99.0% by manifest pin (stricter than the 95% framework default); two-person rule witnesses at both Gate 1 (MFM + clinical pharmacology) and Gate 2 recorded in descriptor metadata as part of the canonicalization payload; prefetch query gates the denylist branch on the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set; `enabled: true` unconditionally with no runtime toggle. The closed pattern set in §3.4.1 is exhaustive against the most common attending-override variants in CDS Hooks descriptors and is closed at the schema level, with extensions only by ADR amendment.

The descriptor shape in §4 records the explicit `intended_use_population_filter[]`, the `metadata.two_person_witnesses[]` recording the Gate-1 and Gate-2 reviewer ids, and the deterministic `descriptor_sha256` computed under RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization. The service-set manifest in §6 records per-service descriptor SHAs and a `service_set_sha256` that recomposes deterministically — this is the value `safety-case-attest` consumes when composing the Gate-3 bundle's `cdsh` member.

Per-service verification in §5 recomputes hook type, posture, bound-Library finalization, coverage, typecheck, hard-block invariant verification, Library content-hash binding, risk engine identity (PREVENT only, never PCE-legacy), age gate (= 18), the closed attending-override pattern scan, the pregnancy-specific reinforcements, and the descriptor SHA's determinism. Producer claims of `verifies: true` are not trusted; the skill recomputes every verification at every run.

Thirteen DQA gates (`GP-A` … `GP-M`) are fail-closed at every service. The "never" list explicitly forbids changes to the closed seven-service set, building the pregnancy denylist with any hook type other than `order-select` or any posture other than `hard-refuse`, permitting attending-override patterns on any descriptor, permitting `documentationOnly`, permitting permissive `suggestions[]` on the pregnancy denylist branch, permitting soft-warning on any denylist branch, substituting PCE-legacy for PREVENT, lowering the age gate below 18, mutating a built descriptor, and running with `--strict false` in production.
