#     htn-hbpm-discharge).
#   - The closed hook-type and posture enums.
#   - The closed attending-override pattern denylist (22 patterns
#     mechanically scanned and rejected at every level of the descriptor
#     JSON tree).
#   - The `htn-pregnancy-denylist`-specific constraint block (hook type
#     `order-select` only; posture `hard-refuse` only; no soft-warning
#     indicator; no `documentationOnly`; no permissive `suggestions[]`;
#     pregnancy value-set in prefetch; coverage floor on the denylist
#     branch ≥ 99.0%; two-person rule witnesses at both Gate 1 and
#     Gate 2; `enabled: true` unconditionally).
#   - The per-service descriptor shape (bound libraries, prefetch,
#     indicator set, suggestions presence flag, age gate, intended-use
#     population filter, two-person witnesses, fixity).
#   - The per-service descriptor canonicalization rule
#     (RFC 8785 JCS with `fixity` excluded; SHA-256 over canonical
#     bytes).
#   - The service-set manifest shape (closed seven entries; the
#     `service_set_sha256` that becomes the input to the Gate-3
#     bundle's `cdsh` member).
#   - Post-package descriptor immutability rules (descriptors are
#     immutable until the next P22 run against a new Library content
#     hash or a new manifest version; mutation attempts are tamper-
#     evident).
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage,
# hard-refusal-on-pregnancy over attending-override. Pregnancy
# denylist is `order-select` + `hard-refuse` with no attending-override
# under any circumstance. PCE-legacy never feeds CDS. Age gate ≥ 18 on
# every service.
#
# This file does NOT contain CQL bytes, terminology bytes, or
# institutional EHR adapters. It is the wiring-layer contract between
# Gate-2-finalized Libraries and the EHR's CDS Hooks runtime.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D5 (PREVENT canonical risk function)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D8 (pregnancy hard-block enforced at order-select)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D9 (three non-overridable human gates; this schema
#     governs the wiring surface that Gate 2 ratifies and Gate 3
#     re-attests)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D10 (PHI fail-closed; the prefetch queries reference
#     manifest-pinned value-sets and descriptor metadata records no
#     patient-identifying content)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D15 (drift detection; descriptor SHAs bind to Library
#     content hashes)
#   - Framework spec §7 (CDS Hooks services; the canonical seven
#     services; pregnancy denylist as `order-select`)
#   - Framework spec §8 (hazards; H-01 mitigation requires the wiring
#     this schema constrains)
#   - `cds-hooks-package-htn` SKILL.md (the only authorized writer)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by
# $ref or by content-hash pointer):
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml  (downstream consumers of
#                                              records that are
#                                              materialized into
#                                              service descriptors via
#                                              the bound Libraries)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                (atomic-unit ids may be
#                                              cited in descriptor
#                                              metadata for traceability)
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                       (referenced for source
#                                              anchors the descriptor's
#                                              metadata may cite)
#   - schemas/gate2-register.yaml             (Library finalization +
#                                              hard-block-invariant
#                                              verification are
#                                              preconditions; the
#                                              `cds_hooks_service_ids_wired[]`
#                                              claim from Gate 2 is
#                                              ratified by descriptors
#                                              under this schema)
#   - schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml            (per-hazard mitigations of
#                                              kind `cds-hooks-service`
#                                              cite the descriptors
#                                              under this schema; the
#                                              Safety Case's `SC-INV-09`
#                                              and `SC-INV-23` are
#                                              recomputed against this
#                                              schema's invariants)
#   - schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml          (downstream consumer; the
#                                              service-set manifest +
#                                              per-service descriptors
#                                              become the `cdsh` bundle
#                                              member at Gate 3)
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml (per-build manifest;
#                                              `intended_use.age_min_inclusive`
#                                              (=18), `risk_engine.name`
#                                              (=PREVENT), pregnancy
#                                              value-set id, tsa_list,
#                                              and `tools_lock` are
#                                              consulted)
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml"
title: "CdsHooksServicesHTN"
description: >
  Auditable, immutable-once-built, deterministic-SHA-bound contract
  for the closed seven-service CDS Hooks service set produced by
  `cds-hooks-package-htn`. Encodes the closed hook-type and posture
  enums, the closed attending-override pattern denylist as a
  schema-level invariant, the `htn-pregnancy-denylist`-specific
  constraint block, the per-service descriptor shape and
  canonicalization rule, the service-set manifest shape, and the
  post-package descriptor immutability rules.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  closed_service_set:
    rule: >
      The service set MUST contain exactly the seven services
      enumerated in §2.1, each appearing exactly once. No service
      may be added, removed, renamed, or reordered at this schema's
      level. Validators MUST refuse documents missing any of the
      seven or containing duplicates.
      Institutional extensions go to a separate `extensions[]` array
      whose presence is explicitly opted in by the manifest's
      `cds_extensions_authorized == true` (default false).

  closed_hook_type_and_posture:
    rule: >
      Every service's `hook` and `posture` MUST be members of the
      closed enums in §2.2 and §2.3. Per-service constraints in §2.4
      pin specific hook + posture combinations per service id;
      validators MUST enforce both schema-level enum membership and
      per-service constraint compliance.

  attending_override_denylist:
    rule: >
      Every descriptor MUST be free of attending-override semantics.
      Validators MUST recursively scan every key and every string
      value in the descriptor JSON tree (case-insensitive after
      Unicode NFC) against the closed pattern set in §2.5
      (AttendingOverridePattern). Any match BLOCKs the build and
      emits an `attending-override-pattern-detected` audit event.
      The pattern set is closed; new patterns are added only by
      ADR-HTN-001 amendment under panel-chair signoff.

  pregnancy_hard_block:
    rule: >
      `htn-pregnancy-denylist` MUST satisfy every constraint in §3.7
      (PregnancyDenylistConstraints): hook type `order-select` only;
      posture `hard-refuse` only; `card.indicator` set restricted to
      {`critical`}; `suggestions[]` empty on the denylist branch;
      `documentationOnly` flag absent; `enabled: true` unconditionally;
      bound Library `PregnancyHTN` with verifying reference test
      passing; coverage floor on the denylist branch ≥ 99.0%;
      two-person rule witnesses at both Gate 1 (MFM + clinical
      pharmacology) and Gate 2; prefetch query references the
      manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id. Any deviation is a
      release blocker. No soft-warning posture is permitted on this
      service under any circumstance.

  pce_legacy_never_feeds_cds:
    rule: >
      No bound Library on any descriptor may carry
      `bound_risk_engine.name == "PCE-legacy"` or
      `bound_risk_engine.legacy_only == true`. PREVENT is canonical
      per ADR-HTN-001 D5; any PCE-legacy reference is a release
      blocker.

  age_gate_eq_18:
    rule: >
      Every descriptor MUST declare `age_gate_min_inclusive == 18`
      (matching the manifest's `intended_use.age_min_inclusive`).
      Lower age gates are a release blocker; higher age gates require
      a manifest amendment under panel-chair signoff.

  library_content_hash_binding:
    rule: >
      Every `bound_libraries[].library_content_hash` MUST recompute
      against the live Library snapshot at packaging time and at
      validation time. Drift indicates Library mutation since Gate 2
      and is a release blocker.

  descriptor_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      Every descriptor's `fixity.descriptor_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256
      of the JCS-canonical (RFC 8785) form of the descriptor with
      `fixity` excluded. Validators recompute and compare; mismatch
      is a release blocker.

  service_set_manifest_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      The service-set manifest's `service_set_sha256` MUST equal
      SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of `services[]` ordered by
      service id ascending. Validators recompute and compare;
      mismatch is a release blocker.

  two_person_witnesses_recorded:
    rule: >
      Every descriptor MUST record in `metadata.two_person_witnesses[]`
      the Gate-1 and Gate-2 reviewer ids whose signoffs cover the
      bound content. For `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the witnesses MUST
      include at least one MFM (or obstetric-medicine) reviewer and
      one clinical-pharmacology reviewer at BOTH Gate 1 AND Gate 2.

  post_package_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once a descriptor is recorded with `state == "built"` and
      `fixity.descriptor_sha256` populated, neither the descriptor's
      content nor its `fixity` may be mutated. Any change to the
      underlying Library content hash, the bound risk engine, the
      hook type, the posture, or any other descriptor field
      invalidates the recorded SHA and forces a fresh packaging run
      against a new Library snapshot or a new manifest version. The
      old descriptor is retained immutably for audit when superseded.

  superseded_descriptors:
    rule: >
      A descriptor whose underlying Library content hash changes is
      marked `state == "superseded"` with `superseded_by_descriptor_sha256`
      pointing to the new descriptor. The chain is monotone; cycles
      are forbidden.

  enabled_unconditionally:
    rule: >
      Every descriptor MUST set `enabled: true` unconditionally; no
      runtime toggle, feature flag, or environment-conditional
      disable is permitted at packaging time. EHR-side workflow
      scoping is the institution's responsibility and does not
      propagate to the descriptor's `enabled` flag.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Closed service ids (the seven-service set)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdsHooksServiceId:
    type: string
    enum:
      - htn-bp-stage-and-confirm
      - htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold
      - htn-pharm-first-line-check
      - htn-pregnancy-denylist
      - htn-resistant-workup
      - htn-secondary-screen
      - htn-hbpm-discharge

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Closed hook types
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdsHooksHookType:
    type: string
    enum:
      - order-select
      - order-sign
      - medication-prescribe
      - patient-view
      - encounter-discharge

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Closed posture enum
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CdsHooksPosture:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hard-refuse
      - soft-warning      # accepted only on non-denylist branches per per-service constraints; never on htn-pregnancy-denylist
      - informational

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Per-service hook + posture constraint matrix (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PerServiceConstraintMatrix:
    description: |
      Validators MUST enforce the per-service constraint matrix below,
      in addition to the schema-level enum membership rules. The matrix
      is closed; new rows or relaxations require ADR-HTN-001 amendment.

      htn-bp-stage-and-confirm:
        - hook       MUST be: patient-view
        - posture    MUST be: informational
        - bound_libs MUST be: [HBPStaging]
        - asserts    MUST include: bp-confirmation-out-of-office

      htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold:
        - hook       MUST be: patient-view
        - posture    MUST be: informational
        - bound_libs MUST be: [PreventRisk, TreatmentThreshold]
        - asserts    MUST include: prevent-canonical-binding,
                                   pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql

      htn-pharm-first-line-check:
        - hook       MUST be: order-select
        - posture    MUST be: hard-refuse  (denylist branches)
                              soft-warning (older-adult orthostasis branch ONLY)
                              informational (general first-line guidance branch ONLY)
        - bound_libs MUST be: [FirstLineSelection, SpecialPopulationModifiers]
        - asserts    MUST include: aki-triple-whammy-warning,
                                   hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning

      htn-pregnancy-denylist:
        - hook       MUST be: order-select          (no exceptions)
        - posture    MUST be: hard-refuse           (no exceptions)
        - bound_libs MUST be: [PregnancyHTN]
        - asserts    MUST include: pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
        - additional constraints in §3.7 (PregnancyDenylistConstraints)

      htn-resistant-workup:
        - hook       MUST be: patient-view
        - posture    MUST be: informational
        - bound_libs MUST be: [ResistantHTN]
        - asserts    MUST include: aldosteronism-screen-resistant

      htn-secondary-screen:
        - hook       MUST be: patient-view
        - posture    MUST be: informational
        - bound_libs MUST be: [SecondaryHTNTriggers]

      htn-hbpm-discharge:
        - hook       MUST be: encounter-discharge
        - posture    MUST be: informational
        - bound_libs MUST be: [HBPStaging]
        - asserts    MUST include: bp-confirmation-out-of-office

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Closed attending-override pattern denylist
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttendingOverridePattern:
    type: string
    enum:
      - permit_on_attending_override
      - permitOnAttendingOverride
      - attending_override
      - attendingOverride
      - override_role
      - overrideRole
      - override_reason_required
      - overrideReasonRequired
      - attending_can_override
      - attendingCanOverride
      - override_with_attending_co_sign
      - overrideWithAttendingCoSign
      - permit_on_co_sign
      - permitOnCoSign
      - override_permitted
      - overridePermitted
      - suppressible
      - suppressibleByRole
      - documentationOnly
      - documentation_only
      - soft_warning
      - softWarning
    description: >
      Closed pattern set. Validators MUST recursively scan every key
      and every string value in the descriptor JSON tree (and in
      `prefetch` template values) for any of these patterns,
      case-insensitive after Unicode NFC. Any match BLOCKs the
      build. The set is closed at the schema level; additions require
      ADR-HTN-001 amendment under panel-chair signoff.
      NOTE: the `soft_warning` / `softWarning` patterns are denied on
      ALL descriptors at the field-name and descriptor-string-value
      level; the `posture: soft-warning` enum value is permitted on
      non-denylist branches per the per-service constraint matrix in
      §2.4. Validators distinguish the two: the `posture` field is
      checked against the enum, while string values that contain the
      pattern (e.g., descriptive text leaking through) are blocked.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Library names (closed; mirrored from gate2-register.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LibraryName:
    type: string
    enum:
      - HBPStaging
      - PreventRisk
      - TreatmentThreshold
      - FirstLineSelection
      - SpecialPopulationModifiers
      - PregnancyHTN
      - ResistantHTN
      - SecondaryHTNTriggers
      - HypertensiveUrgencyEmergency

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Hard-block invariant kinds (mirrored from gate2-register.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HardBlockInvariantKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse
      - pregnancy-firstline-restricted
      - pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql
      - prevent-canonical-binding
      - age-gate-ge-18
      - aki-triple-whammy-warning
      - hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning
      - beta-blocker-no-abrupt-discontinuation
      - older-adult-orthostasis-monitoring
      - aldosteronism-screen-resistant
      - bp-confirmation-out-of-office

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 Card indicator levels (CDS Hooks 2.0)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CardIndicator:
    type: string
    enum:
      - info
      - warning
      - critical
      - hard-stop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Population filter (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PopulationFilter:
    type: string
    enum:
      - general-adult
      - older-adult
      - pregnant
      - postpartum
      - ckd
      - t2dm
      - hf-rEF
      - hf-pEF
      - cad
      - post-stroke
      - secondary-htn-suspected
      - urgency
      - emergency
      - resistant-htn
      - all-build-records

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 Out-of-scope populations (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OutOfScopePopulation:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pediatric
      - acute-stroke-blood-pressure
      - perioperative-blood-pressure
      - bp-management-in-icu-shock

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Reviewer roles (mirrored; relevant subset for two-person witnesses)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReviewerRole:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hypertension-specialist
      - clinical-pharmacologist
      - mfm-or-obstetric-medicine
      - geriatrician
      - primary-care-clinician
      - clinical-informaticist
      - nephrology
      - endocrinology
      - emergency-medicine
      - critical-care
      - panel-chair
      - medical-director

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Risk engine (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RiskEngineName:
    type: string
    enum:
      - PREVENT
      - PCE-legacy   # MUST NEVER appear in any bound Library; enum exists only to make the deny rule machine-checkable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.13 Descriptor lifecycle states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DescriptorState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - built
      - verified
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.14 Service-set lifecycle states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ServiceSetState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - built
      - verified
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.15 Audit-event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - service-built
      - service-verified
      - service-rejected
      - service-superseded
      - service-withdrawn
      - service-set-built
      - service-set-verified
      - attending-override-pattern-detected
      - pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected
      - pregnancy-denylist-hook-type-mismatch
      - pce-legacy-binding-detected
      - documentation-only-detected
      - age-gate-mismatch
      - library-content-hash-drift
      - service-set-cardinality-mismatch
      - pregnancy-witnesses-missing
      - descriptor-sha-nondeterministic
      - descriptor-mutation-attempt

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.16 Verification methods
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VerificationMethod:
    type: string
    enum:
      - reference-test-pack-pass
      - library-snapshot-shape-match
      - service-descriptor-shape-match
      - prefetch-value-set-resolved
      - attending-override-pattern-scan-clean
      - canonical-sha-match

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 BoundLibrary
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BoundLibrary:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - library_id
      - library_name
      - library_content_hash
      - gate2_register_path
      - gate2_register_sha256
      - asserts_invariant_kinds
      - bound_risk_engine
    properties:
      library_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^lib-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      library_name:        { $ref: "#/$defs/LibraryName" }
      library_content_hash:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          The Gate-2-finalized Library content hash. Validators MUST
          recompute against the live snapshot at validation time;
          drift is a release blocker.
      gate2_register_path:    { type: string }
      gate2_register_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      asserts_invariant_kinds:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/HardBlockInvariantKind" }
      bound_risk_engine:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [name, legacy_only]
        properties:
          name:        { $ref: "#/$defs/RiskEngineName" }
          legacy_only: { type: boolean }
      coverage_pct:
        type: number
        minimum: 0.0
        maximum: 100.0
        description: >
          Synthea branch coverage at packaging time, copied from the
          Library's Gate-2 coverage_summary. For
          `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the denylist-branch-specific
          coverage is recorded in
          `coverage_pct_denylist_branch` and validated separately.
      coverage_pct_denylist_branch:
        type: [number, "null"]
        minimum: 0.0
        maximum: 100.0
        description: >
          Required (non-null) on `htn-pregnancy-denylist`'s bound
          Library `PregnancyHTN`; MUST be ≥ 99.0. Null on all other
          services.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 PrefetchTemplate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrefetchTemplate:
    type: object
    additionalProperties:
      type: string
    description: >
      CDS Hooks prefetch template (FHIR query strings keyed by name).
      Validators MUST scan every value for AttendingOverridePattern
      matches and reject any descriptor where a match is found.
      For `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the prefetch MUST contain a key
      `pregnancy` whose query references the manifest-pinned
      pregnancy value-set id; absence is a release blocker.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 TwoPersonWitness
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TwoPersonWitness:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [role, reviewer_id, gate]
    properties:
      role:        { $ref: "#/$defs/ReviewerRole" }
      reviewer_id: { type: string, pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      gate:
        type: string
        enum: [gate-1, gate-2]
      cohort_id:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Metadata
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DescriptorMetadata:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - build_run_id
      - build_version_label
      - manifest_payload_sha256
      - gate1_cohort_ids
      - gate2_cohort_ids
      - two_person_witnesses
      - prov_activity_id
    properties:
      build_run_id:           { type: string, format: uuid }
      build_version_label:
        type: string
        pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
      manifest_payload_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      gate1_cohort_ids:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      gate2_cohort_ids:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      two_person_witnesses:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/TwoPersonWitness" }
      prov_activity_id:       { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      sair_anchor_record_ids:
        type: array
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      sair_anchor_atomic_unit_ids:
        type: array
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 Fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DescriptorFixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [descriptor_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      descriptor_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of the descriptor with `fixity` excluded.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 ServiceDescriptor (root descriptor type)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ServiceDescriptor:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - service_id
      - title
      - description
      - hook
      - posture
      - enabled
      - bound_libraries
      - prefetch
      - indicator_set
      - suggestions_present
      - documentation_only
      - age_gate_min_inclusive
      - intended_use_population_filter
      - out_of_scope_populations
      - metadata
      - state
      - fixity
    properties:
      service_id:    { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksServiceId" }
      title:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      description:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      hook:          { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksHookType" }
      posture:       { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksPosture" }
      enabled:
        type: boolean
        const: true
        description: >
          MUST be true unconditionally. EHR-side workflow scoping is
          the institution's responsibility and does not propagate to
          this flag (`enabled_unconditionally`).
      bound_libraries:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/BoundLibrary" }
      prefetch:      { $ref: "#/$defs/PrefetchTemplate" }
      indicator_set:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/CardIndicator" }
        description: >
          Closed-by-policy indicator set per service. For
          `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, MUST equal exactly
          `["critical"]`. For `hard-refuse` postures on other
          services, MUST be a subset of `["critical", "hard-stop"]`.
          For `informational` postures, MUST be `["info"]`. For
          `soft-warning` postures, MUST be `["warning"]`.
      suggestions_present:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          MUST be `false` for the denylist branch on
          `htn-pregnancy-denylist`. Validators interpret this flag in
          conjunction with the descriptor's hook + posture + branch
          set; when the descriptor has multiple branches (e.g.,
          `htn-pharm-first-line-check` with denylist + monitoring +
          informational branches), `suggestions_present` is the
          aggregate disjunction over branches and an additional
          per-branch field (recorded in `metadata.prov_activity_id`'s
          PROV evidence) records the per-branch values.
      documentation_only:
        type: boolean
        const: false
        description: MUST be false. Documentation-only bypass is forbidden (`attending_override_denylist`).
      age_gate_min_inclusive:
        type: integer
        const: 18
      intended_use_population_filter:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PopulationFilter" }
      out_of_scope_populations:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/OutOfScopePopulation" }
      metadata:                 { $ref: "#/$defs/DescriptorMetadata" }
      state:                    { $ref: "#/$defs/DescriptorState" }
      superseded_by_descriptor_sha256:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$"
      fixity:                   { $ref: "#/$defs/DescriptorFixity" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 PregnancyDenylistConstraints (cross-field invariants applied
  #     when service_id == "htn-pregnancy-denylist")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # The constraint block is documentation embedded in the schema for
  # validators; the JSON Schema itself enforces the values via the
  # generic ServiceDescriptor type plus the cross-field invariants in §5.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PregnancyDenylistConstraints:
    description: |
      For ServiceDescriptor whose service_id == "htn-pregnancy-denylist",
      validators MUST enforce ALL of the following:

      a) hook == "order-select"
      b) posture == "hard-refuse"
      c) enabled == true
      d) documentation_only == false
      e) suggestions_present == false
      f) indicator_set == ["critical"]   (exactly; no other elements)
      g) age_gate_min_inclusive == 18
      h) intended_use_population_filter MUST contain "pregnant" and "postpartum"
         (no other populations may be included; the filter is exact-match)
      i) out_of_scope_populations MUST contain "pediatric"
      j) bound_libraries.length == 1
      k) bound_libraries[0].library_name == "PregnancyHTN"
      l) bound_libraries[0].asserts_invariant_kinds MUST contain
         "pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse"
      m) bound_libraries[0].coverage_pct_denylist_branch MUST be non-null AND >= 99.0
      n) bound_libraries[0].bound_risk_engine.name == "PREVENT" OR the Library
         declares no risk-engine binding (PregnancyHTN does not bind the risk
         engine; the constraint is "MUST NOT be PCE-legacy")
      o) prefetch MUST contain a key "pregnancy" whose template references
         the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id (an opaque string token
         resolved at validation against
         `manifest.intended_use.pregnancy_value_set_id`)
      p) metadata.two_person_witnesses[] MUST contain:
            - at least one role in {"mfm-or-obstetric-medicine"} at gate-1
            - at least one role in {"clinical-pharmacologist"}    at gate-1
            - at least one role in {"mfm-or-obstetric-medicine"} at gate-2
            - at least one role in {"clinical-pharmacologist"}    at gate-2
      q) NO key or string value anywhere in the descriptor JSON tree
         (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC) matches any
         AttendingOverridePattern from §2.5.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 Audit event
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 ServiceManifestEntry (one per service in the manifest)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ServiceManifestEntry:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [id, descriptor_path, descriptor_sha256]
    properties:
      id:                 { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHooksServiceId" }
      descriptor_path:
        type: string
        description: Relative path to the per-service descriptor file at packaging time.
      descriptor_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The schema defines TWO root types:
#   - ServiceDescriptor (per-service file)
#   - ServiceSetManifest (cohort-wide manifest)
#
# JSON Schema does not natively support multi-root files; consumers
# select the root type by file path:
#   - `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/<service-id>.json`     → ServiceDescriptor
#   - `work/<run_id>/cds-hooks/manifest.json`         → ServiceSetManifest
#
# The `type` field below describes the ServiceSetManifest as the
# document-level root; per-service descriptors are validated against
# `#/$defs/ServiceDescriptor` directly.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

type: object
title: ServiceSetManifest
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - build_run_id
  - manifest_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - services
  - service_set_sha256
  - state
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  build_run_id:        { type: string, format: uuid }

  manifest_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"

  predecessor_service_set_sha256:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$"

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Services (closed seven, exactly once each)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  services:
    type: array
    minItems: 7
    maxItems: 7
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ServiceManifestEntry" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Service-set fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  service_set_sha256:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
    description: >
      SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of `services[]` ordered by
      `id` ascending. Validators recompute and compare; mismatch is
      a release blocker.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 State
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state: { $ref: "#/$defs/ServiceSetState" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Fixity (manifest-level)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [manifest_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      manifest_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of THIS document with
          `fixity` excluded. The hash MUST be deterministic across
          re-runs given identical inputs.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 Optional institutional extensions (off by default)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  extensions:
    type: [array, "null"]
    description: >
      Institutional service extensions, permitted only if the manifest's
      `cds_extensions_authorized == true`. Each extension follows the
      ServiceDescriptor type but is NOT a member of the closed
      seven-service set. The Gate-3 bundle hash covers the union of
      `services[]` and `extensions[]` if present.
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ServiceDescriptor" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: CDH-INV-01
    description: >
      `services[]` MUST contain each `CdsHooksServiceId` from §2.1
      exactly once. Duplicates or missing ids are a release blocker
      (closed_service_set).

  - id: CDH-INV-02
    description: >
      Every `ServiceManifestEntry.descriptor_sha256` MUST equal the
      `fixity.descriptor_sha256` of the file at
      `descriptor_path`, recomputed under JCS at validation time.
      Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-03
    description: >
      `service_set_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical
      form of `services[]` ordered by `id` ascending. Validators
      recompute and compare; mismatch is a release blocker
      (service_set_manifest_canonicalization).

  - id: CDH-INV-04
    description: >
      For every ServiceDescriptor, `fixity.descriptor_sha256` MUST
      equal SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of the descriptor with
      `fixity` excluded (descriptor_canonicalization). The hash MUST
      be deterministic across re-runs given identical inputs.

  - id: CDH-INV-05
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's (hook, posture, bound_libraries) MUST
      satisfy the per-service constraint matrix in §2.4
      (PerServiceConstraintMatrix). Any deviation is a release blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-06
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `enabled` MUST be true unconditionally
      (`enabled_unconditionally`). Validators MUST refuse `false` or
      conditional expressions.

  - id: CDH-INV-07
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `age_gate_min_inclusive` MUST be 18.
      Lower values are a release blocker (age_gate_eq_18).

  - id: CDH-INV-08
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `documentation_only` MUST be false
      (attending_override_denylist).

  - id: CDH-INV-09
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `bound_libraries[].library_content_hash`
      MUST recompute against the live Library snapshot at
      validation time. Drift is a release blocker
      (library_content_hash_binding).

  - id: CDH-INV-10
    description: >
      No bound Library on any ServiceDescriptor may have
      `bound_risk_engine.name == "PCE-legacy"` OR
      `bound_risk_engine.legacy_only == true`. PCE-legacy never feeds
      CDS (pce_legacy_never_feeds_cds).

  - id: CDH-INV-11
    description: >
      For every ServiceDescriptor:
        - posture == "hard-refuse" implies indicator_set ⊆ {"critical","hard-stop"};
        - posture == "soft-warning" implies indicator_set == ["warning"];
        - posture == "informational" implies indicator_set == ["info"].
      Mismatched posture and indicator_set is a release blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-12
    description: >
      Validators MUST recursively scan every key and every string
      value in every ServiceDescriptor (and in `prefetch` template
      values) for any AttendingOverridePattern from §2.5
      (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC). Any match BLOCKs the
      build and emits an `attending-override-pattern-detected` audit
      event.

  - id: CDH-INV-13
    description: >
      For ServiceDescriptor whose service_id == "htn-pregnancy-denylist",
      ALL of the constraints in §3.7 (PregnancyDenylistConstraints,
      items a..q) MUST hold. Any violation BLOCKs the build and emits
      the corresponding closed audit event from §2.15
      (`pregnancy-denylist-hook-type-mismatch`,
      `pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected`,
      `pregnancy-witnesses-missing`,
      `attending-override-pattern-detected`,
      `documentation-only-detected`,
      `library-content-hash-drift`, etc.).

  - id: CDH-INV-14
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `metadata.two_person_witnesses[]` MUST
      include at least one Gate-1 witness AND at least one Gate-2
      witness. For `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the witnesses MUST
      include MFM (or obstetric-medicine) AND clinical pharmacology
      at BOTH gates (CDH-INV-13 reinforces this with closed
      role-specific constraints).

  - id: CDH-INV-15
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `metadata.gate2_cohort_ids[]` MUST
      resolve to Gate-2 cohort register files in state `finalized`
      at validation time. Any non-finalized cohort is a release
      blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-16
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `metadata.manifest_payload_sha256`
      MUST equal the active manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at
      packaging time. Manifest drift between packaging and
      validation is a release blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-17
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  - id: CDH-INV-18
    description: >
      `fixity.manifest_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the
      JCS-canonical form of this document with `fixity` excluded.
      The hash MUST be deterministic across re-runs given identical
      inputs.

  - id: CDH-INV-19
    description: >
      Once a ServiceDescriptor's `state == "built"` and
      `fixity.descriptor_sha256` is populated, neither the descriptor
      content nor its `fixity` may be mutated
      (post_package_immutability). Mutation attempts MUST be detected
      by SHA recompute and blocked; the audit event
      `descriptor-mutation-attempt` is emitted.

  - id: CDH-INV-20
    description: >
      `predecessor_service_set_sha256` MUST be set whenever this
      service-set manifest supersedes a prior one. The chain is
      monotone; cycles are forbidden. Validators MUST resolve and
      verify against the predecessor's recorded
      `service_set_sha256`.

  - id: CDH-INV-21
    description: >
      `extensions` MAY be non-null only if the active manifest's
      `cds_extensions_authorized == true`. When present, every entry
      follows the ServiceDescriptor type and is subject to all
      schema-level invariants except `closed_service_set`
      (extensions are NOT members of §2.1). For each extension,
      hook + posture MUST be permitted by the institution's
      manifest amendment, and AttendingOverridePattern scanning is
      enforced.

  - id: CDH-INV-22
    description: >
      For every ServiceDescriptor whose posture includes
      `hard-refuse` (whether on a single branch or aggregated),
      validators MUST verify that the bound Libraries' Gate-2
      register entry is `accepted` or `accepted-with-comment` and
      the verifying reference test for every declared
      `asserts_invariant_kind` passes. Unverified hard-block
      mitigations are a release blocker.

  - id: CDH-INV-23
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `intended_use_population_filter[]`
      MUST be a non-empty subset of PopulationFilter. For
      `htn-pregnancy-denylist`, the filter MUST be exactly
      `["pregnant", "postpartum"]` (set-equal; ordering enforced by
      JCS canonicalization).

  - id: CDH-INV-24
    description: >
      Every ServiceDescriptor's `out_of_scope_populations[]` MUST
      contain `pediatric`. Validators MUST refuse descriptors that
      omit pediatric from out-of-scope.

  - id: CDH-INV-25
    description: >
      For every ServiceDescriptor of `service_id ==
      "htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold"`, the bound Library
      `PreventRisk` MUST declare both
      `prevent-canonical-binding` AND `pce-legacy-never-feeds-cql`
      in `asserts_invariant_kinds`, and both MUST verify under their
      reference tests at validation time.

  - id: CDH-INV-26
    description: >
      For every ServiceDescriptor of `service_id ==
      "htn-pharm-first-line-check"`, the bound Libraries MUST
      collectively declare both `aki-triple-whammy-warning` AND
      `hyperkalemia-aceiarb-mra-warning`. The descriptor's
      indicator_set across hard-refuse branches MUST be a subset of
      `["critical", "hard-stop"]`.

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 A ServiceDescriptor for `htn-pregnancy-denylist` (the most-restricted
#       service; serves as the reference shape for §3.7).
#   6.2 A ServiceSetManifest covering the closed seven-service set.
#
# EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from a real Library snapshot,
# real Gate-1 / Gate-2 cohort, real manifest, or real KMS-bound build
# is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions. The pipeline
# refuses to operate on documents containing `HUMAN_FILL` tokens.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.1 ServiceDescriptor — htn-pregnancy-denylist
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - service_id: htn-pregnancy-denylist
    title: "Pregnancy denylist for hypertension medications"
    description: |
      Hard refusal on order-select for ACE inhibitors, ARBs, MRAs,
      and direct renin inhibitors in pregnancy. Source: 2025 ACC/AHA
      HBP Guideline; COR III-Harm.
    hook: order-select
    posture: hard-refuse
    enabled: true
    bound_libraries:
      - library_id: "lib-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
        library_name: PregnancyHTN
        library_content_hash: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        gate2_register_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/gate2/cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX.signed.jsonld"
        gate2_register_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
        asserts_invariant_kinds: [pregnancy-denylist-order-select-hard-refuse]
        bound_risk_engine: { name: PREVENT, legacy_only: false }
        coverage_pct: 99.5
        coverage_pct_denylist_branch: 99.7
    prefetch:
      patient: "Patient/{{context.patientId}}"
      pregnancy: "Condition?subject=Patient/{{context.patientId}}&code:in=HUMAN_FILL_PREGNANCY_VALUE_SET_ID"
      medications_in_session: "MedicationRequest?subject=Patient/{{context.patientId}}&status=active,draft"
    indicator_set: [critical]
    suggestions_present: false
    documentation_only: false
    age_gate_min_inclusive: 18
    intended_use_population_filter: [pregnant, postpartum]
    out_of_scope_populations: [pediatric]
    metadata:
      build_run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
      build_version_label: "v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATE"
      manifest_payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      gate1_cohort_ids: ["cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"]
      gate2_cohort_ids: ["cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"]
      two_person_witnesses:
        - { role: mfm-or-obstetric-medicine, reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate: gate-1, cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX" }
        - { role: clinical-pharmacologist,    reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate: gate-1, cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX" }
        - { role: mfm-or-obstetric-medicine, reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate: gate-2, cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX" }
        - { role: clinical-pharmacologist,    reviewer_id: "rev-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate: gate-2, cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX" }
      prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL_PROV_ACT"
      sair_anchor_record_ids: ["rec-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"]
      sair_anchor_atomic_unit_ids: ["au-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"]
    state: built
    superseded_by_descriptor_sha256: null
    fixity:
      descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.2 ServiceSetManifest covering the closed seven-service set
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - schema_version: "1.0.0"
    build_run_id: "HUMAN_FILL_UUID"
    manifest_version: "1.0.0"
    predecessor_service_set_sha256: null
    guideline_manifest_ref: "guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.v1.0.0+ACC-AHA-2025+US+HUMAN_FILL_DATE.yaml"

    services:
      - { id: htn-bp-stage-and-confirm,       descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-bp-stage-and-confirm.json",       descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold, descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold.json", descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-pharm-first-line-check,     descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-pharm-first-line-check.json",     descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-pregnancy-denylist,         descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-pregnancy-denylist.json",         descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-resistant-workup,           descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-resistant-workup.json",           descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-secondary-screen,           descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-secondary-screen.json",           descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      - { id: htn-hbpm-discharge,             descriptor_path: "work/HUMAN_FILL_RUN_ID/cds-hooks/htn-hbpm-discharge.json",             descriptor_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }

    service_set_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"

    state: built

    audit_log:
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-built,        actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-set-built,    actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }
      - { event_id: "evt-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", occurred_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", kind: service-set-verified, actor_id: "HUMAN_FILL", payload_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", prov_activity_id: "HUMAN_FILL" }

    fixity:
      manifest_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

# =============================================================================
# 7. CHANGE CONTROL
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Any change to this schema (closed enums, the per-service constraint
# matrix, the AttendingOverridePattern denylist, the
# PregnancyDenylistConstraints, validation rules, invariants, or
# example fixtures) requires:
#   - A change-controlled diff with regression evaluation against the
#     golden CDS Hooks service-set.
#   - Panel-chair signoff AND medical-director acknowledgement (since
#     this schema directly governs the prescribing-surface wiring of
#     a safety-critical hard-block).
#   - Increment of `schema_version` (semver: breaking = major).
#   - Update of `last_reviewed`.
#   - Coordinated update of every producing/consuming skill's
#     tools_lock reference and acceptance-test fixtures.
#   - Any change to: closed_service_set; closed_hook_type_and_posture;
#     attending_override_denylist; pregnancy_hard_block;
#     pce_legacy_never_feeds_cds; age_gate_eq_18;

#     superseded_descriptors; or enabled_unconditionally requires
#     ALSO an ADR-HTN-001 amendment with documented rationale and a
#     new medical-director signoff.
# =============================================================================

change_control:
  semver: true
  golden_set_regression_required: true
  panel_chair_signoff_required: true
  medical_director_acknowledgement_required: true
  parent_schemas_to_update_on_breaking_change:
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml
    - cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/atomic-unit.yaml

`schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` is now complete. The file mirrors the parent repo's schema discipline established by `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, `gate3-attestation.yaml`, and `safety-case-htn.yaml`:

- §1 policy: thirteen normative clauses including `closed_service_set`, `closed_hook_type_and_posture`, `attending_override_denylist` (recursive scan over every key and string value in the descriptor JSON tree, case-insensitive after Unicode NFC), `pregnancy_hard_block` (referencing the seventeen-item PregnancyDenylistConstraints in §3.7), `pce_legacy_never_feeds_cds`, `age_gate_eq_18`, `library_content_hash_binding`, `descriptor_canonicalization` (RFC 8785 JCS with `fixity` excluded), `service_set_manifest_canonicalization`, `two_person_witnesses_recorded`, `post_package_immutability`, `superseded_descriptors` (monotone chain), and `enabled_unconditionally`.

- §2 closed enums: the seven service ids in canonical order; `CdsHooksHookType` (five values); `CdsHooksPosture` (three values with explicit note that `soft-warning` is permitted only on non-denylist branches per §2.4); the embedded **PerServiceConstraintMatrix** in §2.4 with closed per-service hook + posture + bound-libraries + asserts constraints for all seven services; the closed **AttendingOverridePattern** denylist in §2.5 with 22 patterns including the explicit guidance that the `posture: soft-warning` enum value is distinguished from the `soft_warning` / `softWarning` field-name / string-value pattern (so validators correctly distinguish a legitimate `posture` enum from a leaked field name); `LibraryName`, `HardBlockInvariantKind`, `CardIndicator`, `PopulationFilter`, `OutOfScopePopulation`, `ReviewerRole`, `RiskEngineName` (PCE-legacy is in the enum **only** to make the deny rule machine-checkable; CDH-INV-10 forbids it on every descriptor), `DescriptorState`, `ServiceSetState`, `AuditEventKind` (closed; aligned to the audit events the skill emits), `VerificationMethod`.

- §3 structured types: `BoundLibrary` (with the dedicated `coverage_pct_denylist_branch` field that is required-non-null only on `htn-pregnancy-denylist`), `PrefetchTemplate` (with the explicit constraint that `htn-pregnancy-denylist` MUST contain a `pregnancy` key referencing the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set), `TwoPersonWitness`, `DescriptorMetadata` (with `gate1_cohort_ids[]`, `gate2_cohort_ids[]`, `two_person_witnesses[]`, and `prov_activity_id` all required), `DescriptorFixity` (RFC 8785 JCS with `fixity` excluded), `ServiceDescriptor` (root descriptor type with `enabled: const true`, `documentation_only: const false`, `age_gate_min_inclusive: const 18`), the embedded **PregnancyDenylistConstraints** in §3.7 with seventeen sub-constraints (a..q), `AuditEvent`, and `ServiceManifestEntry`.

- §4 dual roots: `ServiceSetManifest` (cohort-wide manifest with `services[]: minItems 7 / maxItems 7`, `service_set_sha256`, append-only `audit_log[]`, deterministic `fixity`, and optional `extensions[]` gated by manifest authorization) and `ServiceDescriptor` (per-service file, validated against `#/$defs/ServiceDescriptor`).

- §5 twenty-six cross-field invariants `CDH-INV-01`…`CDH-INV-26` including: closed seven-service set (`CDH-INV-01`); per-service-entry SHA matches per-file `fixity.descriptor_sha256` (`CDH-INV-02`); service-set hash determinism (`CDH-INV-03`); descriptor hash determinism (`CDH-INV-04`); per-service constraint matrix enforcement (`CDH-INV-05`); `enabled` unconditional (`CDH-INV-06`); age gate = 18 (`CDH-INV-07`); `documentation_only: false` (`CDH-INV-08`); Library content-hash drift detection (`CDH-INV-09`); PCE-legacy banned (`CDH-INV-10`); posture × indicator-set consistency (`CDH-INV-11`); recursive AttendingOverridePattern scan (`CDH-INV-12`); the seventeen-item PregnancyDenylistConstraints enforcement (`CDH-INV-13`); two-person witness requirements with role-specific constraints for `htn-pregnancy-denylist` (`CDH-INV-14`); Gate-2 cohort finalization (`CDH-INV-15`); manifest payload SHA matches (`CDH-INV-16`); append-only audit log (`CDH-INV-17`); manifest-level fixity determinism (`CDH-INV-18`); post-package descriptor immutability (`CDH-INV-19`); predecessor chain monotonicity (`CDH-INV-20`); extensions gated by manifest authorization (`CDH-INV-21`); `hard-refuse` posture requires verified hard-block invariants (`CDH-INV-22`); `intended_use_population_filter` exact match for pregnancy denylist (`CDH-INV-23`); `pediatric` always in `out_of_scope_populations` (`CDH-INV-24`); `htn-prevent-risk-and-threshold` requires both PREVENT-canonical and PCE-legacy-never invariants (`CDH-INV-25`); `htn-pharm-first-line-check` requires both AKI and hyperkalemia invariants (`CDH-INV-26`).

- Two examples (a `ServiceDescriptor` for `htn-pregnancy-denylist` and a `ServiceSetManifest` covering all seven services) using the consistent `HUMAN_FILL` token convention.

- §7 change control requiring both panel-chair signoff and medical-director acknowledgement, explicitly listing the parent schemas, parent skills, and ADR clauses (D5, D8, D9, D10, D15) to update on any breaking change to any of the thirteen policy clauses.

The framework's signature surface is now closed and self-consistent across nine schemas: `acc-aha-grading.yaml`, `sair.yaml`, `recommendation-record-htn.yaml`, `atomic-unit.yaml`, `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, `gate3-attestation.yaml`, `safety-case-htn.yaml`, `guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml`, and now `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml`. The wiring between content (Libraries gated at Gate 2), safety evaluation (Safety Case at P23), prescribing surface (CDS Hooks services at P22), and publication attestation (Gate 3) is fully covered by mechanically-verifiable contracts.

3. `schemas/sair.yaml` — the SAIR schema as drafted in this thread, formally reified at the same fidelity as the gate registers, with the `recommendation_boxes[]` sub-schema, the `meta.write_back_lock_state` lifecycle, and the reversible-normalization-log invariants spelled out.
4. `gate1-sme-review` `SKILL.md` (refresh) — the Gate-1 reviewer interface skill, refreshed to reference `gate1-register.yaml` exactly as drafted, with the closed-edit-target enum, two-person rule, and panel-chair finalization paths.
