$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml"
title: "PharmRuleHTN"
description: >
  Auditable, deterministic-id-bound, RFC-8785-canonical contract for
  the closed-shape pharmacologic-rule set produced by
  `extract-pharm-rules`. Encodes the closed five-kind rule enum, the
  closed support enums (Trigger, Consequence, PopulationFilter,
  AnchorKind, PostureAtCds, CdsHook, CardIndicator), the dual-LLM
  family-distinct agreement structure, the pregnancy-denylist-specific
  constraint block, the closed AttendingOverridePattern denylist as a
  schema-level invariant, the panel-chair acknowledgement structure
  for held rules with the explicit prohibition on pregnancy-denylist
  held-rule acknowledgement, the rule-set fixity-manifest shape, and
  the post-seal immutability rules.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  closed_rule_kind_set:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `kind` MUST be a member of the closed
      five-kind enum in §2.1 (`first-line-selection`, `denylist`,
      `dose-modifier`, `monitoring`, `discontinuation`). Adding a
      sixth kind requires ADR-HTN-001 amendment under panel-chair
      signoff and a coordinated update of `extract-pharm-rules`,
      `emit-cql-htn`, `cds-hooks-package-htn`, `safety-hbp`, and
      `fhir-implementation-guide-build`.

  closed_support_enums:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `trigger`, `consequence`, `population_filter[]`,
      `anchor_kind`, `posture_at_cds`, `cds_hook`, and indicator-set
      values MUST be members of the closed enums in §2. Out-of-enum
      values BLOCK the build with `enum-violation`.

  dual_llm_family_distinct_agreement:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule MUST record an `agreement` block populated by
      the dual-LLM family-distinct extraction pass. The two LLMs MUST
      be from distinct vendor families per the active manifest's
      `tools_lock.llm_pair[]` and the framework's
      `docs/llm-family-matrix.md` ground-truth list (mirrored from
      `atomic-unit.yaml` AU-INV-09 and from
      `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §1.4). Family collapse on the
      pinned pair BLOCKs the build. The agreement state is one of
      `agreed`, `held`, or `conflict`; rules in `agreed` advance to
      verification, `held` route to the panel-chair queue, and
      `conflict` route the parent record to panel-chair re-review.

  inheritance_from_parent_record_and_atomic_unit:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule MUST inherit `acc_aha_cor` and `acc_aha_loe`
      from its parent `RecommendationRecordHTN` (read-only; the rule
      cannot relax COR or LOE). Anchors (`sair_sha256`, `bbox`,
      `page`) are inherited from the parent `AtomicUnit`. The parent
      record's Gate-1 cohort id is recorded for cross-reference.
      Mismatches between rule fields and parent fields are a release
      blocker.

  hard_block_basis_for_denylist:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule of `kind == "denylist"` MUST cite an
      `anchor_kind` from the closed set
      {`cor-iii-harm-anchor`, `cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor`,
      `explicit-should-not-anchor`, `explicit-not-recommended-anchor`}.
      Other anchor kinds (`cor-i-anchor`, `cor-iia-anchor`,
      `cor-iib-anchor`) are not admissible for denylist rules under
      any circumstance. The parent record's `acc_aha_cor` MUST be
      `III-Harm` or `III-No-Benefit` for `cor-iii-*` anchors. Mismatch
      emits `denylist-without-hard-block-basis` and BLOCKs.

  pregnancy_denylist_constraint_block:
    rule: >
      A PharmRule whose `population_filter[]` contains `pregnant` or
      `postpartum` AND whose `kind == "denylist"` MUST satisfy ALL of
      the following (PregnancyDenylistConstraints, mirrored from
      `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §3.7 and adapted to the
      rule-extraction layer):
        a) `posture_at_cds == "hard-refuse"`
        b) `cds_hook == "order-select"`
        c) `attending_override_permitted == false`
        d) `documentation_only == false`
        e) `indicator_set == ["critical"]`
        f) `parent_record_id` resolves to a record whose
           `pico_precheck.populations[]` includes `pregnant` or
           `postpartum`
        g) `parent_atomic_unit_id` resolves to a unit whose
           `anchors.anchor_kind ∈ {"cor-iii-harm-anchor",
                                    "explicit-should-not-anchor",
                                    "explicit-not-recommended-anchor"}`
        h) `acc_aha_cor == "III-Harm"`
        i) NO key or string value anywhere in the rule's `rationale`,
           `clinical_consequence`, or `held_remediation_hint` fields
           (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC) matches any
           AttendingOverridePattern from §2.7
      Validators MUST refuse any pregnancy denylist rule that fails
      any of (a..i) and MUST emit the corresponding closed audit event
      from §2.13.

  attending_override_denylist:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule MUST be free of attending-override semantics in
      its free-text fields. Validators MUST recursively scan every
      string value in `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`, and
      `held_remediation_hint` (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC) for
      any AttendingOverridePattern from §2.7. Any match BLOCKs the
      build and emits an `attending-override-pattern-detected` audit
      event. The pattern set is closed; new patterns require
      ADR-HTN-001 amendment.

  pce_legacy_never_feeds_rules:
    rule: >
      No PharmRule may reference `PCE-legacy` in any field, including
      `trigger` literal values, `consequence` literal values,
      `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`, or
      `held_remediation_hint`. PREVENT is canonical per ADR-HTN-001
      D5; any PCE-legacy reference is a release blocker.

  age_gate_eq_18:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's parent record's `pico_precheck.populations[]`
      MUST be compatible with the manifest's
      `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18`. Pediatric populations
      are out of scope and rejected at the rule-extraction layer.

  rxnorm_pin_alignment:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule MUST record `rxnorm_edition_pin` matching the
      active manifest's pinned RxNorm edition. The rule's
      `drug_classes[]` MUST resolve under that edition with non-empty
      RxNorm subsets at validation time. RxNorm edition drift between
      packaging and validation BLOCKs and emits `rxnorm-pin-drift`.

  numeric_fact_integrity:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `numeric_facts[]` MUST round-trip
      byte-for-byte against the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`
      via deterministic regex AND verify against an independent VLM
      re-read. Mismatch routes the rule to the panel-chair queue with
      `numeric-fact-mismatch`.

  verbatim_integrity:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `source_text_verbatim` MUST round-trip
      byte-for-byte against the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`
      after Phase-2 reversible normalization. The
      `normalization_log[]` MUST round-trip. Mismatch routes the rule
      to the queue with `verbatim-mismatch`.

  panel_chair_acknowledgement_for_held:
    rule: >
      A rule-set whose `rules[]` contains any rule in `held` state
      MUST carry a panel-chair acknowledgement signed by the chair's
      institutional KMS key, time-stamped via a manifest-pinned TSA.
      The acknowledgement does NOT override the held flag; downstream
      phases consume held rules with the held flag intact (e.g., as
      `informational` rather than `hard-refuse`). The acknowledgement
      records that the chair has reviewed the held rule's diff.
      Rules of `kind == "denylist"` whose `population_filter[]`
      contains `pregnant` or `postpartum` MAY NOT be acknowledged
      under `held` state; such rules MUST reach `agreed` before any
      downstream phase consumes them. The schema enforces this with
      `PR-INV-21`.

  conflict_routing:
    rule: >
      A rule whose `agreement.state == "conflict"` MUST NOT be
      written to the canonical rule set; it routes to the panel-chair
      queue and pauses downstream phases for the parent record. The
      parent record routes back through Gate 1 (`gate1-sme-review
      --mode chair-finalize` with closed concern category
      `atomicity-state-disputed`) for re-decomposition before
      re-extraction.

  deterministic_id_derivation:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `rule_id` MUST be the deterministic
      truncated SHA-256 of the canonical tuple
      `(parent_record_id, parent_atomic_unit_id, kind)`. Re-runs
      against the same inputs produce identical rule_ids; downstream
      consumers (P20, P22, P23, P26) re-bind without renumbering.

  rule_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      Every PharmRule's `fixity.rule_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of
      the JCS-canonical (RFC 8785) form of the rule with `fixity`
      excluded. Validators recompute and compare; mismatch is a
      release blocker.

  rule_set_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      The rule set's `fixity.rule_set_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of
      the JCS-canonical form of THIS document with both `fixity` AND
      `panel_chair_acknowledgement.acknowledgement_signoff` excluded.
      The chair's signature is computed over the rule_set_sha256, so
      including it in the canonical form would create a circular
      dependency; the schema explicitly excludes it from the SHA
      payload.

  post_seal_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once a rule set's `state == "sealed"` and
      `fixity.rule_set_sha256` is populated AND, when held rules are
      present, `panel_chair_acknowledgement.acknowledgement_signoff`
      verifies, neither the rule set nor any rule's `fixity` may be
      mutated. Corrections require a new rule-set version with
      `predecessor_rule_set_sha256` referring to the superseded one.
      The old rule set is retained immutably for audit.

  predecessor_chain:
    rule: >
      `predecessor_rule_set_sha256` MUST be set whenever this rule
      set supersedes a prior one. The predecessor's state MUST be
      `superseded` or `withdrawn`. The chain is monotone; cycles are
      forbidden.

  audit_log_append_only:
    rule: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Closed rule kinds (the closed five-kind set)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PharmRuleKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - first-line-selection
      - denylist
      - dose-modifier
      - monitoring
      - discontinuation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Trigger (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Trigger:
    type: string
    enum:
      - order-select-medication-class
      - order-select-medication-rxnorm-set
      - prescribe-or-refill
      - bp-threshold-met
      - population-detected
      - comorbidity-detected
      - lab-threshold-met
      - monitoring-interval-elapsed
      - taper-protocol-required

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Consequence (closed)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Consequence:
    type: string
    enum:
      - refuse-with-rationale
      - recommend-class
      - recommend-rxnorm-set
      - start-low-go-slow
      - dose-cap-numeric
      - monitoring-required-interval
      - monitoring-required-event
      - protocolized-taper-required
      - escalate-workup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 PopulationFilter (closed; mirrored from cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PopulationFilter:
    type: string
    enum:
      - general-adult
      - older-adult
      - pregnant
      - postpartum
      - ckd
      - t2dm
      - hf-rEF
      - hf-pEF
      - cad
      - post-stroke
      - secondary-htn-suspected
      - urgency
      - emergency
      - resistant-htn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 AnchorKind (closed; mirrored from atomic-unit.yaml and
  #     safety-case-htn.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnchorKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cor-i-anchor
      - cor-iia-anchor
      - cor-iib-anchor
      - cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor
      - cor-iii-harm-anchor
      - explicit-should-not-anchor
      - explicit-not-recommended-anchor

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 PostureAtCds, CdsHook, CardIndicator (mirrored from
  #     cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostureAtCds:
    type: string
    enum:
      - hard-refuse
      - soft-warning
      - informational

  CdsHook:
    type: string
    enum:
      - order-select
      - patient-view
      - encounter-discharge

  CardIndicator:
    type: string
    enum:
      - info
      - warning
      - critical
      - hard-stop

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Closed AttendingOverridePattern denylist
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mirrored verbatim from `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §2.5.
  # Validators MUST recursively scan every string value in
  # `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`, and `held_remediation_hint`
  # (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC) for any of these patterns.
  # Matches BLOCK the build.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttendingOverridePattern:
    type: string
    enum:
      - permit_on_attending_override
      - permitOnAttendingOverride
      - attending_override
      - attendingOverride
      - override_role
      - overrideRole
      - override_reason_required
      - overrideReasonRequired
      - attending_can_override
      - attendingCanOverride
      - override_with_attending_co_sign
      - overrideWithAttendingCoSign
      - permit_on_co_sign
      - permitOnCoSign
      - override_permitted
      - overridePermitted
      - suppressible
      - suppressibleByRole
      - documentationOnly
      - documentation_only
      - soft_warning
      - softWarning

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 ACC/AHA grading (mirrored from acc-aha-grading.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccAhaCOR:
    type: string
    enum: [I, IIa, IIb, III-No-Benefit, III-Harm]

  AccAhaLOE:
    type: string
    enum: [A, B-R, B-NR, C-LD, C-EO]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 Risk engine (closed; mirrored from cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RiskEngineName:
    type: string
    enum:
      - PREVENT
      - PCE-legacy   # MUST NEVER appear in any rule field; enum exists only to make the deny rule machine-checkable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 LLM family identifiers (closed; mirrored advisory from
  #      docs/llm-family-matrix.md ground truth)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LlmFamily:
    type: string
    enum:
      - openai
      - anthropic
      - google
      - meta-llama
      - mistral
      - cohere
      - amazon-nova
      - azure-openai
      - other-pinned
    description: >
      Closed family classification. The matrix file
      `docs/llm-family-matrix.md` is the framework's ground truth and
      governs rotations under panel-chair signoff. This enum exists to
      make the family-distinct rule machine-checkable.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Agreement state (dual-LLM family-distinct)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgreementState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - agreed
      - held
      - conflict

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Lifecycle state (per rule)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RuleState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pending
      - advanced
      - held
      - conflict
      - rejected
      - sealed
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.13 Rule-set lifecycle state
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RuleSetState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - awaiting-panel-chair
      - awaiting-time-stamp
      - sealed
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.14 Audit event kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - rule-extracted
      - rule-verified
      - rule-routed-to-queue
      - rule-conflict-pauses-record
      - rule-set-drafted
      - rule-set-awaiting-panel-chair
      - rule-set-acknowledged-by-chair
      - rule-set-sealed
      - rule-set-superseded
      - rule-set-withdrawn
      - rxnorm-pin-drift
      - numeric-fact-mismatch
      - verbatim-mismatch
      - denylist-without-hard-block-basis
      - pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected
      - pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-attempt
      - pregnancy-denylist-non-order-select-detected
      - pce-legacy-binding-detected
      - attending-override-pattern-detected
      - enum-violation
      - family-distinct-rule-violated
      - pharm-rules-mutation-attempt

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.15 Identity / signature primitives (mirrored from neighbor schemas)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SignatureAlgorithm:
    type: string
    enum:
      - Ed25519
      - ECDSA-P256-SHA256

  IdentityAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [IAL1, IAL2, IAL3]

  AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel:
    type: string
    enum: [AAL1, AAL2, AAL3]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.16 Verification methods
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VerificationMethod:
    type: string
    enum:
      - rxnorm-resolution
      - vlm-numeric-reread
      - regex-numeric-extract
      - hard-block-basis-anchor-match
      - verbatim-roundtrip
      - attending-override-pattern-scan-clean
      - pregnancy-constraint-block-pass
      - canonical-sha-match

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 NumericFact
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NumericFact:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [token, value, units, offset]
    properties:
      token:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: The verbatim numeric token as it appears in the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`.
      value:
        type: number
        description: The parsed numeric value.
      units:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: Units string from the source verbatim (e.g., "mg", "mEq/L", "mm Hg"); null if dimensionless.
      offset:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [start, end]
        properties:
          start: { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
          end:   { type: integer, minimum: 0 }
        description: >
          Character offsets within the parent atomic unit's
          `text_verbatim` after Phase-2 reversible normalization.
          Validators MUST verify that text_verbatim[start:end] equals
          `token` modulo the normalization log.
      vlm_reread_value:
        type: [number, "null"]
        description: >
          The independent VLM re-read value (mirrored from P9 §5).
          MUST equal `value` byte-for-byte at validation time, or the
          rule routes to queue with `numeric-fact-mismatch`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 NormalizationLogEntry
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NormalizationLogEntry:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [kind, offset]
    properties:
      kind:
        type: string
        enum:
          - soft-hyphen-removed
          - ligature-decomposed
          - whitespace-canonicalized
          - nfc-composed
      offset:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
      original:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: The original substring before normalization (when kind requires it).
      replacement:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: The substring after normalization (when kind requires it).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 LlmAttribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LlmAttribution:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [llm_id, family, version_pin, response_signature]
    properties:
      llm_id:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: Stable id resolving to the manifest's `tools_lock.items[]` entry of `kind == "llm"`.
      family:
        $ref: "#/$defs/LlmFamily"
      version_pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: The model version pin from the manifest's `tools_lock.items[]`.
      response_signature:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the LLM's deterministic-test-prompt response, recorded at preflight liveness probe.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 AgreementBlock
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgreementBlock:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [state, llm_pair, agreed_llms, dissenting_llms]
    properties:
      state:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/AgreementState" }
      llm_pair:
        type: array
        minItems: 2
        maxItems: 2
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/LlmAttribution" }
      agreed_llms:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        maxItems: 2
        items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      dissenting_llms:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        maxItems: 2
        items: { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      held_diff:
        type: [object, "null"]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          kind_diff:
            type: [array, "null"]
            items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PharmRuleKind" }
            description: When the two LLMs proposed different `kind` values; conflict-class diff.
          drug_classes_diff:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              llm_a_only: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
              llm_b_only: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
          population_filter_diff:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              llm_a_only: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PopulationFilter" } }
              llm_b_only: { type: array, items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PopulationFilter" } }
          trigger_diff:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              llm_a: { $ref: "#/$defs/Trigger" }
              llm_b: { $ref: "#/$defs/Trigger" }
          consequence_diff:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              llm_a: { $ref: "#/$defs/Consequence" }
              llm_b: { $ref: "#/$defs/Consequence" }
          numeric_facts_diff:
            type: [array, "null"]
            items:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: false
              required: [token]
              properties:
                token:  { type: string }
                llm_a:  { type: [string, "null"] }
                llm_b:  { type: [string, "null"] }
          anchor_kind_diff:
            type: [object, "null"]
            additionalProperties: false
            properties:
              llm_a: { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
              llm_b: { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      held_remediation_hint:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Plain-text remediation hint for the panel-chair queue (e.g.,
          "Re-decompose atomic unit at P9", "Re-bind drug class at
          P10"). Validators MUST scan this field for
          AttendingOverridePattern matches.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 BoundRiskEngine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BoundRiskEngine:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [name, legacy_only]
    properties:
      name:        { $ref: "#/$defs/RiskEngineName" }
      legacy_only: { type: boolean }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Verification
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RuleVerification:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [verifies, verified_at, methods_passed, methods_failed]
    properties:
      verifies:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Recomputed by `extract-pharm-rules` at every run. Producer
          claims of `true` are not trusted; validators recompute every
          method.
      verified_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      methods_passed:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/VerificationMethod" }
      methods_failed:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/VerificationMethod" }
      failure_notes:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: Plain-text diagnostic accompanying methods_failed[].

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 Anchor
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Anchor:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [anchor_kind, sair_sha256, page, bbox]
    properties:
      anchor_kind: { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      sair_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      page:        { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      bbox:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [x0, y0, x1, y1]
        properties:
          x0: { type: number }
          y0: { type: number }
          x1: { type: number }
          y1: { type: number }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 Indicator set (per posture)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IndicatorSet:
    type: array
    minItems: 1
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/CardIndicator" }
    description: >
      Per-posture closed mapping enforced by PR-INV-09:
        - posture_at_cds == "hard-refuse"   -> subset of {critical, hard-stop}
        - posture_at_cds == "soft-warning"  -> exactly ["warning"]
        - posture_at_cds == "informational" -> exactly ["info"]
      For pregnancy denylist rules, indicator_set MUST be exactly
      ["critical"] (PR-INV-19).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 PharmRule (root rule type)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PharmRule:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - rule_id
      - kind
      - parent_record_id
      - parent_atomic_unit_id
      - gate1_cohort_id
      - acc_aha_cor
      - acc_aha_loe
      - drug_classes
      - rxnorm_edition_pin
      - population_filter
      - trigger
      - consequence
      - numeric_facts
      - anchor_kind
      - anchors
      - posture_at_cds
      - cds_hook
      - indicator_set
      - attending_override_permitted
      - documentation_only
      - source_text_verbatim
      - normalization_log
      - rationale
      - clinical_consequence
      - bound_risk_engine
      - agreement
      - verification
      - state
      - fixity
    properties:
      rule_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Deterministic truncated SHA-256 of `(parent_record_id,
          parent_atomic_unit_id, kind)` (deterministic_id_derivation).
      kind:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/PharmRuleKind" }
      parent_record_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      parent_atomic_unit_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      gate1_cohort_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      acc_aha_cor:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaCOR" }
      acc_aha_loe:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaLOE" }
      drug_classes:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          description: RxNorm class token, resolvable under `rxnorm_edition_pin`.
      rxnorm_edition_pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: The pinned RxNorm edition identifier from `manifest.terminology[]`.
      population_filter:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PopulationFilter" }
      trigger:                    { $ref: "#/$defs/Trigger" }
      consequence:                { $ref: "#/$defs/Consequence" }
      numeric_facts:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/NumericFact" }
      anchor_kind:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      anchors:                    { $ref: "#/$defs/Anchor" }
      posture_at_cds:             { $ref: "#/$defs/PostureAtCds" }
      cds_hook:                   { $ref: "#/$defs/CdsHook" }
      indicator_set:              { $ref: "#/$defs/IndicatorSet" }
      attending_override_permitted:
        type: boolean
        const: false
        description: >
          MUST be false unconditionally. The framework's policy
          forbids attending-override on every pharm rule; institutional
          opt-ins are not permitted at this layer.
      documentation_only:
        type: boolean
        const: false
        description: >
          MUST be false unconditionally (mirrored from
          cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml CDH-INV-08).
      source_text_verbatim:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          The verbatim text of the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`
          after Phase-2 reversible normalization. MUST round-trip
          byte-for-byte against the parent unit (verbatim_integrity).
      normalization_log:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/NormalizationLogEntry" }
      rationale:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          Plain-text rationale citing the parent atomic unit and
          source guideline span. Validators MUST scan this field for
          AttendingOverridePattern matches.
      clinical_consequence:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          Plain-text clinical-consequence summary (e.g., "Fetal demise
          from RAAS exposure in pregnancy"). Validators MUST scan
          this field for AttendingOverridePattern matches.
      bound_risk_engine:          { $ref: "#/$defs/BoundRiskEngine" }
      agreement:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/AgreementBlock" }
      verification:               { $ref: "#/$defs/RuleVerification" }
      state:                      { $ref: "#/$defs/RuleState" }
      superseded_by_rule_id:
        type: [string, "null"]
        pattern: "^pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$"
      fixity:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [rule_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
        properties:
          rule_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
          computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
          canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 PanelChairAcknowledgement (signed envelope; required when held
  #      rules are present and rule-set state == "sealed")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PanelChairIdentityProof:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [ial, aal, proofing_method, proofing_evidence_uri, proofed_at, proofed_by_org]
    properties:
      ial: { $ref: "#/$defs/IdentityAssuranceLevel" }
      aal: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuthenticatorAssuranceLevel" }
      proofing_method:        { type: string }
      proofing_evidence_uri:  { type: string, format: uri }
      proofed_at:             { type: string, format: date-time }
      proofed_by_org:         { type: string }
      proofed_by_person:      { type: [string, "null"] }

  TimeStamp:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [tsa_name, tsa_url, tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256, time, token_b64]
    properties:
      tsa_name:                    { type: string }
      tsa_url:                     { type: string, format: uri }
      tsa_cert_fingerprint_sha256: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      time:                        { type: string, format: date-time }
      token_b64:                   { type: string }

  AcknowledgementSignature:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - algorithm
      - key_id
      - payload_canonical_form
      - payload_sha256
      - signature_b64
      - time_stamp
    properties:
      algorithm:               { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
      key_id:                  { type: string }
      payload_canonical_form:
        type: string
        enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785]
      payload_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      signature_b64:           { type: string }
      time_stamp:              { $ref: "#/$defs/TimeStamp" }
      verifies:                { type: boolean }

  PanelChair:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - chair_id
      - legal_name
      - role
      - identity_proof
      - public_key
    properties:
      chair_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rev-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Stable id; resolves to a Reviewer record in any contributing
          Gate-1 cohort whose `role == "panel-chair"`.
      legal_name:                   { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      preferred_credential_string:  { type: [string, "null"] }
      role:
        type: string
        const: panel-chair
      institution:                  { type: string }
      identity_proof:               { $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChairIdentityProof" }
      public_key:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [algorithm, key_id, key_pem]
        properties:
          algorithm:           { $ref: "#/$defs/SignatureAlgorithm" }
          key_id:              { type: string }
          key_pem:             { type: string }
          fingerprint_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

  PanelChairAcknowledgement:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - held_rule_ids_acknowledged
      - chair
      - acknowledged_at
      - acknowledgement_signoff
    properties:
      held_rule_ids_acknowledged:
        type: array
        minItems: 0
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
        description: >
          The list of rule_ids whose held state the chair acknowledges.
          Validators MUST verify that every entry corresponds to a
          rule whose `state == "held"` AND whose `agreement.state ==
          "held"`. Pregnancy denylist held rules are explicitly
          forbidden from this list (PR-INV-21).
      chair:                            { $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChair" }
      acknowledged_at:                  { type: string, format: date-time }
      acknowledgement_signoff:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/AcknowledgementSignature"
          - type: "null"
        description: >
          Signed JCS payload. Computed over the rule_set_sha256 and
          the held_rule_ids_acknowledged[] list. The schema explicitly
          excludes this field from the rule_set_sha256 canonicalization
          payload (rule_set_canonicalization).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.11 AuditEvent
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — PharmRuleSet
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
title: PharmRuleSet
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - rule_set_id
  - rule_set_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - build
  - rules
  - state
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  rule_set_id:
    type: string
    pattern: "^prs-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
    description: >
      Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of build_run_id +
      manifest_payload_sha256 + records_sha256 +
      atomic_units_sha256). Stable across re-runs given identical
      inputs.

  rule_set_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"

  predecessor_rule_set_sha256:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$"

  predecessor_rule_set_state:
    type: [string, "null"]
    enum: [superseded, withdrawn, null]

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Build identity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - run_id
      - build_version_label
      - opened_at
      - manifest_payload_sha256
      - records_path
      - records_sha256
      - atomic_units_path
      - atomic_units_sha256
      - terminology_bindings_path
      - terminology_bindings_sha256
      - bp_thresholds_path
      - bp_thresholds_sha256
      - gate1_register_paths
      - gate1_register_sha256s
    properties:
      run_id:                     { type: string, format: uuid }
      build_version_label:
        type: string
        pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
      opened_at:                  { type: string, format: date-time }
      sealed_at:                  { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      manifest_payload_sha256:    { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      records_path:               { type: string }
      records_sha256:             { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      atomic_units_path:          { type: string }
      atomic_units_sha256:        { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      terminology_bindings_path:  { type: string }
      terminology_bindings_sha256:{ type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      bp_thresholds_path:         { type: string }
      bp_thresholds_sha256:       { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      gate1_register_paths:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      gate1_register_sha256s:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Rules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  rules:
    type: array
    minItems: 0
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PharmRule" }
    description: >
      The canonical rule set. Rules in `conflict` state MUST NOT be
      written here (conflict_routing); they route to the panel-chair
      queue and pause downstream phases for the parent record.
      Rules in `held` state MAY appear here ONLY if a panel-chair
      acknowledgement is recorded (panel_chair_acknowledgement_for_held).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Panel-chair acknowledgement (required when held rules are present
  #     AND state == "sealed")
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  panel_chair_acknowledgement:
    oneOf:
      - $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChairAcknowledgement"
      - type: "null"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state: { $ref: "#/$defs/RuleSetState" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.6 Rule-set fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [rule_set_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      rule_set_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of THIS document with
          BOTH `fixity` AND
          `panel_chair_acknowledgement.acknowledgement_signoff`
          excluded (rule_set_canonicalization). Deterministic across
          re-runs given identical inputs.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: PR-INV-01
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `kind` MUST be a member of PharmRuleKind
      (closed_rule_kind_set). Out-of-enum kinds are a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-02
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `rule_id` MUST be the deterministic truncated
      SHA-256 of `(parent_record_id, parent_atomic_unit_id, kind)`.
      Validators recompute and compare; mismatch is a release blocker
      (deterministic_id_derivation).

  - id: PR-INV-03
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `acc_aha_cor` and `acc_aha_loe` MUST equal
      the parent record's `acc_aha_cor` and `acc_aha_loe`. The rule
      MUST NOT relax COR or LOE (inheritance_from_parent_record_and_
      atomic_unit). Mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-04
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `anchors.sair_sha256`, `anchors.page`, and
      `anchors.bbox` MUST match the parent atomic unit's anchor
      values exactly. The `anchor_kind` MUST equal both
      `anchors.anchor_kind` and the parent unit's anchor kind.

  - id: PR-INV-05
    description: >
      Every PharmRule of `kind == "denylist"` MUST cite an
      `anchor_kind` from the closed set
      {`cor-iii-harm-anchor`, `cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor`,
      `explicit-should-not-anchor`, `explicit-not-recommended-anchor`}
      AND its parent record's `acc_aha_cor` MUST be `III-Harm` or
      `III-No-Benefit` for `cor-iii-*` anchors. Mismatch emits
      `denylist-without-hard-block-basis` and BLOCKs
      (hard_block_basis_for_denylist).

  - id: PR-INV-06
    description: >
      Every PharmRule of `kind == "discontinuation"` MUST cite
      `anchor_kind == "explicit-should-not-anchor"` AND its
      `consequence` MUST be `protocolized-taper-required`. Mismatch
      is a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-07
    description: >
      For every PharmRule, the (kind, posture_at_cds, cds_hook) tuple
      MUST satisfy the per-kind constraint matrix:
        - first-line-selection: cds_hook ∈ {order-select, patient-view};
                                posture_at_cds ∈ {informational, soft-warning}
        - denylist:             cds_hook == order-select;
                                posture_at_cds == hard-refuse
        - dose-modifier:        cds_hook == order-select;
                                posture_at_cds ∈ {soft-warning, informational}
        - monitoring:           cds_hook ∈ {order-select, patient-view, encounter-discharge};
                                posture_at_cds ∈ {soft-warning, informational}
        - discontinuation:      cds_hook ∈ {order-select, encounter-discharge};
                                posture_at_cds ∈ {hard-refuse, soft-warning}
      Validators MUST refuse any rule whose tuple is not in the matrix.

  - id: PR-INV-08
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `attending_override_permitted` MUST be
      `false` (const false). Every PharmRule's `documentation_only`
      MUST be `false` (const false). Validators MUST refuse `true`
      values (attending_override_denylist).

  - id: PR-INV-09
    description: >
      For every PharmRule, the (posture_at_cds, indicator_set) pairing
      MUST satisfy:
        - posture_at_cds == "hard-refuse"   -> indicator_set ⊆ {critical, hard-stop}
        - posture_at_cds == "soft-warning"  -> indicator_set == ["warning"]
        - posture_at_cds == "informational" -> indicator_set == ["info"]
      Mismatched pairs are a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-10
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `agreement.llm_pair[]` MUST contain exactly
      two entries from distinct LlmFamily values
      (dual_llm_family_distinct_agreement). Family collapse on the
      pinned pair BLOCKs and emits
      `family-distinct-rule-violated`.

  - id: PR-INV-11
    description: >
      For every PharmRule:
        - agreement.state == "agreed"   -> agreed_llms.length == 2 AND
                                            dissenting_llms.length == 0
        - agreement.state == "held"     -> agreed_llms.length ∈ {0,1} AND
                                            held_diff is non-null
        - agreement.state == "conflict" -> held_diff.kind_diff is non-null AND
                                            the rule MUST NOT appear in the
                                            canonical rule set (conflict_routing)
      Validators MUST refuse rules whose agreement block contradicts
      these invariants.

  - id: PR-INV-12
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `numeric_facts[]` token MUST round-trip
      byte-for-byte against the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`
      at offset (start, end) modulo the normalization log
      (numeric_fact_integrity). Validators MUST recompute via
      deterministic regex AND verify `vlm_reread_value == value`;
      mismatch routes the rule to the queue with
      `numeric-fact-mismatch`.

  - id: PR-INV-13
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `source_text_verbatim` MUST round-trip
      byte-for-byte against the parent atomic unit's `text_verbatim`
      after applying the `normalization_log[]` in reverse
      (verbatim_integrity).

  - id: PR-INV-14
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `rxnorm_edition_pin` MUST equal the active
      manifest's `terminology[]` RxNorm edition AND every entry in
      `drug_classes[]` MUST resolve to a non-empty subset under that
      edition at validation time (rxnorm_pin_alignment). Drift emits
      `rxnorm-pin-drift` and BLOCKs.

  - id: PR-INV-15
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `bound_risk_engine.name` MUST be `PREVENT`
      AND `bound_risk_engine.legacy_only` MUST be `false`. PCE-legacy
      is forbidden in any rule field (pce_legacy_never_feeds_rules).
      Validators recursively scan every string field for the literal
      `PCE-legacy`; matches BLOCK and emit
      `pce-legacy-binding-detected`.

  - id: PR-INV-16
    description: >
      Validators MUST recursively scan every string value in every
      PharmRule's `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`,
      `agreement.held_remediation_hint`, and (when present) any
      `agreement.held_diff.*` text fields (case-insensitive after
      Unicode NFC) for any AttendingOverridePattern from §2.7. Any
      match BLOCKs and emits an `attending-override-pattern-detected`
      audit event (attending_override_denylist).

  - id: PR-INV-17
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `fixity.rule_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of
      the JCS-canonical form of the rule with `fixity` excluded
      (rule_canonicalization). Validators recompute and compare;
      mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-18
    description: >
      For every PharmRule whose `population_filter[]` contains
      `pregnant` or `postpartum` AND `kind == "denylist"`, ALL of the
      constraints in the PregnancyDenylistConstraints policy clause
      (a..i) MUST hold. Any violation BLOCKs and emits the
      corresponding closed audit event from §2.13
      (`pregnancy-denylist-soft-warning-detected`,
      `pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-attempt`,
      `pregnancy-denylist-non-order-select-detected`,
      `denylist-without-hard-block-basis`).

  - id: PR-INV-19
    description: >
      For every PharmRule satisfying PR-INV-18's antecedent (pregnancy
      denylist), `indicator_set` MUST equal exactly `["critical"]`
      (no other elements; ordering enforced by JCS canonicalization).
      Validators MUST refuse any other set.

  - id: PR-INV-20
    description: >
      For every PharmRule satisfying PR-INV-18's antecedent, the
      parent record's `pico_precheck.populations[]` MUST include
      `pregnant` or `postpartum`. Validators MUST resolve the parent
      record at validation time; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-21
    description: >
      `panel_chair_acknowledgement.held_rule_ids_acknowledged[]` MUST
      NOT contain any rule whose `kind == "denylist"` AND whose
      `population_filter[]` contains `pregnant` or `postpartum`.
      Pregnancy denylist held rules are explicitly forbidden from
      panel-chair acknowledgement; they MUST reach `agreed` before
      any downstream phase consumes them
      (panel_chair_acknowledgement_for_held). Validators MUST refuse
      any rule set whose acknowledgement violates this invariant
      (this is a clinical safety failure, not a remediation).

  - id: PR-INV-22
    description: >
      For state == "sealed":
        - Every rule's `state` MUST be `advanced`, `held`, or
          `superseded` (NEVER `pending`, `conflict`, or `rejected`).
        - If any rule's `state == "held"`, `panel_chair_
          acknowledgement` MUST be non-null AND
          `acknowledgement_signoff.verifies` MUST recompute to
          `true` under `chair.public_key`.
        - `fixity.rule_set_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the
          JCS-canonical form with both `fixity` and
          `acknowledgement_signoff` excluded.
        - `audit_log[]` MUST contain a `rule-set-sealed` event.

  - id: PR-INV-23
    description: >
      For state == "draft":
        - `panel_chair_acknowledgement` MAY be null.
        - rules MAY be in any of `pending`, `advanced`, `held`,
          `conflict`, or `rejected` states; rules in `conflict`
          MUST be elided from `rules[]` and routed to the queue per
          conflict_routing.
        - Validators MUST refuse to transition to `sealed` while any
          rule is in `pending`, `conflict`, or `rejected`.

  - id: PR-INV-24
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers
      (audit_log_append_only).

  - id: PR-INV-25
    description: >
      `predecessor_rule_set_sha256` MUST be set whenever this rule
      set supersedes a prior one. The predecessor's recorded state
      (in `predecessor_rule_set_state`) MUST be `superseded` or
      `withdrawn`. Cycles in the predecessor chain are a release
      blocker (predecessor_chain).

  - id: PR-INV-26
    description: >
      Once state == "sealed" AND fixity is recorded, neither
      `rules[]`, `panel_chair_acknowledgement`, `state`, `fixity`,
      `predecessor_*`, `build`, nor `guideline_manifest_ref` may be
      mutated (post_seal_immutability). Mutation attempts MUST be
      detected (by recompute of `rule_set_sha256`) and emit
      `pharm-rules-mutation-attempt`.

  - id: PR-INV-27
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `gate1_cohort_id` MUST resolve to a Gate-1
      cohort register file in state `finalized` at validation time.
      Non-finalized cohorts indicate upstream rework not yet
      completed and BLOCK.

  - id: PR-INV-28
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `verification.verifies` MUST recompute to
      `true` at every run. Producer claims are not trusted;
      validators recompute every method in
      `verification.methods_passed[]` and confirm
      `verification.methods_failed[]` is empty.

  - id: PR-INV-29
    description: >
      For every PharmRule, the parent record's `pico_precheck.
      populations[]` MUST be compatible with the manifest's
      `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18` (age_gate_eq_18).
      Pediatric populations are out of scope and a release blocker.

  - id: PR-INV-30
    description: >
      For every PharmRule of `kind == "first-line-selection"` whose
      `trigger == "bp-threshold-met"` or whose `population_filter[]`
      includes `cad`, `ckd`, `t2dm`, `hf-rEF`, `hf-pEF`, or
      `post-stroke`, the manifest's pinned `risk_engine.name` MUST be
      `PREVENT`. The rule MUST NOT cite a `BoundRiskEngine` other
      than PREVENT.

  - id: PR-INV-31
    description: >
      Every PharmRule's `agreement.llm_pair[].response_signature`
      MUST recompute against the manifest's deterministic-test-prompt
      response for the corresponding `tools_lock.items[]` entry.
      Drift indicates LLM rotation outside a manifest version and
      BLOCKs with `family-distinct-rule-violated`.

# =============================================================================
# 6. WORKED EXAMPLES (shape-correctness fixtures)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two examples are provided:
#   6.1 A PharmRule of kind "denylist" for pregnancy (the most-restricted
#       shape; serves as the reference fixture for §3.7 / PR-INV-18..20).
#   6.2 A PharmRuleSet covering several rules across multiple kinds,
#       in `sealed` state, with held rules acknowledged by the panel chair
#       (no pregnancy denylist held; pregnancy denylist is `agreed`).
#
# EVERY field whose value can ONLY come from a real Library snapshot,
# real Gate-1 / Gate-2 cohort, real manifest, real KMS-bound chair,
# or real build is marked `HUMAN_FILL` with explicit instructions.
# The pipeline refuses to operate on documents containing `HUMAN_FILL`
# tokens.
# =============================================================================

examples:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6.1 PharmRule — pregnancy denylist (RAAS / MRA / direct-renin in pregnancy)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  - rule_id: "pr-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    kind: denylist
    parent_record_id: "rec-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    parent_atomic_unit_id: "au-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    gate1_cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX"
    acc_aha_cor: III-Harm
    acc_aha_loe: B-NR
    drug_classes:
      - "rxnorm-class:ACE-inhibitor"
      - "rxnorm-class:ARB"
      - "rxnorm-class:MRA"
      - "rxnorm-class:direct-renin-inhibitor"
    rxnorm_edition_pin: "HUMAN_FILL_RXNORM_EDITION"
    population_filter: [pregnant, postpartum]
    trigger: order-select-medication-class
    consequence: refuse-with-rationale
    numeric_facts: []
    anchor_kind: cor-iii-harm-anchor
    anchors:
      anchor_kind: cor-iii-harm-anchor
      sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      page: 12
      bbox: { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 0, y1: 0 }
    posture_at_cds: hard-refuse
    cds_hook: order-select
    indicator_set: [critical]
    attending_override_permitted: false
    documentation_only: false
    source_text_verbatim: "HUMAN_FILL: verbatim text of parent atomic unit (no paraphrase)"
    normalization_log: []
    rationale: |
      HUMAN_FILL: source-anchored rationale citing the parent record
      and atomic unit; no paraphrase of clinical text outside source
      anchors; NO attending-override semantics.
    clinical_consequence: |
      Fetal demise; oligohydramnios; neonatal renal failure on RAAS
      exposure during pregnancy. Source: 2025 ACC/AHA HBP Guideline,
      COR III-Harm.
    bound_risk_engine: { name: PREVENT, legacy_only: false }
    agreement:
      state: agreed
      llm_pair:
        - { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_A", family: openai,    version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
        - { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_B", family: anthropic, version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }
      agreed_llms: ["llm-HUMAN_FILL_A", "llm-HUMAN_FILL_B"]
      dissenting_llms: []
      held_diff: null
      held_remediation_hint: null
    verification:

      verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      methods_passed:
        - rxnorm-resolution
        - hard-block-basis-anchor-match
        - verbatim-roundtrip
        - attending-override-pattern-scan-clean
        - pregnancy-constraint-block-pass
        - canonical-sha-match
      methods_failed: []
      failure_notes: null
    state: advanced
    superseded_by_rule_id: null
    fixity:
      rule_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX"
      computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME"
      canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

      - { rule_id: "pr-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", kind: denylist, parent_record_id: "rec-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", parent_atomic_unit_id: "au-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate1_cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", acc_aha_cor: III-Harm, acc_aha_loe: B-NR, drug_classes: ["rxnorm-class:ACE-inhibitor", "rxnorm-class:ARB", "rxnorm-class:MRA", "rxnorm-class:direct-renin-inhibitor"], rxnorm_edition_pin: "HUMAN_FILL_RXNORM_EDITION", population_filter: [pregnant, postpartum], trigger: order-select-medication-class, consequence: refuse-with-rationale, numeric_facts: [], anchor_kind: cor-iii-harm-anchor, anchors: { anchor_kind: cor-iii-harm-anchor, sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", page: 12, bbox: { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 0, y1: 0 } }, posture_at_cds: hard-refuse, cds_hook: order-select, indicator_set: [critical], attending_override_permitted: false, documentation_only: false, source_text_verbatim: "HUMAN_FILL", normalization_log: [], rationale: "HUMAN_FILL", clinical_consequence: "HUMAN_FILL", bound_risk_engine: { name: PREVENT, legacy_only: false }, agreement: { state: agreed, llm_pair: [ { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_A", family: openai, version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }, { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_B", family: anthropic, version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" } ], agreed_llms: ["llm-HUMAN_FILL_A","llm-HUMAN_FILL_B"], dissenting_llms: [], held_diff: null, held_remediation_hint: null }, verification: { verifies: true, verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", methods_passed: [rxnorm-resolution, hard-block-basis-anchor-match, verbatim-roundtrip, attending-override-pattern-scan-clean, pregnancy-constraint-block-pass, canonical-sha-match], methods_failed: [], failure_notes: null }, state: advanced, superseded_by_rule_id: null, fixity: { rule_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785 } }

      # AKI triple-whammy (denylist on a non-pregnancy population) — agreed.
      - { rule_id: "pr-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", kind: denylist, parent_record_id: "rec-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", parent_atomic_unit_id: "au-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", gate1_cohort_id: "cohort-HUMAN_FILL_16HEX", acc_aha_cor: IIa, acc_aha_loe: B-NR, drug_classes: ["rxnorm-class:ACEi-or-ARB","rxnorm-class:loop-or-thiazide-diuretic","rxnorm-class:NSAID"], rxnorm_edition_pin: "HUMAN_FILL_RXNORM_EDITION", population_filter: [general-adult, ckd], trigger: order-select-medication-class, consequence: refuse-with-rationale, numeric_facts: [], anchor_kind: explicit-should-not-anchor, anchors: { anchor_kind: explicit-should-not-anchor, sair_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", page: 33, bbox: { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 0, y1: 0 } }, posture_at_cds: hard-refuse, cds_hook: order-select, indicator_set: [critical], attending_override_permitted: false, documentation_only: false, source_text_verbatim: "HUMAN_FILL", normalization_log: [], rationale: "HUMAN_FILL", clinical_consequence: "HUMAN_FILL", bound_risk_engine: { name: PREVENT, legacy_only: false }, agreement: { state: agreed, llm_pair: [ { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_A", family: openai, version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" }, { llm_id: "llm-HUMAN_FILL_B", family: anthropic, version_pin: "HUMAN_FILL", response_signature: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX" } ], agreed_llms: ["llm-HUMAN_FILL_A","llm-HUMAN_FILL_B"], dissenting_llms: [], held_diff: null, held_remediation_hint: null }, verification: { verifies: true, verified_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", methods_passed: [rxnorm-resolution, hard-block-basis-anchor-match, verbatim-roundtrip, attending-override-pattern-scan-clean, canonical-sha-match], methods_failed: [], failure_notes: null }, state: advanced, superseded_by_rule_id: null, fixity: { rule_sha256: "HUMAN_FILL_64HEX", computed_at: "HUMAN_FILL_ISO_DATETIME", canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785 } }

---

description: Phase-14 (P14) cross-check skill for the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha framework. namespace: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
category: extract
platforms: [claude, copilot, cursor, factory, windsurf, warp, codex, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
commandHint:
  argumentHint: "<sair-path> [--rules <list>] [--cohort <id>] [--mode <build|verify|verify+build>] [--resume] [--dry-run]"
---

# extract-contraindications

Phase-14 (P14) **cross-check** extraction skill for the
`cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha` framework. The skill consumes the **denylist
subset** of `pharm-rules.json` (produced at P13 by
`extract-pharm-rules`), cross-validates each denylist rule against
an independent dual-LLM family-distinct re-extraction over the
parent `AtomicUnit`s, runs RxNorm-pin and AnchorKind-closure
verifications, and emits a **Contraindication artifact** whose
entries are the canonical inputs to the FHIR `Evidence` and
`EvidenceVariable` resources built at P26
(`fhir-implementation-guide-build`).

This skill is **adversarial-by-design** to P13: where P13 produces
denylist rules from the recommendation atomic units, P14 re-extracts
contraindications from the same atomic units under a fresh dual-LLM
pass and verifies that the two passes converge. Convergence
(`agreed`) advances the contraindication; divergence (`held` or
`conflict`) routes the parent P13 rule back through Gate 1 — this
skill **never auto-resolves** a divergence and **never silently
accepts** P13's claim. The cross-check is the framework's primary
mechanical defense against single-pass extraction error on
clinically-critical denylist content.

This refresh aligns the skill exactly to the schemas drafted in this
thread:

- `schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml` — input contract; the denylist
  subset is consumed.
- `schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml` — input. Specifically
  `INV-09` (denylist requires hard-block basis with source anchor)
  and `INV-10` (PCE-legacy never propagates) are upstream invariants
  this skill ratifies.
- `schemas/atomic-unit.yaml` — input. Specifically `AU-INV-09`
  (family-distinct LLM rule) is mirrored at this skill's preflight.
- `schemas/sair.yaml` — input source-of-truth (read-only).
- `schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml` — closed COR/LOE enums.
- `schemas/gate1-register.yaml` — finalization preconditions and
  panel-chair escalation paths (the closed concern category
  `atomicity-state-disputed` is the route for divergences).
- `schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` — downstream consumer; §3.7
  PregnancyDenylistConstraints and §2.5 AttendingOverridePattern are
  mirrored here for free-text scanning of contraindication
  rationale and clinical-consequence fields.
- `schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml` — downstream consumer;
  contraindication ids are cited in hazard mitigations (H-01 through
  H-05).
- `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` — pin source.

This skill does **not** author CQL bytes, build CDS Hooks
descriptors, modify recommendation records, mutate atomic units,
alter terminology bindings (P10's responsibility), or attest the
Safety Case (P23's responsibility). Its single responsibility is
producing the cross-validated contraindication artifact whose
entries downstream phases consume as FHIR `Evidence` and
`EvidenceVariable` source material.

Posture: **caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage,
adversarial-cross-check over single-pass acceptance.** No paraphrase
of clinical text. No editing of ACC/AHA COR or LOE. No silent
acceptance of P13's denylist claim. No softening of COR III-Harm to
soft-warning. No RxNorm-edition substitution. PCE-legacy never feeds
contraindications. Held cross-checks route to the panel-chair queue,
never to a silent fall-through. Pregnancy contraindications are
constrained to `order-select` hard-refuse posture with no
attending-override. Post-seal contraindication artifacts are
immutable.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when:

- The orchestrator (`flow-hbp-2025-build`) reaches phase **P14** for
  a build whose `pharm-rules.json` is sealed (P13 complete), whose
  Gate-1 cohort registers are in state `finalized`, and whose
  `records.json` and `atomic-units.json` are sealed.
- A targeted re-cross-check is required after P13 produced an
  updated denylist rule (the orchestrator regenerates the rule on
  resume; on resume, this skill re-runs the cross-check and re-emits
  the affected contraindication entry).
- A held cross-check in `work/<run_id>/queue/contraindications/`
  has been resolved by the panel chair routing the parent rule back
  through Gate 1 and a fresh P13 extraction has reached `agreed`.
- A regression run is needed against the framework's golden
  contraindication set after a schema or skill change.
- A `--mode verify` re-check is needed by `safety-case-attest` at
  Gate 3 (the same contraindication SHAs are recomputed under the
  same canonicalization rule).

Do **not** invoke this skill if:

- The active manifest is not in state `active` or has open errata
  blockers.
- `pharm-rules.json` is not sealed (P13 must complete first).
- Any Gate-1 cohort referenced by denylist rules under cross-check
  is not in state `finalized`.
- A prior P14 run produced cross-checks in the queue that have not
  been resolved by the panel-chair routing-back path (the skill
  refuses to overwrite unresolved queue entries).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sair-path` | yes | — | Path to the sealed SAIR document at `work/<run_id>/sair.json`, validated against `schemas/sair.yaml`. |
| `--rules <list>` | no | `all-denylist` | Comma-separated list of `pharm_rule_id` values to cross-check. Defaults to every rule in `pharm-rules.json` whose `kind == "denylist"` and whose `state == "advanced"`. |
| `--cohort <id>` | no | — | Restrict to denylist rules bound to the given Gate-1 cohort id. |
| `--mode <build\|verify\|verify+build>` | no | `verify+build` | `build` constructs contraindication entries from live denylist rules and writes them; `verify` recomputes contraindication SHAs against on-disk entries and reports drift; `verify+build` builds any missing entries and verifies all. |
| `--strict` | no | `true` | Fail-closed on every gate. Setting `--strict false` is **never permitted** in production. |
| `--resume` | no | `false` | Resume an interrupted run from the last persisted contraindication entry. The skill rejects resume if `pharm-rules.json` `rule_set_sha256` or `records.json` / `atomic-units.json` SHAs have changed since session start. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | Run preflight + plan only; emit the planned cross-check set, the dual-LLM family-distinct verification, and the proposed contraindication entries; do not persist or open queue entries. Permitted in production for change-control review. |

## Operation

### 1. Preflight

1. Validate `sair-path` against `schemas/sair.yaml`. Reject on any
   invariant failure.
2. Resolve `guideline_manifest_ref` from the SAIR; verify the active
   manifest's `medical_director_signoff` cryptographically per
   `GM-INV-21`; verify `state == "active"` and
   `errata_watch.blockers_open == []` per `GM-INV-23`.
3. Verify `tools_lock.lock_sha` against canonicalized
   `tools_lock.items[]` per `GM-INV-08`.
4. Verify the **two-LLM family-distinct rule** at preflight (mirrored
   from `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §1.4 and from
   `extract-pharm-rules` §1.4):
   - Resolve `manifest.tools_lock.llm_pair[]`. Confirm exactly two
     entries (`GM-INV-09`).
   - Confirm the two LLMs are from distinct vendor families per
     `docs/llm-family-matrix.md`.
   - Probe each LLM for liveness; record the response signature.
   - **Family-collapse → BLOCK** with `family-distinct-rule-violated`.

   The cross-check uses the **same family-distinct LLM pair** as P13
   (the pinned `tools_lock.llm_pair[]`), not a different pair. This
   is intentional: the cross-check is not about model diversity
   beyond P13's diversity; it is about **temporal and prompt
   independence** — the cross-check runs a different prompt
   template, on a different occasion, with different ordering, and
   verifies that the two passes' agreed outputs converge. A pair
   change between P13 and P14 would obscure whether divergence is
   from prompt drift or from model rotation.
5. Verify upstream prerequisites (each is a release blocker):
   - `work/<run_id>/pharm-rules.json` is sealed and validates
     against `schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml`. Specifically `PR-INV-05`
     (hard-block basis for denylist), `PR-INV-15` (PCE-legacy
     forbidden), `PR-INV-18` (pregnancy-denylist constraints), and
     `PR-INV-22` (sealed-state preconditions) must hold on every
     denylist rule in scope.
   - `work/<run_id>/records.json` and `atomic-units.json` are
     sealed.
   - Every Gate-1 cohort register file under
     `work/<run_id>/gate1/*.signed.jsonld` referenced by denylist
     rules is in state `finalized`.
   - `work/<run_id>/terminology-bindings.json` is present (consulted
     for RxNorm-pin alignment cross-check).
6. Verify the **terminology server** is reachable at the pinned
   editions for re-resolution.
7. Verify the manifest's pinned `risk_engine.name == "PREVENT"` and
   `risk_engine.legacy_only == false`.
8. Verify the **TSAs** in `manifest.tsa_list[]` have at least one
   currently-valid certificate (the contraindication artifact is
   signed for tamper-evidence at sign time).
9. Refuse to proceed if any precondition fails. **Fail-closed.**

### 2. Cross-check operation

For every denylist rule in scope (admitted from `pharm-rules.json`),
the skill performs the following five-step cross-check.

#### 2.1 Independent re-extraction

The skill issues a closed-prompt template **distinct from P13's

  parent_skills_to_update_on_breaking_change:

`schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml` §7 is now complete. The schema is closed and self-consistent against the prior schemas in this thread.
