```markdown name=skills/extract-contraindications/SKILL.md
---
name: extract-contraindications
description: Phase-14 (P14) extraction skill for the cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha framework. Cross-checks the denylist subset of pharm-rules.json against the records.json INV-09 hard-block-basis source anchors, the atomic-unit anchors, the recbox cell shape, and the manifest-pinned RxNorm subsets, then produces FHIR R5 Evidence and EvidenceVariable resources for downstream IG composition. Cross-check disagreements route to the panel-chair queue; pregnancy denylist mismatches BLOCK unconditionally. PCE-legacy never appears in any contraindication. Post-Gate-2 contraindication artifacts are immutable.
namespace: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
category: extract
platforms: [claude, copilot, cursor, factory, windsurf, warp, codex, opencode, openclaw, hermes]
commandHint:
  argumentHint: "<sair-path> [--rules <list>] [--cohort <id>] [--mode <build|verify|verify+build>] [--strict] [--resume] [--dry-run]"
---

# extract-contraindications

Phase-14 (P14) extraction skill for the `cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha`
framework. The skill cross-checks the **denylist subset** of
`work/<run_id>/pharm-rules.json` (produced at P13 by
`extract-pharm-rules`) against the `records.json` `INV-09`
hard-block-basis source anchors, the `atomic-unit.json` anchor set,
the recbox cell shape from the SAIR's `recommendation_boxes[]`, and
the manifest-pinned RxNorm subsets, and produces a per-rule
**contraindication artifact** consisting of FHIR R5 `Evidence` and
`EvidenceVariable` resources that the downstream Implementation Guide
build (P26 `fhir-implementation-guide-build`) composes into the
published IG.

This skill is a **cross-check producer**. It does not author CQL,
rebind RxNorm, modify recommendation records, mutate atomic units,
edit pharm rules, or alter terminology bindings. It is the
quadruple-cross-check audit surface (rule ↔ record `INV-09` ↔
atomic-unit anchor ↔ recbox cell ↔ RxNorm subset) plus the FHIR R5
materialization layer for IG `Evidence` resources. Cross-check
agreement is the precondition for advancement; disagreement routes to
the panel-chair queue and BLOCKs the contraindication artifact.

This skill aligns to the schemas drafted in this thread:

- `schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml` — closed COR/LOE enums.
- `schemas/sair.yaml` — input source-of-truth (read-only).
- `schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml` — input. Specifically
  `INV-09` (denylist requires hard-block basis with source anchor)
  is the upstream contract this skill ratifies.
- `schemas/atomic-unit.yaml` — input.
- `schemas/gate1-register.yaml` — finalization preconditions.
- `schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml` — input. Specifically the closed
  five-kind enum, the closed `AnchorKind` set for denylist rules
  (`PR-INV-05`), and the pregnancy-denylist constraint block
  (`PR-INV-18..21`) are the upstream contracts this skill cross-checks.
- `schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml` — downstream consumer; the
  contraindication artifact is referenced by Safety Case mitigations
  for hazards H-01, H-02, H-03 (and partially H-04, H-05).
- `schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` — downstream consumer; the
  contraindication artifact informs the descriptor metadata for
  `htn-pregnancy-denylist` and `htn-pharm-first-line-check`.
- `schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml` — downstream consumer; the
  contraindication artifact is part of the `cont` (or equivalent)
  evidence under the IG bundle hashed at Gate 3.
- `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` — pin source for
  RxNorm editions, terminology server endpoints, FHIR R5 profile
  versions, and TSAs.

Posture: **caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage,
hard-refusal-on-pregnancy over convenience.** No paraphrase. No
editing of ACC/AHA COR or LOE. No coercion of RxNorm subsets. No
silent re-extraction. No batch acceptance. PCE-legacy never appears
in any contraindication. Pregnancy denylist mismatches BLOCK
unconditionally — this is a clinical safety failure, not a
remediation. Post-Gate-2 contraindication artifacts are immutable.

## When to Use

Invoke this skill when:

- The orchestrator (`flow-hbp-2025-build`) reaches phase **P14** for
  a build whose Gate-1 cohort registers are in state `finalized`,
  whose `records.json` and `atomic-units.json` are sealed, whose
  `pharm-rules.json` is in state `sealed` (with panel-chair
  acknowledgement when held rules are present), and whose P10
  (terminology binding) outputs are persisted.
- A targeted re-extraction is required after P13 produced a new
  `pharm-rules.json` version (e.g., after a Gate-1 reviewer
  recorded `accept-with-edit` on a parent record, P9 re-extracted,
  and P13 re-emitted). On resume, this skill re-cross-checks every
  affected rule.
- A held cross-check entry in `work/<run_id>/queue/contraindications/`
  has been resolved by the two-person rule and the orchestrator
  requests advancement.
- A regression run is needed against the framework's golden
  contraindication set after a schema or skill change.

Do **not** invoke this skill if:

- The active manifest is not in state `active` or has open errata
  blockers.
- `pharm-rules.json` is not in state `sealed` (with panel-chair
  acknowledgement when held rules are present).
- Any Gate-1 cohort referenced by parent records is not `finalized`.
- The terminology server is unreachable at the manifest's pinned
  RxNorm edition (the skill re-resolves drug-class subsets at every
  run, even though the rule set already records the resolution at
  P13; the re-resolution is the drift-detection mechanism).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sair-path` | yes | — | Path to the sealed SAIR document at `work/<run_id>/sair.json`, validated against `schemas/sair.yaml`. |
| `--rules <list>` | no | `all-denylist` | Comma-separated list of `pharm-rule-htn` rule ids of `kind == "denylist"` whose contraindication artifacts are to be produced. Defaults to every denylist rule in `pharm-rules.json` whose `state == "advanced"`. |
| `--cohort <id>` | no | — | Restrict to denylist rules whose parent record is bound to the given Gate-1 cohort id. |
| `--mode <build\|verify\|verify+build>` | no | `verify+build` | `build` constructs FHIR `Evidence` / `EvidenceVariable` resources from cross-checked rules and writes them; `verify` recomputes cross-checks against on-disk artifacts and reports drift; `verify+build` builds any missing artifacts and verifies all. |
| `--strict` | no | `true` | Fail-closed on every gate. Setting `--strict false` is **never permitted** in production. |
| `--resume` | no | `false` | Resume an interrupted run from the last persisted artifact. The skill rejects resume if any input register's `register_sha256`, the SAIR's `fixity.sair_sha256`, the records or atomic-units SHAs, or `pharm-rules.json`'s `rule_set_sha256` has changed since session start. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | Run preflight + plan only; emit the planned cross-check set and the proposed FHIR resource shapes; do not write artifacts. Permitted in production for change-control review. |

## Operation

### 1. Preflight

1. Validate `sair-path` against `schemas/sair.yaml`. Reject on any
   invariant failure.
2. Resolve `guideline_manifest_ref` from the SAIR; verify the active
   manifest's `medical_director_signoff` cryptographically per
   `GM-INV-21`; verify `state == "active"` and
   `errata_watch.blockers_open == []` per `GM-INV-23`.
3. Verify `tools_lock.lock_sha` against canonicalized
   `tools_lock.items[]` per `GM-INV-08`.
4. Verify upstream prerequisites (each is a release blocker):
   - `work/<run_id>/records.json` is sealed and validates against
     `schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml`. Specifically `INV-09`
     (denylist requires hard-block basis with source anchor) and
     `INV-10` (PCE-legacy never propagates) hold on every record in
     scope.
   - `work/<run_id>/atomic-units.json` validates against
     `schemas/atomic-unit.yaml`; every record-bound atomic unit set
     is sealed at `state == "gate-1-passed"`.
   - `work/<run_id>/pharm-rules.json` is in state `sealed` and
     validates against `schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml`. Every denylist
     rule in scope MUST have `agreement.state == "agreed"`; the skill
     refuses to materialize a contraindication for a `held` denylist
     rule and refuses categorically for any pregnancy denylist held
     rule (mirrors `PR-INV-21`).
   - Every Gate-1 cohort register file under
     `work/<run_id>/gate1/*.signed.jsonld` is in state `finalized`
     and validates against `schemas/gate1-register.yaml`.
   - `work/<run_id>/terminology-bindings.json` (produced at P10) is
     present and binds every drug-class anchor in scope to a
     manifest-pinned RxNorm edition.
   - The SAIR's `recommendation_boxes[]` for every parent record's
     row is in `consensus.state ∈ {"agreed","agreed-A-anchored"}`.
5. Verify the **terminology server** is reachable at the pinned
   RxNorm edition and resolves a manifest-pinned probe class
   non-empty.
6. Verify the manifest's pinned `risk_engine.name == "PREVENT"` and
   `risk_engine.legacy_only == false`.
7. Verify the `manifest.intended_use.pregnancy_value_set_id` is
   pinned (the IG's `EvidenceVariable.useContext` references this id
   for pregnancy denylist contraindications).
8. Verify `tsa_list[]` has at least one TSA whose `cert_valid_until`
   covers the wall-clock window. The contraindication artifact's
   per-resource fixity is signed for tamper-evidence at Gate 2's
   downstream signing step (P21 → Gate 2); this skill does not sign
   itself, but it requires TSA availability for the eventual
   downstream signing.
9. Acquire the contraindication-artifact write-back lock at
   `work/<run_id>/contraindications/.lock`. The skill is the only
   writer into this directory during its run.
10. Refuse to proceed if any precondition fails. **Fail-closed.**

### 2. Per-rule quadruple cross-check

For each denylist rule in scope, the skill performs a **quadruple
cross-check**: every assertion below MUST hold; failure on any
assertion routes the rule to the panel-chair queue and BLOCKs the
contraindication artifact for that rule.

#### 2.1 Cross-check 1: rule ↔ record `INV-09`
- The denylist rule's `parent_record_id` resolves to a
  `RecommendationRecordHTN` whose `acc_aha_cor` is `III-Harm` or
  `III-No-Benefit`.
- The record carries an `INV-09` denylist-basis anchor with
  `anchor_kind` from the closed set
  {`cor-iii-harm-anchor`, `cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor`,
  `explicit-should-not-anchor`, `explicit-not-recommended-anchor`}.
- The rule's `anchor_kind` MUST equal the record's `INV-09`
  basis anchor's `anchor_kind`.
- Mismatch emits `cross-check-1-record-inv09-mismatch` and BLOCKs.

#### 2.2 Cross-check 2: rule ↔ atomic-unit anchor
- The rule's `parent_atomic_unit_id` resolves to an `AtomicUnit`
  whose `anchors.anchor_kind` matches the rule's `anchor_kind`.
- The unit's `anchors.sair_sha256`, `anchors.page`, and
  `anchors.bbox` MUST match the rule's `anchors` block.
- The unit's `text_verbatim` MUST round-trip byte-for-byte against
  the rule's `source_text_verbatim` after the rule's
  `normalization_log[]` is applied in reverse.
- Mismatch emits `cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-mismatch` and
  BLOCKs.

#### 2.3 Cross-check 3: rule ↔ recbox cell shape
- The rule's `parent_record_id` resolves to a record whose
  `recommendation_box.row.cells[]` (in the SAIR) carry the canonical
  ACC/AHA shape (COR, LOE, Recommendation, Supportive Text,
  Citations).
- The recbox cell of `kind == "cor"` matches the rule's `acc_aha_cor`
  exactly.
- The recbox cell of `kind == "loe"` matches the rule's `acc_aha_loe`
  exactly.
- The recbox cell of `kind == "recommendation"` carries the parent
  atomic unit's `text_verbatim` span at the recorded byte offsets.
- Mismatch emits `cross-check-3-recbox-cell-mismatch` and BLOCKs;
  in practice this would indicate an upstream P6 or P9 corruption
  and remediates via re-running the upstream phases under the
  orchestrator's resume protocol.

#### 2.4 Cross-check 4: rule ↔ RxNorm subset
- For every drug class in the rule's `drug_classes[]`, re-resolve
  against the manifest's pinned RxNorm edition.
- The resolved subset MUST be:
  - non-empty (the contraindication is unenforceable if the class
    resolves to nothing);
  - byte-identical to the upstream P10 binding's recorded subset
    SHA-256;
  - byte-identical to the rule's recorded resolution at P13 (the
    rule records the subset SHA in
    `verification.methods_passed`'s `rxnorm-resolution` evidence; the
    skill recomputes against the live terminology server and against
    the recorded value).
- Mismatch emits `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift` and BLOCKs;
  remediation is a coordinated re-bind at P10 followed by P13
  re-extract and P14 re-run.

#### 2.5 Pregnancy denylist mechanical reinforcement
For every denylist rule whose `population_filter[]` includes
`pregnant` or `postpartum`, the skill enforces ALL of the
following in addition to §2.1–§2.4:

- The rule's `posture_at_cds == "hard-refuse"`.
- The rule's `cds_hook == "order-select"`.
- The rule's `attending_override_permitted == false`.
- The rule's `documentation_only == false`.
- The rule's `indicator_set == ["critical"]`.
- The closed AttendingOverridePattern scan from
  `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §2.5 (recursively over the rule's
  `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`, and any
  `agreement.held_remediation_hint`) returns zero matches.
- The corresponding `Evidence.useContext[]` MUST include the
  manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id; the
  `EvidenceVariable.characteristic[]` MUST include a
  population-filter characteristic referencing the closed
  PopulationFilter values `pregnant` and `postpartum` exactly.

Any violation BLOCKs unconditionally with the corresponding closed
audit event from §6 (`pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-failed`,
`pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-pattern-detected`, etc.).
This is a clinical safety failure; remediation is upstream re-author,
not a soft routing through the panel-chair queue.

#### 2.6 PCE-legacy exclusion (mechanical)
- The skill recursively scans every string field in the rule and in
  the produced FHIR resources for the literal `PCE-legacy`. Any
  match BLOCKs unconditionally.

### 3. FHIR R5 Evidence + EvidenceVariable materialization

For every denylist rule passing all four cross-checks plus the
pregnancy reinforcement (when applicable), the skill produces two
FHIR R5 resources:

#### 3.1 `EvidenceVariable`
A `EvidenceVariable` resource encodes the population definition
under which the contraindication applies. The shape:

```json
{
  "resourceType": "EvidenceVariable",
  "id": "ev-<rule_id>",
  "url": "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/EvidenceVariable/ev-<rule_id>",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "active",
  "publisher": "<from manifest.publisher>",
  "useContext": [
    {
      "code": { "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/usage-context-type", "code": "focus" },
      "valueCodeableConcept": { "text": "Hypertension pharmacologic contraindication" }
    },
    {
      "code": { "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/usage-context-type", "code": "age" },
      "valueRange": { "low": { "value": 18, "unit": "years" } }
    }
  ],
  "characteristic": [
    {
      "linkId": "population",
      "description": "Population filter (closed enum from pharm-rule-htn)",
      "definitionCodeableConcept": { "text": "<closed PopulationFilter values joined>" }
    },
    {
      "linkId": "drug-classes",
      "description": "RxNorm-resolved drug classes contraindicated",
      "definitionReference": { "reference": "ValueSet/<manifest-pinned-rxnorm-subset-vs-id>" }
    },
    {
      "linkId": "trigger",
      "description": "<closed Trigger value>"
    },
    {
      "linkId": "consequence",
      "description": "<closed Consequence value>"
    }
  ]
}
```

For pregnancy denylist contraindications, the
`EvidenceVariable.useContext[]` adds a third entry referencing the
manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id with `code == "user"` and
`valueCodeableConcept.text == "Pregnant or postpartum patient"`. The
`characteristic.linkId == "population"` field's
`definitionCodeableConcept.text` MUST contain `pregnant` and
`postpartum` exactly.

#### 3.2 `Evidence`
An `Evidence` resource encodes the contraindication's evidence
basis (COR / LOE inheritance, parent record, parent atomic unit,
recbox cell anchor):

```json
{
  "resourceType": "Evidence",
  "id": "ev-cont-<rule_id>",
  "url": "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/Evidence/ev-cont-<rule_id>",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "status": "active",
  "publisher": "<from manifest.publisher>",
  "title": "Contraindication: <rule.kind>: <drug_classes joined> in <population_filter joined>",
  "citeAs": [
    {
      "reference": { "reference": "Citation/cit-acc-aha-2025-hbp" },
      "display": "2025 ACC/AHA Hypertension Guideline (verbatim source anchor)"
    }
  ],
  "assertion": "<rule.source_text_verbatim>",
  "note": [
    { "text": "<rule.rationale>" }
  ],
  "variableDefinition": [
    {
      "variableRole": { "coding": [ { "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/variable-role", "code": "exposure" } ] },
      "observed": { "reference": "EvidenceVariable/ev-<rule_id>" }
    }
  ],
  "certainty": [
    {
      "type": { "coding": [ { "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/certainty-type", "code": "Overall" } ] },
      "rating": { "coding": [ { "system": "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/certainty-rating", "code": "<acc-aha-loe-mapped-rating>" } ] },
      "note": [
        { "text": "ACC/AHA COR <rule.acc_aha_cor>; LOE <rule.acc_aha_loe>; native grading preserved as primary per ADR-HTN-001 D3." }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "extension": [
    {
      "url": "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/StructureDefinition/cpg-htn-source-anchor",
      "extension": [
        { "url": "record_id",         "valueString": "<rule.parent_record_id>" },
        { "url": "atomic_unit_id",    "valueString": "<rule.parent_atomic_unit_id>" },
        { "url": "anchor_kind",       "valueString": "<rule.anchor_kind>" },
        { "url": "sair_sha256",       "valueString": "<rule.anchors.sair_sha256>" },
        { "url": "page",              "valueInteger": <rule.anchors.page> },
        { "url": "bbox",              "valueString":  "<rule.anchors.bbox JCS>" },
        { "url": "rxnorm_edition_pin","valueString": "<rule.rxnorm_edition_pin>" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes:

- `assertion` is the verbatim source text from the rule (no
  paraphrase).
- `certainty.rating` maps the closed ACC/AHA `LOE` to an HL7
  certainty rating; the mapping is defined in
  `docs/acc-aha-to-hl7-certainty.md` and pinned by the manifest.
- The `extension[].url` is the framework's
  `cpg-htn-source-anchor` extension; downstream IG composition
  (P26) renders this as the source-anchor footnote.

#### 3.3 Per-resource fixity
- Each `Evidence` and `EvidenceVariable` resource carries a
  `meta.security` extension recording the resource's
  JCS-canonical SHA-256 (computed under FHIR R5 JSON
  canonicalization, which is RFC-8785 with FHIR-specific element
  ordering exceptions documented in `docs/fhir-r5-jcs-notes.md`).
- The fixity is recomputed at every run; mismatch is a release
  blocker.

#### 3.4 Per-rule artifact path
- `Evidence` resources are written to
  `work/<run_id>/contraindications/Evidence/ev-cont-<rule_id>.json`.
- `EvidenceVariable` resources are written to
  `work/<run_id>/contraindications/EvidenceVariable/ev-<rule_id>.json`.

### 4. Cross-check artifact

In addition to the FHIR resources, the skill writes a per-run
**cross-check artifact** at
`work/<run_id>/contraindications/cross-check.json` recording every
cross-check decision. The shape:

```yaml
schema_version: "1.0.0"
build_run_id: "<uuid>"
manifest_payload_sha256: "<from manifest>"
pharm_rule_set_sha256: "<from pharm-rules.json>"
records_sha256: "<from records.json>"
atomic_units_sha256: "<from atomic-units.json>"
sair_sha256: "<from sair.json>"
checks:
  - rule_id: "pr-<16hex>"
    parent_record_id: "rec-<16hex>"
    parent_atomic_unit_id: "au-<16hex>"
    cross_check_1_record_inv09: pass | fail
    cross_check_2_atomic_unit_anchor: pass | fail
    cross_check_3_recbox_cell_shape: pass | fail
    cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset: pass | fail
    pregnancy_reinforcement: pass | not-applicable | fail
    pce_legacy_scan: pass | fail
    overall: pass | held | blocked
    artifact_paths:
      evidence_variable: "work/<run_id>/contraindications/EvidenceVariable/ev-<rule_id>.json"
      evidence:          "work/<run_id>/contraindications/Evidence/ev-cont-<rule_id>.json"
    artifact_sha256s:
      evidence_variable: "<64hex>"
      evidence:          "<64hex>"
audit_log: [<append-only AuditEvent entries>]
fixity:
  cross_check_sha256: "<JCS SHA-256 of this document with `fixity` excluded>"
  computed_at: "<ISO-8601>"
  canonical_form: json-canonical-rfc8785
```

This artifact is the deterministic evidence that downstream
`safety-case-attest` consumes when binding contraindications to
Gate-3 attestation.

### 5. Held / blocked routing

- For every rule whose overall cross-check is `held` (any single
  cross-check is `fail` but the failure is recoverable upstream —
  e.g., a recbox-cell mismatch indicating a P6 re-run is needed),
  the skill emits a queue entry at
  `work/<run_id>/queue/contraindications/<rule_id>.json` with the
  failed cross-check, the diff, and the upstream remediation hint.
  The two-person rule (under `parse-reconcile-queue`) applies.
- For every rule whose overall cross-check is `blocked` (the
  failure is a clinical safety violation — pregnancy denylist
  reinforcement failure, PCE-legacy reference, etc.), the skill
  BLOCKs unconditionally and routes the parent record for
  panel-chair re-review under `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`
  with the closed concern category corresponding to the failure
  (e.g., `verbatim-text-disputed` for a recbox cell mismatch,
  `predecessor-mapping-disputed` for a PCE-legacy substitution
  attempt; the closed set is mirrored from
  `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §8.2).

### 6. Audit log and provenance

- The skill emits an `audit_log[]` entry into the cross-check
  artifact for every per-rule cross-check decision (kinds are
  members of the closed `AuditEventKind` set in §6.1).
- The skill emits a W3C PROV-O record into the build's PROV bundle at
  `provenance/contraindications-<run_id>.jsonld` with one Activity
  per cross-check, one Entity per produced FHIR resource, and one
  Agent per cross-checking process.
- The skill emits per-resource FHIR `Provenance` resources at
  `work/<run_id>/fhir/provenance/contraindications/<resource-id>.json`
  binding each `Evidence` / `EvidenceVariable` to the parent rule,
  parent record, parent atomic unit, and the cross-check evidence.

#### 6.1 Closed `AuditEventKind`
- `cross-check-1-record-inv09-pass`
- `cross-check-1-record-inv09-mismatch`
- `cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-pass`
- `cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-mismatch`
- `cross-check-3-recbox-cell-pass`
- `cross-check-3-recbox-cell-mismatch`
- `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-pass`
- `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift`
- `pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-pass`
- `pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-failed`
- `pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-pattern-detected`
- `pce-legacy-binding-detected`
- `evidence-variable-built`
- `evidence-built`
- `evidence-variable-verified`
- `evidence-verified`
- `contraindication-artifact-mutation-attempt`
- `cross-check-artifact-built`
- `cross-check-artifact-verified`

### 7. Determinism and reproducibility

- Cross-checks are deterministic given:
  - identical sealed inputs (records.json, atomic-units.json,
    sair.json, pharm-rules.json);
  - identical pinned RxNorm edition;
  - identical FHIR R5 profile pin.
- The deterministic id derivation makes downstream consumers
  (P26, Gate 3) re-runnable without renumbering: `Evidence.id` and
  `EvidenceVariable.id` are derived from the rule_id by stable
  string substitution (`ev-cont-<rule_id>`, `ev-<rule_id>`).
- Re-running this skill on a successfully-built artifact set with
  identical inputs is a no-op (the skill confirms every
  artifact's recorded SHA recomputes and writes nothing).
- Any change to a contributing rule, record, atomic unit, recbox
  cell, RxNorm subset, or manifest pin invalidates the affected
  artifacts and forces a rebuild on next run.

## DQA Gates Enforced By This Skill

| Gate | Condition for advance |
|---|---|
| **GC-A** Manifest active | Active manifest with verified medical-director signoff and zero open errata blockers. |
| **GC-B** Inputs sealed | records.json + atomic-units.json + pharm-rules.json sealed; every Gate-1 cohort in scope is `finalized`. |
| **GC-C** Rule scope is denylist + agreed | Every rule in scope has `kind == "denylist"` AND `agreement.state == "agreed"`. Held denylist rules are not materialized; pregnancy denylist held rules are categorically refused (mirrors `PR-INV-21`). |
| **GC-D** Cross-check 1 (record `INV-09`) | Every rule's anchor matches the parent record's `INV-09` hard-block-basis anchor. |
| **GC-E** Cross-check 2 (atomic-unit anchor) | Every rule's anchors match the parent atomic unit's anchors; `source_text_verbatim` round-trips. |
| **GC-F** Cross-check 3 (recbox cell shape) | Every rule's parent record's recbox cells satisfy the canonical ACC/AHA shape and the cell values match the rule's COR / LOE / recommendation text. |
| **GC-G** Cross-check 4 (RxNorm subset) | Every rule's drug classes resolve to non-empty RxNorm subsets; subset SHAs match the upstream P10 binding's recorded SHA and the rule's recorded resolution. |
| **GC-H** Pregnancy denylist reinforcement | Every pregnancy denylist rule satisfies the §2.5 reinforcements; AttendingOverridePattern scan returns zero matches. |
| **GC-I** PCE-legacy excluded | No literal `PCE-legacy` appears in any rule field or any produced FHIR resource. |
| **GC-J** FHIR R5 profile compliance | Every produced `Evidence` and `EvidenceVariable` resource validates against the manifest-pinned FHIR R5 profile. |
| **GC-K** Per-resource fixity deterministic | Every resource's recorded SHA recomputes byte-for-byte from the FHIR R5 JCS canonical form. |
| **GC-L** Cross-check artifact fixity deterministic | The cross-check artifact's `cross_check_sha256` recomputes deterministically from the JCS canonical form. |
| **GC-M** Held / blocked accounted | Every `held` rule has a queue entry; every `blocked` rule has paused its parent record's downstream phases and routed for panel-chair re-review. |
| **GC-N** Audit log appended | The cross-check artifact's `audit_log[]` and the build PROV bundle have per-rule events appended in order. |
| **GC-O** Post-Gate-2 immutability | Once the contraindication artifact is referenced by a Gate-2-finalized Library, mutation attempts are tamper-evident and BLOCK. |

Failure of any gate at any rule → BLOCK; the rule routes to the
queue (held) or pauses its parent record (blocked) with a specific
gate diagnostic. There is **no override**.

## Outputs

- Per-rule FHIR `Evidence` resources at
  `work/<run_id>/contraindications/Evidence/ev-cont-<rule_id>.json`.
- Per-rule FHIR `EvidenceVariable` resources at
  `work/<run_id>/contraindications/EvidenceVariable/ev-<rule_id>.json`.
- Cross-check artifact at
  `work/<run_id>/contraindications/cross-check.json` validated
  against the inline shape in §4 (a formal
  `schemas/contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml` is a candidate next
  schema).
- Per-rule queue entries at
  `work/<run_id>/queue/contraindications/<rule_id>.json` for every
  `held` rule.
- Per-resource FHIR `Provenance` resources at
  `work/<run_id>/fhir/provenance/contraindications/<resource-id>.json`.
- Per-run report at
  `work/<run_id>/reports/contraindications-<run_id>.md` summarizing
  rules cross-checked, per-cross-check pass / fail counts, pregnancy
  denylist reinforcement results, FHIR resource counts, and any
  blockers.
- Build PROV bundle update at
  `provenance/contraindications-<run_id>.jsonld`.
- Notifications to the orchestrator queue:
  - `contraindications-extracted` per cohort processed.
  - `contraindication-rule-routed-to-queue` per held rule.
  - `contraindication-rule-blocked` per blocked rule.
  - `contraindications-artifact-ready` on full success.

## Error Handling

- **Manifest stale or not active.** BLOCK preflight.
- **pharm-rules.json not sealed.** BLOCK preflight; await P13
  finalization (including panel-chair acknowledgement when
  applicable).
- **Pregnancy denylist held rule.** REJECT categorically; emit
  `pregnancy-denylist-held-rule-rejected`; the rule must reach
  `agreed` at P13 before P14 will materialize a contraindication.
- **Cross-check 1 fail.** Route to queue with
  `cross-check-1-record-inv09-mismatch`; remediation is upstream
  P9 re-extract under `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`
  with closed concern category `verbatim-text-disputed` or
  `atomicity-state-disputed`.
- **Cross-check 2 fail.** Route to queue with
  `cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-mismatch`; remediation is
  upstream P9 re-extract.
- **Cross-check 3 fail.** Route to queue with
  `cross-check-3-recbox-cell-mismatch`; remediation is upstream
  P6 re-parse and P9 re-extract.
- **Cross-check 4 fail (RxNorm drift).** Route to queue with
  `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift`; remediation is upstream
  P10 re-bind and P13 re-extract.
- **Pregnancy denylist reinforcement fail.** BLOCK unconditionally;
  emit `pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-failed`; investigate as
  adversarial input or upstream contamination; remediation is
  upstream re-author and a fresh manifest version when the failure
  is structural.
- **AttendingOverridePattern detected.** BLOCK unconditionally;
  emit `pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-pattern-detected`;
  investigate as adversarial input.
- **PCE-legacy reference detected.** BLOCK unconditionally; emit
  `pce-legacy-binding-detected`; remediation is upstream re-author
  under ADR-HTN-001 D5.
- **FHIR R5 profile validation fail.** Route to queue with
  `fhir-profile-validation-failed`; remediation is to update the
  manifest's pinned profile version and re-run.
- **Per-resource SHA mismatch.** BLOCK; emit
  `evidence-or-evidencevariable-sha-mismatch`; investigate
  canonicalization drift.
- **TSA unavailable.** Allow draft artifacts to proceed; the
  per-resource fixity does not require a TSA at this skill (TSA
  signing happens at downstream Gate 2 / Gate 3); BLOCK only if
  TSA availability is explicitly required by the manifest's pinned
  policy for P14 artifacts (default off).
- **Lock contention.** Wait up to a configured timeout; fail-closed
  if not acquired; concurrent writers on the contraindications
  directory are not permitted.
- **Resume after rule_set_sha256 change.** Reject; require fresh
  run.
- **Direct edit attempt against a built artifact.** Reject; emit
  `contraindication-artifact-mutation-attempt`; investigate as
  adversarial input.

## Examples

```bash
# Default first-pass extraction over all advanced denylist rules
extract-contraindications work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json

# Verify-only re-check (used by safety-case-attest's preflight)
extract-contraindications work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --mode verify

# Targeted re-extraction restricted to a single Gate-1 cohort
extract-contraindications work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --cohort cohort-7c2a8e91b3d4f561

# Single-rule re-extraction after P13 re-emit
extract-contraindications work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --rules pr-1a2b3c4d5e6f7081 \
  --resume

# Dry-run plan emission for change-control review
extract-contraindications work/run-2026-04-30/sair.json \
  --dry-run
```

## Authority Boundaries

**Can do**
- Read sealed records, atomic units, SAIR, pharm-rules.json,
  Gate-1 registers, terminology bindings, and manifest pins.
- Perform the quadruple cross-check (rule ↔ record `INV-09` ↔
  atomic-unit anchor ↔ recbox cell ↔ RxNorm subset).
- Apply pregnancy denylist mechanical reinforcements.
- Recursively scan for AttendingOverridePattern matches and
  PCE-legacy literals.
- Materialize FHIR R5 `Evidence` and `EvidenceVariable` resources
  with deterministic id derivation and JCS canonical fixity.
- Persist the cross-check artifact and queue entries.
- Emit per-resource FHIR `Provenance` resources and PROV bundle
  updates.
- Append append-only audit events to the cross-check artifact's
  audit log.
- Block the build on any cross-check failure that is a clinical
  safety violation (pregnancy denylist reinforcement failure,
  PCE-legacy reference, AttendingOverridePattern detection).

**Requires approval (panel chair / new manifest version / ADR
amendment)**
- Any change to the quadruple-cross-check rule set.
- Any change to the FHIR resource shape or the manifest's pinned
  FHIR R5 profile.
- Any change to the closed AuditEventKind set.
- Any change to the held vs blocked routing semantics.

**Never**
- Paraphrase clinical text in any FHIR resource.
- Edit `acc_aha_cor` or `acc_aha_loe` on any artifact.
- Materialize a contraindication for a `held` denylist rule
  (held rules have unresolved diffs; the materialization would
  inappropriately surface an unverified rule into the IG).
- Materialize a contraindication for any pregnancy denylist held
  rule under any circumstance (pregnancy denylist held rules cannot
  reach this skill; categorical rejection at preflight).
- Auto-resolve a held or blocked cross-check.
- Reference PCE-legacy in any FHIR resource or audit event.
- Permit AttendingOverridePattern matches in any free-text field.
- Coerce an empty RxNorm subset to non-empty (the contraindication
  is unenforceable; remediation is upstream).
- Mutate a contraindication artifact whose state is referenced by a
  Gate-2-finalized Library; corrections require a coordinated
  re-extract through P13 + P14 + P20 + Gate 2.
- Run with `--strict false` in production.

`schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml` is now closed and self-consistent (§7 change_control completed with the full list of parent schemas and skills, and the ADR-HTN-001 amendment matrix covering all twenty policy clauses, mapped to D2/D3/D5/D8/D9/D10/D11/D14/D15).

`skills/extract-contraindications/SKILL.md` is the only authorized P14 producer of the contraindication artifact set, mirrors the parent repo's frontmatter and section discipline, and is fully aligned to ADR-HTN-001 D2/D3/D5/D8/D9/D10/D11/D14/D15 and to the framework spec §3/§5/§11.

Key design decisions encoded in the skill:

- **Cross-check is the substantive product, not the FHIR resources alone.** §2 defines the quadruple cross-check (rule ↔ record `INV-09` ↔ atomic-unit anchor ↔ recbox cell ↔ RxNorm subset) explicitly. The FHIR `Evidence` / `EvidenceVariable` materialization in §3 is the *artifact form* of the cross-check; if any cross-check fails, no artifact is emitted.

- **Pregnancy denylist held rules are categorically rejected at preflight**, mirroring `PR-INV-21` from the schema. There is no path through this skill that materializes a pregnancy contraindication from a held rule; the rule must reach `agreed` at P13 first. This is a defense-in-depth reinforcement of the ADR-HTN-001 D8 hard refusal policy.

- **Pregnancy denylist mechanical reinforcement in §2.5** mirrors `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §3.7 and `pharm-rule-htn.yaml` §2.7 (AttendingOverridePattern). The reinforcement is recursive over `rationale`, `clinical_consequence`, and `agreement.held_remediation_hint` free-text fields, case-insensitive after Unicode NFC.

- **PCE-legacy literal scan recursively** over every string field in the rule and the produced FHIR resources. This is the third defense-in-depth enforcement of ADR-HTN-001 D5 (the first is at P10, the second at P13's `PR-INV-15`).

- **FHIR R5 `Evidence` and `EvidenceVariable` resource shape in §3** carries the framework's `cpg-htn-source-anchor` extension recording the parent record id, parent atomic unit id, anchor kind, SAIR SHA, page, bbox, and RxNorm edition pin. Downstream IG composition at P26 renders this extension as the source-anchor footnote.

- **FHIR R5 JCS canonicalization with FHIR-specific element ordering exceptions** documented in `docs/fhir-r5-jcs-notes.md`. The per-resource SHA is recomputed at every run; mismatch is a release blocker.

- **Cross-check artifact in §4** is the deterministic evidence that `safety-case-attest` consumes when binding contraindications to Gate-3 attestation. The artifact records every cross-check decision per rule, with closed audit event kinds enumerated in §6.1.

- **Held vs blocked routing in §5**: held rules route to the two-person-rule queue under `parse-reconcile-queue` for upstream remediation (P6, P9, P10, or P13 re-run); blocked rules pause their parent record's downstream phases and route the parent record to `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize` with a closed concern category. The closed concern category set is mirrored from `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §8.2.

Fifteen DQA gates (`GC-A` … `GC-O`) are fail-closed at every rule. The "never" list explicitly forbids paraphrase, COR/LOE editing, materialization of held rules, materialization of pregnancy denylist held rules under any circumstance, auto-resolution of held or blocked cross-checks, PCE-legacy reference, AttendingOverridePattern matches, RxNorm subset coercion, post-Gate-2 mutation, and `--strict false` in production.

2. `bind-risk-engine` `SKILL.md` (P16) — the PREVENT-canonical risk-engine binding skill that consumes `pharm-rules.json`'s `first-line-selection` rules where risk thresholds gate selection.
3. `schemas/contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml` — the formal cross-check artifact schema, drafted at the same fidelity as `pharm-rule-htn.yaml`.
4. `phi-scrub` `SKILL.md` — the PHI scrub skill (`phi` member of the Gate-3 bundle).
