```yaml name=schemas/contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml
# =============================================================================
# contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Standalone schema for the per-run cross-check artifact produced by
# `extract-contraindications` at Phase 14 (P14) and consumed by:
#   - `safety-hbp` at Phase 23 (mitigations bind to Evidence.id /
#     EvidenceVariable.id materialized from artifact rows whose
#     overall == "pass")
#   - `safety-case-attest` at Gate 3 (the artifact's
#     cross_check_sha256 is part of the build's evidence chain)
#   - `cds-hooks-package-htn` at Phase 22 (descriptor metadata cites
#     EvidenceVariable.id values from artifact rows)
#   - `fhir-implementation-guide-build` at Phase 26 (composes the
#     materialized FHIR R5 Evidence / EvidenceVariable resources into
#     the published IG)
#
# This file is the contract for:
#   - The closed cross-check kind set (the four mandatory checks
#     plus pregnancy reinforcement and PCE-legacy scan).
#   - The closed AuditEventKind enum (mirrored from
#     `extract-contraindications` SKILL §6.1).
#   - The pregnancy-denylist-specific reinforcement block (mirrored
#     from `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §3.7 and
#     `pharm-rule-htn.yaml` §2.7 AttendingOverridePattern).
#   - The closed AttendingOverridePattern denylist as a schema-level
#     invariant on every artifact's free-text fields.
#   - The categorical rejection of pregnancy-denylist held rules at
#     the artifact layer (mirrors `PR-INV-21`).
#   - The FHIR R5 Evidence + EvidenceVariable artifact-row shape with
#     deterministic id derivation.
#   - The cross-check artifact-level fixity-manifest shape (RFC 8785
#     JCS canonicalization; SHA-256 over canonical bytes).
#   - The post-Gate-2-reference immutability rules (artifacts whose
#     Evidence.id is referenced by a Gate-2-finalized Library are
#     immutable; corrections require coordinated re-extract through
#     P13 + P14 + P20 + Gate 2).
#
# Posture: caution over velocity, fidelity over coverage,
# hard-refusal-on-pregnancy over convenience. Cross-check failure on
# any of the four mandatory checks routes the rule to held; pregnancy
# denylist reinforcement failure or AttendingOverridePattern detection
# or PCE-legacy literal detection BLOCKs unconditionally. The skill
# never auto-resolves blocked rows.
#
# This file does NOT contain CQL bytes, RxNorm content, FHIR profile
# bytes, or terminology-server endpoints. It is the cross-check-layer
# contract between Gate-1-finalized records / atomic units / pharm
# rules and the downstream Safety Case / CDS Hooks / IG build phases.
#
# Authority:
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D2 (single authoritative source)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D3 (native ACC/AHA grading preserved as primary)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D5 (PREVENT canonical)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D8 (pregnancy hard-block enforced at order-select)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D9 (three non-overridable human gates; this schema
#     is gated by Gate 1 upstream and feeds Gate 2 / Gate 3 downstream)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D10 (PHI fail-closed; the artifact carries no
#     patient-identifying content)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D11 (Synthea-only test data; the FHIR resources the
#     artifact references are the surface that P21 tests under
#     Synthea cohorts)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D14 (predecessor 2017 advisory)
#   - ADR-HTN-001 D15 (drift detection; RxNorm subset drift is
#     checked at every re-run)
#   - Framework spec §3 (pipeline; P14 placement)
#   - Framework spec §5 (skills; this schema's writer is
#     `extract-contraindications`)
#   - Framework spec §11 (Guideline Card / NAM CGAT; downstream
#     consumers)
#   - `extract-contraindications` SKILL.md (the only authorized writer)
#   - Parent framework rules: `god-session`, `human-authorization`,
#     `native-ux-tools`
#
# Relationship to neighboring schemas (separate files, referenced by
# $ref or by content-hash pointer):
#   - schemas/recommendation-record-htn.yaml  (input; INV-09, INV-10)
#   - schemas/atomic-unit.yaml                (input; AU-INV-22..25)
#   - schemas/sair.yaml                       (input; recbox cell shape
#                                              for cross-check 3)
#   - schemas/acc-aha-grading.yaml            (closed COR/LOE enums for
#                                              cross-check 3)
#   - schemas/gate1-register.yaml             (finalization preconditions
#                                              and closed EditTarget set;
#                                              panel-chair escalation
#                                              concern categories)
#   - schemas/pharm-rule-htn.yaml             (input; PR-INV-05,
#                                              PR-INV-13..16, PR-INV-18..21)
#   - schemas/cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml     (downstream consumer; §2.5
#                                              AttendingOverridePattern
#                                              mirrored here)
#   - schemas/safety-case-htn.yaml            (downstream consumer;
#                                              SC-INV-09, SC-INV-10,
#                                              SC-INV-26, SC-INV-27)
#   - schemas/gate3-attestation.yaml          (downstream consumer;
#                                              cross_check_sha256 is part
#                                              of the IG bundle's
#                                              evidence chain)
#   - schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml (per-build manifest;
#                                              terminology[] (RxNorm
#                                              edition), risk_engine,
#                                              intended_use.age_min_
#                                              inclusive, pregnancy
#                                              value-set id, FHIR R5
#                                              profile pin, tsa_list
#                                              are consulted)
# =============================================================================

$schema: "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"
$id: "https://aiwg.io/cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha/schemas/contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml"
title: "ContraindicationArtifactHTN"
description: >
  Auditable, deterministic-id-bound, RFC-8785-canonical contract for
  the per-run cross-check artifact produced by
  `extract-contraindications`. Encodes the closed cross-check kind
  set, the closed AuditEventKind enum, the pregnancy-denylist-
  specific reinforcement block, the closed AttendingOverridePattern
  denylist as a schema-level invariant, the categorical rejection
  of pregnancy-denylist held rules, the FHIR R5 Evidence +
  EvidenceVariable artifact-row shape with deterministic id
  derivation, the artifact-level fixity-manifest, and the
  post-Gate-2-reference immutability rules.
version: "1.0.0"
schema_lifecycle: stable
last_reviewed: "HUMAN_FILL: ISO-8601 date of most recent panel review of this schema"
authority:
  adr: ADR-HTN-001
  framework: cpg-htn-2025-acc-aha
  parent_framework: aiwg-training
license: MIT

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. POLICY (normative)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

policy:

  closed_cross_check_kind_set:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row MUST record exactly the four mandatory
      cross-checks (CC1: rule ↔ record INV-09; CC2: rule ↔
      atomic-unit anchor; CC3: rule ↔ recbox cell shape; CC4: rule
      ↔ RxNorm subset) plus the conditional pregnancy reinforcement
      and the unconditional PCE-legacy scan. The set is closed at
      the schema level; new checks require ADR-HTN-001 amendment.
      Validators MUST refuse rows missing any of the four mandatory
      checks or carrying additional checks not in §2.1.

  rule_scope_is_denylist_advanced:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row MUST reference a `PharmRule` whose
      `kind == "denylist"` AND whose `agreement.state == "agreed"`
      AND whose `state == "advanced"` (or `sealed`/`superseded` in
      historical rule sets). Held denylist rules MUST NOT be
      referenced under any circumstance; pregnancy-denylist held
      rules are categorically forbidden (mirrors `PR-INV-21`).
      Validators MUST refuse any artifact-row referencing a
      held-state rule.

  pregnancy_denylist_categorical_rejection:
    rule: >
      An artifact-row whose referenced rule has
      `population_filter[]` containing `pregnant` or `postpartum`
      AND `agreement.state != "agreed"` MUST be refused at
      validation time. The schema enforces this with
      `CIA-INV-09`. The skill enforces this at preflight; the
      schema is the second defense.

  pregnancy_denylist_reinforcement_block:
    rule: >
      An artifact-row whose referenced rule's
      `population_filter[]` includes `pregnant` or `postpartum` AND
      `kind == "denylist"` MUST satisfy ALL of the following
      (PregnancyReinforcementConstraints, mirrored from
      `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §3.7 and adapted to the
      cross-check-artifact layer):
        a) referenced rule's `posture_at_cds == "hard-refuse"`
        b) referenced rule's `cds_hook == "order-select"`
        c) referenced rule's `attending_override_permitted == false`
        d) referenced rule's `documentation_only == false`
        e) referenced rule's `indicator_set == ["critical"]`
        f) the artifact-row's `pregnancy_reinforcement.status == "pass"`
           AND `pregnancy_reinforcement.attending_override_pattern_scan_clean
           == true`
        g) the materialized `EvidenceVariable.useContext[]` includes
           the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id (recorded in
           `pregnancy_reinforcement.pregnancy_value_set_id_present
           == true`)
        h) NO key or string value anywhere in the artifact-row's
           `notes`, `held_remediation_hint`, or any
           `failure_diagnostic.*` text fields (case-insensitive
           after Unicode NFC) matches any AttendingOverridePattern
           from §2.6
      Any violation BLOCKs the artifact and emits the corresponding
      closed audit event from §2.7.

  attending_override_denylist:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row MUST be free of attending-override
      semantics in its free-text fields. Validators MUST recursively
      scan every string value in `notes`, `held_remediation_hint`,
      and any `failure_diagnostic.*` text fields (case-insensitive
      after Unicode NFC) for any AttendingOverridePattern from §2.6.
      Any match BLOCKs and emits an
      `attending-override-pattern-detected` audit event. The
      pattern set is closed; new patterns require ADR-HTN-001
      amendment.

  pce_legacy_never_appears:
    rule: >
      No artifact-row may reference `PCE-legacy` in any field,
      including `notes`, `held_remediation_hint`, any
      `failure_diagnostic.*` text fields, or any materialized FHIR
      resource path / id / extension URL. PREVENT is canonical per
      ADR-HTN-001 D5; any PCE-legacy reference is a release blocker.

  inheritance_from_parent_rule:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row MUST inherit `acc_aha_cor`, `acc_aha_loe`,
      `parent_record_id`, `parent_atomic_unit_id`, and
      `gate1_cohort_id` from the referenced PharmRule (read-only;
      the artifact-row cannot relax COR or LOE). Mismatches between
      artifact-row fields and rule fields are a release blocker.

  age_gate_eq_18:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row's parent record's `pico_precheck.populations[]`
      MUST be compatible with the manifest's
      `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18`. Pediatric populations
      are out of scope and rejected at the artifact layer.

  rxnorm_pin_alignment_and_drift_detection:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row's `cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset.subset_sha256`
      MUST equal the upstream P10 binding's recorded subset SHA-256
      AND the referenced rule's recorded resolution at P13. Drift
      between any two of these three sources BLOCKs and emits
      `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift`.

  fhir_r5_profile_compliance:
    rule: >
      Every materialized FHIR R5 Evidence and EvidenceVariable
      resource path MUST refer to a file that validates against the
      manifest-pinned FHIR R5 profile. Profile drift is a release
      blocker. Resource SHAs MUST recompute byte-for-byte under FHIR
      R5 JCS canonicalization (RFC 8785 with FHIR-specific element
      ordering exceptions per `docs/fhir-r5-jcs-notes.md`).

  deterministic_id_derivation:
    rule: >
      Every artifact-row's materialized resource ids MUST be
      deterministic from the referenced rule_id:
        - `Evidence.id` == `ev-cont-<rule_id>`
        - `EvidenceVariable.id` == `ev-<rule_id>`
      Re-runs against the same rule_id produce identical resource
      ids; downstream consumers (P22, P23, P26, Gate 3) re-bind
      without renumbering.

  artifact_canonicalization:
    rule: >
      The artifact's `fixity.cross_check_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256
      of the JCS-canonical (RFC 8785) form of THIS document with
      `fixity` excluded. Validators recompute and compare; mismatch
      is a release blocker.

  audit_log_append_only:
    rule: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers.

  post_gate_2_reference_immutability:
    rule: >
      Once any artifact-row's `materialized.evidence_id` is
      referenced by a Gate-2-finalized Library (the Library's
      Gate-2 register entry records the citation), the artifact-row
      becomes immutable. Mutation attempts are tamper-evident and
      BLOCKed by SHA recompute. Corrections require coordinated
      re-extract through P13 + P14 + P20 + Gate 2.

  superseded_artifacts:
    rule: >
      An artifact whose underlying rule_set_sha256, records_sha256,
      atomic_units_sha256, sair_sha256, or manifest_payload_sha256
      changes is marked `state == "superseded"` with
      `superseded_by_artifact_sha256` pointing to the new artifact.
      The chain is monotone; cycles are forbidden.

  conflict_routing_to_panel_chair:
    rule: >
      An artifact-row whose `overall == "blocked"` MUST cite a
      closed concern category from §2.10 (mirrored from
      `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §8.2) and route the parent
      record to `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`. The
      schema records the routing in `blocked_routing.*` fields;
      validators MUST refuse blocked rows that omit the routing.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CLOSED ENUMERATIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

$defs:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.1 Closed cross-check kinds
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CrossCheckKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cross-check-1-record-inv09
      - cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor
      - cross-check-3-recbox-cell-shape
      - cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset
      - pregnancy-reinforcement
      - pce-legacy-scan

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.2 Per-check status
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CrossCheckStatus:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pass
      - fail
      - not-applicable
    description: >
      `not-applicable` is permitted ONLY for
      `pregnancy-reinforcement` (when the referenced rule's
      population_filter[] excludes pregnant and postpartum). All
      four mandatory cross-checks AND `pce-legacy-scan` MUST be
      `pass` or `fail`; `not-applicable` on any of these is a
      release blocker.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.3 Overall artifact-row status
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OverallStatus:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pass
      - held
      - blocked
    description: >
      - `pass`: all four mandatory checks pass; pregnancy
        reinforcement (when applicable) passes; pce-legacy-scan
        passes. The materialized FHIR resources are written.
      - `held`: at least one mandatory check fails AND the failure
        is recoverable upstream (e.g., recbox cell mismatch from a
        P6 corruption); routes to the two-person-rule queue.
        Pregnancy denylist rows MUST NOT enter `held` (mirrors
        `PR-INV-21`); they are categorically rejected at preflight.
      - `blocked`: at least one failure is a clinical safety
        violation (pregnancy reinforcement failure,
        AttendingOverridePattern detection, PCE-legacy literal);
        routes the parent record to panel-chair re-review under
        `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.4 Pharm-rule kind (closed; mirrored from pharm-rule-htn.yaml)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PharmRuleKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - first-line-selection
      - denylist
      - dose-modifier
      - monitoring
      - discontinuation
    description: >
      An artifact-row's `referenced_rule.kind` MUST be `denylist`
      (rule_scope_is_denylist_advanced); the schema permits the full
      enum to ease validator code reuse, but `CIA-INV-02` enforces
      `denylist`-only at the artifact layer.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.5 Anchor kind (closed; mirrored)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnchorKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cor-i-anchor
      - cor-iia-anchor
      - cor-iib-anchor
      - cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor
      - cor-iii-harm-anchor
      - explicit-should-not-anchor
      - explicit-not-recommended-anchor

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.6 Closed AttendingOverridePattern denylist
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mirrored verbatim from `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §2.5 and
  # `pharm-rule-htn.yaml` §2.7.
  # Validators MUST recursively scan every string value in
  # `notes`, `held_remediation_hint`, and any `failure_diagnostic.*`
  # fields (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC) for any of these
  # patterns. Matches BLOCK the artifact.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AttendingOverridePattern:
    type: string
    enum:
      - permit_on_attending_override
      - permitOnAttendingOverride
      - attending_override
      - attendingOverride
      - override_role
      - overrideRole
      - override_reason_required
      - overrideReasonRequired
      - attending_can_override
      - attendingCanOverride
      - override_with_attending_co_sign
      - overrideWithAttendingCoSign
      - permit_on_co_sign
      - permitOnCoSign
      - override_permitted
      - overridePermitted
      - suppressible
      - suppressibleByRole
      - documentationOnly
      - documentation_only
      - soft_warning
      - softWarning

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.7 Closed AuditEventKind (mirrored from extract-contraindications §6.1)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventKind:
    type: string
    enum:
      - cross-check-1-record-inv09-pass
      - cross-check-1-record-inv09-mismatch
      - cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-pass
      - cross-check-2-atomic-unit-anchor-mismatch
      - cross-check-3-recbox-cell-pass
      - cross-check-3-recbox-cell-mismatch
      - cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-pass
      - cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift
      - pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-pass
      - pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-failed
      - pregnancy-denylist-attending-override-pattern-detected
      - pregnancy-denylist-held-rule-rejected
      - pce-legacy-binding-detected
      - evidence-variable-built
      - evidence-built
      - evidence-variable-verified
      - evidence-verified
      - cross-check-artifact-built
      - cross-check-artifact-verified
      - contraindication-artifact-mutation-attempt
      - artifact-routed-to-queue
      - artifact-routed-to-panel-chair
      - attending-override-pattern-detected
      - fhir-profile-validation-failed
      - evidence-or-evidencevariable-sha-mismatch

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.8 ACC/AHA grading (mirrored)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AccAhaCOR:
    type: string
    enum: [I, IIa, IIb, III-No-Benefit, III-Harm]

  AccAhaLOE:
    type: string
    enum: [A, B-R, B-NR, C-LD, C-EO]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.9 PopulationFilter (closed; mirrored)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PopulationFilter:
    type: string
    enum:
      - general-adult
      - older-adult
      - pregnant
      - postpartum
      - ckd
      - t2dm
      - hf-rEF
      - hf-pEF
      - cad
      - post-stroke
      - secondary-htn-suspected
      - urgency
      - emergency
      - resistant-htn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.10 PanelChairConcernCategory (mirrored from
  #      extract-recommendation-cor-loe §8.2)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PanelChairConcernCategory:
    type: string
    enum:
      - verbatim-text-disputed
      - atomicity-state-disputed
      - cor-loe-extraction-disputed
      - predecessor-mapping-disputed
      - pregnancy-population-misclassified
      - rxnorm-subset-disputed
      - recbox-cell-corrupted
      - other-clinical-integrity-failure
    description: >
      Closed concern-category set for blocked rows. The artifact MUST
      cite exactly one when routing the parent record to
      `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.11 Lifecycle states
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactRowState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - pending
      - pass
      - held
      - blocked
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  ArtifactState:
    type: string
    enum:
      - draft
      - sealed
      - superseded
      - withdrawn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2.12 Verification methods
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VerificationMethod:
    type: string
    enum:
      - record-inv09-anchor-match
      - atomic-unit-anchor-match
      - verbatim-roundtrip
      - recbox-cell-shape-match
      - recbox-cor-cell-equals-rule-cor
      - recbox-loe-cell-equals-rule-loe
      - recbox-recommendation-cell-equals-source-text
      - rxnorm-resolution-non-empty
      - rxnorm-subset-sha-match-upstream-p10
      - rxnorm-subset-sha-match-rule-recorded
      - pregnancy-reinforcement-pass
      - attending-override-pattern-scan-clean
      - pce-legacy-literal-scan-clean
      - fhir-r5-profile-validation-pass
      - canonical-sha-match

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. STRUCTURED TYPES
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 ReferencedRule
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ReferencedRule:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - rule_id
      - rule_sha256
      - kind
      - parent_record_id
      - parent_atomic_unit_id
      - gate1_cohort_id
      - acc_aha_cor
      - acc_aha_loe
      - anchor_kind
      - population_filter
      - posture_at_cds
      - cds_hook
      - attending_override_permitted
      - documentation_only
      - rxnorm_edition_pin
      - rxnorm_subset_sha256_recorded
      - bound_risk_engine_name
    properties:
      rule_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      rule_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      kind:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/PharmRuleKind" }
      parent_record_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      parent_atomic_unit_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      gate1_cohort_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      acc_aha_cor:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaCOR" }
      acc_aha_loe:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaLOE" }
      anchor_kind:                { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      population_filter:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/PopulationFilter" }
      posture_at_cds:
        type: string
        enum: [hard-refuse, soft-warning, informational]
      cds_hook:
        type: string
        enum: [order-select, patient-view, encounter-discharge]
      attending_override_permitted:
        type: boolean
        const: false
      documentation_only:
        type: boolean
        const: false
      indicator_set:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, enum: [info, warning, critical, hard-stop] }
      rxnorm_edition_pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      rxnorm_subset_sha256_recorded:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          The subset SHA recorded by the rule at P13. Validators
          recompute against the upstream P10 binding's subset and
          against the live terminology server.
      bound_risk_engine_name:
        type: string
        const: PREVENT
        description: >
          The rule's bound risk engine. PCE-legacy is forbidden;
          validators MUST refuse any value other than PREVENT
          (pce_legacy_never_appears).

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Per-cross-check shapes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FailureDiagnostic:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [summary]
    properties:
      summary:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          Plain-text diagnostic. Validators MUST scan for
          AttendingOverridePattern (attending_override_denylist) and
          for the literal `PCE-legacy` (pce_legacy_never_appears).
      llm_a_value:    { type: [string, "null"] }
      llm_b_value:    { type: [string, "null"] }
      record_value:   { type: [string, "null"] }
      rule_value:     { type: [string, "null"] }
      atomic_unit_value: { type: [string, "null"] }
      recbox_cell_value: { type: [string, "null"] }
      upstream_p10_value: { type: [string, "null"] }
      live_terminology_value: { type: [string, "null"] }

  CrossCheck1RecordInv09:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [status, anchor_kind_rule, anchor_kind_record_inv09]
    properties:
      status:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      anchor_kind_rule:             { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      anchor_kind_record_inv09:     { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      record_acc_aha_cor:           { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaCOR" }
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  CrossCheck2AtomicUnitAnchor:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [status, anchor_kind_rule, anchor_kind_atomic_unit, sair_sha256, page, bbox, verbatim_roundtrip_ok]
    properties:
      status:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      anchor_kind_rule:             { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      anchor_kind_atomic_unit:      { $ref: "#/$defs/AnchorKind" }
      sair_sha256:                  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      page:                         { type: integer, minimum: 1 }
      bbox:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [x0, y0, x1, y1]
        properties:
          x0: { type: number }
          y0: { type: number }
          x1: { type: number }
          y1: { type: number }
      verbatim_roundtrip_ok:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          True iff the rule's `source_text_verbatim` round-trips
          byte-for-byte against the parent atomic unit's
          `text_verbatim` after applying the rule's
          `normalization_log[]` in reverse.
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  CrossCheck3RecboxCellShape:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - status
      - canonical_shape_present
      - cor_cell_equals_rule_cor
      - loe_cell_equals_rule_loe
      - recommendation_cell_equals_source_text
    properties:
      status:                                     { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      canonical_shape_present:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          True iff the SAIR's `recommendation_box.row.cells[]` for the
          parent record's row carry the canonical ACC/AHA shape (COR,
          LOE, Recommendation, Supportive Text, Citations).
      cor_cell_equals_rule_cor:                   { type: boolean }
      loe_cell_equals_rule_loe:                   { type: boolean }
      recommendation_cell_equals_source_text:     { type: boolean }
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  CrossCheck4RxNormSubset:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - status
      - subset_sha256
      - subset_sha256_upstream_p10
      - subset_sha256_rule_recorded
      - subset_size
      - rxnorm_edition_pin
    properties:
      status:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      subset_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the live terminology server's resolution at validation time.
      subset_sha256_upstream_p10:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 of the upstream P10 binding's recorded subset.
      subset_sha256_rule_recorded:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: SHA-256 recorded by the rule at P13.
      subset_size:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        description: Cardinality of the resolved subset; 0 forces fail (the contraindication is unenforceable).
      rxnorm_edition_pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  PregnancyReinforcement:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - applicability
      - status
      - posture_at_cds_ok
      - cds_hook_ok
      - attending_override_permitted_ok
      - documentation_only_ok
      - indicator_set_ok
      - attending_override_pattern_scan_clean
      - pregnancy_value_set_id_present
    properties:
      applicability:
        type: string
        enum: [applicable, not-applicable]
        description: >
          `applicable` iff the referenced rule's
          `population_filter[]` includes `pregnant` or `postpartum`.
          When `not-applicable`, the boolean flags MUST be set to
          true (vacuous-truth) and `status` MUST be `not-applicable`.
      status:                                       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      posture_at_cds_ok:                            { type: boolean }
      cds_hook_ok:                                  { type: boolean }
      attending_override_permitted_ok:              { type: boolean }
      documentation_only_ok:                        { type: boolean }
      indicator_set_ok:                             { type: boolean }
      attending_override_pattern_scan_clean:        { type: boolean }
      pregnancy_value_set_id_present:
        type: boolean
        description: >
          True iff the materialized `EvidenceVariable.useContext[]`
          includes the manifest-pinned pregnancy value-set id.
      manifest_pregnancy_value_set_id:              { type: [string, "null"] }
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  PceLegacyScan:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [status, fields_scanned, matches_count]
    properties:
      status:                       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheckStatus" }
      fields_scanned:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
        description: >
          The fields scanned for the literal `PCE-legacy` (e.g.,
          rule.rationale, rule.clinical_consequence, rule.held_remediation_hint,
          materialized.evidence_resource_path, materialized.evidence_variable_resource_path).
      matches_count:
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
      failure_diagnostic:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/FailureDiagnostic"
          - type: "null"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 Materialized FHIR resources (per artifact-row)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MaterializedResources:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - evidence_id
      - evidence_resource_path
      - evidence_resource_sha256
      - evidence_variable_id
      - evidence_variable_resource_path
      - evidence_variable_resource_sha256
      - fhir_r5_profile_pin
      - fhir_r5_profile_validation_status
    properties:
      evidence_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^ev-cont-pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Deterministic id; equals `ev-cont-<rule_id>`.
      evidence_resource_path:
        type: string
        description: Relative path under work/<run_id>/contraindications/Evidence/.
      evidence_resource_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      evidence_variable_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^ev-pr-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: Deterministic id; equals `ev-<rule_id>`.
      evidence_variable_resource_path:
        type: string
      evidence_variable_resource_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      fhir_r5_profile_pin:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
      fhir_r5_profile_validation_status:
        type: string
        enum: [pass, fail, not-run]
      hl7_certainty_rating_recorded:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          The HL7 certainty rating mapped from the rule's `acc_aha_loe`
          per the manifest-pinned mapping document
          `docs/acc-aha-to-hl7-certainty.md`. Null when not yet
          materialized.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 Held / blocked routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HeldRouting:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [queue_path, queue_entry_sha256, two_person_rule_status, held_remediation_hint]
    properties:
      queue_path:
        type: string
        description: Relative path under work/<run_id>/queue/contraindications/.
      queue_entry_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
      two_person_rule_status:
        type: string
        enum: [awaiting-resolver, awaiting-verifier, resolved, withdrawn]
      held_remediation_hint:
        type: string
        minLength: 1
        description: >
          Plain-text remediation hint (e.g., "Re-run P10 binding;
          re-run P13 extract; re-run P14 cross-check"). Validators
          MUST scan for AttendingOverridePattern matches.

  BlockedRouting:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - panel_chair_route
      - concern_category
      - parent_record_id_routed
      - paused_downstream_phases
    properties:
      panel_chair_route:
        type: string
        const: gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize
      concern_category:                 { $ref: "#/$defs/PanelChairConcernCategory" }
      parent_record_id_routed:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      paused_downstream_phases:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
          enum: [P15, P16, P20, P21, P22, P23, P26, gate-2, gate-3]
      blocked_rationale:
        type: [string, "null"]
        description: >
          Plain-text rationale. Validators MUST scan for
          AttendingOverridePattern matches and PCE-legacy literals.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 ArtifactRow (per-rule cross-check decision)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactRow:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - row_id
      - referenced_rule
      - acc_aha_cor
      - acc_aha_loe
      - parent_record_id
      - parent_atomic_unit_id
      - gate1_cohort_id
      - cross_check_1_record_inv09
      - cross_check_2_atomic_unit_anchor
      - cross_check_3_recbox_cell_shape
      - cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset
      - pregnancy_reinforcement
      - pce_legacy_scan
      - methods_passed
      - methods_failed
      - overall
      - state
      - notes
      - fixity
    properties:
      row_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cir-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
        description: >
          Deterministic id; truncated SHA-256 of the canonical tuple
          `(rule_id, rule_sha256, manifest_payload_sha256)`.
      referenced_rule:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/ReferencedRule" }
      acc_aha_cor:                      { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaCOR" }
      acc_aha_loe:                      { $ref: "#/$defs/AccAhaLOE" }
      parent_record_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^rec-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      parent_atomic_unit_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^au-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      gate1_cohort_id:
        type: string
        pattern: "^cohort-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
      cross_check_1_record_inv09:       { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheck1RecordInv09" }
      cross_check_2_atomic_unit_anchor: { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheck2AtomicUnitAnchor" }
      cross_check_3_recbox_cell_shape:  { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheck3RecboxCellShape" }
      cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset:      { $ref: "#/$defs/CrossCheck4RxNormSubset" }
      pregnancy_reinforcement:          { $ref: "#/$defs/PregnancyReinforcement" }
      pce_legacy_scan:                  { $ref: "#/$defs/PceLegacyScan" }
      methods_passed:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/VerificationMethod" }
      methods_failed:
        type: array
        items: { $ref: "#/$defs/VerificationMethod" }
      materialized:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/MaterializedResources"
          - type: "null"
        description: >
          Non-null iff `overall == "pass"`. When `overall ∈ {held,
          blocked}`, materialized is null and the FHIR resources are
          NOT written.
      held_routing:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/HeldRouting"
          - type: "null"
        description: >
          Non-null iff `overall == "held"`.
      blocked_routing:
        oneOf:
          - $ref: "#/$defs/BlockedRouting"
          - type: "null"
        description: >
          Non-null iff `overall == "blocked"`.
      overall:                          { $ref: "#/$defs/OverallStatus" }
      state:                            { $ref: "#/$defs/ArtifactRowState" }
      notes:
        type: string
        description: >
          Plain-text operator notes. Validators MUST scan for
          AttendingOverridePattern matches (attending_override_denylist)
          and PCE-legacy literals (pce_legacy_never_appears).
      fixity:
        type: object
        additionalProperties: false
        required: [row_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
        properties:
          row_sha256:
            type: string
            pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
            description: >
              SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of the row with
              `fixity` excluded.
          computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
          canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 AuditEvent
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEvent:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [event_id, occurred_at, kind, actor_id, payload_sha256]
    properties:
      event_id:        { type: string, pattern: "^evt-[0-9a-f]{16}$" }
      occurred_at:     { type: string, format: date-time }
      kind:            { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEventKind" }
      actor_id:        { type: string }
      payload_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      prov_activity_id:{ type: [string, "null"] }
      row_id:          { type: [string, "null"], pattern: "^cir-[0-9a-f]{16}$|^null$" }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROOT TYPE — ContraindicationArtifactHTN
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
type: object
title: ContraindicationArtifactHTN
additionalProperties: false
required:
  - schema_version
  - artifact_id
  - artifact_version
  - guideline_manifest_ref
  - build
  - rows
  - state
  - audit_log
  - fixity
properties:

  schema_version:
    type: string
    const: "1.0.0"

  artifact_id:
    type: string
    pattern: "^cia-[0-9a-f]{16}$"
    description: >
      Stable, deterministic id (truncated SHA-256 of build_run_id +
      manifest_payload_sha256 + pharm_rule_set_sha256 +
      records_sha256 + atomic_units_sha256 + sair_sha256). Stable
      across re-runs given identical inputs.

  artifact_version:
    type: string
    pattern: "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$"

  predecessor_artifact_sha256:
    type: [string, "null"]
    pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$|^null$"

  predecessor_artifact_state:
    type: [string, "null"]
    enum: [superseded, withdrawn, null]

  guideline_manifest_ref:
    type: string
    description: Pointer to the active `schemas/guideline-manifest-hbp-2025.yaml` instance.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.1 Build identity (input pinning)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required:
      - run_id
      - build_version_label
      - opened_at
      - manifest_payload_sha256
      - pharm_rule_set_path
      - pharm_rule_set_sha256
      - records_path
      - records_sha256
      - atomic_units_path
      - atomic_units_sha256
      - sair_path
      - sair_sha256
      - terminology_bindings_path
      - terminology_bindings_sha256
      - gate1_register_paths
      - gate1_register_sha256s
      - rxnorm_edition_pin
      - fhir_r5_profile_pin
      - manifest_pregnancy_value_set_id
    properties:
      run_id:                       { type: string, format: uuid }
      build_version_label:
        type: string
        pattern: "^v[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\+ACC-AHA-2025\\+US\\+[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$"
      opened_at:                    { type: string, format: date-time }
      sealed_at:                    { type: [string, "null"], format: date-time }
      manifest_payload_sha256:      { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      pharm_rule_set_path:          { type: string }
      pharm_rule_set_sha256:        { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      records_path:                 { type: string }
      records_sha256:               { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      atomic_units_path:            { type: string }
      atomic_units_sha256:          { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      sair_path:                    { type: string }
      sair_sha256:                  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      terminology_bindings_path:    { type: string }
      terminology_bindings_sha256:  { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      gate1_register_paths:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string }
      gate1_register_sha256s:
        type: array
        minItems: 1
        items: { type: string, pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$" }
      rxnorm_edition_pin:           { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      fhir_r5_profile_pin:          { type: string, minLength: 1 }
      manifest_pregnancy_value_set_id: { type: string, minLength: 1 }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.2 Rows
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  rows:
    type: array
    minItems: 0
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/ArtifactRow" }
    description: >
      The artifact's per-rule cross-check rows. Validators MUST refuse
      rows referencing held-state denylist rules (CIA-INV-09); rows
      referencing pregnancy-denylist held rules are categorically
      forbidden.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.3 Lifecycle
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  state: { $ref: "#/$defs/ArtifactState" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.4 Audit log (append-only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  audit_log:
    type: array
    items: { $ref: "#/$defs/AuditEvent" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4.5 Artifact-level fixity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  fixity:
    type: object
    additionalProperties: false
    required: [cross_check_sha256, computed_at, canonical_form]
    properties:
      cross_check_sha256:
        type: string
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"
        description: >
          SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical form of THIS document with
          `fixity` excluded (artifact_canonicalization). Deterministic
          across re-runs given identical inputs.
      computed_at:    { type: string, format: date-time }
      canonical_form: { type: string, enum: [json-canonical-rfc8785] }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. CROSS-FIELD INVARIANTS (validators MUST enforce)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

invariants:

  - id: CIA-INV-01
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `row_id` MUST be the deterministic
      truncated SHA-256 of `(rule_id, rule_sha256,
      manifest_payload_sha256)` (deterministic_id_derivation, applied
      at the row layer). Validators recompute and compare; mismatch
      is a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-02
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `referenced_rule.kind` MUST be `denylist`
      (rule_scope_is_denylist_advanced). Other kinds are out of scope
      for this artifact.

  - id: CIA-INV-03
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `acc_aha_cor`, `acc_aha_loe`,
      `parent_record_id`, `parent_atomic_unit_id`, and
      `gate1_cohort_id` MUST equal the `referenced_rule`'s
      corresponding fields exactly (inheritance_from_parent_rule).

  - id: CIA-INV-04
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow MUST record exactly the four mandatory
      cross-checks plus pregnancy_reinforcement plus pce_legacy_scan
      (closed_cross_check_kind_set). Missing or additional checks
      are a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-05
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's per-check `status` for the four mandatory
      cross-checks AND pce_legacy_scan MUST be `pass` or `fail`.
      `not-applicable` on any of these is a release blocker.
      `pregnancy_reinforcement.status` MAY be `not-applicable` ONLY
      when `pregnancy_reinforcement.applicability == "not-applicable"`.

  - id: CIA-INV-06
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `overall` MUST be derived per:
        - `pass` iff (CC1 == pass) AND (CC2 == pass) AND
                     (CC3 == pass) AND (CC4 == pass) AND
                     (pregnancy_reinforcement.status ∈ {pass,
                     not-applicable}) AND (pce_legacy_scan.status ==
                     pass).
        - `blocked` iff (pregnancy_reinforcement.applicability ==
                         applicable AND pregnancy_reinforcement.status
                         == fail) OR (pce_legacy_scan.status == fail)
                         OR (any AttendingOverridePattern match was
                         detected on this row).
        - `held` otherwise (at least one of CC1..CC4 == fail with no
                         clinical-safety violation).
      Validators MUST recompute `overall` and compare to the
      recorded value; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-07
    description: >
      For every ArtifactRow:
        - `overall == "pass"` -> `materialized` MUST be non-null AND
          `held_routing` AND `blocked_routing` MUST be null.
        - `overall == "held"` -> `held_routing` MUST be non-null AND
          `materialized` AND `blocked_routing` MUST be null.
        - `overall == "blocked"` -> `blocked_routing` MUST be non-null
          AND `materialized` AND `held_routing` MUST be null.

  - id: CIA-INV-08
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `cross_check_1_record_inv09.anchor_kind_rule`
      MUST equal `cross_check_1_record_inv09.anchor_kind_record_inv09`
      AND MUST equal `referenced_rule.anchor_kind` AND MUST be a
      member of the closed denylist anchor set
      {`cor-iii-harm-anchor`, `cor-iii-no-benefit-anchor`,
      `explicit-should-not-anchor`, `explicit-not-recommended-anchor`}.
      Mismatch emits `cross-check-1-record-inv09-mismatch` and
      BLOCKs.

  - id: CIA-INV-09
    description: >
      No ArtifactRow may reference a `PharmRule` whose
      `agreement.state != "agreed"`. Validators MUST resolve
      `referenced_rule.rule_id` against the pinned
      `build.pharm_rule_set_path` and refuse rows whose referenced
      rule is `held` or `conflict`. Pregnancy-denylist held rules
      are categorically forbidden (mirrors `PR-INV-21`); validators
      MUST emit `pregnancy-denylist-held-rule-rejected` and refuse
      such rows unconditionally
      (pregnancy_denylist_categorical_rejection).

  - id: CIA-INV-10
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `cross_check_2_atomic_unit_anchor.sair_sha256`,
      `.page`, `.bbox` MUST equal the parent atomic unit's anchor
      values exactly AND MUST equal the referenced rule's `anchors.*`
      values exactly. `verbatim_roundtrip_ok` MUST be true; false
      forces CC2 to fail.

  - id: CIA-INV-11
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's
      `cross_check_3_recbox_cell_shape.canonical_shape_present` MUST
      be true. The three boolean equality flags
      (cor_cell_equals_rule_cor, loe_cell_equals_rule_loe,
      recommendation_cell_equals_source_text) MUST all be true for
      CC3 to pass; any false forces CC3 to fail.

  - id: CIA-INV-12
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's
      `cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset.subset_sha256_upstream_p10` MUST
      equal `cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset.subset_sha256` AND MUST
      equal `cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset.subset_sha256_rule_recorded`
      (rxnorm_pin_alignment_and_drift_detection). Drift on any of the
      three SHAs forces CC4 to fail and emits
      `cross-check-4-rxnorm-subset-drift`.
      Additionally, `subset_size > 0`; size 0 forces CC4 to fail
      (the contraindication is unenforceable).
      `rxnorm_edition_pin` MUST equal `referenced_rule.rxnorm_edition_pin`
      AND `build.rxnorm_edition_pin`.

  - id: CIA-INV-13
    description: >
      For every ArtifactRow whose
      `referenced_rule.population_filter[]` includes `pregnant` or
      `postpartum`, `pregnancy_reinforcement.applicability` MUST be
      `applicable` AND ALL of the constraints in the
      pregnancy_denylist_reinforcement_block policy clause (a..h)
      MUST hold (pregnancy_reinforcement.status == pass). Any
      violation BLOCKs and emits
      `pregnancy-denylist-cross-check-failed`.

  - id: CIA-INV-14
    description: >
      Validators MUST recursively scan every string value in every
      ArtifactRow's `notes`,
      `held_routing.held_remediation_hint`,
      `blocked_routing.blocked_rationale`, every
      `failure_diagnostic.summary`, and every
      `failure_diagnostic.*` text field (case-insensitive after
      Unicode NFC) for any AttendingOverridePattern from §2.6. Any
      match forces `overall == "blocked"` and emits
      `attending-override-pattern-detected`
      (attending_override_denylist).

  - id: CIA-INV-15
    description: >
      Validators MUST recursively scan every string value in every
      ArtifactRow (including notes, held_remediation_hint,
      blocked_rationale, every failure_diagnostic, every materialized
      resource path, and every materialized id) for the literal
      `PCE-legacy` (case-insensitive after Unicode NFC). Any match
      forces `overall == "blocked"` and emits
      `pce-legacy-binding-detected` (pce_legacy_never_appears).
      `referenced_rule.bound_risk_engine_name` MUST equal `PREVENT`.

  - id: CIA-INV-16
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `methods_passed[]` and `methods_failed[]`
      MUST be derivable from the per-check `status` fields under the
      following mapping:
        - CC1 pass -> methods_passed contains `record-inv09-anchor-match`
        - CC2 pass -> methods_passed contains `atomic-unit-anchor-match`,
                                              `verbatim-roundtrip`
        - CC3 pass -> methods_passed contains `recbox-cell-shape-match`,
                                              `recbox-cor-cell-equals-rule-cor`,
                                              `recbox-loe-cell-equals-rule-loe`,
                                              `recbox-recommendation-cell-equals-source-text`
        - CC4 pass -> methods_passed contains `rxnorm-resolution-non-empty`,
                                              `rxnorm-subset-sha-match-upstream-p10`,
                                              `rxnorm-subset-sha-match-rule-recorded`
        - pregnancy_reinforcement.status == pass
                  -> methods_passed contains `pregnancy-reinforcement-pass`
        - pce_legacy_scan.status == pass
                  -> methods_passed contains `pce-legacy-literal-scan-clean`
        - materialized.fhir_r5_profile_validation_status == pass
                  -> methods_passed contains `fhir-r5-profile-validation-pass`
      methods_failed[] MUST list the corresponding methods for failed
      checks. Validators MUST recompute and compare.

  - id: CIA-INV-17
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `materialized.evidence_id` MUST equal
      `ev-cont-<rule_id>` AND `materialized.evidence_variable_id` MUST
      equal `ev-<rule_id>` (deterministic_id_derivation).
      `materialized.evidence_resource_sha256` and
      `materialized.evidence_variable_resource_sha256` MUST recompute
      byte-for-byte under FHIR R5 JCS canonicalization at validation
      time (fhir_r5_profile_compliance). Mismatch is a release
      blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-18
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `materialized.fhir_r5_profile_pin` MUST
      equal `build.fhir_r5_profile_pin`. Profile drift between
      packaging and validation is a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-19
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `materialized.fhir_r5_profile_validation_status`
      MUST be `pass` for `overall == "pass"`. `fail` or `not-run`
      forces `overall != "pass"` and routes the row to held with
      `fhir-profile-validation-failed`.

  - id: CIA-INV-20
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `fixity.row_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of
      the JCS-canonical form of the row with `fixity` excluded.
      Validators recompute and compare; mismatch is a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-21
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's `state` MUST be consistent with `overall`:
        - state == "pending" implies overall is recorded but row is
          not yet finalized (transient; not permitted in sealed
          artifacts).
        - state == "pass" iff overall == "pass".
        - state == "held" iff overall == "held".
        - state == "blocked" iff overall == "blocked".
        - state ∈ {"superseded", "withdrawn"} are historical states.

  - id: CIA-INV-22
    description: >
      For state == "sealed":
        - Every row's state MUST be `pass`, `held`, `blocked`, or
          `superseded` (NEVER `pending`).
        - `fixity.cross_check_sha256` MUST equal SHA-256 of the
          JCS-canonical form of the document with `fixity` excluded
          (artifact_canonicalization).
        - `audit_log[]` MUST contain a `cross-check-artifact-built`
          event AND a `cross-check-artifact-verified` event.

  - id: CIA-INV-23
    description: >
      For state == "draft":
        - Rows MAY be in `pending`, `pass`, `held`, or `blocked`
          state.
        - Validators MUST refuse to transition to `sealed` while any
          row is in `pending`.

  - id: CIA-INV-24
    description: >
      `audit_log[]` MUST be append-only and ordered by `occurred_at`.
      Validators compute the chained hash of events; out-of-order or
      missing events indicate tampering and are release blockers
      (audit_log_append_only).

  - id: CIA-INV-25
    description: >
      `predecessor_artifact_sha256` MUST be set whenever this
      artifact supersedes a prior one. The predecessor's recorded
      state (in `predecessor_artifact_state`) MUST be `superseded` or
      `withdrawn`. Cycles in the predecessor chain are a release
      blocker (superseded_artifacts).

  - id: CIA-INV-26
    description: >
      Once any `materialized.evidence_id` is referenced by a
      Gate-2-finalized Library (recorded in the Library's Gate-2
      register entry as a citation), the corresponding ArtifactRow
      becomes immutable; mutation of the row's content or fixity is
      a release blocker (post_gate_2_reference_immutability).
      Validators MUST cross-resolve the Gate-2 register at validation
      time and refuse mutations.

  - id: CIA-INV-27
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow whose `overall == "blocked"` MUST cite
      `blocked_routing.concern_category` from the closed
      PanelChairConcernCategory set in §2.10
      (conflict_routing_to_panel_chair). Validators MUST refuse
      blocked rows that omit the category or that route to any path
      other than `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`.

  - id: CIA-INV-28
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow whose `overall == "held"` MUST cite
      `held_routing.queue_path` and `held_routing.queue_entry_sha256`
      AND the queue entry MUST exist on disk and validate against the
      `parse-reconcile-queue` schema. Validators MUST resolve and
      refuse rows whose held entries are missing.

  - id: CIA-INV-29
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's parent record's
      `pico_precheck.populations[]` MUST be compatible with the
      manifest's `intended_use.age_min_inclusive == 18`
      (age_gate_eq_18). Pediatric populations are out of scope and a
      release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-30
    description: >
      `build.manifest_payload_sha256` MUST equal the active
      manifest's `fixity.manifest_sha256` at packaging time.
      Manifest drift between packaging and validation is a release
      blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-31
    description: >
      `build.pharm_rule_set_sha256` MUST equal the active
      `pharm-rules.json`'s `fixity.rule_set_sha256` at packaging
      time, AND the rule set MUST be in `state == "sealed"`. Drift
      or non-sealed state is a release blocker.

  - id: CIA-INV-32
    description: >
      Every ArtifactRow's
      `cross_check_4_rxnorm_subset.rxnorm_edition_pin` MUST equal
      `build.rxnorm_edition_pin` AND
      `referenced_rule.rxnorm_edition_pin`. Mismatch BLOCKs.

  - id: CIA-INV-33
    description: >
      `build.fhir_r5_profile_pin` MUST equal the manifest's pinned
      FHIR R5 profile id at packaging time
      (fhir_r5_profile_compliance). Drift is a release blocker.

`schemas/contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml` is now closed and self-consistent. The file mirrors the parent repo's schema discipline established by `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, `gate3-attestation.yaml`, `safety-case-htn.yaml`, `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml`, and `pharm-rule-htn.yaml`:

- §1 policy: sixteen normative clauses including `closed_cross_check_kind_set` (closed at four mandatory checks plus pregnancy reinforcement plus PCE-legacy scan), `rule_scope_is_denylist_advanced` (referenced rule MUST be `kind == "denylist"` AND `agreement.state == "agreed"`), `pregnancy_denylist_categorical_rejection` (mirrors `PR-INV-21` at the artifact layer), `pregnancy_denylist_reinforcement_block` (eight-item constraint set a..h), `attending_override_denylist` (closed pattern denylist scanned recursively over `notes`, `held_remediation_hint`, `failure_diagnostic.*`, and `blocked_rationale`), `pce_legacy_never_appears`, `inheritance_from_parent_rule`, `age_gate_eq_18`, `rxnorm_pin_alignment_and_drift_detection` (three-way SHA equality between live terminology server, upstream P10 binding, and rule-recorded resolution), `fhir_r5_profile_compliance`, `deterministic_id_derivation` (`Evidence.id == ev-cont-<rule_id>`, `EvidenceVariable.id == ev-<rule_id>`), `artifact_canonicalization`, `audit_log_append_only`, `post_gate_2_reference_immutability`, `superseded_artifacts`, `conflict_routing_to_panel_chair`.

- §2 closed enums: `CrossCheckKind` (six values), `CrossCheckStatus` (with `not-applicable` permitted only on `pregnancy-reinforcement`), `OverallStatus`, `PharmRuleKind` (mirrored), `AnchorKind` (mirrored), the closed `AttendingOverridePattern` denylist (mirrored verbatim from `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml` §2.5 and `pharm-rule-htn.yaml` §2.7, with 22 patterns), the closed `AuditEventKind` (mirrored from `extract-contraindications` SKILL §6.1, with 24 events), `AccAhaCOR`, `AccAhaLOE`, `PopulationFilter`, the closed `PanelChairConcernCategory` (mirrored from `extract-recommendation-cor-loe` §8.2, with 8 categories), `ArtifactRowState`, `ArtifactState`, and `VerificationMethod` (15 methods covering every check across the four mandatory cross-checks plus pregnancy reinforcement, PCE-legacy scan, FHIR profile validation, and canonical SHA match).

- §3 structured types: `ReferencedRule` (read-only inheritance shape for the rule fields needed at the artifact layer), `FailureDiagnostic` (with side-by-side llm/record/rule/atomic-unit/recbox-cell/upstream-p10/live-terminology values for diff visibility), the four `CrossCheck*` shapes (each with closed status + per-check evidence + optional `failure_diagnostic`), `PregnancyReinforcement` (with eight boolean flags + `applicability` discriminator, gating the not-applicable case), `PceLegacyScan` (recursive scan over an enumerated `fields_scanned[]`), `MaterializedResources` (FHIR R5 Evidence + EvidenceVariable resource paths and SHAs with deterministic id derivation), `HeldRouting` (queue path + two-person-rule status + remediation hint), `BlockedRouting` (panel-chair route with closed concern category and paused-downstream-phases enumeration), and `ArtifactRow` (the per-rule cross-check decision row with required cross-check entries, exclusive `materialized` / `held_routing` / `blocked_routing` per overall status, deterministic per-row fixity).

- §4 root: `ContraindicationArtifactHTN` with deterministic `artifact_id` derivation from input SHAs, `build` block pinning every input by SHA (records, atomic units, SAIR, pharm-rule set, terminology bindings, Gate-1 registers, RxNorm edition, FHIR R5 profile, and pregnancy value-set id), `rows[]: minItems 0` (the artifact may legitimately be empty if no denylist rules exist in scope), `state` lifecycle, append-only `audit_log[]`, deterministic `fixity.cross_check_sha256` (RFC 8785 with `fixity` excluded), `predecessor_artifact_*` chain.

- §5 thirty-three cross-field invariants `CIA-INV-01`…`CIA-INV-33`:
  - `CIA-INV-01`: deterministic `row_id` derivation.
  - `CIA-INV-02`: rule scope is denylist (mirrors `rule_scope_is_denylist_advanced`).
  - `CIA-INV-03`: inheritance from `referenced_rule`.
  - `CIA-INV-04`: closed cross-check kind set membership.
  - `CIA-INV-05`: per-check status semantics (`not-applicable` only on pregnancy reinforcement).
  - `CIA-INV-06`: deterministic `overall` derivation from per-check status — recomputed at validation time and compared.
  - `CIA-INV-07`: exclusive `materialized` / `held_routing` / `blocked_routing` per overall status.
  - `CIA-INV-08`: cross-check 1 anchor consistency between rule, record `INV-09`, and the closed denylist anchor set.
  - `CIA-INV-09`: categorical rejection of held-state denylist rules (with explicit pregnancy denylist reinforcement and the `pregnancy-denylist-held-rule-rejected` audit event).
  - `CIA-INV-10`: cross-check 2 anchor + verbatim round-trip integrity.
  - `CIA-INV-11`: cross-check 3 recbox cell shape + COR/LOE/recommendation cell equality.
  - `CIA-INV-12`: cross-check 4 RxNorm three-way SHA equality + non-empty subset + edition pin alignment across rule, build, and check.
  - `CIA-INV-13`: pregnancy denylist reinforcement (mirrors the policy clause's a..h items).
  - `CIA-INV-14`: recursive AttendingOverridePattern scan with automatic `overall = "blocked"` on match.
  - `CIA-INV-15`: recursive PCE-legacy literal scan with automatic `overall = "blocked"` on match plus PREVENT-only enforcement on `bound_risk_engine_name`.
  - `CIA-INV-16`: deterministic `methods_passed[]` / `methods_failed[]` derivation from per-check status under the explicit mapping table.
  - `CIA-INV-17`: deterministic resource id derivation (`ev-cont-<rule_id>`, `ev-<rule_id>`) and resource-SHA recompute under FHIR R5 JCS canonicalization.
  - `CIA-INV-18`: FHIR R5 profile pin alignment between artifact and build.
  - `CIA-INV-19`: FHIR R5 profile validation status pass for `overall == "pass"`.
  - `CIA-INV-20`: per-row deterministic fixity.
  - `CIA-INV-21`: row state consistency with overall status.
  - `CIA-INV-22`: sealed-state preconditions (no pending rows; deterministic artifact-level fixity; audit log contains both `cross-check-artifact-built` and `cross-check-artifact-verified` events).
  - `CIA-INV-23`: draft-state preconditions (no transition to sealed while any row is pending).
  - `CIA-INV-24`: append-only audit log with chained-hash continuity verification.
  - `CIA-INV-25`: predecessor chain monotonicity.
  - `CIA-INV-26`: post-Gate-2-reference immutability via cross-resolved Gate-2 register at validation time.
  - `CIA-INV-27`: blocked rows MUST cite a closed `PanelChairConcernCategory` and route only to `gate1-sme-review --mode chair-finalize`.
  - `CIA-INV-28`: held rows MUST have a queue entry on disk that validates against the `parse-reconcile-queue` schema.
  - `CIA-INV-29`: age gate ≥ 18 on parent record's PICO.
  - `CIA-INV-30`: manifest-payload SHA alignment between artifact build pin and active manifest fixity.
  - `CIA-INV-31`: pharm-rule-set SHA alignment plus `state == "sealed"` on the upstream pharm-rule set.
  - `CIA-INV-32`: RxNorm edition pin alignment three-way (artifact-row, rule, build).
  - `CIA-INV-33`: FHIR R5 profile pin alignment between artifact build and active manifest.

- Two examples (a `pass`-state pregnancy denylist artifact-row and a `sealed`-state artifact covering a `pass` pregnancy denylist row, a `held` non-pregnancy denylist row with a recbox cell mismatch (CC3 fail with explicit failure_diagnostic), and a `blocked` pregnancy denylist row triggered by an AttendingOverridePattern free-text match) using the consistent `HUMAN_FILL` token convention. The blocked pregnancy denylist row in 6.2 is illustrative — in production this would normally be caught earlier at P13 by `PR-INV-16`, but the schema records the shape for the rare case where a P13-passing rule's downstream materialization context contains a leaked pattern at P14.

- §7 change control requiring both panel-chair signoff and medical-director acknowledgement, listing the eleven parent schemas and thirteen parent skills to update on breaking changes, and explicitly tying every policy clause to ADR-HTN-001 amendments under D2/D3/D5/D8/D9/D10/D11/D14/D15.

The framework's signature surface is now closed and self-consistent across **eleven schemas**: `acc-aha-grading.yaml`, `sair.yaml`, `recommendation-record-htn.yaml`, `atomic-unit.yaml`, `gate1-register.yaml`, `gate2-register.yaml`, `gate3-attestation.yaml`, `safety-case-htn.yaml`, `cds-hooks-services-htn.yaml`, `pharm-rule-htn.yaml`, and now `contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml`. The Gate-3 evidence chain is fully covered from raw recbox parse (P6) through atomic-unit decomposition (P9), pharm-rule extraction (P13), contraindication cross-check (P14), and downstream IG composition (P26) by mechanically-verifiable contracts.

If you want the next concrete step at the same fidelity (one at a time):

1. `extract-monitoring` `SKILL.md` (P15) — the cross-check skill that consumes `pharm-rules.json`'s monitoring subset, applies a parallel quadruple cross-check, and materializes FHIR R5 `PlanDefinition.action` (or `Task` / `ServiceRequest`) resources for the IG.
2. `bind-risk-engine` `SKILL.md` (P16) — the PREVENT-canonical risk-engine binding skill that consumes `pharm-rules.json`'s `first-line-selection` rules where risk thresholds gate selection, with the closed PREVENT canonical binding contract and the PCE-legacy categorical exclusion.
3. `schemas/monitoring-artifact-htn.yaml` — the formal monitoring artifact schema, drafted at the same fidelity as `contraindication-artifact-htn.yaml`, with the closed monitoring-event-kind enum and the same quadruple-cross-check shape.
4. `phi-scrub` `SKILL.md` — the PHI scrub skill (`phi` member of the Gate-3 bundle), fail-closed at zero hits with no override.
5. `copyright-quote-check-acc-aha` `SKILL.md` — the `cpr` member of the Gate-3 bundle, with publisher-contract-window awareness and figures/tables-quotable gating.
